title: Mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔla [Developer] ƒe Nuɖeɖewo
description: Nuɖeɖe siwo wò hia be nàtsɔ atu Zcash dzi la, woƒo ƒu ɖe nu si wòwɔ sia me ta, eye womete ɖe wo nɔewo ƒe dzi o.
text: Mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔla [Developer] ƒe Nuɖeɖewo Nuɖeɖe siwo wò hia be nàtsɔ atu Zcash dzi la, woƒo ƒu ɖe nu si wòwɔ sia me ta, eye womete ɖe wo nɔewo ƒe dzi o. Nuwo ƒe ɖoɖo trɔ keŋkeŋ le 2026 me. zcashd, si nɔ ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ [node] la neti ƒe akpa gã te ŋutɔ ƒe eƒe ŋkekeawo katã, va se eƒe agbe ƒe nuwuwu 18 July 2026 le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe [block] ƒe kɔkɔme 3417100, eye ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ siwo me wotrɔ naneke o la katã tu le kɔkɔme ma, eye woagbe be woagatrɔ aɖe o. Fiafiɖewo siwo woŋlɔ na zcashd nye xoxoŋutinya fifia eye menye gɔmedzedze teƒe o, eyata woɖo axa sia ɖe nu si wɔ ɖe eteƒe la ŋu. Nuwo ƒe ɖoɖo le kpɔm kpuie Akpa Nu si nàtsɔ Dze egɔme kple :-- :-- :-- Ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo [Full node] Zebra alo Zakura The Zebra Book, zakura.com Ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo ƒe gakotoku [wallet] Zallet, le beta me The Zallet Book Gakotoku ƒe nyatakaka si hiã ƒe mɔ [Light wallet server] Zaino alo lightwalletd Zaino, lightwalletd Gakotoku ƒe librarywo librustzcash crates librustzcash Mobile Android kple iOS SDKs Android, iOS Ŋlɔɖi Protocol ƒe ŋlɔɖi kple ZIPs zips.z.cash Ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔwo Ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ aɖe doa ɖase ɖe gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi [consensus] ŋu eye wòlé ɖoɖonu [chain] la. Dɔwɔwɔ siwo woɖe ɖe ŋgɔ nyuie le fifia koe li eve. Zebra nye Zcash Foundation ƒe ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ, woŋlɔe kple Rust, eye enye esi fiafiɖe geɖe bua be wòle. The Zebra Book ƒo nu tso ale si nàɖoe eye nàwɔ dɔ kplee ŋu, eye repository nye afi si wole mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔla dɔ wɔm. Zakura nye ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ [node] yeye, si eŋlɔlawo ɖe eme be enye "gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi [consensus]-si wɔa ɖeka kple Zcash ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo [full node], si woɖo na wòate ŋu akpɔ nu geɖe", eye wòƒe sync le tsɔtsɔm kabakaba, gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe [block] ƒe tata kple zcashd ƒe mode si wɔa ɖeka. Sean Bowe, Zcash ƒe hadɔwɔtɔ gã ɖeka, kple Dev Ojha kplɔe. Enye dɔ si ŋutɔ ame sia ame ate ŋu awɔ le Apache 2.0 te le zakura-core/zakura. ZecHub ƒe Full Nodes axa la ƒo nu tso vɔsametɔwo siwo le wo dome ŋu. Ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo ƒe gakotoku zcashd tsɔ gakotoku ɖeka de ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ la kple. Gakotoku ma va bu, eye Zallet nye esi wɔ ɖe eteƒe. Zallet Book la gblɔ be enye "ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo ƒe Zcash gakotoku si woŋlɔ kple Rust" si "wom le wɔm be wòanye zcashd gakotoku ƒe nɔƒe". Xlẽ dedie le dedienɔnɔ ƒe nukpɔkpɔ la hafi nàɖo ŋutɔ ɖe eŋu. Zallet le beta me, "womemekpɔe blibo o", trɔtrɔ siwo gbãa nu "ate ŋu ava ɣeyiɣi sia ɣeyiɣi, eye woaɖe wò be nàtutu eye nàwɔ Zallet gakotoku la ake", eye wometsɔ zcashd RPC ƒe mɔwo katã va o haɖe. Ne èle ɖoɖo xoxo aɖe trɔm la, ZecHub ƒe trɔm ƒe fiafiɖe tso zcashd yi Zebra kple Zallet, kple Zallet nubabla ƒe kpuieŋlɔ. Gakotoku ƒe nyatakaka si hiã ƒe mɔwo Gakotoku geɖe menoa ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ aɖe o. Wodoa gbe na server aɖe si lé ɖoɖonu la eye wòtrɔa eƒe kpɔkpɔ sue aɖe na wo. lightwalletd nye subɔsubɔ gãtɔ, woŋlɔe kple Go, eye womɔe be enye "megbe ƒe subɔsubɔ si naa mɔ si mesia bandwidth geɖe o be woatsɔ ado gbe na Zcash blockchain". Zaino nye indexer yeye, woŋlɔe kple Rust, eye woxlea nu tso validator blibo aɖe me ɖe teƒe be wòatsɔ eya ŋutɔ ƒe ɖoɖonu ƒe kɔpi. Light Client Protocol ƒe agbalẽwo ƒo nu tso protocol la ŋutɔ ŋu. Lightwallet Nodes axa la ƒo nu tso nu si server siawo ate ŋu akpɔ kple nu si womate ŋu akpɔ tso zãla aɖe ŋu, si wòle be nàse egɔme hafi nàtia ɖeka. Gakotoku tutu Gakotoku ƒe dɔ geɖe wɔna le Rust crates siwo le librustzcash te, siwo mobile SDKs kple desktop gakotoku geɖe tutu ɖo. Woŋlɔ crate ɖeka sia ɖeka ƒe agbalẽ le docs.rs. Krate Esi wozanae na :-- :-- zcashclientbackend "APIwo siwo nana be woawɔ ɣaɣla [shielded] Zcash nyatakaka si hiã ƒe mɔ [light client]wo", eye wòtsɔ ɖoɖo ɖe eŋu kple gaɖoɖo [transaction] wɔwɔ ɖe eme zcashclientsqlite "Zcash nyatakaka si hiã ƒe mɔ si SQLite tu wɔ", si nye dzesiwo ƒe nɔƒe ƒe akpa na esi le etame zcashkeys "Zcash kɔkɔe kple gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi [address] dzi kpɔkpɔ" zcashprimitives "Rust ƒe Zcash gɔmedzedze ƒe wɔwɔwo" zcashprotocol "Zcash protocol ƒe network constants kple asixɔxɔ ƒomeviwo" orchard "Orchard ƒe ɣaɣla gaɖoɖo protocol" s

title: Zcash ƒe Ŋgɔyiyi Gadzraɖoƒe
description: Dɔwɔƒe aɖeke mele Zcash tɔ o. Ke hã ele be ame aɖe naxe fe na gakotokuwo (wallets), ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ (node) ƒe kɔmpiutadɔwɔnuwo, numekuku kple nufiafia. Le…
text: Zcash ƒe Ŋgɔyiyi Gadzraɖoƒe Kpuie ko (TL;DR) Zcash xea fe na eƒe ŋutɔ ƒe ŋgɔyiyi tso gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe fetuwo me, eya ta eƒe tulawo mekpɔa ŋu ɖe gadolala siwo tso gotagome la ŋu o Egbea la, gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe fetu ɖesiaɖe ƒe 8% yina na Zcash Community Grants, eye 12% yina na gadzraɖoƒe si ga tɔwo (coin holders) kpɔa dzi. Nukulawo (miners) xɔa susɔea Gakpekpeɖeŋu sia trɔ le fetu ƒe afãmama (halving) ɖesiaɖe me: gɔmeɖolawo ƒe fetu (founders' reward) le gɔmedzedzea me, Ŋgɔyiyi Gadzraɖoƒe (Development Fund) tso 2020, gadaka si wotu (lockbox) tso 2024, eye ga tɔwo ƒe dzikpɔkpɔ tso November 2025 Ga tɔwo daa akɔ tso ale si woazã 12% gadzraɖoƒea ŋu. Zcash Community Grants ŋutɔ tsoa nya me le eƒe ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋuwo (grants) ŋu Èdi gakpekpeɖeŋua? Bia tso Zcash Community Grants si na dɔ yeye, alo tso ga tɔwo ƒe ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu siwo wona ɖe dɔ siwo wowu enu xoxo ta (retroactive grants) si na dɔ si nèwɔ xoxo Ame kawo ŋuti wòle Zcash zãla yeye siwo di be yewoanya ame si xea fe na Zcash Tulawo, ŋlɔlawo kple gɔmeɖeɖelawo siwo le gakpekpeɖeŋu dim Ga tɔ siwo di be yewoase nusi ŋu yewodaa akɔ le gɔme Nusita esia le vevie Dɔwɔƒe aɖeke mele Zcash tɔ o. Ke hã ele be ame aɖe naxe fe na gakotokuwo (wallets), ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ (node) ƒe kɔmpiutadɔwɔnuwo, numekuku kple nufiafia. Le esi teƒe be Zcash naƒo ga tso gadolalawo gbɔ la, eɖea gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe fetu yeye ɖesiaɖe ƒe akpa aɖe ɖe vovo na ŋgɔyiyi. Esia nana ame siwo le Zcash tum la ƒe susu nɔa eƒe zãlawo kple eƒe ɣaɣla (privacy) ƒe taɖodzinu dzi. Ale si wòtrɔ Ɣeyiɣi Nusi dzɔ Ale si womaa gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe fetu ɖesiaɖe --- --- --- 2016 va ɖo 2020 Gɔmeɖolawo ƒe fetu. Wòxe fe na Zcash ƒe gɔmeɖolawo, gadola gbãtɔwo, dɔwɔlawo kple Zcash Foundation, va se ɖe fetu ƒe afãmama gbãtɔ 20% na gɔmeɖolawo ƒe fetu Nov 2020 va ɖo Nov 2024 Ŋgɔyiyi Gadzraɖoƒe, si Canopy wɔ (ZIP 1014) 7% Electric Coin Company, 5% Zcash Foundation, 8% Ga ƒe Kpekpeɖeŋu Gãwo (emegbe Zcash Community Grants) Nov 2024 va ɖo Nov 2025 Gadaka si wotu, si NU6 wɔ (ZIP 1015) 8% Zcash Community Grants, 12% yi Ŋgɔyiyi Gadzraɖoƒe si Wotsɔ Ðo Ðe Megbe ƒe Gadaka si Wotu me, eye wodzra ɖo va se ɖe esime nutoa me tɔwo tso nya me le ale si woazãe ŋu Nov 2025 va ɖo fifia Ga tɔwo ƒe dzikpɔkpɔ, si NU6.1 ɖo anyi (ZIP 1016) 8% Zcash Community Grants, 12% na Gadzraɖoƒe si Ga Tɔwo Kpɔa Dzi, si wodze egɔme kple gadaka si wotu me ga Le ɣeyiɣi ɖesiaɖe me la, nukulawo xɔa 80% susɔea. Ale si wòwɔa dɔe egbea Tso esime NU6.1 dze dɔwɔwɔ gɔme le November 24, 2025 dzi la, gakpekpeɖeŋu ƒe mɔ eve doa go tso gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe fetu ɖesiaɖe me: 8% na Zcash Community Grants (ZCG). Dziɖuha aɖe si le ɖokuisi naa ga na dɔ yeye le Zcash ƒe ƒuƒoƒo me: gakotokuwo, dɔwɔnuwo (tools), numekuku, nufiafia kple kpekpewo. 12% na Gadzraɖoƒe si Ga Tɔwo Kpɔa Dzi. Edze egɔme kple ga siwo wodzra ɖo ɖe gadaka si wotu me. Ga tɔwo daa akɔ tso alesi be woaxe ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋuwo tso eme alo woagblee wòanɔ anyi. Safuitɔ Habɔbɔwo (Key-Holder Organizations) lé gaa ɖe asi, eye se bla wo be woazãe ɖe ale si ga tɔwo tso nya me ko nu (ZIP 1016). Ɖoɖo sia anɔ dɔ wɔm va se ɖe Zcash ƒe fetu ƒe afãmama etɔ̃lia. ZIP 1016 ɖe mɔ be ŋkekea ate ŋu atrɔ, elabena NU7 trɔa gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe ɣeyiɣiɖoɖo. Emegbe nutoa me tɔwo atso nya me be yewoalé ɖe eŋu, atrɔe alo awu enu. Ame si tsoa nya me Zcash Community Grants dzraa biabiawo me kpɔna eye wodaa akɔ le ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu ɖesiaɖe ŋu. Ga tɔwo tsɔa woƒe ZEC daa akɔ le 12% gadzraɖoƒea ƒe susuɖoɖowo ŋu. Womebua woƒe gawo ɖe ga me hafi daa akɔ o. Tɔtrɔ le gakpekpeɖeŋua ŋutɔ me hiã ZIP yeye kple mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ (network upgrade), le nutoa me tɔwo ƒe nyaƒoƒo le Zcash Nutoa me tɔwo ƒe Nyaƒoƒoƒe megbe. Be nàkpɔ nuwo katã ƒe nɔnɔme la, kpɔ Zcash ƒe Dziɖuɖu kple Ale si wowɔ ɖoɖo ɖe Zcash ŋu. Ale si nàxɔ gakpekpeɖeŋu Dɔ yeye si nèdi be yeawɔ: bia tso Zcash Community Grants gbɔ. Dɔ si nèwu enu xoxo: bia tso Ga Tɔwo ƒe Ga ƒe Kpekpeɖeŋu siwo Wona ɖe Dɔ si Wowɔ Xoxo Ta gbɔ, siwo wowɔna le ɣleti etɔ̃ ɖesiaɖe me. Kpekpeɖeŋu suewo na wiki sia: ZecHub naa nunana kpekpeɖeŋunalawo l

title: Ale si Zcash wɔa ɖoɖo le
description: Ɖoɖo la ƒe gɔmesese wɔa nu bubuawo katã bɔbɔe. Efia wò ame si wɔnɔa code si wòtsɔa wɔ dɔ dzi, ame si nàte ŋu ayi gbɔ be nàbia ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu [grant], kple…
text: Ale si Zcash wɔa ɖoɖo le TL;DR Ƒomevi ɖeka menye wɔ Zcash o, ke boŋ hame siwo nye ɖe ɖe le wɔe, eye wòwɔ ɖe sia ɖe ƒe akpa wɔn Eƒe ŋutinya ƒe akpa gã me la, hame eve kplɔ ŋgɔ le mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖo me: Electric Coin Company kple Zcash Foundation Le 2026 ƒe dzove me la, Electric Coin Company ƒe ƒuƒo blibo la dze ɖe edzi le dziɖuɖu [governance] ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu ta, eye nutome la woɖo ɖe ƒuƒo siwo le ɖe ɖe me Egbe la, ƒuƒoawo vovovo wɔn protocol, ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ [node] ƒe software, gakotoku [wallet], nunyala ƒe dɔ, nu ƒe dziyiyi [scaling], kple ga ƒe nana Hame aɖeke mekpɔa Zcash ɖekaɖeka o, network la nye open source eye zãzã faa [permissionless], eye wòyi edzi wɔa dɔ nyuie le trɔtrɔ siawo katã me Ame kae wònye na Ame yeye siwo di be yewoase ame siwo wɔa eye wɔnɔa Zcash dzi gɔme Ame sia ame si tɔtɔe le hame ƒe ŋkɔ geɖe siwo le nutome la me ta Ame siwo do kpɔ ɖe dɔwɔwɔ ŋu alo le afɔfɔ ɖe afia aɖe ŋu be woawɔ dɔ kplii alo woaɖo ɖoɖo aɖe ɖa Nu ka ta esia le vevie Ɖoɖo la ƒe gɔmesese wɔa nu bubuawo katã bɔbɔe. Efia wò ame si wɔnɔa code si wòtsɔa wɔ dɔ dzi, ame si nàte ŋu ayi gbɔ be nàbia ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu [grant], kple ame si wɔ akpa si le network la me si nèle dzidzɔe ŋu. Eɖea Zcash ƒe ŋusẽ si menoa tsi o aɖe hia: elabena wo ma dɔ la ɖe ƒuƒo siwo le ɖe ɖe dome, dɔƒe ɖeka si ŋu nu katã dze mɔ o ate ŋu akpɔ project la ɖeka alo akpɔe ɖe te. Axa sia nye anyigbatata. Na hame sia hame si katã exɔ axa blibo le wiki sia dzi la, àkpɔ dzesi kpui aɖe kple link be nàxlẽ nu geɖe, le nu si woŋlɔ xoxo le afi ma ƒe gbugbɔɖi ƒe nɔnɔ teƒe. Ale si wònɔna tsã Le Zcash ƒe ŋutinya ƒe akpa gã me la, hame eve kplɔ mɔ la ŋgɔ. Electric Coin Company wɔ Zcash le 2016 me eye wòɖo core development ƒe ƒuƒo la ƒe amewo geɖe dɔ. Bootstrap, nonprofit ƒe board si wowɔ be wòakpe ɖe Zcash ŋu, kpɔe dzi. Zcash Foundation wɔ dɔ kplii abe nonprofit si le ɖe eɖokui ŋu ene, eye wòtsɔ eɖokui de protocol la ƒe dzikpɔkpɔ kple ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ si le ɖe eɖokui ŋu ƒe tutu me. Woɖea ga na wo evea zi geɖe tso gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe [block] ƒe fetu ƒe akpa si woda ɖi na mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖo ta me. Pillar eve sia ƒe ɖoɖo la li hena ƒe geɖe, gake wòde asi le gaƒe mama sia kple hame eveawo ƒe nɔnɔ ɖekae. Esi mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖo ƒe ga si nègbɔna la trɔ eye eƒe ŋkeke didi ƒe future mekpɔa edzi o la, nusiatsɔ awɔ ga na dɔ si le edzi yina la zu kuxi si va kpɔ ŋusẽ geɖe. Ga ƒe kuxi sia le nu geɖe si trɔ emegbe la ƒe megbe, eye wònye nusi ta ƒuƒo aɖewo ɖea asi le ga si tso afima va, esi bubuawo le ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu dzi. 2026 ƒe ɖoɖo yeye Le 2026 ƒe dzove me la, ɖoɖo la trɔ ŋutɔ. Le dzove ƒe ŋkeke 7 lia dzi la, Electric Coin Company ƒe chief executive, Josh Swihart, gblɔ le X dzi be company la ƒe ƒuƒo blibo la dze ɖe edzi. Bootstrap nye nonprofit si wowɔ le 2020 me be wòakplɔ Electric Coin Company dzi, si zu eƒe wholly owned subsidiary. Ƒomevi la kple board sia dome kpekpeɖeŋu la tso dzi ɖo dzi eye wòku ɖe nu vovovo aɖewo ŋu, abe hame la ƒe afi si wòle yi ge, ale si woaxɔ ga na mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖo, kple Zashi gakotoku la ƒe future ene; ƒuƒo la di be woatsɔe aɖe private company me be woate ŋu axɔ ga tso afima. Swihart ƒo nu tso dzoɖe la ŋu abe constructive discharge ene, si nye se ƒe nyagblɔɖi si fia be wotrɔ nɔnɔawo vevie ale gbegbe be dzoɖe zu nu si wɔm wòle vevie, eye wògblɔ be board la ƒe akpa gã la va le afi si menye ɖeka kple Zcash ƒe mission o. Nya la ƒe akpa bubu hia be nu nanɔ dzɔdzɔe. Bootstrap de kpekpeɖeŋu la fia abe dziɖuɖu kple nonprofit ƒe se ƒe wɔwɔ nyuie ƒe nya ene. Zcash ƒe founder, Zooko Wilcox, ɖe asi kpe board ƒe amewo siwo wɔ ŋkɔ le kpekpeɖeŋu la me ŋu le dutoƒo me, eye wògblɔ be ewo dɔ kplii hena ƒe geɖe eye wòkpɔ wo abe amewo siwo ƒe nɔnɔ nyo ŋutɔ ene, esi wòɖe eƒe nya me be menɔ akpa aɖeke dzi le kpekpeɖeŋu la me o. Nu eve li si mewɔ kpekpeɖeŋu o. Ƒomevi aɖeke meɖe nya be ame aɖe wɔ nu vɔ̃ si se bla o, eyata esia nye company kple dziɖuɖu ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu, menye se ƒe nya o. Eye Zcash network la ŋutɔ mekpɔ nɔnɔ aɖeke o; enɔ open source, zãzã faa, dedie, eye wòle dɔ wɔm blibo le ɣeyiɣi blibo la me, nya si Swihart kp

Ɖoɖowo ƒuƒopé [dashboard] aɖewo fia wo le ƒeƒe me ɣeyiɣi me, ke nye gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ma ke kple ɣeyiɣi ma ke. NU7 ƒe nɔnɔme NU7 le dɔ wɔm le Testnet si duto ate ŋu akpɔ la dzi le kɔkɔe 4,465,026 (wodze egɔme le October 4, 2026). Mainnet ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ƒe kɔkɔe nye 3,543,405 (ZIP 259), eye woɖo be woadze egɔme le November 5, 2026. Eƒe dɔƒe (ZIP 259): Sekondi 25 gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒewo (ZIP 218) — kpekpeɖeŋu gbãtɔ naa ɣeyiɣi kpui le teƒe 3; ZEC ƒe gaɖeɖe le ŋkeke sia ŋkeke me metrɔ o. Mɔ̃ ƒe Dziɖuɖu ƒe Mɔnu (ZIP 235 + ZIP 237) — woaɖe gaɖoɖo ƒe adzɔwo ƒe 60% le gaƒeƒu me vaɖo dzadzraƒe aɖe me, eye woagbugbɔa woade na nukulawo le ɣeyiɣi ƒe ɖoɖo si mekaka fetu ƒe afãmama o me, si adze egɔme le February 2031 ƒe ƒome. Sprout ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ƒe nudidi (ZIP 2003) — version 4 gaɖoɖowo meganye seawo nu o; ga siwo gaƒo le Sprout me la meganyo avu o. Ɣaɣla ƒe nudzɔdzɔwo ƒe seɖoƒe kple xexlẽ ƒe kuxi ƒe ɣeyiɣi ƒe abɔ gã wu (17 → 102 gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒewo). Womeɖoa gaɖoɖo ƒe nɔnɔme yeye aɖeke o. Gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi [consensus] ƒe alɔ̃fɔ ƒe dzesi: 0x77190ad9. Kpɔ ɣaɣla ƒe Nunyametsotso ƒe ɣeyiɣi ƒe mɔdzraɖoƒe kple ZIP 259 ne nèdi nyatakakawo katã. Forum ƒe ɣeyiɣi ƒe mɔdzraɖoƒe: NU7 Ɣeyiɣi ƒe Mɔdzraɖoƒe.

description: ZEC nye dzidzime ga si wotu ɖe Zcash gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu dzi. Eyae nye ga si sɔ keke na cash le internet dzi. Ne eɖo wɔnɔnu geɖe kple Bitcoin hã la, eɖɔ…
text: Zcash ƒe Gɔmedzedzeawo TL;DR ZEC nye dzidzime ga si wotu ɖe Zcash gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu [blockchain] dzi To vovo na Bitcoin, ZEC ƒe ŋuɖoɖo li be wòawɔ ɣaɣla [shielded] (ame ƒe eme) gaɖoɖo [transaction]wo bliboe kple zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛ [proof]wo Èle wò ga ƒe ɣaɣla [privacy] ƒe dziɖuɖu me: tia nu si nàfia, kple ame si nàfia na Zcash ƒe nɔnɔme nye dɔwɔwɔ ƒe aʋaʋa, zãzã faa [permissionless], eye wòe nye ha nuɖo agni [decentralized] --- Nu kae nye ZEC? --- ZEC nye dzidzime ga si wotu ɖe Zcash gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu dzi. Eyae nye ga si sɔ keke na cash le internet dzi. Ne eɖo wɔnɔnu geɖe kple Bitcoin hã la, eɖɔ Bitcoin ƒe kuxi gãtɔ ɖe ete be eɖe mɔ na ezalawo be woawɔ ga ƒe gaɖoɖowo le ame ƒe eme bliboe. Nu ka tae ame ƒe eme ga le vevie? ZEC ƒe mɔɖeɖe na amewo be woatsɔ nyatakakawo aɖo ɖe mɔ si zãzã faa. Ne peer-to-peer, zãzã faa ga ƒe ɖoɖo li la, ekpena ŋusẽ amewo be woaɖe asi le asixɔxɔ ŋu alo woawɔ gaɖoɖo kple amewo, le ha siwo ɖe asi le nuwo ŋu ƒe wɔnɔ ɖe aga. ZEC na amewo be woatia ɣeyiɣi si me woadze be woaɖe woƒe ga ƒe nyatakakawo fia amewo. Nudzɔdzɔwo Zcash Kple ɣaɣla ƒe ƒoɖoɖo ɣaɣla ƒe ƒomea Zcash ƒe ɣaɣla ƒe aɖaŋuwo Nu kae nye Zcash? Zcash nye "Zerocash" protocol ƒe wɔwɔ. Enye blockchain-dzi ƒe ledger si nye dɔwɔwɔ ƒe aʋaʋa, eye zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛɖeɖe ƒe ɖoɖo si me nu geɖe le. Wotu eƒe code ɖe Bitcoin ƒe code dzi, eye eƒe dɔ veviee nye be wòana ɣaɣla ƒe se si le dzi ɖe mɔ si eƒe ɖaseɖigbalɛɖeɖe ƒe ɖoɖo le gaɖoɖo ƒe metadata ƒe ame ƒe eme ƒomeɖeɖe ŋu. Le eƒe dzitsinya me la, Zcash nye ame ƒe eme nyatakaka ƒe nutome si wotsɔa ɖoa ɖe mɔ si zãzã faa ne woawɔ gaɖoɖo. Nu ka tae esɔ na mía? Zcash ɖɔ Bitcoin ƒe kuxi gãtɔ ɖe ete; nyatakaka ƒe ame ƒe eme nutome kple eƒe tsɔtsɔ. Le xexe si me blockchain ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo kple cryptocurrencywo le dzidzime vevie geɖe la, gaɖoɖowo siwo wɔnɔ abe ame si me womeka ŋkɔ na ene la megblɔ be woate ŋu aɖa ezala ƒe ɣaɣla o. Wozãa ŋkuɖodzinuwo geɖe be woakpɔ blockchain ƒe gaɖoɖowo ƒe nɔnɔme. Nudzɔdzɔwo Gɔmedzedzeawo Aleke Wòwɔa Dɔe --- Axɔsewo Siwo Kplɔe ɖo Yɔyɔ ƒe Mɔfiame — Mɔfiame ɖe afɔ me afɔ me na ZEC ƒe nutome tɔwo Gakotokuwo — Tia ɣaɣla gakotoku be nàtsɔ wò ZEC anɔ eme ZEC ƒe Ɛnu — Afisi kple ale si nàxɔ ZEC Ɣaɣla Gaƒuƒoƒowo — Aleke Zcash gaƒuƒoƒowo le gaɖoɖowo ɖea ame ƒe eme zk-SNARKs — Cryptography si le Zcash ƒe ɣaɣla megbe

text: Nu ka nye ZecHub? --- ZecHub nye ha nuɖo agni [decentralized] srɔ̃ƒe na Zcash ƒe nusrɔ̃. Míewɔ esia to mɔ aɖewo dzi. Nufiafiawo Wiki-dokumentewo Podcast si ƒoa nyamedzidzia kple habɔbɔa ƒe amewo. [Nyadzɔdzɔgbalẽ [newsletter] si doa le kwasiɖa sia kple kwasiɖa sia me Zcash.](https://zechub.substack.com/) Nufiafiawo, blog ŋkekeviwo, kple nyadzɔdzɔgbalẽ la nye open source, eye woɖoe ɖe GitHub dzi, si fia be habɔbɔa ƒe amesi ke hã ate ŋu akpe ɖe eŋu. Esia ana be nyawo nanɔ nyateƒe, eye be kana la ŋutɔ magblẽ o le nuɖoɖo ɖeka ƒe megbe o. Ne èye yeye le Zcash me la, zã mɔfia sia. Nu siwo katã le GitHub ƒe repository sia me mele be woabu be nye gaxɔxɔ alo gaɖoɖo ƒe aɖaŋu o - woɖoe ɖe afi ma be woatsɔ awɔ nyadziɖi ko. --- Ne èdi be yɔ nu aɖe kpe ɖe wiki axa sia ŋu alo nàfia tɔtrɔwo, taflatse yi ɖe ZecHub github repo dzi eye nàdo pull request.

text: Ame kae ate ŋu akpɔ wò Zcash Fexexe? TL;DR Zcash na wò gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ƒomevi eve: nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi [transparent] (t) kple ɣaɣla [shielded] (z alo u). Nu si amewo kpɔ le dodoa me la ɖe gaɖoƒe ƒomevi siwo dome wò fexexe lia la ŋu. ɣaɣla yi ɣaɣla fexexe koe ɣla dɔlila, xɔla, kple ga ƒe home. Ɣaɣla gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi menye safui ɖeka ko o. Eya nye safuiwo ƒe ƒuƒoƒo sue, eye nàte ŋu na ame aɖe nukpɔm ko ƒe mɔ ne nèle gazã ƒe ŋusẽ nam o. Ne nèma nukpɔsafui na ame aɖe vɔ la, mègale ŋu ate ŋu xɔe megbe o. --- Nu ɖeka si wòse egɔme gbã Le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu geɖewo dzi la, tiaɖe mele o. Nu sia nu si nèdo ɖa la nye dukɔme nu tegbee, tegbee na ame sia ame si le kpɔm. Zcash na wò tiaɖe le ema teƒe. Wòwɔ tiaɖe sia zi eve: zi ɖeka ne nètia gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi si nàdo ɖa na, eye zi ɖeka ne nèɖo ta ame kae anɔ safui si ate ŋu axle wò ɖeɖeƒome. Nɔnɔmetata si le ete la ƒo nu tso evea siaa ŋu. --- Tiaɖe gbã: gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ka Zcash fexexe sia fexexe lia le gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi eve dome, eye ɖeka sia ɖeka ate ŋu anye nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi alo ɣaɣla. Esia nana mɔ ene, eye ɖeka sia ɖeka ɖe nyatakaka ƒe akpa vovovo fia. Nuƒoƒo la bɔbɔe wu ale si wòbu ene: nu sia nu si de nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ŋu la zu dukɔme nu. Fexexe si nɔ ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo [pool] me le mɔ blibo la me la, meɖe nu bubu aɖeke fia o negbe adzɔ ko. Esia le vevie wu ne nèle ga xɔm tso gatrɔƒe me. Gatrɔƒe geɖewo doa ga ɖa na nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo ko, ale be gaɖeɖa la nye dukɔme nu. Ɣla ga la wò ŋutɔ enumake wòva ɖo, hafi nàzãe. Ne nàdi be nàkpɔ ale si dzadzraƒe xle nu le nyateƒe la me, kpɔ Nu si gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe dzadzraƒe ate ŋu akpɔ. --- Tiaɖe evelia: ame kae axɔ safui Ɣaɣla si nègate ŋu asi le gbe maɖe o la meɖe vi o. Ɣeaɖewo la, ele na wò be nàɖe nu aɖe fia na akɔntabula, kpekpeaɖela, alo tax ƒe dɔwɔƒe. Zcash wɔ esia ne wòmebia be nàɖe asi le ŋusẽ ƒe nudzɔdzɔ ŋu o. Gazazãsafui [Spending key]. Ekpɔ nu sia nu eye wòzãa ga. Eyae nye ga la. Enɔ kplii na wò, eye womama na ame aɖeke o, le ta aɖeke nu o. Full Viewing Key. Nukpɔm ko. Efia ga si ge ɖe eme kple ga si doa ɖa ƒe nudzɔdzɔwo kple balansewo, gake mate ŋu azã zatoshi ɖeka pɛ o. Esiae nàma na kpekpeaɖela alo akɔntabula. Incoming Viewing Key. Eme keke wu esia hã: efia fexexewo siwo va ɖo ko. Gatrɔƒe alo asitsɔla ate ŋu awɔ esia be wòaɖe kpe edzi be wò gaɖoɖo va ɖo, esi gazazãsafui la ganɔ hardware si mekpena internet ŋu o. Ɖoɖoɖo la le vevie. Na safui si me keke wu si wɔ dɔ la, menye si hã la si nèkpɔ le asiwò la o. --- Akpa si amesiaminɔwo mekpena o Womate ŋu aɖe nukpɔsafui ɖa o. "Matrɔ mama la megbe" ƒe dzesi aɖeke mele o. Ne ame aɖe xɔe vɔ la, ate ŋu axle gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ma le esi wònɔ anyi la blibo. Ne wòhia be nàtɔ mɔ na ame ma o la, nàtsɔ wò ga yi gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi yeye aɖe dzi. Adzɔwo nye dukɔme nu hã le ɣaɣla fexexe blibo me. Woɣla ga ƒe home la; womɣla adzɔ la o. Dukɔme nu nye tegbee. Nu sia nu si ɖoɖonu la fia egbe la, afia le ƒe 20 megbe hã. Ɖoɖo be nàɣla fexexe aɖe le wòdoe ɖa megbe la menye nu si nàte ŋu awɔ o. --- Wɔe le nɔnɔme me Zã gakotoku [wallet] si wɔa ɣaɣla le gɔmedzedze me, abe ZODL alo Zingo! ene. Hafi nàma nukpɔsafui, bia safui kae me keke wu si ɖo biabia si wobia la ŋu. --- Nuɖoɖowo Nukpɔsafuiwo ƒe nyagblɔɖe (Electric Coin Company) [Nyatakaka tɔxɛ ɣaɣla [selective disclosure] kple nukpɔsafuiwo (Electric Coin Company)](https://electriccoin.co/blog/viewing-keys-selective-disclosure/) ZIP 310: Nukpɔsafuiwo Ale si Zcash teknolojia wɔa dɔ Axewo si kpena eŋu Zcash ƒe gɔmedzedze nuwo Zcash ƒe mɔfia na zazãla yeye Nu si gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe dzadzraƒe ate ŋu akpɔ Nukpɔsafuiwo Gaɖoɖowo --- Ne wòdi be nàtsɔ nu kpe ɖe wiki axa sia ŋu alo nàɖo asaɖaɖa aɖe ɖa la, medekuku yi ZecHub GitHub repo eye nàɖo pull request aɖe ɖa.

text: Zcash Ƒe Gɔmedzedze ZEC Ƒe Zã nyawo [use case] Fexexewo [payment] Ameawo zã ZEC be woawɔ gaɖoɖo [transaction] le mɔ nyui kple dedie me, eye adzɔ [fee] sue koe woaxe. Ɣaɣla [shielded] Zcash na gaɖoɖowo nakpɔa ɣaɣla [privacy], eye wòna wo hã mɔ be woama gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi [address] kple gaɖoɖo ƒe nyawo ne woedi. Ŋutinya, "Z-Z" gaɖoɖowo doa le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu [blockchain] si le duma me, ale be woanya be wowɔe eye woxe adzɔwo. Ke hã, gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo, gaɖoɖo ƒe asime kple nya kpui [memo] ƒe afi la katã woɣlaŋlɔ [encryption] eye amewo mate ŋu akpɔ wo le duma me o. Nudzraƒe si ƒe Asime Le Anyi Ameawo ate ŋu azã ZEC hã be woaɖo nunɔamesiwo ɖe nudzraƒe sesẽ, si doa ɣaɣla ɖa, me. ZEC ƒe unit miliyoni 21 koe akpɔ gbeɖe, esia fia be nudzraƒe la ƒe asime le anyi. Ne woɖe ZEC ƒe milionitɔ 21 la le [nukuku [mining] me va dze mɔ me](https://z.cash/mining-zcash/) la, nudzraƒe la ava zu nusi tsia nu ƒe asiwo o. Nudzraƒe siwo tsia nu ƒe asiwo o nye agbalẽ nyui tsɔ ɖa ŋgɔ na asime ƒe dzidzi ne dzikpɔlawo katãwo tsia dukɔ ƒe ga ƒe asime. Nyaɖoɖo Ameawo ate ŋu azã nya kpui ƒe afi le ɣaɣla Z-Z gaɖoɖo me be woaɖo nyawo siwo woɣlaŋlɔ blibo. Be wòaɖo nya kpui, ele be zãlawo nawɔ gaɖoɖo eye woaxe gaɖoɖo ƒe adzɔ, si le $0.01 te. text: Zcash Gɔmedzedze Nu kae nye Zcash ƒe gaɖoɖo ƒe agbenɔnɔ? Zcash ƒe ga ƒe gɔmeɖoɖo sɔ kple Bitcoin ƒe ga ƒe akpa 21 million ZEC si wode ɖo. Le sekond 75 siaa megbe la, wɔa nukuku na yeye gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe le Zcash gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu me, eye gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe fetu 1.5625 ZEC va yɔ le ga ƒe mɔzɔzɔ me. Mema ƒe fetu sia wo maa na nukulawo kple Zcash ƒe ŋgɔyiyi gaƒoƒo. Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe fetu la ƒe hãhã maa va zu afã le ƒe ene sia ƒe abe, va se ɖe esi ZEC 21 million katã anɔ mɔzɔzɔ me. Zcash ƒe ga ƒe vɔvɔɖiɖi sɔ kplikpaa kple Bitcoin tɔ. Ele vevie be nàde dzesii be, esi wɔa ga yeyeawo la, ga ƒe vɔvɔɖiɖi ɖea dzi, eye le hãhã ɖesiaɖe me la, eƒe kadodo ɖea dzi ŋutɔ. text: Zcash Ɖeviwo Ɖevi geɖe li siwo kpena ɖe amedzrowo ŋu be woase Zcash gɔme. Zcash Media Zcash Media nye ɖeɖe ƒe habɔbɔ si ƒe nusrɔ̃lɛ ƒe video-dokumentriwo le Zcash ŋu. Woƒe video gbãtɔe, "Built to Fix Bitcoin's Fatal Flaw, What is Zcash (ZEC)?", nye ŋgɔdonya nyui na Zcash. X (tsã woyɔna be Twitter) Twitter nye kadodo ƒe teƒe vevi na Zcash ƒe hadome, eye wòanye nenema hã na cryptocurrency ƒe teƒe gã la. E nye teƒe nyui be nànya nu siwo katã le Zcash ŋu yim, eye nàte ŋu ade dzoku le hadome ƒe amedzro veviwo yome. Ɛnye dokument si xlɔ account siwo wòle be nàdze yome ƒe xexlẽme. Zcash Hadome Zcash Community nye hadome ƒe nudzraɖoƒe si hadome ŋutɔ kpɔna, eye wòfia hadome ƒe dɔwo siwo kpena ɖe Zcash ƒe ecosystem ŋu. E nye mɔ nyui be nànya Zcash ƒe hadome kple eƒe dɔ vovovowo abe ga ene. Zcash Ƒe Nyadzɔdzɔƒe Abe ale si woegblɔe le amedzro yeyewo ƒe mɔfiame la me ene, Zcash ƒe nyadzɔdzɔƒe nye teƒe nyui be woawɔ nyadzedze didi le Zcash ƒe nyawo kple susu siwo wometsɔ va la ŋu. Woɖena susu yeyewo katã ɖe nyadzɔdzɔƒe la dzi be hadome la nakpɔ mɔ na woƒe nyadzedze kple medeasi. Z.cash Z.cash nye Zcash ƒe website vevi. Etsɔ Zcash ƒe emenyawo kple dokumentwo na amedzro ƒe ƒomevi vovovo, eye ena mɔ amedzro yeyewo be woage ɖe Zcash ƒe teknikal gɔmeseseawo me wu. Zcash GitHub Ènya code ŋutɔ eye nèle didim be nàge ɖe Zcash ƒe teknikal akpa me wu oa? Zcash GitHub Repo nye repository na zcashd, si nye Zcash ƒe ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ [node] ƒe dɔwɔwɔ gbãtɔ. zcashd va ɖo eƒe kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe nuwuwu le 18 July 2026, eye womakpɔa eŋu o azɔ; download axa si nyawo sia tsɔna ƒe kadodo ɖo ɖe eme tsã la hã menoa dɔ o. Ɖoɖo si wokpɔna fifia enye Zebra na ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ la kple Zallet na gakotoku [wallet] la — kpɔ zcashd be nàva ɖe Zebra kple Zallet ƒe migration guide ŋu. Zcash Foundation GitHub Repository bubu si le GitHub ƒe dɔwo ŋu, si me Zcash Foundation le, eye woɖe zebra hã ɖe eme; esia nye Zcash ƒe ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ ƒe dɔwɔwɔ le Rust me. title: Blossom
description: Blossom de dzi le Zcash mainnet dzi le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 653,600 (December 11, 2019 UTC).
text: Blossom Blossom de dzi le Zcash mainnet dzi le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 653,600 (December 11, 2019 UTC). Nu si nànyae: Ale si Blossom wɔe be Zcash gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe va le kabakaba teƒe ɖe eve, esi wòmetɔ asi le ZEC si network la wɔna le ɣeyiɣi me la dzi o. Blossom nye Zcash mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ network upgrade. ZIP 206 wɔe. Eye gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi [consensus] ƒe tɔtrɔ vevi aɖe si le eŋu la woɖe fia le ZIP 208 me. Blossom nye nu ƒe dziyiyi [scaling] ƒe mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ: Ewɔ be ɣeyiɣi si woɖo daɖi be gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe aɖe kple si kplɔe ɖo la nɔa me tso sekondi 150 yi sekondi 75, ale be gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒewo vana le kabakaba teƒe ɖe eve. Electric Coin Company kplɔ dɔ la eye wògblɔ Blossom. Nu ka ta esia le vevie. Ne nèdo ZEC ɖa la, nèle network la ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu lalam be wòakafu le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe aɖe me. Ne gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒewo mena va enumake o la, nàlala ɣeyiɣi didi. Tsã ɖe Blossom gɔme la, woɖo gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe yeye aɖe be wòava le sekondi 150 siaa me. Blossom tsɔ dzodzo sia va afã, yi sekondi 75, ale be kpekpeɖeŋuwo vana kaba eye ɖoɖonu [chain] la ate ŋu atsɔ gaɖoɖowo geɖe akeke le ɣeyiɣi ma ke me. Ewɔ esia esi wòmedze ZEC geɖe o alo wòmetɔ asi le fetu ƒe afãmama [halving] si woɖo ɣeyiɣi na le etsɔme la dzi o. TL;DR (Kpuie ko) Blossom nye Zcash ƒe mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ [network upgrade] etɔ̃lia, si dze dɔwɔwɔ gɔme le mainnet ƒe gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe [block] 653,600 dzi (December 11, 2019 UTC). ZIP 206 ye wotsɔ ɖo eŋu, eye eƒe tɔtrɔ vevi la le ZIP 208 me. Eɖe gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe dzodzo si woɖo daɖi dzi kpɔtɔ tso sekondi 150 yi sekondi 75. Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒewo vana zi eve wu tsã, eyata gaɖoɖo [transaction] ƒe kpeɖodzi gbãtɔwo vana kaba, eye gaɖoɖo ʋɛ siwo network la wɔna le ɣeyiɣi aɖe me la dzi ɖe edzi kabakaba zi eve. Be ZEC ƒe ɖeɖe ɖe go nayi edzi le ɖoɖo nu la, ema fetu si wotsɔna naa le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ɖesiaɖe ta la ƒe afã, eye wòdzi ɣeyiɣi si dzi fetu ƒe afãmama [halving] dzɔna ɖo la ɖe edzi zi eve, tso gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 840,000 yi 1,680,000. ZEC si wowɔna le ɣeyiɣi ɖesiaɖe me ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ blibo kple ɣeyiɣi ŋutɔŋutɔ si dzi fetu ƒe afãmama siwo gbɔna la adzɔ la metrɔ o. Enye tɔtrɔ si le be ame sia ame nawɔ eye wòka akpa eveawo siaa: ele be ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ [node] ɖesiaɖe natrɔ eɖokui be wòanɔ ɖoɖonu [chain] la dzi. Kpɔɖeŋu si wòakpɔ kple ŋku Blossom le abe bus mɔ̃ si le eƒe dzodzowo dzim ɖe eve ene. Fifia bus vana le sekɛnd 75 ɖesiaɖe me le esi teƒe be wòava le sekɛnd 150 ɖesiaɖe me, eya ta àlala ɣeyiɣi ƒe afã ko (kpeɖodzi siwo vana kaba [faster confirmations]), eye mɔ̃ la tsɔa mɔzɔlawo ɖe eve (nu siwo wòtsɔna le ɣeyiɣi aɖe me [throughput]). Be kulawo ƒe fetu katã nanɔ ale ke, woma kula ɖesiaɖe ƒe fetu le mɔzɔzɔ ɖeka ɖesiaɖe ta ɖe afã: wozãa ga ma ke na fetu katã, gake woxea fe la le mɔzɔzɔ siwo sɔ gbɔ ɖe eve me. Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒewo si vana kaba Blossom ƒe tɔtrɔ vevi la bɔe. Zcash ƒe gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe dzodzo si woɖo daɖi, si nye ɣeyiɣi si network la di be wòanɔ gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe aɖe kple si kplɔe ɖo dome la, tso sekondi 150 yi sekondi 75 (ZIP 208). Woɖoa gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒewo to dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɖaseɖigbalɛ [proof] me, eyata vovo le ɣeyiɣi si wònɔa wo dome ŋutɔ me, gake fifia network la di gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe aɖe le sekondi 75 siaa me le sekondi 150 ƒe teƒe. Nu eve do tso ema me: Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒewo vana le kabakaba teƒe ɖe eve, ale be ɖoɖonu la ate ŋu atsɔ gaɖoɖowo geɖe kple ɣeyiɣi ƒe akpa siaa. Wò gaɖoɖo ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu gbãtɔ ava kaba, elabena màlala ɣeyiɣi didi na gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe si kplɔe ɖo la o. Dzadzra gaƒoƒo ɖe te Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe si vana kaba la do biabia aɖe ɖa. Ne Zcash wɔ gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe geɖe teƒe ɖe eve eye gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe siaa nɔ fetu ma ke xɔm la, network la awɔ ZEC le kabakaba teƒe ɖe eve. Blossom ƒo nuvɔ̃ ma dzi. Ewɔ be fetu si woana le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe siaa me la yi afã, eye wòwɔ be gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe-fetu ƒe fetu ƒe afãmama ƒe ɣeyiɣi tso gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 840,000 yi 1,680,000 (ZIP 208). Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe geɖe teƒe ɖe eve, siwo katã xɔa fetu afã, hea ZEC ƒe lolome ma ke le ɣeyiɣi ƒe akpa siaa. Gaƒoƒo blibo ƒe ɖoɖo kple fetu ƒe afãmamawo ƒe ɣeyiɣi le ɣeyiɣi ŋutɔ me metrɔ o. Mɔ̃ ƒ

description: Canopy dze dɔwɔwɔ gɔme le Zcash mainnet dzi le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe (block) 1,046,400 dzi (November 18, 2020 UTC).
text: Canopy Canopy dze dɔwɔwɔ gɔme le Zcash mainnet dzi le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe (block) 1,046,400 dzi (November 18, 2020 UTC). Nusi nàsrɔ̃: alesi Zcash yi edzi kpe ga ɖe eƒe ŋutɔ ƒe ŋgɔyiyi ŋu esime gbãtɔwo ƒe fetu (founders reward) wu enu, kple alesi Canopy ɖo gamama si dzi mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ siwo va emegbe gale tutum ɖo. Canopy nye Zcash ƒe mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ (network upgrade) atɔ̃lia, si woyɔna hã be Network Upgrade 4 (NU4). Wotsɔe de dɔwɔwɔ me to ZIP 251 dzi, eye wòdze dɔwɔwɔ gɔme le mainnet gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 1,046,400 dzi le November 18, 2020 (UTC), ɣeyiɣi ma ke si me Zcash ƒe gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe fetu ƒe afãmama (halving) gbãtɔ dzɔ. Canopy nye dziɖuɖu (governance) kple gaŋuɖoɖo ƒe trɔtrɔ vevietɔ. Ewu gbãtɔwo ƒe fetu gbãtɔ la nu eye wòdze Zcash Ŋgɔyiyi Gadzraɖoƒe (Development Fund) yeye la gɔme, si xea fe na Electric Coin Company, Zcash Foundation, kple ame ɖokuisitɔ siwo xɔa ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu (grant). Ɖoɖo si le gadzraɖoƒe ma megbe la tso dziɖuɖu ƒe dɔwɔwɔ didi aɖe si nutoa me tɔwo wɔ le 2019 me. Nusita esia le vevie. Zcash kpea ga ɖe eƒe ŋutɔ ƒe ŋgɔyiyi ŋu tso gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe fetuwo me, elabena dɔwɔƒe aɖeke mele megbe na o. Wona gbãtɔwo ƒe fetu si xe fe ɖe eƒe ƒe gbãtɔwo ta la nawu enu le fetu ƒe afãmama gbãtɔ dzi. Canopy ye nye eteƒenɔla: eɖo gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe fetu ɖesiaɖe ƒe akpa aɖe si meɖana o ɖe Ŋgɔyiyi Gadzraɖoƒe la me eye wòɖo ame siwo axɔe. Mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ siwo va emegbe ɖɔ ɖoɖo ma ɖo, va se ɖe NU6.1 dzi. Ŋgɔyiyi gadzraɖoƒe la Canopy wu gbãtɔwo ƒe fetu gbãtɔ la nu eye wòtsɔ Zcash Ŋgɔyiyi Gadzraɖoƒe ɖɔlii. Trɔtrɔa va le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ma ke dzi si dzi Zcash ƒe fetu ƒe afãmama gbãtɔ dzɔ, esime gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe fetu ɖiɖi tso 6.25 ZEC va 3.125 ZEC. Eyata nukulawo (miners) kpɔ be woma woƒe fetu ɖe afã le ŋkeke ma ke dzi si dzi akpa yeye aɖe tso fetu sue ma me dze yiyi na ŋgɔyiyi gɔme. Wona gadzraɖoƒe la nawɔ dɔ ƒe ene, tso fetu ƒe afãmama gbãtɔ sia dzi le November 2020 va se ɖe fetu ƒe afãmama evelia dzi le 2024. Woŋlɔ ɖoɖo si dzi wolɔ̃ ɖo la ɖi abe ZIP 1014 ene. Gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi (consensus) ƒe mɔ̃ si ʋãa ga la ŋutɔŋutɔ enye gakpekpeɖeŋu ƒe tɔsisi (funding stream) ƒe ɖoɖo: ZIP 207 he mɔ si dzi woato aɖo gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe akpa aɖe ɖe xɔla siwo wotia la gbɔ vɛ, eye ZIP 214 ɖo se tɔxɛwo kple xɔlawo ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo (addresses) na Ŋgɔyiyi Gadzraɖoƒe la. Alesi woma ga la Ŋgɔyiyi Gadzraɖoƒe la xɔa gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe fetu ɖesiaɖe ƒe 20 le alafa me. Nukulawo xɔa 80 le alafa me susɔeawo. Emegbe woma 20 le alafa me ma ɖe akpa etɔ̃, le ZIP 1014 nu. 35 le alafa me na Bootstrap Project, si nye Electric Coin Company ƒe dɔwɔƒe tsitsitɔ. 25 le alafa me na Zcash Foundation. 40 le alafa me na Ga ƒe Kpekpeɖeŋu Gãwo (Major Grants), si kpea ga ɖe dɔ siwo ame ɖokuisitɔwo wɔna ŋu eye Zcash Foundation kpɔa edzi. Emegbe Ga ƒe Kpekpeɖeŋu Gãwo zu Zcash Community Grants (ZCG). Ne èdzidze akpa siawo ɖe gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe fetu blibo la ŋu boŋ tsɔ wu gadzraɖoƒe la ɖeɖeko ŋu la, wozua 7 le alafa me na Electric Coin Company, 5 le alafa me na Zcash Foundation, kple 8 le alafa me na Ga ƒe Kpekpeɖeŋu Gãwo. Mɔ eve siawo siaa le xexlẽdzesi mawo ke ŋu ƒom. Sprout gaƒuƒoƒo ƒe trɔtrɔ Canopy dze gaƒuƒoƒo (pool) ɣaɣla (shielded) xoxotɔ kekeake ɖeɖeɖa gɔme hã. Sprout nye Zcash ƒe gaƒuƒoƒo ɣaɣla gbãtɔ, eye Canopy dze edzi ɖeɖe gɔme to ZIP 211 dzi. Tso ɣeyiɣi si Canopy dze dɔwɔwɔ gɔme la, womate ŋu atsɔ asixɔxɔ yeye aɖeke akpe ɖe Sprout gaƒuƒoƒo la ŋu o. Le mɔ̃ɖaŋununya ƒe nyagbɔgblɔ me la, ele be vpubold teƒe le JoinSplit ɖesiaɖe me nanye zero. Ame ate ŋu aɖe ga siwo le Sprout me xoxo la le eme kokoko, eyata womedo mɔ na ame aɖeke o, gake gaƒuƒoƒo la ate ŋu aɖiɖi ko tso fifia dzi. Esia nye afɔɖeɖe gbãtɔ ɖe Sprout gaƒuƒoƒo xoxo la ɖeɖeɖa le nuwuwu me ŋu, ne gaƒuƒoƒo ɣaɣla yeyeawo naxɔ eteƒe. Mɔ̃ɖaŋununya ƒe nu bubuwo Kpe ɖe gakpekpeɖeŋu ƒe trɔtrɔawo ŋu la, Canopy tsɔ mɔ̃ɖaŋununya ƒe ZIP sue eve hã vɛ. ZIP 212 trɔ alesi xɔla kpɔa Sapling ƒe nya ɣaɣla si nɔa anyi hena ɣeyiɣi kpui (ephemeral secret), to edzi kpɔkpɔ tso didienu (note) ƒe nya si womeɣla o

title: Crosslink Ƒe Mɔɖoɖo
description: Crosslink ƒe Mɔɖoɖo nye ŋgɔyiyi gã aɖe le Zcash ƒe tɔtrɔ me, eye wòkplɔe yi Ƒomekɔkɔe Proof-of-Stake (PoS) kple Proof-of-Work (PoW) ƒe mɔnu gbɔ. PoW si wozãna…
text: Crosslink Ƒe Mɔɖoɖo Nu Si Wòle Be Nànya Le Kpuie Crosslink ƒe mɔɖoɖo nye ɖoɖo si woɖoe be wòanye Zcash ƒe Proof-of-Work/Proof-of-Stake (PoW/PoS) ƒe ƒomekɔkɔe ƒe akpa. Eƒoa PoW kple Byzantine Fault Tolerance (BFT) ƒe mɔɖoɖo nu, eye eƒea nuwuwu kakaɖedzi be woakpɔ ɖe edzi ne PoW alo PoS ɖeka koe gale dedie. Ƒomekɔkɔe PoS va kple notarywo siwo doa gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒewo ɖe edzi le ZEC si woƒoe le ga ƒuƒoƒo [staking] me dzi — gbã la, wole te ɖe teƒe ɖeka; megbe la, woatia wo le ZEC si woƒoe le ga ƒuƒoƒo me dzi. Crosslink ƒe ta nye be wòana agbaleƒoƒo eve: agbaleƒoƒo si wotsɔ nuwuwu wɔe (LOGfin) na trɔtrɔ megatrɔ o ƒe dedie, kple agbaleƒoƒo si me gãmesese ƒe mɔnu mekpɔ akpa (LOGba) si do ŋgɔ na eƒe gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe L ko. Dedienɔnɔ ƒe Mɔnu dzea dzi ne agbaleƒoƒo si wotsɔ nuwuwu wɔe megbe akpa wu gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe L: PoW yi edzi, ke ga ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo katã tɔ gbɔ va se ɖe esia ƒe fifi me. Ɣeyiɣi yi la, PoS ƒe nusiwo doa gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ɖe edzi axɔ fetu ƒe akpa si le dzidzime yi edzi, eye esia aɖe PoW ƒe nukulawo ƒe xɔɖe le anyi; mɔɖoɖoa ɖea tɔtrɔwo ƒe mɔ le vie vie. Shielded Labs le mɔɖoɖoa ŋu wɔm, eye mɔɖoɖo li na Crosslink 2 ƒe kɔkɔe ɖe Zcash ƒe Zebra ƒe klient me. Crosslink menɔ dɔ wɔm le Zcash ƒe mainnet dzi o. Ele dɔ wɔm le Shielded Labs ƒe Feature Net, afi nudzodzro ƒe network si ame sia ame ate ŋu akpɔ ɖe eŋu. Kpɔ "Afi si Crosslink tsɔ tsi" le anyi. Ɖeɖe Me Tɔxɛ Gɔmedzedze: Zcash Ƒe Ƒomekɔkɔe PoS Kple Crosslink Ƒe Mɔɖoɖo Crosslink ƒe Mɔɖoɖo nye ŋgɔyiyi gã aɖe le Zcash ƒe tɔtrɔ me, eye wòkplɔe yi Ƒomekɔkɔe Proof-of-Stake (PoS) kple Proof-of-Work (PoW) ƒe mɔnu gbɔ. PoW si wozãna le blema, togbɔ be wònye mɔ si dzi womate ŋu aka le network ƒe dedie ɖo o la, wometsɔe ɖe dzidzedze o, elabena eɖuna ŋusẽ geɖe, eye nukuku [mining] ƒe dɔwɔwɔ gãwo ƒe akpɔkpɔ le eŋu. Crosslink trɔna va kple ƒomekɔkɔe ƒe mɔnu aɖe, si ƒoa PoW ƒe ŋusẽ si woɖoe kpɔ kple PoS ƒe dɔwɔwɔ nyuitɔ kple dziɖuɖu [governance] ƒe viwo nu. Tɔtrɔ sia sɔ kple xexeame bliboa ƒe ɖoɖowo le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu [blockchain] ƒe nu yeye wɔwɔ me, afi si dɔwɔwɔwo le yi yim le mɔnu siwo menoa anyigba gbegblẽ o kple ha nuɖo agni [decentralized] ƒe mɔnuwo gbɔ. Crosslinks ƒe gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi [consensus] ƒe mɔnu evea nana be Zcash nɔa ɣaɣla [privacy] ƒe kakaɖedzi si le eƒe asitsala mɔnuwo me la ɖeasi, le esime wòle tɔtrɔm be wòawɔ dɔ le egbea ƒe kuxiwo ŋu. Ƒomekɔkɔe Proof-of-Stake (PoS) ƒe mɔnu ƒoa Proof-of-Work (PoW) si wozãna le blema kple PoS nu, eye eƒe ta nye be wòamɔ kuxiwo abe 51% ƒe asrɔ̃nu ene, le esime wònɔ ha nuɖo agni me eye wòɖe ŋusẽ ƒe zãzã le anyi. Ƒomekɔkɔe PoS va kple notarywo siwo doa gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒewo ɖe edzi le ZEC si woƒoe le ga ƒuƒoƒo me dzi. Woɖo mɔnu sia be wòana ɖoɖonu [chain] ƒe dedie kple teƒe siwo wɔna be woakpɔ gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒewo ɖe edzi nyuie wu, eye wòana mɔnu si sesẽ wu PoW ƒe mɔnuwo ko. Nu Ka Ta Ƒomekɔkɔe PoS/PoW Wòanye Nudzodzro Gbã? Ena ŋgɔyiyi yi PoS blibo gbɔ. Ena be nukuku kple ga ƒuƒoƒo ƒe zã nyawo [use case] nawɔ dɔ ɖekae, eye wòana ekɔsɔkɔsɔ ƒe akpawo nakpe ɖe eŋu. Eɖea dedie ƒe kuxi siwo ate ŋu ava le PoS ƒe mɔɖoɖoa me la ɖe anyi va se ɖe esime nusiwo doa gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ɖe edzi la ƒe ga ƒuƒoƒo kple dzixɔse nava gã wu. Ethereum fia mɔnu sia xoxo le Production me. Nu Si Crosslink Nye Crosslink ƒe mɔɖoɖo nye ɖoɖo si woɖoe be wòanye Zcash ƒe Proof-of-Work/Proof-of-Stake (PoW/PoS) ƒe ƒomekɔkɔe ƒe akpa. Eƒoa PoW kple Byzantine Fault Tolerance (BFT) ƒe mɔɖoɖo nu, eye eƒea nuwuwu kakaɖedzi be woakpɔ ɖe edzi ne PoW alo PoS ɖeka koe gale dedie. Ɖoɖoa le mɔ kpɔm be wòasesẽ network ƒe dedie kple ha nuɖo agni, to nusiwo doa gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ɖe edzi si woƒoe le ga ƒuƒoƒo me ƒe kɔkɔe me, le esime wòle nukulawo ƒe gomekpɔkpɔ ɖeasi. Ɖoɖoa ƒe nɔnɔme vevi aɖe, si woyɔna be Crosslink 2, wɔna be mɔnu sia naɖe bɔbɔe to BFT ƒe nufialaawo kple nukulawo ƒoƒo ɖekae me. Mɔnu si me nu mekpɔ akpa sia ɖea ɖoɖo ƒe tɔtrɔwo ɖe anyi, eye ena be woazã BFT ƒe akpa "metsi o", eye esia nana be eƒe nudzodzro kple eƒe dɔwɔwɔ naɖe bɔbɔe, le esime wònɔ dedie ƒe se gãwo ɖeasi. Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɖoɖoa kplɔ

title: FROST
description: Schnorr ƒe asidede agbalẽ te si nye digital la nye algorithm ƒe ƒuƒoƒo: (KeyGen, Sign, Verify).
text: FROST Nyatakaka Vevi FROST (Flexible Round-Optimised Schnorr Threshold Signatures) nye xexlẽme asidede agbalẽ te kple klavi ƒe dzidzeme le amehawo dome ƒe ɖoɖo: asidela geɖewo siaa le klavi sia tɔ̃ ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu aɖe si wo ƒe sia, eye wòhiã be wo dometɔ geɖe si wo da ɖo la nakpe ɖe eŋu be woawɔ asidede agbalẽ te aɖe. Esi emetsonu la nye Schnorr ƒe asidede agbalẽ te ɖeka, gaɖoɖo [transaction] si wowɔ ale la ƒe nɔnɔ le network me anɔ abe gaɖoɖo kawaida ene. Ehia ƒoƒo meɖoɖowo vi, wòate ŋu awɔ dɔ le ɣeyiɣi ɖeka me, eye wòate ŋu ade dzesi ame si wɔ nu vɔ̃ la eye wòadoe ɖe zaza me. Na Zcash, esia fia be FROST na amehawo siwo le anyigba ƒe teƒe vovovowo te ŋu nɔ la ate ŋu akplɔ gaɖoɖo ƒe ŋusẽ le ɣaɣla ZEC dzi — esia ƒe vi na gakotoku [wallet] ƒe dzrala, gaƒoƒoƒe, dɔwɔƒewo siwo menye asikplɔ-dzralá o, kple Zcash Shielded Assets (ZSA). Chelsea Komlo (University of Waterloo, Zcash Foundation) kple Ian Goldberg (University of Waterloo) wɔe. Nu Si Wòasrɔ Gbã Nu kae nye Schnorr ƒe asidede agbalẽ te? Schnorr ƒe asidede agbalẽ te si nye digital la nye algorithm ƒe ƒuƒoƒo: (KeyGen, Sign, Verify). Schnorr ƒe asidede agbalẽ tewo le viɖe geɖe. Viɖe vevi aɖe nye be ne wowɔ asidede le mesaj ma ke dzi kple klavi geɖe, woate ŋu aƒo asidede agbalẽ te siwo do tso eme la ƒu ɖe asidede agbalẽ te ɖeka me. Esia ate ŋu aɖe multisig ƒe fexexe [payment] kple gaɖoɖowo bubu siwo kplɔ multisig ɖo la ƒe lolome ɖe anyi kakhulu. Nu kae nye FROST? Flexible Round-Optimised Schnorr Threshold Signatures - Chelsea Komlo (University of Waterloo, Zcash Foundation) kple Ian Goldberg (University of Waterloo) wɔe. FROST nye xexlẽme asidede agbalẽ te kple klavi ƒe dzidzeme le amehawo dome ƒe ɖoɖo si hia ƒoƒo meɖoɖowo vi, eye wòate ŋu awɔ dɔ le ɣeyiɣi ɖeka me. FROST ƒe ɖoɖo nye Schnorr ƒe asidede agbalẽ te ƒe xexlẽme ƒe version. To vovo na asidede agbalẽ tewo siwo le ame ɖeka ƒe nɔnɔ me la, xexlẽme asidede agbalẽ tewo hia be asidela geɖe si wo da ɖo nakpe ɖe eŋu, esi sia sia le klavi sia tɔ̃ ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu aɖe si wo ƒe. Nu kae nye Threshold Signatures? Chelsea Komlo - Zcon3 Eya ta, asidede agbalẽ te ƒe wɔwɔ le xexlẽme ƒe nɔnɔ me hia dɔ bubu tso network ƒe ƒoƒo me le asidelawo dome, eye esia wɔna be wòxɔ asi ne woɖe ɣaɣla ƒe kpekpeɖeŋuwo ɖe mɔ̃dɔlawo dzi siwo ƒe network ŋusẽ meganɔ o, alo ne woƒo nu le network si mele nuteƒe o dzi. Wona network ƒe dɔ bubu le asidede ƒe dɔwɔwɔ me nɔa anyi sue wu to mɔ yeye aɖe si dea tso forgery ƒe attacks me, eye wòle dɔ wɔm na scheme bubuwo hã. FROST nana xexlẽme asidede agbalẽ te ƒe ɖoɖowo nɔnɔ nyuie wu to asidede agbalẽ te ƒe dɔwɔwɔ siwo menye nuwɔwɔ ƒe xexlẽme o ƒe numeɖeka me, be woate ŋu awɔ wo katã le ɣeyiɣi ɖeka me le dedie (concurrency). Woate ŋu azãe abe ƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖo si me asidelawo doa mesaj 2 eye woxɔ mesaj 2 katã ene, alo abe asidede ƒe ɖoɖo si woɖe nyuie si le ƒoƒo ɖeka me kple ɖoɖo gbã ƒe akpa ene. FROST xɔ eƒe nɔnɔ nyuie ƒe akpa aɖe to mɔ si na ɖoɖo la ƒe dɔ nɔ teƒe ne ame aɖe wɔa nu vɔ̃, eye woade dzesi ame ma eye woadoe ɖe dɔwɔwɔ siwo gbɔna me. Woɖo dedie ƒe ɖaseɖigbalɛwo si fia be FROST le dedie tso chosen-message attacks me, ne discrete logarithm ƒe kuxi le sesĩe, eye fliatɔ la kplɔ amehawo siwo sɔ ɖe xexlẽme la nu o, le afisia. Alekee FROST wɔa dɔ? FROST ƒe ɖoɖo la ƒe akpa vevi evee: Gbã la, amehawo n le klavi ƒe dzidzeme le amehawo dome (DKG) ƒe ɖoɖo aɖe dzi be woawɔ nukpɔsafui [viewing key] si wo katã ƒe. Le nuwuwu la, ame sia sia kpɔ klavi sia tɔ̃ ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu kple nukpɔsafui ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu si nye dukɔ ƒe. Emegbe la, amehawo t-le-n me ate ŋu awɔ xexlẽme asidede ƒe ɖoɖo la ɖekae be woawɔ Schnorr ƒe asidede agbalẽ te si le eteƒe. Nɔnɔ Ƒe Nɔnɔ / Mɔ Ƒe Ŋutinya Bu FROST be enye gaƒoƒoƒe ƒe akpa si ƒu nɔe ne klavi tɔwo si woɖe mɔ na wɔnɔ la trɔ woƒe klaviwo ɖekae — ke menye be klavi tɔ sia sia nɔa anyi o; xexlẽme aɖe ko (kpɔɖeŋu, ame 3 le ame 5 me). Ne woƒu akpa la, ame si le gota mate ŋu akpɔ klavi tɔ kaewo va o, alo be ame ɖeka wu nɔ eme hã o. Nenema ke, ƒuƒoƒo aɖe ate ŋu ana mɔ na Zcash ƒe gaɖoɖo, eye network la kpɔ asidede

title: FROST & Ɖoɖoƒe ƒe Kpɔɖeŋu na ɣaɣla ZEC
description: Ne nàkpɔ FROST protocol ƒe cryptographic nyatakakawo katã la, kpɔ FROST teknikal axa.
text: FROST & Ɖoɖoƒe ƒe Kpɔɖeŋu na ɣaɣla ZEC Ne nàkpɔ FROST protocol ƒe cryptographic nyatakakawo katã la, kpɔ FROST teknikal axa. FROST threshold custody gava le Zcash ƒe wɔnawo me zi geɖe — eyae nye track si xɔ tsɔn wu le ZecHub Hackathon 2026 — gake wometsɔa nyateƒe sia gblɔna ɖe ame bubuwo nu dzɔdzɔe o. Axa sia ɖe esime wònye, esime nèhĩãe vavã, eƒe ƒomeviwo, kple dɔwɔnu siwo de asi le eŋu egbe la fia. --- Nyatakaka kpui FROST na ame siwo lée kɔkɔe me la wɔa ɣaɣla Zcash gaɖoƒe ƒe dzikpɔkpɔ ɖekae, eye ame aɖeke meɖea asi ɖe private key blibo la ŋu o. t-of-n threshold fia be: ele be ame t nadze asi ɖekae be woatsɔ ga; ame t-1 alo ame siwo sɔe kple esia le eme o mate ŋu aɖe ga la ɖeka o. Gaɖoɖowo nɔa abe ɣaɣla gaɖoɖo bubu siawo ene — ɖoɖonu dzi ƒe dzesi aɖeke menye be wozã threshold signing o. Esia to vovo ŋutɔ na nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi multisig (si le ɖoɖonu dzi kple si Zcash de asi le eŋu xoxo) — FROST wɔa dɔ le ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo me. Ewɔa dɔ nyuie na DAOwo, gatrɔƒewo, asikplɔ-dzralá ƒe subɔsubɔwo, hadede ƒe gaɖoɖowo, kple team ƒe gadzraɖoƒewo — afi sia afi si key ƒe vɔ̃ɖi ƒe teƒe ɖeka menyo o. --- Nu kae nye FROST le gbe bɔbɔe me? Bu be business ƒe hadɔwɔla etɔ lée kɔkɔe ƒe akpa ɖe sia ɖe. Be woatsɔ ga tso woƒe gakotoku me la, ele be ame eve le etɔa dome nadze asi ɖekae. Gaɖoɖo si dze eme la nɔa abe ame ɖeka ƒe dɔdɔɖoɖo sia tɔgbi ene — nukpɔla aɖeke mate ŋu akpɔ tso gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu la me be ame geɖewo wɔ dɔ le eŋu o. FROST (Flexible Round-Optimized Schnorr Threshold Signatures) nye cryptographic protocol si na esia dzɔ le ɣaɣla Zcash ta. Chelsea Komlo (University of Waterloo / Zcash Foundation) kple Ian Goldberg wɔe. Eƒe nɔnɔme veviwoe nye: Threshold: ele be t-of-n ƒe ame siwo dzena asi la koe woakpɔe ɖe eme (abe 2-of-3, 3-of-5 ene) Ɣaɣla: ewɔa dɔ le Orchard ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo me — ga ƒe home, dɔla, kple xɔla nɔa ɣaɣla Mele vovototo o: asidede agbalẽ te mamlɛtɔ la nɔa abe Zcash ɣaɣla gaɖoɖo bubu sia tɔgbi ene Menyɛ asikplɔ-dzralá o: ame ɖeka aɖeke melé key blibo la o — hakɛ coordinator gɔ̃ hã mele eŋu o --- Ɣe ka wòle be nàzã threshold custody? Threshold custody sɔ na wò ne key ɖeka alo ame ɖeka ƒe vɔ̃ɖi mele be wòaga ƒe vɔ̃ɖi o. Nɔnɔme Nu ka ta threshold custody kpena ɖeŋu ----------- ---------------------------- DAO alo team ƒe gadzraɖoƒe Admin ɖeka mate ŋu aɖe ga la ɖeka o; ehiã gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi Gatrɔƒe alo asikplɔ-dzralá Ema key ƒe vɔ̃ɖi ma le dedie ƒe teƒewo alo dɔwɔlawo dome Ame ŋutɔ ƒe cold storage (kple ƒometɔ siwo nèka ɖe dzi) 2-of-3 le iwọ kple ƒometɔ eve dome — ne ku alo mègakpɔ mɔ aɖe o la, ga la magbu o Escrow Nudzɔla, nuƒlela, kple ame si wɔa dzodzro ƒe ɖeɖe lée akpa ɖe sia ɖe; ga la doa go ne ame eve wɔ ɖekae Ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu si xɔ asi ƒe mama ZCG ƒe mɔnu: ele be ame siwo le woawo ŋutɔ ƒe mɔnu la nadze asi geɖe hafi woadze ga Mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔla ƒe key dzikpɔkpɔ Kpɔa ame si le eme ƒe vɔ̃ɖi ŋu — engineer ɖeka mate ŋu aɖe protocol ƒe ga ɖeka o Ɖewohĩ be mèhiã threshold custody na ame ŋutɔ ƒe gakotoku si wò dzra ɖeka, ga suewo, alo nɔnɔme si me hadede ƒe dɔ sesẽ la ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu dze wu vɔ̃ɖi ƒe ɖeɖe la o. --- Aleke wòto vovo na nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi multisig? Zcash de asi le nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi multisig ŋu xoxo — key geɖe siwo hia be woatsɔ ga tso t-address me. Gake nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi multisig wɔa ɣaɣla ƒe ga sesẽ aɖe: multisig ƒe ɖoɖo, public keywo katã, kple ame siwo dzena asi katã le ɖoɖonu dzi kɔ. FROST ɖe fia na esia to dɔwɔwɔ le ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo me: Nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi multisig FROST threshold (ɣaɣla) -- --------------------- -------------------------- Gaƒuƒoƒo Nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi (ame katã ƒe) Orchard (ɣaɣla) Ame siwo dzena asi le ɖoɖonu dzi kɔ Ẽ — public keywo katã ɖea go Ao — mele vovototo na ame ɖeka ƒe gaɖoɖo o Ga ƒe homewo le kɔ Ẽ Ao Hadede hia Ɖoɖonu dzi ƒe script Ɖoɖonu me tɔ o ƒe nyawo ƒe mama Ɣaɣla Aɖeke mele o Ɣaɣla blibo --- Ƒomeviwo kple mɔxɔɖewo FROST xɔ ŋusẽ, gake eƒe ƒomevi vavãwo le esi wòle be nàse egɔme hafi nàzãe: Hadede ƒe dɔ sesẽ Ele be ame siwo dzena asi la nɔ internet dzi ɖekae (alo ɖe eŋu vovo sue) be woawɔ signing ƒe round

title: Ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibowo [Full Nodes]
description: Ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo nye software si wɔa cryptocurrency ƒe gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu blibo, eye wònaa mɔ na wò be nàdzɔ protocol la ƒe nɔnɔmeawo.
text: Ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibowo [Full Nodes] Nu veviwo le eme Ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo dea Zcash gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu [blockchain] blibo ƒe kopi ɖe asi eye wòkpɔ gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe yeyewo kple gaɖoɖo yeyewo katã tsɔe sɔ kple gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi [consensus] ƒe sewo. Zebra (zebrad) nye ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ si wòle be nàɖo egbe. Zakura nye dɔwɔwɔ bubu si wotso tso Zebra me. zcashd ƒe dɔwɔwɔ va yi. Eƒe End-of-Support ƒe tɔtɔ va do gbe 18 July 2026 le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe teƒe 3417100, eye ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ mawo megatrɔa dɔ o. Ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ kple gakotoku [wallet] nye mɔɖeɖe vovovo azɔ. Zallet wɔa dɔ kple ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ eye wòle kɔkɔewo. Wò ŋutɔ ƒe ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ ƒe dɔwɔwɔ naa na wò nàkɔ nu ŋutɔ, eye wòna wòmehia be nàkɔ ame bubu ƒe server dzi o. Gɔmeɖeɖe Vevi Ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo nye software si wɔa cryptocurrency ƒe gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu blibo, eye wònaa mɔ na wò be nàdzɔ protocol la ƒe nɔnɔmeawo. Ewɔa gaɖoɖo siawo katã ƒe ŋutinya blibo tso genesis me, eyata ewɔa nu be wòate ŋu akpɔ gaɖoɖo yeyeawo kple gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe yeyeawo siwo wotsɔ kpe gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu la ŋu la ƒe nyateƒenye. Ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ ƒe Dɔwɔwɔwo Zebra Zebra nye ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo si tsɔ ŋutɔ ɖo eɖokui ɖe Zcash protocol la ŋu, si wɔ ƒe dɔ le production me, si Zcash Foundation wɔ eye wòŋlɔe kple Rust. Esi zcashd ƒe dɔwɔwɔ va yi ta la, Zebra (zebrad) nye ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo si woda aɖaŋu na ɖoɖowɔwɔ yeyeawo. Zebra kpɔa gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒewo kple gaɖoɖowo ŋu, wòxɔa gbɔ kple peer-to-peer network la, eye wòtsɔa RPC ƒe mɔɖoɖo na applicationwo. Gakotoku la nye nuƒoƒo vovovo azɔ: Zallet wɔa dɔ kple Zebra ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ eye wòkpɔa kɔkɔewo kple balancewo ŋu. Esia wɔ ɖe zcashd teƒe, si ƒoa ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ kple gakotoku la ƒu le process ɖeka me. Be wòana ɣaɣla light gakotokuwɔlaawo dɔ la, ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ la wɔa dɔ kple indexer, eye wòate ŋu anye lightwalletd si xɔ se xoxo loo alo Zaino yeye la. Kpɔ be nàxlẽ Zebra agbalẽ la ne nànya ale si woɖoa eƒe dɔwɔwɔ ɖo, eye nàɖo R&D Discord server la me be nàxɔ kpekpeɖeŋu. GitHub Zebra ƒe Agbalẽ Kpɔ Zebra Ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo ne nànya ale si wòate ŋu aɖoe, awɔ eƒe configuration, kple hardware siwo wòhiã. Zakura Zakura nye ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo evelia si sɔ kple consensus, si wotso tso Zebra me eye Valar Group kple Project Tachyon wɔe. Ewɔa dɔ kple protocol ƒe se mawo ke eye wòtsɔa synchronization kabakaba, gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe pruning, kple zcashd RPC compatibility layer kpee. Kpɔ Zakura Ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ. zcashd (ƒe dɔwɔwɔ va yi) Nuxlɔ̃ame: zcashd ƒe dɔwɔwɔ va yi. Electric Coin Company ɖe eƒe deprecation gɔme, eye End-of-Support ƒe tɔtɔ si wɔa eɖokui la va do gbe 18 July 2026 le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe teƒe 3417100. zcashd 6.20.0 ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ siawo katã siwo wometrɔ o tɔ le teƒe ma eye wogbe be woagatrɔ dɔ o, eye software la mekpea NU6.3 o. Zã Zebra. Ne zcashd wallet.dat le asiwò la, wɔ ɖe Migration Guide: zcashd yi zebrad/Zallet la te. zcashd nye Ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo ƒe dɔwɔwɔ gbãtɔ na Zcash, si Electric Coin Company wɔ eye wòle eƒe dɔ kpɔm. Wole build ƒe mɔfiame siwo le ete la ɖom ɖe asi be woatsɔ awɔ nuɖoɖo, kple na dɔwɔla siwo le adzo tso zcashd gbɔ. zcashd tsɔa APIwo ƒe xexlẽ ɖe go toɖe via eƒe RPC interface. APIwo siawo naa dɔwɔwɔ siwo na applicationwo siwo tso afisia nɔa ɖe go la ate ŋu awɔ dɔ kple ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ la. lightwalletd nye application ƒe kpɔɖeŋu si zãa ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo be wòna mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔlawo nate ŋu atu eye woakpɔ mobile-friendly ɣaɣla light gakotokuwo ŋu, evɔ womahiã be woawɔ dɔ kple zcashd tẽ o. RPC commands siwo katã wokpea ƒe xexlẽ blibo zcashd ƒe agbalẽ Dze Ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ ƒe Dɔwɔwɔ gɔme (Linux) Ɖo Dependencies sudo apt update sudo apt-get install \ build-essential pkg-config libc6-dev m4 g++-multilib \ autoconf libtool ncurses-dev unzip git python3 python3-zmq \ zlib1g-dev curl bsdmainutils automake libtinfo5 Tsɔ release yeyetɔ la kopi, wɔ checkout, ɖo dɔwɔwɔ ɖo eye nàtu: git clone https://github.com/zcash/zcash.git cd zcash/ git checkout v5.4.1 ./zcutil/fetch-params.sh .

title: Halo
description: Halo nye zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛ [proof] (ZKP) ƒe ɖoɖo si me mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖo xexlẽnuwo [trusted setup] mele o, eye wòte ŋu wɔ ɖaseɖigbalɛwo ƒe wo nɔewo me…
text: Halo TL;DR Halo nye zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛ [proof] (ZKP) ƒe ɖoɖo si me mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖo xexlẽnuwo [trusted setup] mele o, eye wòte ŋu wɔ ɖaseɖigbalɛwo ƒe wo nɔewo me gbugbɔ ƒoƒo, si Sean Bowe kpɔ le Electric Coin Co. Eɖe mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖo xexlẽnuwo ƒe hiahiã ɖa, eye ewɔe be ɖaseɖigbalɛwo ƒe wo nɔewo me gbugbɔ ƒoƒo nanye nusi wòate ŋu wɔ, si nye Zcash ƒe nu ƒe dziyiyi [scaling] kple dedienyenye ƒe mɔɖoɖo si le fifia ƒe gɔmeɖoƒe. Nu si wònye: zk-SNARK ƒe ɖoɖo si me gbugbɔ ƒoƒo wɔa dɔ nyuie, eye mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖo xexlẽnuwo ƒe vɔsa mele o. Nu ka ta wòle vevie: Zcash ƒe Orchard ɣaɣla [shielded] gaƒuƒoƒo [pool], si wɔ dɔ kple NU5 le 2022 me, zãa Halo 2 — nyadzɔdzɔ me dɔwɔwɔ si wotsɔ gɔmeɖeɖe sia wɔe. Nɔnɔme vevi: "Toxic waste" aɖeke metsɔ tso vɔsa ƒe mɔɖoɖowɔwɔwo me o, eye ɖaseɖigbalɛwo ate ŋu aɖo ɖase kple ɖaseɖigbalɛ bubu siwo menye woƒe xexlẽme o. Mɔ̃ na ame be wòazã: Halo 2 nye dɔwɔnu si ƒe teƒe ŋuti nya le ame sia ame ƒe asi me le MIT kple Apache 2.0 te, eyata ame sia ame le ekosystem me ate ŋu atu ɖe edzi. --- Gɔmeɖeɖe Vevi Halo nye zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛ ƒe ɖoɖo si me mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖo xexlẽnuwo mele o, eye wòte ŋu wɔ wo nɔewo me gbugbɔ ƒoƒo, si Sean Bowe kpɔ le Electric Coin Co. Eɖe mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖo xexlẽnuwo ɖa eye ena be Zcash gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu [blockchain] ƒe nu ƒe dziyiyi nanɔ sɔ gbɔ. Halo nye zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛ ƒe ɖoɖo gbãtɔ si me dɔwɔwɔ nyuie kple wo nɔewo me gbugbɔ ƒoƒo le — ame geɖe bua be enye sayensi ƒe dɔkpɔkpɔ gã aɖe. Akpa eveawo Polynomial Commitment Scheme. Ena be ame si dea adzɔgbeɖeɖe [commitment] te polynomial aɖe ate ŋu adee te kple agbalẽkpa kpuie aɖe, si ame si le kpɔɖeŋu wɔm ate ŋu azã atsɔ akpɔ polynomial si wode adzɔgbeɖeɖe te la ƒe xexlẽme siwo wogblɔe la ƒe nyateƒe. Polynomial Interactive Oracle Proof. Ame si le kpɔɖeŋu wɔm bia be ame si dea ɖase fia (algorithm aɖe) naʋu adzɔgbeɖeɖeawo katã le teƒe siwo wòtsɔe, kple polynomial adzɔgbeɖeɖe ƒe ɖoɖo la, eye wokpɔe be sɔsɔme le wo dome nyateƒetɔ. Mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖo xexlẽnuwo mele o zk-SNARK ƒe tutuwo aɖewo, abe Groth16 ene, hia mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖo xexlẽnuwo be woawɔ woƒe ame katã ƒe parameterwo, si woyɔna be common reference string (CRS). Woma CRS la na ɖasefiawo kple ɖasekpɔlawo; menye ɣaɣla si wòle be wòatsrɔ̃ o. Ele be woaɖe ɣaɣla ƒe titina nu si tututu ma ƒe wɔwɔ hea, si woyɔna be "toxic waste", ɖa. Dedie multi-party computation [secure multi-party computation] ate ŋu ama mɔ̃ sia nava dze ame geɖewo dome: Ceremonia la nye dedie ne ame ɖeka le hã le eƒe katãwo dome de asi protocol la me eye wòatsrɔ̃ eƒe ɣaɣla ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu. Kpɔ ECC ƒe ame katã ƒe parameterwo kple toxic waste ƒe gɔmeɖeɖe. Zcash ƒe Sprout kple Sapling ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒowo zã mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖo xexlẽnuwo [trusted-setup] ƒe ɖaseɖigbalɛ ƒe ɖoɖowo, BCTV14 kple Groth16 le woƒe ɖeɖe me. Woƒe dukɔ ƒe parameterwo [public parameters] gale afɔku hã be woatsɔ awɔ ɖaseɖigbalɛ kple akpɔe. Nɔnɔme si ƒe amegã le nye be, ɖoɖo ƒe nyagbe nuwo [secret setup material] wɔe ɖe asi mea, si ate ŋu ana ɖaseɖigbalɛ siwo menye nyateƒe o nadzɔ; CRS ŋutɔ ƒe tata afia wɔwɔ le mɔ̃ me eye mena nyagbe nuwo ma ƒe ɖeɖe o. Halo ƒoa recursive ɖaseɖigbalɛ ƒe ɖoɖo kple polynomial adzɔgbeɖeɖe ƒe ɖoɖo si tso inner product ƒe argument me. Eƒe dukɔ ƒe parameterwo mehia mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖo xexlẽnuwo ƒe vɔsa alo ɣaɣla setup trapdoor ƒe tsrɔ̃. Halo 2 ƒe agbalẽ la gblɔ dukɔ ƒe group parameterwo siawo ŋuti. Esia to vɔsa me wodzi structured reference string si ate ŋu woatrɔe la gbɔ. Ɖoɖo sia ƒe hiãhiãɖeɖe le ɖa be woagatsɔ ɣaɣla nu siwo wozã le vɔsa me ƒe tsrɔ̃tsrɔ̃ akɔ ɖe Halo ƒe ɖaseɖigbalɛwo ŋu o. Menye ɖase be Sprout alo Sapling ƒe vɔsa si do ŋgɔ la mekpɔ nu vɔ̃ aɖeke o, eye menana ɖase be protocol ƒe tɔtrɔ siwo va emegbe la katã le dedie o. Ɖaseɖigbalɛ siwo le wo ŋutɔ dzi [recursive proofs] dea ɖase ɖe akɔnta siwo wode ɖe woƒe sɛkuitiwo me la ŋu, le ɖaseɖigbalɛ ƒe ɖoɖo la ƒe dzitsinya me. Sɛkuiti siwo le ete kple wɔnana siwo le ete la gale vevie; ECC ƒe Halo 2 ƒe ɖoɖo ƒe gɔmeɖeɖe gblɔ kpuie be afɔɖeɖe yeye alo ɖoɖo ƒe vodada yeyewo ƒe afɔku le eme. Sean Bowe ƒe gɔmeɖ

title: Heartwood
description: Heartwood de dɔwɔwɔ dzi le Zcash mainnet dzi le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 903,000 (July 16, 2020 UTC).
text: Heartwood Heartwood de dɔwɔwɔ dzi le Zcash mainnet dzi le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 903,000 (July 16, 2020 UTC). Nusi nànyae nye: Ale si Heartwood na nukulawo ŋu woate ŋu axɔ woƒe gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe fetuwo tẽ ade ɣaɣla [shielded] gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo me, kple ale si wòwɔe wò na Zcash ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɖaseɖigbalɛ le dɔ me nyatakaka si hiã ƒe mɔwo ŋu. Heartwood nye Zcash mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ, gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi ƒe sewo ƒe hard fork si ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɖoɖo le ZIP 250 me. Ewɔ ŋutinya trɔtrɔ eve: ZIP 213 (ɣaɣla Coinbase) kple ZIP 221 (FlyClient). Heartwood nye Zcash ƒe mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ gã ene, eye Electric Coin Company kple Zcash Foundation ƒo ɖeka de asi le eŋu. Abe Zcash ƒe mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ siawo katã ene la, ewɔ gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi ƒe branch id yeye, dzesi si na replay ƒe mɔxoxo ƒe dzadzɛɖeɖe le afia kple megbe, ale be gaɖoɖo si woɖo le se yeyeawo te la mate ŋu woagbugbɔawɔe le ɖoɖonu xoxo dzi o, eye wogatrɔe. Heartwood dze egɔme le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe teƒe si woɖo ɖi (903,000), menye gaƒoƒo ƒe gaƒoƒo si woɖo ɖi o, eyata gaƒoƒo tututu si nàkpɔ le ɖoɖowo ƒuƒopé dzi la ate ŋu ato vovo vi aɖe le teƒewo dome. Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe la kple ɣeyiɣi la koe nye ɖeka. Nu ka ta esia le vevie. Nukula [miners] wo xɔ ZEC si wo wɔ yeye le ɣesiaɣi si wo wɔ nukuku [mining] le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe [block] ŋu. Hafi Heartwood, woasɔ ga ma aɖo nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi [transparent] gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi [address] dzi, si le ame sia ame ƒe ŋkume. Ame sia ame ate ŋu akpɔ ale si nukula aɖe xɔ ga kple afi si gaawo yi le emegbe. Heartwood na be woate ŋu aɖo fetu ma ɖe ɣaɣla [shielded] gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi dzi tẽ ɖe teƒe, ale be nukula ƒe xɔse nɔ ɣaɣla. Eƒe wɔwɔ hã na gakotoku [wallets] siwo me kpekpeɖeŋu mele kple ɖoɖonu [chains] bubuwo nɔ ŋu aƞlɔ Zcash ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɖaseɖigbalɛ [proof-of-work] me ne woaɖe ɖoɖonu blibo la ƒe download o. ɣaɣla coinbase Coinbase gaɖoɖo [coinbase transaction] nye gaɖoɖo tɔxɛ aɖe si xea gaƒuƒoƒe ƒe fetu. Hafi Heartwood, eƒe nu siwo do goe la ele be woanye nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi, eyata nukula ƒe ZEC yeye si wo wɔ la dzea agbe me ɣesiaɣi le gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi si le duto ƒe ŋkume. Heartwood trɔ gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi [consensus] ƒe sewo ale be, le ZIP 213 ƒe nya me, coinbase gaɖoɖowo ate ŋu akpɔ Sapling nu siwo do goe. Le nyagɔme bɔbɔe me, nukulawo ate ŋu axɔ fetuwo tẽ ɖe ɣaɣla [shielded] gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo Sapling me azɔ. Coinbase ƒe nuwo siwo do goe le nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi me la gale mɔ na wo ha, eyata esia nye mɔ yeye aɖe, menye trɔtrɔ si wodo le ame ŋu o. Nu ka ta Sapling gbã ɣaɣla coinbase ɖo ŋku Sapling nufiawo ŋu tɔxɛ, eye nu ka ta le esia me. ZIP 213 gblɔ be Sapling mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ va kple aƒe ƒe ƒomevi trɔtrɔwo kple dɔwɔwɔ ƒe nyuieɖeɖewo siwo wɔ be ga ƒe ɣaɣla tẽ le coinbase gaɖoɖo me la ate ŋu anɔ anyi. Sprout ƒe ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo gbãtɔ la bia nu geɖe akpa na be woawɔ ɣaɣla le coinbase me. Sapling ƒe ɖaseɖigbalɛ wɔwɔ ƒe mɔ nyui kple didienu ƒe nɔnɔme wɔ be wòwɔa dɔ. Sapling hã ɖe se xoxo si de mɔxɔxɔ ɣaɣla coinbase nufiawo ŋu la ŋu be nanɔ Sapling nufiawo hã ŋu, eye Heartwood ɖe se ma ƒe sesẽɖeɖe le ɖeɖe be woana mɔ na wo. Esia nye kpɔɖeŋu nyui si fia ale si Zcash mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔwo tu ɖe wo nɔewo dzi: mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ ɖeka ƒe dɔwɔƒe zu gɔmeɖoƒe na si gbɔna. FlyClient Heartwood hã trɔ nusi gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe ta adzɔgbeɖeɖe wɔ la. Woɖe ta ƒe field si woyɔna be hashFinalSaplingRoot kpɔ ɣeyiɣi aɖe megbe, eye wotrɔ eƒe ŋkɔ zu hashLightClientRoot. Fifi la, ewɔ adzɔgbeɖeɖe ɖe Merkle Mountain Range (MMR) ƒe ke dzi, si nye nu si woatu yi dzi le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe xoxoawo ƒe ta ƒe nyatakakawo kple metadata dzi, abe ɣeyiɣi ƒe dzesiwo, sesẽƒe ƒe taɖodzinuwo, Sapling ƒe keawo, dɔ si woƒo ƒu, kple gaɖoɖo ƒe xexleŋu ene. Adzɔgbeɖeɖe ma na nyatakaka si hiã ƒe mɔ, alo ɖoɖonu bubu aɖe, ŋu wòate ŋu akpɔ Zcash ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɖaseɖigbalɛ kple ɖaseɖigbalɛ sue si ƒe lolome gãna le logarithm ƒe mɔ nu ko le ɖoɖonu ƒe didime nu. Eƒe vi nye nyatakaka si hiã ƒe mɔ ƒe gakotoku nyuitɔwo kple mɔ bɔbɔe na ame etɔwo kple ɖoɖonu geɖe dome ƒe ƒoƒo, elabena client aɖe magale be wòatsɔ gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe siawo katã adze o be wòaxɔ dɔ si le ɖoɖon

title: Indexer ƒe dodokpɔ: Zaino vs Ztreamer
description: Zaino kple Ztreamer nye indexer [indexers] eve siwo dea lightwallet gRPC protocol, API si Zcash light gakotoku [wallets] wɔa dɔe be woasynchronise. Axɔ sia ƒo…
text: Indexer ƒe dodokpɔ: Zaino vs Ztreamer Zaino kple Ztreamer nye indexer [indexers] eve siwo dea lightwallet gRPC protocol, API si Zcash light gakotoku [wallets] wɔa dɔe be woasynchronise. Axɔ sia ƒo nu tso ƒe siawo ƒe sɔsɔ me, si wòate ŋu awɔ ake hã: ɖe woɖoa ŋuɖoɖowo ɖeka, ɣeyiɣi si woxɔna be woatu woƒe index, kple ale si wodea gakotokuwo dɔ enumake. Nunya vevi Indexer evea woɖoa ɖoɖonu [chain] ƒe nyatakakawo nyuie. Ŋuɖoɖo siawo katã si woate ŋu akpɔ sɔ kple Zebra la sɔ, eyata gakotokuwo ate ŋu azã wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe. Vovototo siwo wokpɔ la nye wɔnɔnɔwo kple nɔnɔme siwo menye gbe sia gbe o: vodada ƒe codewo, hash ɖeka ƒe byte ƒe ɖoɖo, ale si woxlẽ gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi [address] si wogbugbɔ, kple JSON-RPC ŋuɖoɖowo ƒe nɔnɔme ʋɛ aɖewo. Ztreamer tua eƒe index kple keke 6× kabakaba wu le CPU ma ke dzi. Zaino dzena ŋuɖoɖoɖe le sekɔnd 6 megbe, esi wòtsɔa biabiawo ɖe Zebra gbɔ le esime wòle eƒe index tum. Ztreamer dea dɔ kabakaba le nɔnɔme siawo katã si wodɔ kpɔ la me: gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒewo [blocks] geɖe wu 13–17× le sekɔnd ɖeka me le gakotoku blibo ƒe download me. Zaino ƒe ɣeyiɣi si woxɔna ahã tso socket ƒe ɖoɖo ɖeka si melekpɔ o (TCPNODELAY) me, si tsɔna ms 40 kple biabia geɖe. Woate ŋu awɔe kple fli ɖeka. Nu Si Wosɔ Kple Nuwɔwɔ Tutu Node si le megbe Nu ka ta :-- :-- :-- Zaino 0.10.1 Zebra 6.4.2 (direct backend) Zaino ƒe release si li ke dzi Zaino 0.9.0 Zebra 6.4.2 (direct backend) Version si wodzidzɔ le Ztreamer ƒe sɔsɔ si wotsɔ do go ŋu Ztreamer v0.1.0 Zakura node si wode ɖe eme Ztreamer tag si li ke dzi Ztreamer master Zakura 1.5.1 si wode ɖe eme Nu si Ztreamer ƒe install ƒe mɔfiamewo tua Wo evea zã mɔ vovovowo: Zaino wɔa dɔ abe process bubu ene ɖe Zebra ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo [full node] ƒe gbɔ, exlẽa Zebra ƒe nɔnɔme, eye wòle eya ŋutɔ ƒe index ŋu. Eyae nye indexer le Z3 stack me. Kpɔ Zaino. Ztreamer dea Zakura node (Zebra ƒe fork) ɖe process ma ke me, eye wòle compact-block index ɖe asi. Ale Si Wodzidzɔe Nyatakaka ma ke na ame sia ame. Tutu siawo katã dze egɔme tso Zcash Foundation testnet snapshot ma ke me, si wode te le kɔkɔƒe 4,382,897, eyata wo katã wɔ index le ɖoɖonu ma ke ŋu. Ame sia ame ate ŋu awɔe ake. Nu siawo katã wɔa dɔ le GitHub-hosted runnerwo siwo menye ga o dzi: wɔ repository la ƒe fork eye nàƒu workflow ɖeka du. Wɔwɔ etɔ na tutu ɖe sia ɖe, tso index si meɖe asi o me. Server kple load generator la wɔa dɔ le CPU core vovovo dzi. Mɔdzidzɔ: lightwallet-protocol gRPC ƒe method 20 katã (test case 274), wosɔ wo byte ɖe byte le tutuwo dome eye wokpɔ wo sɔ kple Zebra ƒe JSON-RPC. JSON-RPC method 28 si Zaino dea dɔe la hã wokpɔ. Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe kabakaba: ɣeyiɣi kple nu siwo wodzã be woatu index, biabia ɖe sia ɖe ƒe ɣeyiɣi, gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒewo ƒe throughput, klient 1 va se 128, kple gakotoku blibo ƒe download tso Sapling activation yi tip. Emetsotso Index tutu Woxɔ etiti le wɔwɔ etɔ me: Tutu Index wowu Ŋuɖoɖo gbãtɔ Index ƒe lolome le disk dzi :-- --: --: --: Zaino 0.10.1 1,395 s 6 s 22.06 GiB Zaino 0.9.0 1,211 s 6 s 22.06 GiB Ztreamer v0.1.0 216 s 210 s 1.44 GiB Ztreamer master 159 s 158 s 1.44 GiB Zaino mate ŋu azã zi gbãtɔe, elabena wòtsɔa biabiawo ɖo Zebra gbɔ le esime wòle index la tum. Ztreamer mede dɔ aɖeke o vaseɖe esi eƒe index la wo wu. Le CPU model ma ke dzi, Zaino 0.10.1 xɔ ɣeyiɣi 6–6.5× wu Ztreamer v0.1.0, eye wòzã CPU ƒe ɣeyiɣi 7.5–8× (Zebra hã le eme). Dɔde asi Woxɔ etiti le wɔwɔ etɔ me, le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒewo le sekɔnd ɖeka me, negbe woɖo eƒe bubu: Nɔnɔme Zaino 0.10.1 Ztreamer v0.1.0 :-- --: --: Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 1,000 11,414 179,486 Gakotoku blibo ƒe download (280,000 → tip) 11,124 189,041 Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 1,000, klient 128 110,093 229,527 Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ɖeka, klient 128 (biabiawo/s) 6,843 11,044 Kple klient 128 la, vovototo la gbɔna ɖe 2× ŋu, elabena server evea wokaka wo ɖe CPU core eve ko ŋu. Ms 40 ƒe teƒe Le Zaino dzi la, RPC 12 dometɔ 6 ƒe median latency le ms 40 ƒe akpa, eye RPC sia sia ƒe percentile 99 le ms 41 ƒe akpa. Eƒe tae nye ale si Zaino ɖoa eƒe gRPC listener: TCPNODELAY socket option la mede dzi o, eyata operati

title: Ironwood
description: Ironwood wo dze egɔme le Zcash mainnet dzi le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 3,428,143 dzi le July 28, 2026 UTC, eye wòle dɔ wɔm tso ɣeyiɣi ma me.
text: Ironwood Ironwood wo dze egɔme le Zcash mainnet dzi le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 3,428,143 dzi le July 28, 2026 UTC, eye wòle dɔ wɔm tso ɣeyiɣi ma me. Nusi nàxlẽ tso eme nye: nusi Ironwood trɔ, alekee ŋudzedze si le ga si woɣe ɖa me le vevie, kple ale si gaɖoɖowo ƒe xexlẽdzikpɔɖeƒe [turnstile] na ame sia ame ate ŋu akpɔe ɖe edzi be womeda ZEC aɖeke o. Ironwood nye Zcash mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ network upgrade, si woyɔe le nyateƒe me be NU6.3, eye wòtsɔ ɣaɣla [shielded] gaƒuƒoƒo [pool] yeye si ŋkɔe nye ma ke va. ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo nye ga si ƒe asimekaka kple ame siwo tɔe wole be woɣe wo dometɔ ɖa kple zero-knowledge cryptography ƒe ƒuƒoƒo. Ironwood li be wòakpɔ ŋudzedze si le ɖoɖonu ƒe nyateƒenyenye me si woɖe kpɔ le Orchard ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo me la dzi, eye wòana nutoa ƒe amewo mɔ sesĩe wu be woakpɔe ɖe edzi be ZEC ƒe ga blibo la le nyateƒe me. Womeɖo gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi [consensus] ƒe sewo ɖe ZIP 258 me. Nukatae esia le vevie. Le ga si ƒe ʋuʋuɖi [transparent] le kekeake abe Bitcoin ene me la, ame sia ame ate ŋu axlẽ akɔnta si woɖe fia na amewo la akpɔe ɖe edzi be womeda ga aɖeke o. Ga si wòle ɣaɣla me ɣe asimekaka la ɖa, eyata mèate ŋu akpɔe kple ŋku ko o. Le esia ta la, ele be cryptography ŋutɔ naɖo kpe ɖe edzi be ame aɖeke mate ŋu awɔ ga ɣeɣe o. Ironwood le vevie elabena woɖe ŋudzedze kpɔ le kaɖedzi sia me le Orchard gaƒuƒoƒo ta. Mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ sia tɔ agbɔ dzi le fifia, eye wòna ame sia ame mɔ be wòakpɔe ɖe edzi be ZEC ƒe ga blibo la le nyateƒe me. Èye yɔe le Zcash me? Dze egɔme kple Nu kae nye ZEC kple Zcash kple Ɣaɣla Gaƒuƒoƒowo, eye nàtrɔ va afi sia. Nukatae wòhia be Ironwood nanɔ anyi Le May 2026 ƒe nuwuwu me la, dedienɔnɔƒe ƒe nudzidziɖola si wòle ɖeke me o, Taylor Hornby, le protocol ƒe audit si wòwɔ na Shielded Labs ta me la, gblɔ ŋudzedze si le ɖoɖonu ƒe nyateƒenyenye me le Orchard ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo me kple dzidzɔ. Orchard nye Zcash ƒe ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo yeye wu le ɣeyiɣi ma me, eye vodada la le elliptic-curve ƒe akpa aɖe si le eƒe zero-knowledge circuit me, si zazã na Halo 2 ƒe ɖaseɖigbalɛ [proof] wɔwɔ ƒe ɖoɖonu. Ŋudzedze si le ɖoɖonu ƒe nyateƒenyenye me fia be matematiki si ɖo kpe ɖe edzi be gaɖoɖo [transaction] aɖe le nyateƒe me la meɖo kpe ɖe edzi blibo o. Le teori me la, dziɖula aɖe ate ŋu azã vodada la awɔ asimekaka si menye nyateƒe o le Orchard gaƒuƒoƒo me, eye wòazã ga si menye etɔ o, eye ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ [node] biasa aɖeke makpɔ eƒe dziɖoɖo o. Zcash ƒe gaɖoɖowo ƒe xexlẽdzikpɔɖeƒe hã wɔ se na asimekaka si ate ŋu ado go tso Orchard me, eyata womate ŋu awɔ ga blibo la nadzi o, ke hã gaƒuƒoƒo la ŋutɔ ƒe cryptography megblɔ be ga si woɣe ɖa siwo katã le eme la nye nyateƒe o. Xexlẽdzesi siwo le dzi la nye nɔnɔmetata bɔbɔe. Vodada vavã la le circuit la ƒe matematiki ƒe akpa aɖe me, menye be woxlẽ ga siwo ge ɖe eme kple siwo ge doa go abe ale ene o. Nu si wòle be nàɖe asi ɖe eme nye be ŋudzedze si le ɖoɖonu ƒe nyateƒenyenye me ate ŋu ana asimekaka nanɔ gaƒuƒoƒo la me wo makpɔe o. Le vevie ŋutɔ la, ɖase aɖeke mele be woɖe vodada la dzi kpɔ o, ɖase aɖeke mele be eɖo nu vɔ̃ ɖe zãlawo ƒe ga dzi o, eye ɖase aɖeke mele be ZEC ƒe ga blibo la trɔ o. Wokpɔe to dedienɔnɔƒe ƒe nudzidzi me, eye wotɔe dɔ le haɖe aɖeke va kpɔ o. Ŋuɖoɖo Zcash nutoa la ɖo nuwɔwɔwo le akpa akpa me, menye zi ɖeka me o. Le June 2026 ƒe gɔmedzedze me la, nuwɔwɔ kpui aɖe tsi Orchard gaƒuƒoƒo la ƒe dɔ wɔwɔ te vaseɖe esime woɖo nuwɔwɔ blibo la ɖo. NU6.2 mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ la trɔ Orchard circuit ŋutɔ, eye wòtɔ ɖoɖonu ƒe nyateƒenyenye ƒe vɔ̃ɖi si le gɔme la. NU6.3 mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ, Ironwood, tsɔ ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo yeye kple akpɔkpɔƒe si amewo katã nakpɔ va, ale be asimekaka nate ŋu ado go tso Orchard gaƒuƒoƒo xoxo me le audit blibo te. Nusi Ironwood gaƒuƒoƒo la wɔna NU6.2 de Orchard circuit la yɔ ɖe gaɖoɖo yeyeawo katã ta, ke asimekaka si woɖe gbe le se xoxoawo te la gale Orchard gaƒuƒoƒo me. Ironwood na asimekaka ma teƒe dzadzɛ kple mɔ si woato awɔ audit le eƒe yiɖoɖo me. Ironwood gaƒuƒoƒo la nye ɣaɣla asimekaka ƒe gaƒuƒoƒo si NU6.3 wɔ le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 3,428,143 dzi. Wotu wò ɖe circuit

title: Ɖe Zcash le Post-Quantum?
description: Tso Ironwood ƒe mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ me la, Zcash nye quantum-recoverable na ga siwo le Ironwood gaƒuƒoƒo me. Esia nye afɔɖeɖe vavã aɖe, gake menye nu ma ke si…
text: Ɖe Zcash le Post-Quantum? Ŋuɖoɖo kpui Ao, menye fifia o. Tso Ironwood ƒe mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ me la, Zcash nye quantum-recoverable na ga siwo le Ironwood gaƒuƒoƒo me. Esia nye afɔɖeɖe vavã aɖe, gake menye nu ma ke si nye post-quantum dedienɔnɔ o. ZIP 2005, si nye eƒe se gbadza, gblɔe kple nyateƒe be: trɔtrɔa "meɖe protocol la ɖe quantum ƒe futɔwo ŋu le eɖokui me o". Eɖo Ironwood ƒe gawo ɖe nu ŋu be woate ŋu akplɔ wo ayi to Recovery Protocol si ava le etsɔme me, ne woɖe cryptography si le fifia la ɖa. Axa sia ma nu si Zcash kpɔa fifia, nu si Ironwood trɔ, nu si gale afia, kple nu si nye ɖoɖo koe. status table si le nuwuwu gbɔ la fia afisi akpa sia akpa le kple ɣeyiɣi si wotsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu mlɔeba. Ame kawoe wotu e ɖe wo ta Ame sia ame si se "quantum-recoverable" eye woxlẽe be "quantum-proof" Ga ƒe dzilawo siwo le ɖoɖo wɔm be woakplɔ ga ayi Ironwood me Nuŋlɔlawo kple moderatorwo siwo hia ŋuɖoɖo si ƒe nuɖoɖowɔƒe le be woafia amewo Ne wòdi gɔmeɖeɖe tso quantum computing ŋutɔ ŋu la, dze egɔme kple Post-Quantum Security le Zcash. Nu ka ta biabia sia le vɔvɔ̃ Wozãa "Post-quantum" abe ne enye nɔnɔ ƒe ɖeka ene. Na Zcash la, biabia vovovo ene koŋ le esia me, eye woƒe ŋuɖoɖowo vovovo: Ɣaɣla [Privacy]. Ɖe quantum ƒe futɔ ate ŋu akpɔ ame si xe fɛ na ame kae kple fɛ si woxe? Gazaza [Spending]. Ɖe quantum ƒe futɔ ate ŋu azã ga si menye etɔ o? Gaƒe dziyiyi [Inflation]. Ɖe quantum ƒe futɔ ate ŋu awɔ ZEC tso naneke me? Gaxɔxɔ [Recovery]. Ne wòwɔ be woate ŋu aɖe cryptography si le fifia la ɖa la, ɖe dzilawo ate ŋu aɖe woƒe gaawo ado go? Ironwood trɔ ŋuɖoɖo si le biabia ene lia ko, eye esia le didienuwo siwo le Ironwood gaƒuƒoƒo me ko ŋu. Fifiamea si le esia katã megbe nye futɔ si ate ŋu awɔ discrete logarithm le elliptic curves siwo Zcash zã la dzi. Quantum computer gã aɖe si le Shor's algorithm wɔm ate ŋu anye mɔ ɖeka si wòato awɔe. ZIP 2005 fia be ne wòkpɔ ɖeka discrete logarithm ko la, esia dze egɔme be wòate ŋu awɔ ga ƒe dziyiyi si meɖoɖo mele o alo afi ga. Nu si Zcash kpɔa fifia Kplɔlawo sia gblɔ protocol la ƒe nɔnɔ ale si wòle fifia, le futɔ si ate ŋu agbã discrete logarithm ŋu. Ewɔ dɔ na ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo siawo katã, Ironwood hã le eme, elabena Ironwood zã Orchard circuit ma, Halo 2 ɖaseɖigbalɛwo kple RedPallas asidede agbalẽ tewo abe Orchard ene. Nɔnɔ Le quantum ƒe futɔ ŋu egbe Nu si Ironwood trɔ --- --- --- Ɣaɣla Ele teƒe ne futɔa menya wò ɣaɣla gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi o. Ɖaseɖigbalɛwo kple asidede agbalẽ te siwo wogatrɔ wɔnɔa mefia nu bubu aɖeke o. Ne futɔa nya gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi la, ate ŋu aɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ didienu siwo wodo ɖe eŋu, esia gblɔna xoxo siwo wotsɔ ɖe ɖoɖonu dzi hã. Naneke o. ZIP 2005: "Nɔnɔ si le Ɣaɣla ŋu metɔ o na gaƒuƒoƒo aɖeke." Gazaza Womekpɔe ɖe anyi o. Futɔ aɖe ate ŋu awɔ ɖaseɖigbalɛ alo gazaza ƒe asidede agbalẽ te si nye alakpa eye wòafi ga tso ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo aɖeke me, togbɔ be mekɔ gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ma kpɔ hafi o. Naneke haɖe o. Kpɔɖeŋu la ava ne woatrɔ ayi Recovery Protocol si le etsɔme me. Gaƒe dziyiyi Womekpɔe ɖe anyi o. Futɔ aɖe ate ŋu awɔ ɖaseɖigbalɛ si nɔ abe vavã ene eye wòawɔ ZEC le ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo aɖeke me, eye ame aɖeke mate ŋu aŋlɔ esia dzi o. Ɖoɖo ɖeka si le eŋu koe nye gaɖoɖowo ƒe xexlẽdzikpɔɖeƒe: gaƒuƒoƒo aɖeke mate ŋu axe ga akpe wu eƒe balance si woŋlɔ ɖi o. Naneke haɖe o. Ironwood didienuwo le adzɔgbeɖeɖe wɔnɔm na woƒe emetɔwo katã fifia le mɔ si quantum ƒe futɔ mate ŋu awɔ alakpa kplee o, si nye nu si Recovery Protocol si ava la hia be wòana gaƒe ƒe nɔnɔ nakpɔ ɖe anyi. Gaxɔxɔ Sprout, Sapling kple Orchard didienuwo mekpɔ mɔ aɖeke na gaxɔxɔ o. Ne woɖe woƒe protocolwo ɖa la, nu siwo katã gale wo me la mate ŋu akpɔ o. Ironwood didienu ɖe sia ɖe ate ŋu axɔ gake le gɔme. Sapling alo Orchard didienu aɖeke mate ŋu axɔ o. Nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi ZEC nye nya bubu. Eƒe ECDSA asidede agbalẽ tewo ate ŋu anye alakpa ne woanya public key la. Na transparent gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi mamãe la, esia dzɔna zi gbãtɔ si nèzã ga tsoe me, eye ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe hã li esi gaɖoɖo aɖe nɔ mempool me hegblẽ be woakpe ɖe edzi. ZIP 2005 metrɔ naneke le esiawo ŋu o.
