title: Zcash Lightwallet Nodes
description: Ame geɖe kekeawo zãa Zcash to wɔa dɔ kple light wallet, si menɔa blockchain bliboa gɔme o. Le esime ma teƒe la, eƒoa nu kple server si wɔ dɔ ma xoxo. Axa sia…
text: Zcash Lightwallet Nodes TL;DR Ame geɖe kekeawo zãa Zcash to wɔa dɔ kple light wallet, si menɔa blockchain bliboa gɔme o. Le esime ma teƒe la, eƒoa nu kple server si wɔ dɔ ma xoxo. Mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖowo eve le light wallets ƒe subɔsubɔ wɔm egbe: lightwalletd, subɔsubɔ gbãtɔ si wotu kple Go, kple Zaino, indexer yeye si wotu kple Rust. Wò safuiwo menoa wò mɔ̃ dzi o, eye server la mate ŋu azã wò ga alo axle asixɔxɔwo kple nya kpuiawo si le ɣaɣla gaɖoɖowo me o. Nu si server la ate ŋu asrɔ̃e nyuiee lae nye wò IP address kple wò dɔwɔwɔ ƒe gaƒoƒo — ɣaɣla gaɖoɖowo ɣlãa nu si le blockchain dzi, ke menɣlãa wò kadodo kple server la o. Tor ɖea IP dzesi la ɖa; eŋu wɔnɔ wallet siwo wotu ɖe zcashclientbackend dzi me, eye le ZODL me la, e nye ɖoɖo le Advanced Settings me. Àte ŋu atrɔ server si wò gakotoku zãa, alo nàwɔ tɔwò — lightwalletd kple Zaino siaa nye mɔ̃ si le fɔfɔ̃e. Nyati Gbegbe Ame geɖe kekeawo zãa Zcash to wɔa dɔ kple light wallet, si menɔa blockchain bliboa gɔme o. Le esime ma teƒe la, eƒoa nu kple server si wɔ dɔ ma xoxo. Axa sia aɖe nyateƒe le server siawo ŋu, nu si woate ŋu akpɔ tso gbɔwò kple nu si womate ŋu akpɔ o, aleke nàto wò kadodo ɖe Tor dzi, kple aleke nàtrɔ server si wò gakotoku zãa. Mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖowo eve le light wallets ƒe subɔsubɔ wɔm egbe. lightwalletd nye subɔsubɔ gbãtɔ, si wotu kple Go. Zaino nye indexer yeye si wotu kple Rust, eye wotu eŋu le zcashd ƒe deprecation dɔwɔwɔ me. Nu si light wallet server wɔa Light wallet server nɔa wò gakotoku kple Zcash blockchain dome, eye wònaa ɖoɖonu la ƒe nukpɔkpɔ si me data ƒe zãzã medze dɔ ge o. Ewɔ nu etɔ na wò. Enaa compact blocks. Le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒewo bliboa teƒe la, eɖoa wɔnɔnu si kplɔ nu si gakotoku hia ko, be wòanya fexexe si va na eƒe ɣaɣla gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi, nya dzi be woza eƒe didienuwo, eye wòatrɔ eƒe witnesses. Etsɔa wò gaɖoɖowo yi. Ne nèɖo ga la, wò gakotoku naa gaɖoɖo si woɖo nu blibo la server la, eye server la ɖee gbe le network la me. Eɖoa biabiawo ŋu tso ɖoɖonu la ŋu, abe fifi ƒe kɔkɔme kple adzɔ ƒe nyatakaka si wò gakotoku hia ene. Wò gakotoku gale asixɔxɔ dɔa wɔm le afi si nèle. Etsɔa wò safuiwo ɖe asi, eɣe ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒewo ŋu be wòakpɔ wò didienuwo, eye wòwɔa eye wòdea asi gaɖoɖowo ŋu le wò mɔ̃ dzi. Nu si server la ate ŋu akpɔ kple nu si mate ŋu akpɔ o Eyae nye akpa si wòasu be woawɔ vodada le. Wò safuiwo menoa wò mɔ̃ dzi o, ke esia menye be server la mesrɔ̃ naneke tso gbɔwò o. Nya si woɖo le afi sia nye Zcash gakotoku app ƒe threat model, si nyo be nàxlẽ blibo ne esia le vevie na wò. Eɖe futɔwo ƒe ƒomevi vovovowo fia. Esi le vevie na axa sia nye futɔ si ate ŋu awɔ kpɔkpɔ ɖe traffic si le wò gakotoku kple internet dome, kple si le server la kple internet dome. Ame si nɔa server la dzi la le teƒe ma ƒe akpa me le wɔnɔtɔe me, elabena wò gakotoku kpena ɖe eŋu tẽe. Míadze egɔme kple nu si woɣlã. Le futɔ siawo katã ŋu, tso wɔnɔtɔ si ɖo server la ɖe asi me hã, "mate ŋu asrɔ̃ naneke tso user la ƒe cryptographic key material (spending keys, viewing keys, seed phrase, etc.) ŋu o", mate ŋu afi wò ga o, eye mate ŋu awɔ be nàɖo ga si mewɔa be nàɖo o. Asixɔxɔwo kple nya kpuiawo si le ɣaɣla gaɖoɖowo blibo me la gale ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ me. Emegbe la, nu si woɣlã o lae nye. Threat model la bu esiawo be wonye gbɔdzɔdzɔ siwo woanya tso traffic ƒe kpɔla ƒe ŋu: Gbɔdzɔdzɔ Aleke :-- :-- Nyanya ame si nèle "Futɔ la nya user la ƒe IP address, si ate ŋu akplɔ wo yi user la ƒe ame dzidzɔtɔ gbɔ" Nyanya afi si nèle ƒe teƒe kɔkɔe Wòɖea wò IP address kpɔ "le geolocation database me be woaɖo eƒe teƒe kɔkɔe" Nyanya be nèɖo alo nèxɔ ɣaɣla gaɖoɖo, kple gaƒoƒo si me wòwɔe Gaɖoɖo "zãa bandwidth geɖe, si doa ŋku na ame, togbɔ be woɣlã kadodo la". Model la de dzesi be gaɖoɖo kple xɔxɔ ƒe wɔwɔ doa ŋku na server la ŋutɔ Bu gaɖoɖo nenie nèwɔ le ɣeyiɣi me Bandwidth ƒe nɔnɔ ma ke, si woakpɔ le ɣeyiɣi didi me Kpɔ fexexe ƒe nɔnɔ si gbugbɔna Kpɔkpɔ ɖe ɣeyiɣi si me dɔwɔwɔ wɔa Ɖoɖo be gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi aɖe nye tɔwò Futɔ si nya gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi aɖe xoxo "ate ŋu aɖo ga yi gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ma dzi eye wòakpɔ be band

title: NU5
description: NU5 de dze egɔme le Zcash mainnet dzi le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 1,687,104 (May 31, 2022 UTC).
text: NU5 NU5 de dze egɔme le Zcash mainnet dzi le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 1,687,104 (May 31, 2022 UTC). Nu si nànya le esia me nye: ale si NU5 na Zcash gaƒuƒoƒo ɣaɣla yeye si me mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖo xexlẽnuwo mele o, kple gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ƒomekuku ɖeka si wɔa dɔ le gaƒuƒoƒowo katã me. NU5 (Network Upgrade 5) nye Zcash ƒe mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ ene, si ZIP 252 wɔ. E nye cryptography ƒe mɔ̃trɔ gã aɖe. Etsɔ Orchard fexexe ɣaɣla ƒe protocol va, si wotu ɖe Halo 2 ɖaseɖigbalɛ wɔwɔ ƒe ɖoɖo dzi, kple Unified Addresses kple gaɖoɖo ƒe ƒome 5 ƒe nɔnɔme yeye. NU5 do go le Electric Coin Company ƒe zcashd v5.0.0 ƒe tatã me. Nu ka tae esia le vevie. Gaƒuƒoƒo ɣaɣla ƒe dzideƒo le abe mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖo xexlẽnuwo si wɔe ene. Zcash ƒe gaƒuƒoƒo ɣaɣla gbãtɔ eve, Sprout kple Sapling, hiã mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖo xexlẽnuwo ƒe kɔnu ɖeka ƒe kpekpe be woawɔ wo ƒe nya siwo le ɣa me. Ne womegbã nya mawo kpɔ o eye wotsɔe ɖe asi ɖe te, ame aɖe ate ŋu awɔ ZEC ƒe atsyɔ̃tso siwo menye vavã o, eye ame aɖeke makpɔe o. NU5 ƒe Orchard gaƒuƒoƒo na ŋɔdzi ma yi le Halo 2 ɖaseɖigbalɛ wɔwɔ ƒe ɖoɖo si me kpekpe ma ƒomevi aɖeke mele o la zazã me. Mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖo xexlẽnuwo Orchard nye protocol ɣaɣla si NU5 tsɔ va, si woɖe fia le ZIP 224 me. Wotu e ɖe Halo 2 ɖaseɖigbalɛ wɔwɔ ƒe ɖoɖo dzi, si zazãa mɔ aɖe si woyɔna be PLONKish arithmetization le Pallas kple Vesta curve cycle dzi. Nu si míaate ŋu akpɔ tso eme kɔŋ nye: Halo 2 me mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖo xexlẽnuwo kple structured reference string mele o, ale nya ɣa aɖeke si woate ŋu azã vɔ̃ o mele o. Sprout kple Sapling katã ɖo asi ɖe mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖo xexlẽnuwo dzi. Ameha aɖe wɔ kpekpe be woawɔ gaƒuƒoƒo siawo ƒe nya, eye womia be ame mawo dome atɔ̃ ɖeka koe gbã eƒe akpa si le ɣa. Orchard ɖe susu ma ɖa. Gaƒuƒoƒo xoxoawo gali le NU5 megbe hã, eyata mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖo xexlẽnuwo manɔ o ƒe laylayla la ku ɖe ga si nèle Orchard gaƒuƒoƒo me la dzi. Nu si NU5 trɔ NU5 na gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi ƒe tɔtrɔ geɖe va ƒoƒo, eye wo katã dze egɔme ɖeka le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 1,687,104. Etsɔ Orchard gaƒuƒoƒo ɣaɣla (ZIP 224) va, si nye Halo 2 dzi wotu ƒe protocol si woɖe fia le afisia. Etsɔ gaɖoɖo ƒe ƒome 5 nɔnɔme (ZIP 225) va, si nye nɔnɔme si woɖo ɖe ɖoɖo yeye me, kple teƒe vovovo na nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi, Sapling, kple Orchard ƒe nyawo. Woɖe Sprout ƒe ƒeƒewo ɖa, eye ƒome 4 xoxo la gaɖo dzi ɖe dɔmedzoe megbe. Etsɔ Unified Addresses kple nukpɔsafui siwo woɖo ƒoƒo va (ZIP 316), si míaadzro le akpa si kplɔe ɖo me. Etsɔ gaɖoɖo ƒe dzesi ƒe non-malleability (ZIP 244) de dɔme, si nye mɔ̃ yeye si me wowɔna gaɖoɖo ƒe id, si ma wonu si gaɖoɖo la wɔ la tso ɖaseɖigbalɛwo kple asidede agbalẽ te siwo na mɔ̃e la gbɔ. Etsɔ Jubjub point encodings siwo le standard me (ZIP 216) de dɔme be woaɖe encoding siwo menye standard o ɖa eye woana sewo siwo gblɔ nu si woxɔ abe gaɖoɖo vavã ene la nakpɔ ŋusẽ. Ena mɔ̃ be woaɖe gaɖoɖo ƒome 5 dzi le peer-to-peer network la katã (ZIP 239). NU5 hã trɔ ZIP xoxowo dometɔ geɖe (32, 203, 209, 212, 213, 221, kple 401) be woabu Orchard gaƒuƒoƒo yeye la ɖe eme. Unified Addresses Do ŋgɔ na NU5, gaƒuƒoƒo ɖe sia ɖe nɔ gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ƒomekuku tɔe, eye ele be ame si le ga dzom na wò la nanya ƒomekuku si nèdi. Unified Addresses, si woɖe fia le ZIP 316 me, trɔ esia. Unified Address ɖeka ate ŋu aɖo receiverwo ƒoƒo na gaƒuƒoƒo ɖeka kple bubuwo, ale ame si le ga dzom la ƒe gakotoku ti ɖeka si wòate ŋu awɔ dɔ kpli. Nukpɔsafui siwo woɖo ƒoƒo la wɔa dɔ nenema hã na nukpɔkpɔ. Wona mɔ̃ be woakpɔ nuwo le gaƒuƒoƒo siwo gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi aɖe ɖo ƒoƒo la katã me, gake womate ŋu atrɔ naneke o. Ne nàdi nya bubu tso esia ŋu la, kpɔ Nukpɔsafuiwo ƒe axa. Afisi NU5 le NU5 va de Zcash ƒe mɔ̃trɔ siwo va do ŋgɔ la yome: Overwinter, Sapling, Blossom, Heartwood, kple Canopy. Ede dɔme le mainnet dzi le May 31, 2022. Wotia Orchard ƒe curve cycle elabena ekpe ɖe recursion ŋu, si nye gɔmedzedze na nu ƒe dziyiyi ƒe dɔ siwo ava emegbe. NU5 nye mɔ̃trɔ si do ŋgɔ ŋutɔ na NU6 kple NU6.x ƒe mɔ̃trɔwo, siwo tu ɖe Orchard gaƒuƒoƒo dzi eye wotrɔe emegbe. Nu veviwo keke NU5 dze dɔme le mainnet dzi le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 1,687,104 (May 31, 2022 UTC) — Zcash ƒe kriptografi [cryptograph

title: NU6
description: NU6 de dzi le Zcash mainnet dzi le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 2,726,400 (November 23, 2024 UTC).
text: NU6 NU6 de dzi le Zcash mainnet dzi le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 2,726,400 (November 23, 2024 UTC). Nu si nànyae: Ale si Zcash yina edzi doa ga na eya ŋutɔ ƒe ŋgɔyiyi le fetu ƒe afãmama megbe, nusita wòɖo gaƒeɖeɖe ɖi si wòmenya ale si wòazãe haɖe o, kple ale si wòwɔ ZEC ƒe xexlẽdidime katã zu nu si woate ŋu anya tututu. NU6 nye Zcash mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ, si ZIP 253 wɔ, eye wòdzra edzi le mainnet dzi le November 2024 me le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 2,726,400. Enye ga ƒe kple ŋgɔyiyi ƒe gadodo ƒe mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ: Ewɔe be gaƒeɖeɖe si yina le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe fetu me yi ŋgɔyiyi me nanɔ anyi le November 2024 ƒe fetu ƒe afãmama megbe, wòɖo gaƒeɖeɖe le protocol me na emegbe ƒe nɔnɔ si hatsotso la aɖo ŋu, eye wòsẽ ale si woexlẽ ZEC yeye ɖe eme. NU6 kpɔ dzidzɔ le Electric Coin Company kple Zcash Foundation siaa gbɔ. Nusita esia le vevie. Woɖo ɖe Zcash ƒe ŋgɔyiyi ƒe Gaƒuƒoƒo nu be wòakpɔ nu le November 2024 ƒe fetu ƒe afãmama ŋu, si nye evelia le eƒe ŋutinya me. NU6 wɔe be gadodo ma yi edzi, gake teƒe be wòana ga sia katã na amesiwo woɖo ɖi la, wòɖo eƒe akpa ɖe protocol la me be hatsotso la nate ŋu aɖo ŋu emegbe be alekee woazãe. Ewɔe hã be xexlẽ ƒe vovototo si menɔ gbeɖe o nɔ o, ale be ZEC si anɔ anyi gbeɖeka katã ƒe lolome ate ŋu woanya tututu fifia. Kpuie ko (TL;DR) NU6 dze dɔwɔwɔ gɔme le mainnet (Zcash ƒe ɖoɖonu vevitɔ) dzi le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 2,726,400 (November 23, 2024 UTC), eye ZIP 253 ye ɖo eŋu. Ena gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe fetu ƒe 20% yi edzi nɔ yiyim na ŋgɔyiyi le November 2024 ƒe fetu ƒe afãmama megbe: 8% yi na Zcash Community Grants (ZCG), eye 12% yi Ŋgɔyiyi ƒe Gadzraɖoƒe si Wotsɔ Ɖo Hena Emegbe (Deferred Dev Fund Lockbox) yeye la me (ZIP 2001). Gadzraɖoƒe sia nye gadzraɖoƒe si le protocol la ŋutɔ me, eye womeɖo ame si ate ŋu azã ga la o. NU6 gblẽ dziɖuɖu ƒe nyabiase sia ɖi ɖe ɖoɖo nu, eye NU6.1 (2025) ɖo eŋu emegbe. Fifia ZIP 236 bia be coinbase gaɖoɖo (gaɖoɖo gbãtɔ si me nukulawo xɔa woƒe fetu le) ɖesiaɖe ƒe akɔntabubu nadze pɛpɛpɛ. Esia wɔe be nukulawo mate ŋu axɔ ga si sue wu esi dze na wo, eye woatsrɔ̃ ZEC to vodada me o. Ale woate ŋu anya ga si katã ado le etsɔme la pɛpɛpɛ. Gaxɔxɔwo, ɣaɣla, kple gaɖoɖo ƒe sewo metrɔ o: NU6 nye trɔtrɔ si ku ɖe gadodo kple akɔntabubu ŋu. Kpɔɖeŋu si wokpɔna kple ŋku Bu NU6 ŋu abe aƒeme aɖe si nɔ ga tɔxɛ aɖe xem na eƒe xɔtulawo, eye wònya be fexexe ƒe ŋkekea ava wu enu le ɣeyiɣi si woɖo me la ene. Le esi teƒe be NU6 nadzudzɔ fexexe la, emae ma ga la: akpa aɖe yi edzi yina na nutoa me ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe dɔwɔha la, eye akpa bubu yina ƒome ƒe gakɔ aɖe si ƒe ʋuʋudzesi womegaɖe gbeƒã kpɔ o la me. Gakɔ la dzra ga la ɖo vaseɖe esime aƒemetɔwo alɔ̃ ɖe se siwo nu woaʋu gakɔ la le dzi emegbe — ɖekawɔwɔ ma enye NU6.1. Nu si NU6 trɔ NU6 yi edzi nɔ ɖom gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe fetu ƒe 20% na ŋgɔyiyi ƒe gadodo le November 2024 ƒe fetu ƒe afãmama megbe, se si woɖe fia le ZIP 1015 me. Wòmama 20% ma me le mɔ eve. Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe fetu ƒe 8% yina na Zcash Community Grants (ZCG), si doa ga na dɔ si hatsotso la wɔ kple dɔ si woewɔ na hatsotso la. 12% yina ɖe gaƒeɖeɖe yeyee si le protocol me me, si woɖo ɖi na emegbe ƒe zãzã si hatsotso la aɖo ŋu. Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe fetu ƒe akpa si susɔ, kple gaɖoɖo ƒe adzɔwo, yina na nukulawo siwo le network la ŋu ɖaa. NU6 trɔ gadodo ƒe ƒliawo kple dev-fund ƒe se siwo nɔ anyi xoxo (ZIP 207 kple ZIP 214) hã be woawɔ ɖeka kple ɖoɖo yeye sia. Gaƒeɖeɖe si woɖo ɖe emegbe 12% ƒe akpa lae nye susu yeye le NU6 me. Teƒe be woaxe ga na ame aɖe ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi, woɖo ga ma ɖe gaƒuƒoƒo si le protocol me tẽ, si woyɔ be Deferred Dev Fund Lockbox, eye woɖe fia le ZIP 2001 me. Lockbox la nye gadodo ƒe ƒomevi yeye (DEFERREDPOOL), afi si gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe fetu ƒe ga yina ɖe protocol la ŋutɔ me, menye ame alo habɔbɔ aɖe gbɔ o. Network la le exlẽm abe eya ŋutɔ ƒe ɖoɖonu ƒe ga ƒuƒoƒo ƒe nɔnɔ ene, abe ale si wòle ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒowo ƒe nɔnɔwo xlem ene. NU6 wɔ lockbox la le ta me, gake wòde biabia sesẽ la ɖe aƒe: Ame kae dziɖuɖu le ga mawo ŋu, eye alekee woaɖe woaɖa? Woɖo ŋu biabia ma emegbe to NU6.1 me, si ɖo dziɖuɖu la ɖi

text: NU6.1 NU6.1 de dzi le Zcash mainnet dzi le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 3,146,400 (November 24, 2025 UTC). Nusi nànyae nye: ale si Zcash xɔa ga na eŋutɔ ƒe ŋgɔyiyi ne habɔbɔ aɖeke mele dzikpɔm o, kple ale si NU6.1 na hamea kple coin ƒe nɔlawo nyaɖoɖo tɔxɛ le ga sia ŋu. NU6.1 nye Zcash mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ, si wo ɖe fia le ZIP 255 me, eye wòɖo ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu kple dziɖuɖu [governance] ƒe mɔ̃ yeye ɖe Zcash ƒe ŋgɔyiyi ta. Etsɔa gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe fetu ƒe akpa aɖe dea afisi wòayi kple ame siwo ana dziɖuɖu le eŋu, eye wòtsɔ mɔ̃ ƒe dzidzɔsɔŋu sue aɖewo hã va. Zcash nye ha nuɖo agni [decentralized] network si me tɔxɛ ɖeka aɖeke mele o, eyata biabia sesẽ aɖe le eŋu: Aleke wòaxɔ ga na amewo siwo gale eƒom le mɔ̃ si hamea axɔ dzi se le ŋu? NU6.1 nye Zcash ƒe ŋuɣi sia ƒe ŋuɖoɖo. Kpuie ko (TL;DR) NU6.1 dze egɔme le mainnet (Zcash ƒe kɔsɔkɔsɔ vevitɔ) dzi le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 3,146,400 me (November 24, 2025 UTC), eye woɖe eme le ZIP 255 me. Sewo (ZIP 1016) awɔ dɔ va se ɖe Zcash ƒe fetu ƒe afãmama etɔ̃lia dzi, eye esia na ɣeyiɣi nutoa me tɔwo be woalé ŋku ɖe wo ŋu hafi awɔ wo woanɔ anyi tegbee alo atrɔ wo. Gaɖolawo katã ƒo ƒu tsoa nya me be yewoaɖe 12% gadzraɖoƒea ɖe asi na dɔwɔwɔ le ecosystem (dɔwɔha si ƒo xlã Zcash) me alo yewoatu enu ɖe dzi. Kpɔɖeŋu si wokpɔna kple ŋku NU6.1 trɔa ƒome ƒe gakpeɖeƒe si le NU6 ŋutinya me wòzua akɔnta si wokpɔa egbɔ kple se siwo woŋlɔ ɖi. 12% ƒe akpa la megazua "ga si ame aɖeke mate ŋu aka asi o" o, ke boŋ ezua "ga si ŋu gadzraɖolawo [shareholders] dea akɔ le": woaɖee ɖi hena dɔwɔwɔ le ƒuƒoƒo blibo la me alo woanɔ te ɖe edzi wòanɔ ɖaɖi. 8% si yina na hamea ƒe ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu [grants] la yia edzi le eɖokui si, abe ɖoɖo si nɔa anyi ɖaa ene — mehiã akɔdada aɖeke o. Ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe mɔ̃ NU6.1 ma gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe fetu sia sia me akpa etɔ. Akpa gãtɔ, alo 80 percent kple vi, yia nukulawo [miners] gbɔ, ame siwo doa network la ɖe anyi. 8 percent yia Zcash Community Grants (ZCG) gbɔ, si xɔa ga na dɔ si hamea wɔ kple dɔ si wo wɔ na hamea. 12 percent yia gaƒuƒoƒo yeye aɖe me si coin ƒe nɔlawo wɔa dziɖuɖu le eŋu, eye Deferred Dev Fund Lockbox naa eƒe gɔmedzedze. Mɔ̃ sia ƒe sewo wo ɖe fia le ZIP 1016 me, eye wòanɔ anyi va se ɖe Zcash ƒe fetu ƒe afãmama [halving] etɔlia me, si naa hamea ɣeyiɣi be woakpɔ ale si wòwɔna hafi woatsɔe aɖo anyi tegbee alo woatrɔe. title: NU6.2
description: NU6.2 de dɔwɔwɔ dzi le Zcash mainnet dzi le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 3,364,600 (June 3, 2026 UTC).
text: NU6.2 NU6.2 de dɔwɔwɔ dzi le Zcash mainnet dzi le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 3,364,600 (June 3, 2026 UTC). Nusi nànya: Nu si NU6.2 ɖo ɖe enu, nusita Zcash tsi ɣaɣla [shielded] gaɖoɖowo teƒe abe ŋkeke ɖeka ene, kple ale si network la tɔ agbɔgblɔ la mezi ga aɖeke o. NU6.2 nye Zcash mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ, si woɖo ɖe eme nyuie le ZIP 257 me, eye wògaɖe mɔ na Orchard ɣaɣla protocol la azɔ le dzidzɔkpɔ ƒe tsiɖiɖi tsɔtsɔme vɔ megbe. Eɖo soundness ƒe vodada le Orchard ƒe zero-knowledge circuit me, eye wòtrɔ ɖo ɣaɣla gaɖoɖowo. Bu eŋu abe Orchard ƒe vodada ƒe nyateƒe me xexlẽdzikpɔɖeƒe ƒe akpa si wɔ dzidzɔkpɔ ƒe dɔawo ene. Mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ si va do ɖe eŋgɔ, Ironwood (NU6.3), tsɔ gaƒuƒoƒo [pool] yeye kple xexlẽdzikpɔɖeƒe si amewo katã ate ŋu akpɔ kpe ɖe eŋu va. Nu si ta ŋu. Orchard nye afi si Zcash ƒe ɣaɣla [private] fexexe [payments] geɖe va eme le. Ne woxɔ vodada aɖe le matematik si dea gaƒuƒoƒo [pool] ma dzidzɔ la me, network la nɔ tiatia sesẽ aɖe ŋkume: woana ɣaɣla [shielded] gaɖoɖo [transactions]wo nakpɔ mɔ wɔa dɔ kple afɔku si woenya la, alo woatso mɔ na wo va se ɖe esi wole be wodzrae ɖo. NU6.2 nye ale si Zcash tsɔ tia dedie gbã eye wòɖo ɣaɣla [privacy] ɖe te le ŋkeke ɖeka me. Kpuie ko NU6.2 dze dɔwɔwɔ gɔme le mainnet dzi le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 3,364,600 (June 3, 2026 UTC) dzi, eye woɖe eme le ZIP 257 me. Egagbugbɔ Orchard ʋu le esi wotɔ te kpata le ŋɔdzi ta megbe: wokpɔ soundness ƒe vodada aɖe le Orchard ƒe Action circuit me le Shielded Labs ƒe nudzrokpɔ me, eye woɖee fia le mɔ nyui nu le May 2026 ƒe nuwuwu me. Soft fork si wowɔ kpata le ŋɔdzi ta le June 2, 2026 (zcashd v6.12.5, zebra v4.5.3) dzi la tɔ te Orchard gaɖoɖowo hena ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe; nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi kple Sapling yi edzi wɔ dɔ. NU6.2 ƒe hard fork ɖɔ circuit la ɖo (etsɔ seɖoƒe si mele eme o la kpe ɖe eŋu), wɔ ɖaseɖigbalɛ dzikpɔsafui yeye si gbea ɖaseɖigbalɛ gbadza xoxowo, eye wòwɔ ɖaseɖigbalɛ ƒe didime tututu wòzu gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi ƒe se. Ga aɖeke mebu alo tɔ te o, eye kpeɖodzi aɖeke meli be ame aɖe zãe ɖe mɔ gbegblẽ nu o; circuit xoxo ƒe asixɔxɔ ƒe nudzrokpɔ nye Ironwood (NU6.3) ƒe dɔ, to gaƒuƒoƒo yeye kple dutoƒo nudzrokpɔ dzi. Kpɔɖeŋu si wokpɔna kple ŋku NU6.2 nye Orchard ƒe ŋutinya ƒe ta si ƒo nu tso ɖɔɖɔɖo kpata ŋu. Bu gakpe ƒe xɔ aɖe si ƒe ʋɔtrunu me wokpɔ vodada sue aɖe le la ŋu: gadzraɖoƒea dzudzɔa xɔ la zazã ŋkeke ɖeka (dzudzɔƒe la), eɖoa ʋɔtrunu yeye si me vodada mele o (circuit yeye kple safui si wotsɔna kpɔa ɖaseɖigbalɛ dzi [verifying key]), eye wògaʋua eme. Nu siwo katã wodzra ɖo do ŋgɔ na ɖɔɖɔɖo la gakpɔtɔ le afima, eye ame aɖeke meka asi wo ŋu o. Gake woalé ŋku ɖe wo ŋu nyuie, eye woaʋu wo ayi gakpe ƒe xɔ yeye aɖe me (Ironwood ƒe gaƒuƒoƒo yeye) le dukɔa ƒe ŋkume. Nu si dzɔ Nu si dze egɔme nye soundness ƒe vodada le Orchard ƒe Action circuit me, si nye matematiki si wòle be wòaɖe ɖase be ɣaɣla gaɖoɖo sia sia wɔ sewo dzi. Nudzɔdzɔla si wɔa dɔ le eɖokui ŋu, Taylor Hornby, kpɔe le Shielded Labs ƒe nudzrokpɔ me, eye wòtsɔe ɖe go nyuie le May 2026 ƒe nuwuwu me. Enɔ afi ma menye ame aɖeke kpɔe o tso esi Orchard dze egɔme le 2022 me, eye le nyateƒe me la, eŋu ate ŋu na gaɖoɖo si menyo o ava dze abe enyɔ ene, si ate ŋu na woafi ga alo woawɔ fexexe ɖeka zi eve le Orchard gaƒuƒoƒo me. Zcash ƒe gaɖoɖowo ƒe xexlẽdzikpɔɖeƒe ƒe xexlẽkpɔkpɔ hã doa teƒe na asixɔxɔ si ate ŋu ado le Orchard me, ale ZEC ƒe ZEC ƒe blibo nuƒoƒo ate ŋu mègɔ keke o, gake vodada le matematiki si naa ɣaɣla ga nɔ nyuie me la nye nu vevie, eyata network la wɔ nu le ŋkeke ʋɛ aɖewo me. Ironwood ƒe axa la ɖe vodada la kple ale si wòate ŋu awɔ asixɔxɔ va dzɔ ɖe fia blibo. Dzidzɔkpɔ ƒe tsiɖiɖi Le June 2, 2026, emergency soft fork aɖe tsi Orchard gaɖoɖowo katã teƒe kpuie. Woɖee ɖe go abe hotfix le zcashd v6.12.5 kple zebra v4.5.3 me. Woɖe mɔ le ɣaɣla Orchard ƒe dɔdɔ kple xɔxɔ ŋu, ale ɖaseɖigbalɛ [proof] Orchard yeye aɖeke mate ŋu ava dzɔ alo woaxɔe o. text: Dzoe nukpɔsafuiwo [Outgoing Viewing Keys] (OVKs) Dzoe nukpɔsafui (OVK) nye asinu si le byte 32, eye woɖoe be wòana ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ [encryption] na dzoe nya ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ ƒe ɣaɣla [shielded] output ko. Ena be ame aɖe ate ŋu agatrɔ axlẽ didienu [note] ƒe nya gbɔgbɔ si wòɖo ɖa (nudzɔdzɔla ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi [address], asixɔxɔ, kple nya kpui [memo]) tanpa be wòate ŋu ana ga o alo akpɔ didienu siwo va eme o. Nudzɔdzɔla la ƒe nukpɔsafui si va eme le nye si wòtsɔa ɣa nya le didienu si va eme la me ɣe sia ɣe. OVK ƒe tiatia metrɔa nu si nudzɔdzɔla la kpɔ o. Mɔ si dzi woŋlɔa OVK si meku o mele o; eƒe nyae nye byte 32 ko. Nya vevi OVK dea asi ɖe ame si ate ŋu agatrɔ axlẽ fexexe [payment] ɣaɣla ƒe dzoe nya gbɔgbɔ ko ŋu. Gakotokuwo [wallets] tia mɔ etɔ dome: Dɔla (gatrɔxexlẽ ƒe mɔ si le ɖuɖum kple akɔnt ƒe UFVK), Tɔxɛ (gatrɔxexlẽ kple safui si nàtsɔ na), alo Gbegbe (ame aɖeke mate ŋu agatrɔ axlẽ dzoe nya gbɔgbɔ la tso ɖoɖonu [chain] la dzi o). Togbɔ be nàtsɔ Gbegbe alo OVK tɔxɛ hã, UFVK ƒe nɔla la gakpɔ didienu siwo woza kple ate ŋu abu ga si do le akɔnt la me ƒe xexlẽ blibo. Mɔ ɖeka si katã dzi wòate ŋu aɖe ga aɖe ɖa tso UFVK aɖe ŋkume nye be nàkpɔe be didienuwo mekpɔa akɔnt ma ƒe tɔ o (akɔnt vovotɔ alo gakotoku vovotɔ). text: Overwinter Overwinter dze egɔme le Zcash mainnet dzi le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 347,500 (June 26, 2018 UTC). Nu si nàsrɔ̃: ale si Zcash srɔ̃ be yeatrɔ yeŋutɔ ƒe sewo le dedienyi me, kple nusita dzadzraɖo sia wɔ be mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ [network upgrade] siwo va emegbe katã, si Sapling dze egɔme kple, nɔ anyi. Overwinter nye Zcash mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ, si nye etɔ̃ gbã le mɔ̃ la ƒe dzedze megbe. Woɖe egɔme le Zcash Improvement Proposals geɖe me: ZIP 200, ZIP 201, ZIP 202, ZIP 203, kple ZIP 143. Overwinter metsɔ ɣaɣla [shielded] ƒe nɔnɔme yeye aɖeke vɛ o. Ke boŋ, ewɔ protocol la sesẽ be mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ siwo ava emegbe mate ŋu ato le dedienyi me. Woŋlɔ mɔ̃ la ƒe sewo ɖe Electric Coin Company dzi le Zcash ƒe upgrade axa oficial dzi. Nusita esia le vevie. Blockchain si le agbe ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ le afɔku me. Ne èwɔe gbegblẽ la, mɔ̃ la ƒe version eve ate ŋu aɖe asi le nu gbɔ, alo woate ŋu akɔpi gaɖoɖo si woɖo na ɖoɖonu [chain] aɖe ɖe bubu dzi. Do ŋgɔ na Overwinter, Zcash menɔ mɔ si wozãna le dedienyi me be woawɔ se trɔtrɔ akpeɖeɖe, eye womaɖe gaɖoɖo gbugbɔzã ƒe mɔ le o. Overwinter wɔe ɖo. Ewɔ mɔ̃ na Zcash be wòanɔ kple mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ ƒe kɔkɔe ƒe mɔ, eye nu si le vevie wu la, eƒo gaɖoɖo gbugbɔzã ƒe mɔ le afia eve, ale be gaɖoɖo si le se ƒe ƒomevi aɖe te la mate ŋu woagbugbɔazãe le se ƒe ƒomevi bubu te o. Dzadzraɖo siae wɔ be Sapling, kple mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ siwo katã va emegbe, te ŋu dze egɔme le nyuie me. Mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ ƒe mɔ Overwinter tsɔ Network Upgrade Mechanism vɛ, si woɖe egɔme le ZIP 200 me. Mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ ɖe sia ɖe ɖea nu eve gɔme fifia: consensus branch id, si nye dzesi kpui aɖe si na se siwo le dzi fifia, kple activation height, si nye gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe si dzi se yeyeawo dze egɔme. Esia na ame sia ame si wɔa Zcash ƒe software be eƒe gaƒomeɖoɖo ƒe ɣeyiɣi nadze ŋgɔ na trɔtrɔ la. Overwinter ŋutɔ dze egɔme le mainnet dzi le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 347,500. Gaɖoɖo gbugbɔzã ƒe mɔƒoƒo Gbugbɔzãe nye ne ame aɖe tsɔ gaɖoɖo si le ɖoɖonu aɖe te la gbugbɔɖo le ɖoɖonu bubu dzi. Ne ènye zazãla yeye aɖe si le Zcash dom kpɔ zi gbãtɔ, alo hadome ƒe membro si nɔ anyi blewu si le gakotokuwɔ siwo nye ɣaɣla sɔ gbɔ dom, Pepper Sync na nɔnɔme la wɔnate ŋu azu nu si wɔa dɔ nyuie eye wɔnate ŋu adzɔ wu. Pepper Sync ƒe nɔnɔme veviwo Pepper Sync tsɔ nyanyui geɖewo va: Sync Si Yia Kaba Ŋutɔ - Wò gakotoku anɔ klalo le minutiwo me, menye gaƒoƒowo me o. Nudzraɖoɖo Si Le Ŋku - Woɖoa data wɔm le akpa suewo me, eye menye rescan blibo o. Ete Ŋu Atsɔ Gbegbeawo - Ne wò kadodo ƒe kaɖedzi tso, sync aga yi edzi tso afi si wòtsɔe tso. Bɔbɔe & Le Asinye - Woɖoe ɖe telefonwo, laptopwo, kple mɔ̃ bubu siwo me ŋusẽ menɔ geɖe o ta. Nya Si Kɔ Wu - Ŋgɔyiyi ƒe nyadzɔdzɔwo le ɣeyiɣi me na vɔvɔ̃ dzɔdo. Ɣaɣla-Dzidze - Gaɖoɖowo siwo nye ɣaɣla nɔa ɣaɣla le nɔnɔme la blibo me. Nu si nyo wu tso tsã Zingo ƒe version xoxoawo ɖe vɔvɔ̃ dzi na zazãlawo zi geɖe kple sync ɣeyiɣi didiwo, vodada ƒe mɔ̃ si mekɔ o, kple mɔ̃ ƒe ŋusẽ zazã geɖe. Pepper Sync trɔa fukpekpe siawo: Nɔnɔme Zingo Ƒe Version Xoxoawo Zingo 2.0 Kple Pepper Sync ------------------ -------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------- Sync Ƒe Kabakaba Edoa megbe, vevie le ɖoɖo gbãtɔ me Sync gbãtɔ kple sync si yia edzi yia kaba ŋutɔ Vodada Ƒe Dzidzeme Tsi tsaɖeɖe aɖewo kple vodada si mekɔ o Asinye nyo wu kple gbɔgbɔɖoɖo si wɔa eɖokui Zazãla Ƒe Nɔnɔme Sync nɔa abe "mekɔ o" ene na ameyeyeawo Enye nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi [transparent], kple status kple nudzraɖoɖo siwo kɔ wu Mɔ̃ Ƒe Dɔwɔwɔ CPU/memory zazã geɖe Woɖoe ɖe mɔ̃ ƒe ŋusẽ zazã bɔbɔe ta Le nu kpuie me: Sync yia kaba, le asinye wu, eye ewɔa bɔbɔe be woase gɔme. Nɔnɔme Kple Ɖeɖeɖe Bu gakotoku xoxo ƒe sync ŋu abe agbalẽ didi aɖe ƒe xexlẽ tso axa gbãtɔ dzi, kple gbeɖiɖi, hafi woana mɔ na wò be nàgblɔ nu tsoe ŋu ene. Ne ètɔ le afã me, àgɔme ake tso axa gbãtɔ dzi. Pepper Sync xlea agbalẽ ma ke, gake etsɔa bookmark ɖoa afia, xlea ta siwo le vevie na wò gbã, eye ena mɔ wò nàgblɔ nu tso nya la ŋu hafi nàwu axa mamlɛtɔ. Bookmark lae nye nu vevi la. Version siwo katã va yi la kpɔ sync si wotɔ la abe dɔ si ƒe dzɔdzɔ katã bu ene; Pepper Sync kpɔa eŋu abe dzudzɔ ene. Nɔnɔme ƒe mɔfiamewo Mɔ̃ Ƒe Nɔnɔme Kɔkɔe - Eɖea mɔ̃ blibo la fia. Nudzɔdzɔ Kpɔtɔ Ale si Pepper Sync wɔa dɔ (nɔnɔme bɔbɔe) Le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu la scan yeye le akpa gã siwo wɔa dɔ kple kuxi me teƒe la, Pepper Sync wɔa dɔ le afɔɖeɖe sue siwo wɔnate ŋu wɔa dɔ me—eye wòle afi si wòto ɖo ɣesiaɣi. title: Quantum Ƒe Dzesidzedze Le Zcash Me
description: Ne wòdi be yeanya nu si Ironwood trɔ kple ɣeyiɣi ƒe nɔnɔ si le akpa sia akpa ŋu la, kpɔ Esia Zcash Nye Post-Quantum?.
text: Quantum Ƒe Dzesidzedze Le Zcash Me TL;DR Quantum kɔmpiutawo nye afɔmevi ƒe afɔku elabena woate ŋu agbã public-key cryptography si gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonuwo zazã egbea. "Post-quantum" fia cryptography si wɔa dɔ le kɔmpiuta mamlɛawo dzi, gake wowɔe be wòatsi tsitre ɖe quantum kɔmpiutawo ƒe afɔmevi ƒe aʋawɔwɔ ŋu. Zcash menye post-quantum bliboa egbea o. Ɣaɣla [shielded] Zcash ɖea gaɖoɖo ƒe nyatakaka si le ŋkeke me be afɔmevi ƒe aʋawɔlawo nasrɔ la dzi, gake ɣaɣla zazã menye quantum ƒe aʋawɔwɔ ƒe tsitrenyawo bliboa o. Zcash le ɖoɖo wɔm to srɔ̃srɔ̃, ZIP-wo, kple mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ [network upgrade] ƒe aɖaŋuwo me, abe ZIP 2005 kple Project Tachyon ene. Post-quantum ƒe dzodzro nyui aɖe le be wòakpɔ ga, ɣaɣla [privacy], gakotokuwo, gatrɔƒewo, kple gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi [consensus] ƒe sewo katã ɖe anyigba ɖeka dzi. Ne wòdi be yeanya nu si Ironwood trɔ kple ɣeyiɣi ƒe nɔnɔ si le akpa sia akpa ŋu la, kpɔ Esia Zcash Nye Post-Quantum?. Nu Nenye Quantum Kɔmpiuta Wɔwɔ? Kɔmpiuta mamlɛ aɖe dzraa nyatakaka le bits me. Bit ɖeka sia ɖe nye 0 alo 1. Quantum kɔmpiuta zãa quantum bits, si woyɔna be qubits. Woate ŋu azã qubits kple algorithm tɔxɛwo be woaɖɔ matematiki ƒe kuxi aɖewo kpɔ kabakaba akpu wu kɔmpiuta mamlɛwo. Esia menye be quantum kɔmpiuta kabakaba wu nu sia nu me o. Afɔku la le teƒe tɔxɛ aɖe. Cryptography aɖewo tsɔ ɖokuinyenye matematiki si sesẽ na kɔmpiuta mamlɛwo, gake si bɔbɔe wu na quantum kɔmpiuta si hãnyuie. Na gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonuwo la, kpɔɖeŋu vevi ŋutɔe nye public-key cryptography. Wozã public keys kple asidede agbalẽ te [signature]-wo be woaɖe kpe edzi be mɔ le mɔ̃zãla aɖe si be wòazã gaawo. Nu Tae Gaɖoɖowo Ƒuƒoƒo Ƒe Ɖoɖonuwo Hia Esia Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonuwo zãa cryptography na dɔ vovovowo: Cryptography ƒe dɔwɔnu Nu si wòwɔ Quantum ƒe ŋusẽ --- --- --- Digital signatures Ɖe kpe edzi be ga ƒe nownerla de mɔ ga zazã Afɔku gã na elliptic-curve ƒe ɖoɖowo si wozã zi geɖe Hash functions Wɔa gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo, adzɔgbeɖeɖewo, Merkle ƒe atiwo, kple biabiawo Afɔku le eŋu sue, gake dzesidzedze ƒe mɔwo le vevie Zero-knowledge proofs Ɖe kpe edzi be ɣaɣla gaɖoɖowo le nyuie, ne menya nyatakakaawo o Etsɔ ɖaseɖigbalɛ [proof] ƒe ɖoɖo kple eƒe ɖoɖoɖiwo Key agreement Kpe ɖe gakotokuwo ŋu be woaɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ didienu ƒe nyatakaka na xɔlawo Ele be woakpɔe nyuie le quantum ƒe afɔku ƒe kpɔɖeŋu te Quantum kɔmpiuta si ŋusẽ le adekuku ate ŋu ado afɔku signature ƒe ɖoɖo geɖe si wozã egbea, eye elliptic-curve signatures hã le eme. Esia le vevie elabena signature enye nu si na network la nya be gaɖoɖo aɖe xɔ mɔ tso key si dze o me. Hash functions vovoe. Grover ƒe algorithm ate ŋu akpɔ kabakaba le brute force didi me, gake megbãa hash functions abe ale si wògbãa wo bubu ene o. Dzesidzedze ƒe mɔ gãwo ate ŋu akpe ɖe ŋu. Nu Nenye Post-Quantum Cryptography? Post-quantum cryptography nye cryptography si wowɔ be wòanɔ dedie tso kɔmpiuta mamlɛwo kple quantum kɔmpiutawo si ava me ŋu. Menye be cryptography la zãa quantum kɔmpiuta o. Egbea be ɖoɖo la tsɔ matematiki ƒe kuxi bubuwo si sesẽ. Le 2024 me la, NIST ɖe post-quantum ƒe dzadzra se gbãtɔwo si wowu wɔnɛ: ML-KEM na key ƒe ɖoɖo ML-DSA na digital signatures SLH-DSA na hash-based digital signatures Sewo siawo nye mɔzɔzɔ gã aɖe, gake gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu aɖe mate ŋu atrɔ algorithm ɖeka yi bubu me le zã ɖeka me o. Ele be woabui gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi ƒe sewo, gakotokuwo, asikplɔwo dzra mɔwo, gaɖoɖo ƒe lolome, adzɔwo, kple ɣaɣla katã. Ale Si Quantum Ƒe Afɔku Ɖea Eɖokui Ɖe Ɖoɖonu Dzi Mɔ bɔbɔe aɖe si wòate ŋu abu afɔku lae nye: Mɔ̃zãla aɖe wɔa key ƒe pair. Public key alo signature ƒe nyatakaka ate ŋu adze ɖoɖonu dzi [on-chain]. Quantum ƒe aʋawɔla si ava me ate ŋu azã nyatakaka sia si le amewo ƒe ŋku me be wòanya private key la. Ne key sia kpɔa dzi le gaawo ŋu hafi la, afɔku ate ŋu anɔ wo ŋu. Nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi [transparent] gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonuwo ɖea nyatakaka geɖe fia ɖe wɔnɔnɔ me. Gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo, ga ƒe kadodo, kple gaɖoɖo ƒe kadodowo le amewo ƒe ŋku me. title: Ɖeɖe nyatakaka le ɣaɣla me [Private information retrieval]
description: Zcash ɣla ame si wotu gaɖoɖo aɖe ɖo na. Ɣaɣla ma hea biabia aɖe si mekpɔa bɔbɔe o: ne network la mate ŋu akpɔ gaɖoɖo siwo nye tɔwò o la, aleke wò gakotoku ŋutɔ…
text: Ɖeɖe nyatakaka le ɣaɣla me [Private information retrieval] Ɖe asi le eŋu Ɖeɖe nyatakaka le ɣaɣla me, alo PIR, na mɔ device aɖe be wòaxɔ nu ɖeka tso server ƒe nyatakakadzraɖoƒe me, si server la manya nu si wobia o Zcash hia esia elabena gakotoku si le ɣaɣla me mate ŋu abia server be gaɖoɖo kae nye etɔwo ne menye be wòafia eɖokui o Egbea gakotokuwo ƒea nyatakaka geɖe wu esi wo hia eye womekpe ɖe wo ŋu o, si nye susu vevi aɖe si ta sync wɔna blewu PIR ana mɔ gakotoku aɖe be wòaxɔ eya ŋutɔ ƒe nyatakakawo le ɣaɣla me ko, eye wòadzudzɔ teƒe si wɔna be nuwo mekpɔa dzi o, esi ɣaɣla le anyi E nye nu si wo le tsɔtsɔ me fifia na Zcash, eƒe ŋusẽ gã le teori me, eye wo le wɔm be wòanyo na gakotoku siwo wo zãa le nyateƒe me Ame kae wotu esia na Ame sia ame si bia kpɔ be aleke gakotoku si le ɣaɣla me kpɔa eƒe gaawo egbe menana nyatakaka tso ame siwo wònye o Ame yeye siwo kpɔa be woƒoa PIR kple Zcash ƒe nu ƒe dziyiyi dɔwo ƒe nya zi geɖe Nuxlẽlawo siwo di be woase gɔmedzedze la gbã hafi woava ɖe kriptografi si le eƒe te me Kuxi si PIR ɖo ɖe egbe na Zcash Zcash ɣla ame si wotu gaɖoɖo aɖe ɖo na. Ɣaɣla ma hea biabia aɖe si mekpɔa bɔbɔe o: ne network la mate ŋu akpɔ gaɖoɖo siwo nye tɔwò o la, aleke wò gakotoku ŋutɔ akpɔ wo? Egbea, ŋuɖoɖo la menɔ bɔbɔe o. Gakotoku aɖe mate ŋu abia server be gaɖoɖo kae nye tɔnye o, elabena biabia ma afia nu si Zcash le dɔ wɔm be yeɣla. Eyata, gakotoku la ƒea nyatakaka geɖe eye wòle kpɔkpɔ nu ɖeka sia ɖeka le eƒe te be yeakpɔ esi nye etɔ. Ewɔa dɔ, eye wòle ɣaɣla la kpɔm ɖe asi, gake ewɔna blewu eye wòle kpekpeɖeŋu. Nudzodzro sia nye susu vevi si ta gakotoku ƒe sync ate ŋu anɔ blewu. Nu si anyo ŋutɔ nye mɔ si ana gakotoku aɖe abia server be wòana eya ŋutɔ ƒe nyatakaka tututu, eye wòaxɔe, esi server la manya nu si wobia o. Esia tututu nye nu si ɖeɖe nyatakaka le ɣaɣla me naa. Nu si PIR nye Ɖeɖe nyatakaka le ɣaɣla me nye kriptografi ƒe mɔ si naa client aɖe xlẽ nudzraɖoƒe ɖeka tso server ƒe nyatakakadzraɖoƒe me, esi menafia server la nudzraɖoƒe si wòxlẽ o. Bu dzidzime aɖe ŋu, afi si wòate ŋu axɔ agbalẽ tututu si nèdi, gake dzidzimeŋlɔla la manya agbalẽ si wòtsɔ na wò o. Nèxɔ nu si nèdi, eye wò dzidzɔ le ɣaɣla me. PIR nye matematiki ƒe tata le susu sia ŋu, si wo tsɔ wɔa dɔ kple nyatakakadzraɖoƒe eyikeyi. Wo le srɔ̃m gɔmedzedze sia le kriptografi me ƒe ƒe geɖe. Chor, Goldreich, Kushilevitz, kple Sudan ƒo eɖe gɔme gbã le 1995, esi woɖe server geɖe ƒe mɔ la fia, eye single-server ƒe version gbã va le 1997 tso Kushilevitz kple Ostrovsky gbɔ. Menye nu si Zcash wɔ o, e nye dɔƒe si woɖo ɖe anyi xoxo, si Zcash le tsɔm fifia le kuxi si sese ɖe ŋutɔ ŋu ƒe ŋu. Aleke PIR wɔa dɔ, le gɔmedzedze ƒe te Mɔ vevi eve le PIR tutu na, eye vovototo si le wo dome la le vevie. Gbãtɔ la zãa server geɖe. Client la na server geɖe siawo ƒe biabia la ƒe akpa ɖeka sia ɖeka, eye wòtsɔa woƒe ŋuɖoɖowo ƒoa nu le eƒe te. Server ɖeka aɖeke mekɔ nyatakaka ade si aso eŋu be wòanya nu si wobia o. Esia wɔa dɔ kabakaba, gake wòle ɖe edzi be serverwo mana ɖe ɖokpe me o, si sesẽ be woakpɔa ɖe edzi le xexea me. Evelia zãa server ɖeka kple kriptografi si le ŋusẽ me le ame geɖe teƒe. Afisia client la le ɖe dɔwɔnu tɔxɛ aɖe si woyɔna be homomorphic encryption ɖe, eye esia nye mɔ si wòwɔ be wòanyo na dɔwɔwɔ le nyateƒe me, elabena mehia server siwo mana ɖe ɖokpe me o. Mɔ si wozãna: homomorphic encryption Homomorphic encryption nye ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ ƒomevi aɖe si naa server aɖe wɔa akɔnta le nyatakaka ŋu esi wòle ɣaɣla me. Server la wɔa ŋuɖoɖo si le ete, esi mekpɔ asixɔxɔ siwo le eƒe te o. Esi nye single-server PIR si wotu alea ƒe gɔmedzedze. Client la di nu number 3 tso list aɖe me. Wòtua biabia aɖe si, le nyateƒe me, nye "ẽ" si woŋlɔ ɣla na teƒe 3 kple "ao" si woŋlɔ ɣla na teƒe bubu ɖe sia ɖe. Na server la, biabia sia nye haɖehaɖe si menye nu o, mate ŋu anya teƒe si "ẽ" la le o. title: Project Tachyon
description: Zcash ɣlaa ame si wode fexexe na la. Eyae nye ta katã, eye ewɔa kuxi aɖe si me nyuie o: ne ame aɖeke mate ŋu anya ame si fexexe la le etɔ o la, aleke wò ŋutɔ…
text: Project Tachyon TL;DR Tachyon nye ɖoɖo yeye si woɖoe be wòatrɔ ale si Zcash gakotokuwo [wallets] di eye wotsãa ga ɣaɣla [shielded] le eme, be network la ate ŋu akuku va se ɖe zãlawo ƒe xexlẽ gã aɖe dzi Egbea la, gakotoku aɖe ele be wòage ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ [encryption] ƒe gagbã agateŋu le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu [blockchain] la ƒe akpa gã aɖe ŋu, be wòanya fexexewo [payments] siwo nye etɔ, eye esia nye ta vevi si ta ɣaɣla ƒe syncing dzea le dzodzoe Tachyon trɔa esia kple nunya-menya syncɖoɖo, ale be gakotoku aɖe axɔ nu si wòhia, le esi me wòmele nu katã lekpɔm o, eye wòmegblɔna na server aɖe akpa siwo wòdi o Eya hã tsɔa fexexe ƒe nyatakakawo doa tso gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu la me yi fexexe ƒe biabia la me, si wɔa be protocol la nasẽ gɔme, gake etsɔ dzikpɔkpɔ ƒe agbalẽ doa ɖe gakotokuwɔlawo dzi Enye ɖoɖo aɖe si woɖe gbe dzi zi gbãtɔ le April 2025. Menye NU7 ƒe akpa o eye womeɖoe va dze dzi o, eye ehiã mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔla [developer] ƒe dɔ sesẽ si sɔ kple Sapling mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ [network upgrade] Ame kae wòwɔe na Ame sia ame si kpɔ ɣaɣla gakotoku aɖe ƒe syncɖoɖo kpɔ eye wòbia be nukatae wòɖea ƒeɖe nenema Ame yeye siwo kpɔa Tachyon ƒe nya le NU7 kple Zcash ƒe nu ƒe dziyiyi [scaling] gbɔ zi geɖe Nuxlalawo siwo di be woase susu la gɔme tsã hafi woava ɖe cryptography ŋu Kuxi si Tachyon solve Zcash ɣlaa ame si wode fexexe na la. Eyae nye ta katã, eye ewɔa kuxi aɖe si me nyuie o: ne ame aɖeke mate ŋu anya ame si fexexe la le etɔ o la, aleke wò ŋutɔ ƒe gakotoku ate ŋu afi wòtɔwo? Le Bitcoin me la, esia bɔbɔe. Gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo [addresses] nye dukɔme, eyata gakotoku aɖe ate ŋu abia server aɖe be "Nu kae wode ɖe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi sia ŋu?" eye wòaxɔ ŋuɖoɖo. Zcash ɣaɣla gakotoku mate ŋu abia biabia ma o, elabena ne wòbiae la, emafia nu si ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo [pool] la wɔna be wòaɣlae tututu. Eyata Zcash wɔa nu bubu. Dɔla la ɣlaa fexexe ƒe nyatakakawo kple ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ eye wòtsɔe ɖe gaɖoɖo [transaction] la ŋutɔ me. Emegbe wò gakotoku la doa dɔ le ɖoɖonu la dzi ƒe gaɖoɖowo ŋu eye wòɖea ŋku be yeadze ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ le ɖe sia ɖe ŋu. Zaza geɖe be esia ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo katã medzea dzi o. Vi siwo dzea dzi lae nye wò fexexewo. Woyɔ esia be dodokpɔ ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ ƒe gagbã, eye enye ɣaɣla, tso ete ŋu, eye wòlea ɣeyiɣi. Nu si le eme lae nye nu si dɔ la tɔ ɖe edzi. Dɔ si wò gakotoku wɔna ƒe sesẽ ɖe ɖoɖonu la ƒe lolome ŋu, menye fexexe siwo wòxɔ vavã ƒe xexlẽ ŋu o. Ame si mexɔ fexexe ɖeka gɔ̃ hãkpɔ o wɔa dɔ sɔ kple ame si xɔa wo gbe sia gbe. Ne Zcash ƒe lolome le dzidzime la, esia vɔ̃a ɖe ame sia ame ŋu. Le ɖoɖo la ƒe nyawo me la, "eɖe be menye nu si ate ŋu akuku o." Nu si Tachyon trɔna Tachyon wɔa kuxi la ɖe eƒe ke me: etsɔa nu nu tsia blockchain la ƒe zazã be wòanye fexexe ƒe ɣaɣlawo ƒe mɔ doɖa. Le esia ƒe teƒe la, nyatakaka siwo wòhia la zɔa kple fexexe ƒe biabia la ŋutɔ, le mɔ bubu dzi. Fexexe ƒe biabia, URI, alo QR code aɖe tsɔa nyatakaka siwo woɣla le gaɖoɖo la me tsã la. Sean Bowe gblɔa be esia nye fexexewo siwo mele mɔ la me o ƒe zazã gbãtɔ le Zcash ɣaɣla protocol aɖe me. Ne ɖoɖonu la megale nyatakaka mawo tsɔm o la, ta aɖeke megale na wò gakotoku be wòadi wo le eme o, eye dodokpɔ ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ ƒe gagbã ƒe kuxi la bu. Ke hã, wò gakotoku hia be wòanya ɖoɖonu la ƒe nɔnɔme fifia be yeate ŋu atsã ga. Eyae nye ɖoɖo la ƒe akpa evelia, nunya-menya syncɖoɖo: mɔ aɖe si ana gakotoku aɖe nakpɔ nu siwo wòhia le esi me wòmefia na server la nu siwo wòbia o. Nu si esia anɔe na ame si le gakotoku zazãm Syncɖoɖo ƒe lolome magblẽ kple ɖoɖonu la o. Ɣeyiɣi si wò gakotoku atsɔ akpɔ nu siwo dzɔ la adze wò ŋutɔ ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ɖo, menye Zcash ƒe lolome o. Fexexewo anɔ abe ne wòle asi tsɔa fexexe ƒe agbale na ame aɖe ene. Fexexe ƒe biabia la tsɔa nu si xɔla la hia, eyata dzodzro si le dɔla kple xɔla dome la le vevie wu ale si wònɔ egbea. Gakotokuwɔlawo atsɔ dzikpɔkpɔ geɖe. Elabena ɖoɖonu la megale wò fexexe ƒe nyatakakawo ƒe ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ ƒe kɔpi aɖe dzɔm o la, wò gakotoku ƒe data gbuƒe le vevie wu. Backup kple gbugbɔxɔxɔ tso protocol ƒe nɔnɔme me yi nu si gakotoku ƒe software lae wòle be wòawɔe nyui

title: Sapling
description: Sapling dze agbe le Zcash mainnet dzi le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 419,200 (October 29, 2018, 02:15 UTC).
text: Sapling Sapling dze agbe le Zcash mainnet dzi le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 419,200 (October 29, 2018, 02:15 UTC). Nu si nàkpɔe: Sapling wɔ Zcash ƒe fexexe ɣaɣla [private] la zɔ kabakaba eye wò le bɔbɔe be woate ŋu awɔe le telefon alo asikplɔwo dzra mɔ dzi. Sapling nye Zcash ƒe mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ [network upgrade] gã evelia, eye wò dze egɔme le Zcash ƒe ƒe evelia ƒe ŋkeke dzi. Enye gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi [consensus] hard fork si wɔ ɣaɣla gaɖoɖowo ƒe wɔwɔ ɖe yeyee. Woɖe ɖoɖoa fia le ZIP 205 me, gaɖoɖo asidede agbalẽ te [signature] se yeyewo le ZIP 243 me, eye wo katã wotu wo ɖe ZIP 200, mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ ƒe mɔnu la dzi. Nyatakaka bliboa le Zcash Protocol Specification me. Electric Coin Company tu trɔtrɔa eye wò ɖe version gbãtɔ si de dzɔdzɔ na e, zcashd 2.0.0, le August 2018 me. Le ɖoɖonu [chain] dzi, network la kpe ɖe Sapling ƒe sewo ŋu kple eƒe consensus branch id. Nu si ta esia le vevie. Do ŋgɔ na Sapling, fexexe ɣaɣla bliboa wɔwɔ hia be nàlala minutiwo, esi wò computer la wɔ dɔ sesĩe kple memory gigabytewo be wòatu ɖaseɖigbalɛ [proof] la. Esia zɔ blewu eye wò kɔ sesĩe na ame geɖe, eyata zazãla geɖewo, gatrɔƒewo, kple asiwo de asi le ɣaɣla gaɖoɖowo ŋu o eye woɖe ZEC ɖe ŋkume le afi ma. Sapling tsɔ dɔa wɔ ɖe sekondi vie aɖewo kple memory megabyte 40 ko. Trɔtrɔ ɖeka siae wɔe be ɣaɣla ZEC ƒe zazã nanɔ anyi le gbe sia gbe me, le telefon mamãwo kple asikplɔwo dzra mɔwo dzi. TL;DR Sapling nye Zcash ƒe mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ gã evelia, si dze egɔme le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 419,200 (October 29, 2018, 02:15 UTC) — Zcash ƒe ƒe evelia ƒe ŋkeke dzi. Ewɔ ɣaɣla gaɖoɖowo ɖe circuit eve si wo wɔ tso ŋutinya ta (Spend kple Output) ŋu, eye wò ɖe Sprout ƒe JoinSplit circuit ɖeka si zɔ blewu la ɖa (ZIP 205, ZIP 243). Nuwɔna: ɖaseɖigbalɛ ƒe tutu tso minutiwo kple memory gigabytewo me va ɖe sekondi vie aɖewo kple MB 40 — bɔbɔe na telefonwo kple asikplɔwo dzra mɔwo. Nɔnɔme yeye: gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi [address] vovovowo (fexexe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi geɖe siwo ƒe kadodo manɔ anyi tso safui ɖeka me), nukpɔsafuiwo [viewing keys] na nyatakaka kpɔkpɔ ko, kple ɖaseɖigbalɛ tutu ƒe mama tso asidede agbalẽ te wɔwɔ ŋu. Eƒe parameterwo tso ame geɖe ƒe ceremony si le akpa eve me (Powers of Tau + Sapling MPC); dedienya le te esi ne ame ɖeka pɛ hã wɔ nyateƒe. Nɔnɔmetata ƒe ƒoƒo Sprout nye ame si tsɔ agbalẽ ɖeka sia ɖeka zɔe tso afi si woŋlɔe va yi dukɔ bliboa me kple asi — egbe wòle ɣaɣla blibo me, gake ezɔ blewu eye eƒe wɔwɔ le kɔ sesĩe. Sapling trɔ ame ma ke zu bisikleti nola si tsɔ akpa bɔbɔe ɖe eƒe nyuma: egale ɣaɣla me hã, gake ezɔ kabakaba na gbe sia gbe ƒe nudzɔdzɔwo. Eye nukpɔsafui yeyeawo le abe ne nèna auditoa kpɔƒe nyuie le ame nola la ƒe agbalẽ me, eye mèna gaƒe safuiwo nɛ o ene. Nu si trɔ Sapling ƒe dzi vevi nye mɔ kabakaba aɖe si wotsɔ tu zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛ si na ɣaɣla gaɖoɖo nanɔ ɣaɣla me. Sprout ƒe ɖoɖo gbãtɔ la zã proving circuit ɖeka (JoinSplit circuit) si zɔ blewu eye wòɖu memory geɖe. Sapling trɔe kple circuit eve si wo wɔ tso ŋutinya ta, Spend circuit kple Output circuit, si woɖe fia le Zcash Protocol Specification me. Nuwɔna la nye asixɔxɔ gã aɖe le asixɔxɔ me. Le Electric Coin Company nu, woate ŋu atu ɣaɣla gaɖoɖo le sekondi vie aɖewo me kple memory megabyte 40. Do-Sapling Sprout ƒe asigbe la kɔ sesĩe wu, le minutiwo kple memory gigabyte geɖewo ƒe akpa me (Sprout-ƒe nɔŋɔme siawoe nye asigbe ƒe akaka si ame geɖe tsoa dzi). Safui yeyeawo Sapling hã ɖe ɣaɣla gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo kple safuiwo ƒe ƒome yeye aɖe gɔme. Safui ɖeka ate ŋu aɖe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi vovovowo geɖe, siwo nye fexexe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi vovovo siwo ŋkume-kpɔla aɖeke mate ŋu akɔ ɖe wo nɔewo ŋu o. Sapling hã kpe ɖe nukpɔsafuiwo ŋu: nukpɔsafui blibo alo incoming viewing key na wò nàma ŋutega be ame aɖe nakpɔ gakotoku ƒe gaɖoɖowo ƒe nyatakakawo, gake mèna mɔ nɛ be wòazã eƒe ga o. Esia nyo na audit, akonta wɔwɔ, alo be nàɖo kpe edzi ko be wo wɔ fexexe aɖe. Trɔtrɔ si kplɔe ɖo nye be Sapling ma dɔ si nye ɖaseɖigbalɛ tutu la tso dɔ si nye gaɖoɖo asidede agbalẽ te wɔwɔ la ŋu. Mɔ̃ si tu zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛ la mele be wò

title: ɣaɣla (Shielded) Kɔin ƒe Nɔlawo ƒe Akɔtaɖoɖo
description: Le August 2026 me la, Zcash wɔ kɔin ƒe nɔlawo ƒe akɔtaɖoɖo si me akɔtawo nɔ ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ te eye woɖe mamleawo ƒe xexlẽ bliboa ko fia, esi wowɔ ɣaɣla akɔtaɖoɖo…
text: ɣaɣla (Shielded) Kɔin ƒe Nɔlawo ƒe Akɔtaɖoɖo Le August 2026 me la, Zcash wɔ kɔin ƒe nɔlawo ƒe akɔtaɖoɖo si me akɔtawo nɔ ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ te eye woɖe mamleawo ƒe xexlẽ bliboa ko fia, esi wowɔ ɣaɣla akɔtaɖoɖo ƒe ɖoɖo si Valar Group tu. Nusi nàse egɔme: ale si woate ŋu ada akɔta ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu ɖe ZEC si nèle asiwò ƒe lolome, ana nàganɔ ɣaɣla me, eye woaxlẽe nyuie hã, ne ame aɖeke maɖe nusi nèɖo akɔta ɖo o alo nusi nèle asiwò o. ɣaɣla kɔin ƒe nɔlawo ƒe akɔtaɖoɖo na Zcash ƒe nɔlawo nɔ akɔta ɖe ecosystem ƒe biabiawo ŋu kple woƒe ɣaɣla ZEC. Ame aɖeke mate ŋu anya nusi ame ɖeka sia ɖo akɔta ɖo alo ZEC aleke wòle asime o, gake ame sia ame ate ŋu akpɔe ɖa be xexlẽwo le eteŋu. Ewɔa dɔ le akɔtaɖoɖo ƒe ɖoɖonu si Valar Group tu ŋu, si maɖe le Zcash mainnet ŋu o, eye wòƒe ga vavã mele ɖe asi o. Ne èdi be nànya ale si Zcash wɔa ɖoɖo le gbogblɔ me la, kpɔ Zcash Ga ƒe Nadzɔdzɔ kple Dziɖuɖu ƒe Nɔnɔmetata. Axa sia ƒe nya koe nye ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ ƒe akɔtaɖoɖo ƒe ɖoɖo. Èya yeyee le Zcash ŋu oa? Dze egɔme kple Nukae nye ZEC eye Zcash, Ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒowo, eye zk-SNARKs, eye va megbe afisia. Nu ka ta ɣaɣla akɔtaɖoɖo sesẽ Kɔin ƒe nɔlawo ƒe akɔtaɖoɖo nyui di nu ene le ɣeyiɣi ɖeka me, eye mɔ siwo dze ŋgɔ be woatsɔ akpɔ wo la ƒoa ɣli kple wo nɔewo. Kpekpeɖeŋu nanɛ le ga ƒe ƒuƒoƒo nu, ale be ZEC geɖe si wòlé la na kpekpeɖeŋu geɖe. Tiaɖoɖo ƒe ɣaɣla, ale be ame aɖeke manya ale si nèɖo akɔta ɖo o. Ga ƒe ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɣaɣla, ale be ame aɖeke manya ZEC aleke nèle asiwò o. Xexlẽ si le eteŋu eye woate ŋu akpɔe ɖa, si ame sia ame ate ŋu akpɔe ɖa. Ne woadzro kpekpeɖeŋu le ga ƒe ƒuƒoƒo nu la, ekema wòle be woanya ame sia ame ƒe ga ƒe ƒuƒoƒo. Ne woadzro akɔtawo la, wòle be woaʋu wo. Ne wowɔ esia le mɔ bɔbɔe nu la, ekema edoa ŋutinya si ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo le be wòakpɔ ɖa la fia, eye kɔin ƒe akɔtaɖoɖo siwo va yi hã ɖe ga ƒe ƒuƒoƒo ƒe nyawo fia le ta sia nu. ɣaɣla akɔtaɖoɖo wɔa ɖe dzɔdzɔ sia ŋu kple dɔwɔnu mawo ke siwo wɔa ɣaɣla fexexe dɔ: zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛwo, nullifiers, kple ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ. Nuxlɔ̃ame: akɔta ƒe aɖaka si xlẽa eɖokui Gaƒe ƒe xexlẽdzikpɔɖeƒe na wòate ŋu nàxlẽ nusi to gaƒe me la ne mèkpɔ eme o. ɣaɣla akɔta ƒe aɖaka yi edzi ɖeka: exlẽa akɔta siwo woƒo ɣaɣla la ƒe xexlẽ ne meʋu wo kpɔ o. Bu akɔta ƒe aɖaka aɖe si si ŋusẽ tɔxɛ lɔ̃. Ete ŋu atsɔ envelop si woƒo ɣaɣla akpe ɖe xexlẽ si le edzi yim la ŋu ne meʋu eƒe eme o. Dɔdzikpɔlawo ƒe ha aɖe, ame ɖeka mele wo dome si le kplɔɖeƒe la o, va ɖe mamleawo ƒe xexlẽ bliboa ko fia. Eye hafi nàte ŋu atsɔ envelop aɖe ade eme la, èɖe ɖase le ɣaɣla me be nèlé ZEC le ɣeyiɣi si va yi aɖe me eye mèɖo akɔta ɖo kpɔ o, ne mèfia kɔin kawoe nye tɔwò o. Nusiwo katã le ete lae nye ale si wotu aɖaka sia vavã. Ɖeɖe te ŋu akɔtaɖoɖo kple snapshot Akɔtaɖoɖo ƒe ƒeɖeɖe aɖe tsɔa snapshot ƒe kɔkɔƒe, Zcash mainnet gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ɖeka, ɖo anyi, eye wòƒe kpekpeɖeŋu nye wòƒe ɣaɣla ga si nàte ŋu azã le Ironwood gaƒuƒoƒo me le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ma dzi. Se la bɔbɔe: Ironwood ƒe ZEC ɖeka le snapshot la dzi sɔ kple akɔta ɖeka. Na NU7 ƒe scope akɔtaɖoɖo la, snapshot la nye mainnet gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 3,459,350, le August 24, 2026 ƒe 19:00 UTC ƒe ƒome, eye akɔtaɖoɖo la ʋu va se ɖe September 14, 2026 ƒe 19:00 UTC. Nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi ZEC woatsɔ mɔ xoxo la wɔe le vovo me, menye ɖoɖo sia ŋu o. Wòƒe ga mele ɖe asi o eye woƒoa eƒe mɔ o. Woɖo ame siate ŋu akɔtaɖoɖo le snapshot la dzi, eya ta nàte ŋu azã alo atsrɔ̃ ZEC enumake emegbe ne wòmeɖe wòƒe akɔta ŋu o. Ŋkɔŋlɔɖeɖe ƒe afɔɖeɖe aɖeke mele o. Snapshot ƒe kɔkɔƒe ko hiã, si nana dɔa le bɔbɔe eye wòna ame siwo di be woaɖo akɔta ɖo la ƒe nyawo menɔ ʋuʋuɖi o. Ale si nàɖe wòƒe ga ƒe ƒuƒoƒo fia ne mèfia eya o Ne nèɖo akɔta ɖo la, wòƒe gakotoku wɔa zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛ be le snapshot la me nèkplɔ ɣaɣla ZEC aɖewo siwo menye zãtɔ o. Eɖea ga ƒe ƒuƒoƒo si le eteŋu kple eƒe lolome fia na xexlẽ ƒe mɔ̃ɖaŋu si le ɣaɣla me, gake mefia didienu aɖeke o eye mewɔa gaɖoɖo aɖeke le Zcash mainnet ŋu o. Ɖaseɖigbalɛ ma wɔa akɔtaɖoɖo ƒe credit le akɔtaɖoɖo ƒe ɖoɖonu la dzi, si sɔ kple wòƒe snapshot ga ƒe ƒuƒoƒo, eye akɔtaɖoɖo ƒe kplɔɖeƒ

title: Ɣaɣla [shielded] ƒe Dzadzra Me Asidede [cold signing]
description: Nya vevi: Gakotoku [wallet] si doa ɖe eŋu kpɔa nu siawo katã si hiã be woatu ɣaɣla gaɖoɖo [transaction] eye woakpɔe ɖa. Asikplɔwo dzra mɔ [hardware wallet] koe…
text: Ɣaɣla [shielded] ƒe Dzadzra Me Asidede [cold signing] Nya vevi: Gakotoku [wallet] si doa ɖe eŋu kpɔa nu siawo katã si hiã be woatu ɣaɣla gaɖoɖo [transaction] eye woakpɔe ɖa. Asikplɔwo dzra mɔ [hardware wallet] koe le ŋusẽ be wòana mɔ woazã ga. Mamae nye ɣaɣla ƒe dzadzra me asidede ƒe ta vevi blibo. Ɣaɣla wɔwɔ le Zcash me fia be woatsɔ ga atso dukɔmenyawo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi [transparent] gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi [address] aɖo ɣaɣla tɔ me, eye woaɣla gaɖoɖo ƒe nyawo kple Zcash ƒe ɣaɣla ƒe nɔnɔwo. Nu kae trɔ ne nàwɔ ɣaɣla na ZEC? Kple Zcash ƒe nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi gaɖoɖo, woate ŋu akpɔ nyawo abe: Ame si dɔ ga la ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi Ame si xɔ ga la ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi Ga si wotsɔ ɖo la ƒe home Le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu [blockchain] dzi. Ne nàwɔ ɣaɣla na ZEC, wò ga adzo yi ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo [pool] me, abe Ironwood ene. Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu ate ŋu akpɔe be gaɖoɖo aɖe le ete, ke menye be wòaɖe fia wò gaɖoɖo ƒe nya ɣaɣlawo o. Tso NU6.3 mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ [network upgrade] si va le 28 July 2026 la me, ga yeyewo si wòwɔ ɣaɣla na la yina Ironwood gaƒuƒoƒo me, elabena Orchard gaƒuƒoƒo xoxo la megaɖe mɔ na ga yeyewo ƒe deɖe me o, ke wòle mɔ na ga ƒe ɖeɖe tso eme. Ɣaɣla Gaɖoɖo Ƒe Akpaewo Didienu [note] (Ɣaɣla Ƒe Gaƒuƒoƒo Ƒe Nudzraɖoƒe) Didienu nye ɣaɣla, kryptografi ƒe nudzraɖoƒe si fia ZEC ƒe ga si wometsɔ zã o, eye ame aɖe nye etɔ. To vovototo na dukɔmenya gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu, afi si woŋlɔ gaƒuƒoƒowo kple nya ʋuʋuɖi, ɣaɣla didienu doa asitsɔtsɔ ɖe ga ƒe home kple ame si nye etɔ la ƒe nyawo ŋu be ame siwo kpɔa ɖoɖonu dzi la mate ŋu akpɔ ame si nye ga la o. Ne woele gaɖoɖo aɖe gɔme dzem la, gakotoku si doa ɖe eŋu la le agbalẽ la ŋu kpɔm, dea asi ame la ƒe didienuwo si wometsɔ zã o ŋu, eye wòtia didienu siwo wòazã. Gaɣaɣla Ðeɖe Dzesi [nullifier] (Ga Ƒe Zã Gbɔ Eve Ƒe Sedziedzi Mɔ) Esi didienu ƒe nyawo ɣla le dukɔmenya agbalẽa me ta la, hiã be network la nakpɔ mɔ si wòatsɔ ade asi ga ƒe zã gbɔ eve ŋu, eye menya didienu si wozã o. Gaɣaɣla ɖeɖe dzesi nye kryptografi ƒe dzesi tɔxɛ si tso didienu aɖe me. Ne wozã didienu aɖe la, woɖea eƒe gaɣaɣla ɖeɖe dzesi fia le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu dzi. Network la kpɔa be wometsɔ gaɣaɣla ɖeɖe dzesi la ŋlɔ ɖe afi ma kpɔ o. Ne wometsɔe ŋlɔ kpɔ o la, woate ŋu axɔ ga zazã la. Nya si le vevie lae nye be ame si le gota mate ŋu azã gaɣaɣla ɖeɖe dzesi la ade asi didienu si me wòtso la ŋu o. Gakotoku si doa ɖe eŋu la nɔa gaɣaɣla ɖeɖe dzesi si dze eye wòtuae le gaɖoɖo ƒe nyawo ƒe ƒoƒo me. Safuiwo [keys] Safuiwo nye kryptografi ƒe nyawo siwo kpɔa mɔ na wò ga, eye wona wò gakotoku mɔ be wòawɔ dɔwo abe ZEC ƒe xɔxɔ, kpɔkpɔ, kple zazã ene. Gakotoku aɖe kpɔa safui vovovowo, eye ɖe sia ɖe wɔnɛ dɔ vovovo, abe akpaɖeka ƒe akɔnta ate ŋu akpɔ mɔxɔxɔ ƒe nyawo vovovo na nuxexlẽ kple nuŋlɔŋlɔ ene. Safuiwo le vevie ŋutɔ le gakotoku si doa ɖe eŋu kple asikplɔwo dzra mɔ dome, elabena safui vovovowo wɔnɛ dɔ vovovo, eye ɖeka koe hiã be wòanɔ ɣla. Ele vevie be nànyaa be ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo ɖe sia ɖe tua eƒe safuiwo abe atia ƒe ati ene, afi si adewo fia nusi woate ŋu adze tso akpa aɖe me. Zãlawo siwo di be woaxɔ ɣaɣla fexexe [payment] la hiã be woakpɔ ɣaɣla fexexe ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi, si wòdzea tso gazazãsafui [spending key] me. Safui ƒe kɔkɔe 1. Gazazãsafui Esiae nye safui si hiã dedie le dedienɔnɔ ŋu. Ewɔa be ame ate ŋu akpɔ kryptografi ƒe ŋusẽ be wòaɖe mɔ na ZEC ƒe zazã. Esiae nye safui si woƒoa nu tso ne woƒoa nu tso "asikplɔwo dzra mɔ kpɔ safui la" le nyatakakaa ƒe akpa bubuwo me. Le dzadzra me asidede ƒe ɖoɖo me la, wole gazazãsafui la dzram ɖe asikplɔwo dzra mɔ la me, eye wometsɔe ƒoa fia gakotoku si doa ɖe eŋu la o. Megahiã be gakotoku si doa ɖe eŋu la nakpɔ safui sia kura o. Le Sapling kple Orchard siaa me la, safui ƒe kɔkɔe dzena ga zazã ƒe mɔxɔxɔ kple nukpɔkpɔ ƒe ŋusẽwo abe atiƒe eve siwo tso gazazãsafui gɔmedzeƒe me ene: Sapling: Gazazãsafui si woɖe ɖe go (𝑎𝑠𝑘,𝑛𝑠𝑘,𝑜𝑣𝑘) dzea ɖaseɖigbalɛ [proof] ƒe mɔxɔxɔ safuiwo (𝑎𝑘,𝑛𝑠𝑘) kple full viewing keywo (𝑎𝑘,𝑛𝑘,𝑜𝑣𝑘), siwo hã dzea incoming viewing keywo (𝑖𝑣𝑘) kple gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi vovo

title: Sprout
description: Zcash dze egɔme le October 28, 2016, kple Sprout ɣaɣla [shielded] gaƒuƒoƒo [pool].
text: Sprout Zcash dze egɔme le October 28, 2016, kple Sprout ɣaɣla [shielded] gaƒuƒoƒo [pool]. Nuxlɔ̃ame: Ne NU7 dze egɔme la, eana be ZEC siwo gale Sprout gaƒuƒoƒo me la mate ŋu wɔ fexexe o (mainnet ƒe dzeɖeɖe ƒe teƒe le 3,543,405, woɖo ŋgɔ be anɔ le 5 November 2026; kpɔ ZIP 259). Ne èle Sprout ga siwo ŋu la, xlẽ Gaxɔ ga siwo eye nàtrɔ wo gbã. Nu si nàkpɔe: Sprout nye afi si Zcash dze egɔme le, esi wòwɔ ga si le ɣaɣla me eye wòate ŋu aɖe eɖokui fia le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu si le agbe dzi me zi gbã. Sprout nye Zcash network ƒe gɔmedzedze, menye mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ network upgrade si va megbe o. Ede dɔ le genesis block dzi le October 28, 2016. ZIP si wode xexlẽ mele o la mee ɖe Sprout gɔme o: ZIP ƒe ɖoɖo la dze egɔme emegbe kple Overwinter, eyata Sprout ƒe numetoto tso Zcash Protocol Specification gbãtɔ kple Zerocash ƒe tutu si dzi wotu e la dzi. Electric Coin Company (le esime ma me la, Zerocoin Electric Coin Company), si Zooko Wilcox nɔ kplɔm, wɔe eye wodo e ɖe asi. Sprout ɖe zk-SNARK ɣaɣla [shielded] gaɖoɖowo [transactions] siwo wɔnɔ dɔ me gbãtɔ kple ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo [pool] gbãtɔ fia, ale be amewo ate ŋu adɔ ZEC kple amesi dɔe, amesi xɔe, kple gaƒe si woɣla, ke network la hã kpɔ be gaƒeawo ƒe akonta sɔ. Ŋkɔ la fia ɖoɖonu [chain] ɖevi si mele tsitsi me, si timu la katã xɔe se be wòatsi. Nu ka ta esia le vevie. Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu siawo katã siwo nɔ anyi hafi Sprout la ɖea wò fexexewo fia: ame sia ame ate ŋu akpɔ ame si xe ga na ame kae kple gaƒe si wòxe. Sprout nye network gbãtɔ si le agbe me eye zãzã faa [permissionless], si te ŋu fia nudzɔdzɔ siawo le ɣaɣla me eye wòagaɖe ɖase be ame aɖeke mele aʋaʋã wɔm o. Esia le vevie na ga ƒe ɣaɣla si le amewo ƒe gbe sia gbe agbeme, si nèle mɔ kpɔm na le cash alo bank ƒe nyagbalẽ si ame bubu mate ŋu axlẽ o me. Egblɔ hã be ɣaɣla sesẽ si le ɖoɖonu dzi [on-chain] ate ŋu awɔ dɔ le nuwɔna me, ke menye agbalẽ ƒe aɖaŋu ko o. Mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖo xexlẽnuwo [trusted setup] ƒe Ceremony si na esia dzɔ la zu kpɔɖeŋu na cryptography ƒe dɔwo si va megbe, eye ɖaseɖigbalɛ [proof] ƒe mɔɖoɖo si blea ɣeyiɣi eye wòhia memory geɖe, si Sprout va kple la, eyae wɔ be timu la tu Sapling le ƒe eve megbe. Ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo gbãtɔ Sprout wɔ gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi [address] ƒomevi eve. Nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi [transparent] gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo (t-addresses) wɔ dɔ abe Bitcoin ene, eye nudzɔdzɔwo katã le agbalẽ si le dukɔ bliboa ƒe asi me dzi. Ɣaɣla gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo (z-addresses) ɖoa ga ɖe Sprout ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo me, afi si ame si do ga, ame si xɔ ga, kple gaƒe la katã nɔa ɣaɣla me. Nunya si le eme nye zk-SNARKs, zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛwo siwo na gaɖoɖo aɖe ate ŋu afia be enyo, ne ga meɖo zi eve o eye asitsɔwo ƒe xexlẽ sɔ, ke mefia nudzɔdzɔ aɖeke o. Sprout nye zi gbãtɔ si esia wɔ dɔ le production me le cryptocurrency si le agbe me dzi. Ceremony zk-SNARKs si le Sprout me hia public parameters aɖe, eye be woawɔ wo dedie la, ehia mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖo zi ɖeka si woyɔna be Ceremony. Ame ade siwo nɔ teƒe vovovo kple didi me la, ame sia ame wɔ dɔ kple ɣ secret aɖe, si woyɔna be toxic waste. Ne ame aɖeke ate ŋu afɔ nu siwo katã ƒo ƒu ake la, ate ŋu awɔ ZEC tso naneke me. Aɖaŋua trɔ afɔku sia zu se bɔbɔe aɖe: Ne ame ɖeka ko hã tsrɔ eƒe akpa la, woagate ŋu afɔ secret bliboa ƒo ƒu ake o, eyata ga ƒe aʋaʋã wɔwɔ megate ŋu adzɔ o. Ame siwo ƒe ŋkɔwo woɖe fia le dukɔ bliboa me la domee nye Zooko Wilcox, Andrew Miller, Peter Van Valkenburgh, Peter Todd, kple Derek Hinch tso NCC Group. Ame ɖeka tia be yeanɔ ŋkɔmanya me. Gɔmedzeƒe Sprout nye gɔmeɖoƒe si tɔtrɔ sia tɔtrɔ si va megbe tu eɖe dzi. Esi mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ ƒe mɔɖoɖo va kple Overwinter la, eɖe ŋkɔ na se gbãtɔwo be consensus branch id 0, si fia ko be mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ aɖeke meva do o haɖe. Nu siwo katã va tso emegbe (Overwinter, Sapling, Blossom, Heartwood, Canopy, NU5, NU6, kple nu siwo va yi edzi) le ɖoɖonu Sprout dze egɔme la dzi. Wogblɔ dzeɖoɖoa le August 2016 be genesis aɖe egɔme le October 28, Ceremony la wɔ dɔ le kwasiɖawo siwo nɔ eŋgɔ me, eye genesis gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe timestamp si woŋlɔ ɖe eme ɖaa fia be

title: Gaɖoɖowo ƒe xexlẽdzikpɔɖeƒe [turnstile]
