text: Gaɖoɖowo ƒe xexlẽdzikpɔɖeƒe [turnstile] Eŋu kpuie Gaɖoɖowo ƒe xexlẽdzikpɔɖeƒe nye duto ƒe nukpɔkpɔ se si ƒoa nuƒoƒo tso asixɔxɔe si ge dzɔmetsonu ge ɖe ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo [shielded pool] sia me eye wodo goe le eme Ewɔe be amesia ameate ŋu akpɔe be gaƒuƒoƒo aɖeke meaɖe ga geɖe wu esi woɖo ɖe eme o, togbɔ be gaɖoɖowo siwo le eme la nye ɣaɣla Esia doa ZEC ƒe xexlẽme kpɔ tso vodada si woɣe ɖe ameŋku me, elabena klosalo siwo menye vavã o mate ŋu ado go tso gaƒuƒoƒo aɖe me ne womegblẽ xexlẽme la o Fexexewo siwo le gaƒuƒoƒo aɖe me nɔa ɣaɣla. Gaɖoɖo si tsɔa ZEC dea tso gaƒuƒoƒo aɖe me yi bɔbɔe me fia ga si wòtsɔ dea Gaɖoɖowo ƒe xexlẽdzikpɔɖeƒe tae wòwɔe be tso Orchard yi Ironwood ƒe asiɖeɖe te ŋu aɖo kpe ɖe edzi be ɣaɣla ƒe xexlẽme le nyuie Ame kae wòwɔe na Ame sia ame si di be yease ale si Zcash dea eƒe ɣaɣla xexlẽme ɖe dzideƒo me Zãlawo siwo le Orchard yi Ironwood ƒe asiɖeɖe yome eye womedi be woanya ale si wòɖo kpe ɖe edzi be xexlẽme la le vavã Ame yeyewo siwo di be woase ale si ga ƒe ƒoƒo si nye ɣaɣla hã te ŋu anɔ kpɔkpɔ te Kuxi la ɣaɣla Zcash ɣea ga ƒe asixɔxɔ, amesiwo ɖoa ga, kple amesiwo xɔa ga. Ɣaɣla siae nye ta. Ke evia biabia sesẽ aɖe: ne ame aɖeke mate ŋu akpɔ nu si le ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo me o la, alekee ame aɖe anya be ZEC ƒe xexlẽme blibo le nyuie? Alekee wòakpɔ ga si wòmate ŋu akpɔ o? Ne vodada aɖe na mɔ be ame aɖe wɔ klosalo siwo menye vavã o le ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo aɖe me kpɔ la, ɣaɣla ma ke si dea dzideƒotɔwo kpɔ la aɣe klosalo wɔwɔ ma ɖe ameŋku me. Ne nukpɔkpɔ aɖeke mele o la, makaka sia ana amewo ƒe dzideƒo le xexlẽme blibo la ŋu adze le vɔvɔ̃ me. Gaɖoɖowo ƒe xexlẽdzikpɔɖeƒe nye nukpɔkpɔ si wɔe be kuxi sia ƒe nuɖoɖo ava. Nu si gaɖoɖowo ƒe xexlẽdzikpɔɖeƒe nye Bu ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo ɖe sia ɖe be wònye xɔ aɖe si mɔ̃ ƒe xexlẽme ɖeka koe le. Ɣesiaɣi si asixɔxɔ aɖe tso afima va ge ɖe gaƒuƒoƒo me, alo tso eme yi afi bubu, etoa mɔ̃ la dzi eye woexlẽe le duto ƒe ŋkume. Gaɖoɖowo siwo le xɔ la me nɔa ɣaɣla, ke boŋ xexlẽme si le mɔ̃ la ŋu la dze ɖe ame sia ame ŋku. Se la bɔbɔe: gaƒuƒoƒo aɖe mate ŋu aɖe asixɔxɔ geɖe wu esi ge ɖe eme o. Ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔwo [nodes] gbegbe gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe aɖeke si ana gaƒuƒoƒo ƒe asixɔxɔ nadze ɖe zero te. Wokpɔa asixɔxɔ si wowɔ dzitsinya le gaƒuƒoƒo aɖe me ɣesiaɣi, elabena enye asixɔxɔ blibo si ge ɖe eme tso asixɔxɔ blibo si do go la ŋu. Duto ƒe xexlẽme siae nye gaɖoɖowo ƒe xexlẽdzikpɔɖeƒe. Ale si wòwɔ dɔe Zcash xɔ ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒowo geɖe le eƒe ŋutinya me, abe Sprout, Sapling, kple Orchard ene. Asixɔxɔ dea tso nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi ɖoɖonu [transparent chain] me yi gaƒuƒoƒowo me, eye ɣeaɣi aɖe hã dea tso gaƒuƒoƒo aɖe me yi bɔbɔe. Gaɖoɖowo ƒe xexlẽdzikpɔɖeƒe kpɔa nyawo siawo: Ne ZEC de ge ɖe ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo aɖe me la, wokpea ga ma ɖe gaƒuƒoƒo ma ƒe duto ƒe asixɔxɔ ŋu Ne ZEC do go tso gaƒuƒoƒo aɖe me la, wotsɔea le asixɔxɔ la me Ɖoɖonu la gbegbea gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe aɖeke si ana gaƒuƒoƒo aɖe ƒe asixɔxɔ nadze ɖe zero te, si fia be nu do go geɖe wu esi ge ɖe eme kpɔ o Gaɖoɖo ɖe sia ɖe fia eƒe asixɔxɔ ƒe mɔ́dodo kple mɔ́xexlẽme ko le gaƒuƒoƒo aɖe me alo tso eme, si nye eƒe asixɔxɔ ƒe balance. Na fexexe le gaƒuƒoƒo ɖeka me la, esiae nye adzɔ ko Ɖoɖonu la kplɔa asixɔxɔ ƒe balance ɖe sia ɖe le mɔ sia nu na asixɔxɔ gaƒuƒoƒo ɖe sia ɖe, siwo ŋu Sprout, Sapling, Orchard, Ironwood gaƒuƒoƒo yeye la, kple nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi kple lockbox ƒe balancewo hã le. Eya ta, togbɔ be wogbe gaƒuƒoƒo aɖe ƒe emetɔ ŋkume hã la, nu si ate ŋu ado go ɣeaɣi sia ɣeaɣi la ƒe dzadzra le nu si ge ɖe eme ŋu. Asixɔxɔ ƒe tsikpɔkpɔ si woɣe ɖe ameŋku me mate ŋu ado go yi ame ƒe asi o. Ale si wokpɔa asixɔxɔ ƒe balance Xexlẽme si le mɔ̃ la ŋu la ate ŋu anɔ dzideƒo me elabena wode se ɖe gaɖoɖo ɖe sia ɖe ŋu be wòaɖo kpe ɖe edzi be etsɔ asixɔxɔ vavãe wɔ dɔ, togbɔ be asixɔxɔ ŋutɔ nɔa ɣaɣla hã. Ɣaɣla gaɖoɖo ɖe sia ɖe ɖea nume vavã ɖeka: asixɔxɔ ƒe mɔ́dodo kple mɔ́xexlẽme si etsɔ dea ɖe gaƒuƒoƒo me alo etsɔa doa go, si woyɔna be eƒe asixɔxɔ ƒe balance. Asixɔxɔ ƒe balance si nye nyuie fia be gadzudzɔwo do go tso gaƒuƒoƒo me yi nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi ƒe akpa, ke esi nye vɔvɔ̃ fia be gadzudzɔwo g

title: Ɖekae ƒe Gaɖoƒe ƒe Dzesi [Unified Address] (ZIP-316) ƒe Kaka Kpɔ
description: Esia nye nusrɔ̃mɔfi, menye decoder si woɖo ɖe akpaɖe o alo fexexe ƒe library si wòate ŋu akɔpi eye nàtsɔ o. Eɖe fia ale si Ɖekae ƒe Gaɖoƒe ƒe Dzesi wɔe ene…
text: Ɖekae ƒe Gaɖoƒe ƒe Dzesi [Unified Address] (ZIP-316) ƒe Kaka Kpɔ Esia nye nusrɔ̃mɔfi, menye decoder si woɖo ɖe akpaɖe o alo fexexe ƒe library si wòate ŋu akɔpi eye nàtsɔ o. Eɖe fia ale si Ɖekae ƒe Gaɖoƒe ƒe Dzesi wɔe ene, ale be nàse nu si library siwo wòléa ɖe asi wɔa le eƒe me. Ne nu aɖe anwɔ ga vavã ŋu la, de asi na ZIP-316 ƒe specification kple dɔwɔwɔ siwo wòtsɔ ka ɖe ete afii. --- Nɔnɔme gã la Ɖekae ƒe Gaɖoƒe ƒe Dzesi (UA) nye gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ƒe akpa ɖeka si tsɔ receiver ƒe ƒomevi geɖe: nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi [Transparent], Sapling, Orchard, alo woƒe akpaɖe ƒoƒo. Gakotoku [wallet] si wòle fexexe wɔm atia receiver gaƒuƒoƒo si nyo wu si wòate ŋu akpe ɖe eŋu. Bu UA be enye agbalẽ ƒe akpɔdzi si wotu ɖe eŋu, si me kadi siwo wode dzesi ɖe wo ŋu le. Kadi ɖeka sia ɖeka fia mɔ vovovo si wòato atsɔ ava ɖe gbɔwò. Be application aɖe nakpɔ gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi aɖe la, ele be wòawɔ esiawo: Ʋu akpɔdzi la: Ɖe text ƒe akpa la me. Trɔ emenyawo ƒe ƒoƒo: Ɖe ɣaɣla ƒe ɖeɖe vovovo (F4Jumble) ɖa. Xlẽ kadi ɖeka sia ɖeka: Ɖe receiver ɖeka sia ɖeka me. Wɔ protocol ƒe sewo dzi: Gbe entrywo gbɔ alo gbee wo ɖe woƒe typecode ƒe range nu. --- Nu ka ta "ɖe Bech32m ko me" meɖe o UA tsɔ Bech32m text encoding, gake Bech32m ƒe ɖeɖe meɖe receiver siwo woate ŋu azã la fia o. ZIP-316 tsɔ F4Jumble ƒo payload la kple ŋutete hafi wòawɔ encoding. F4Jumble na be ne wo trɔ dzesi ɖeka pɛ le gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi la me la, decoded output la katã trɔ. Esia doa mɔ na address malleability ƒe attackwo, afi si attack wɔla aɖe trɔ bytewo le gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi la ƒe titina, eye prefix kple suffix la gake nɔ ekpɔm be wòle bɔbɔe. Se vevi: Malleability ƒe ɣaɣla wɔ dɔ ko ne wòƒe application wɔ ɖeɖe kple kaka kpɔ ƒe mɔ katã. Ɖeɖe ƒe akpa aɖe ko ɖea dedie ɖa, eye wòle afɔku katã la ɖe asi. --- Ɖeɖe ƒe mɔ la, afɔ ɖeka ɖe afɔ ɖeka Afɔ 1: Ɖe Bech32m me eye nàkpɔ network la Akpa si amewo ate ŋu axlẽ (HRP): u fia mainnet; utest fia testnet. (Mainnet ƒe UAwo dze egɔme kple u1, afi si 1 nye Bech32 ƒe separator.) Didime ƒe se: Bech32m si wozãna ɖo character 90 ƒe se. UAwo zu edze se sia ŋu zi geɖe, eya ta ele be woatsi didime ƒe kakawɔ siwo wozãna ɖa le decoder la me. Trɔ Bech32m ƒe nyawo siwo le bit 5 me yi bit 8 ƒe byte siwo wozãna me. Afɔ 2: Trɔ F4Jumble F4Jumble nye Feistel network si wɔ round 4, si woɖo ɖe BLAKE2b ŋu: Akpa gome ƒe didime: min(64, floor(length / 2)) bytes. Byte 64 ƒe katã dzɔ ɖe BLAKE2b ƒe output ƒe didime si gã wu ŋu. Akpa gome ƒe dre la tsɔ payload si susɔ la. Hash ƒe functionwo: Wòtrɔ G kple H ƒe zãzã kple personalization ƒe dzesi siwo meɖe o (UAF4JumbleG kple UAF4JumbleH). Round ƒe ɖoɖo: Encoding si yi ŋgɔ la zã G(0) → H(0) → G(1) → H(1). Trɔtrɔ (unscrambling) la zã H(1) → G(1) → H(0) → G(0). Range ƒe kakpɔ: Gbe input siwo le ZIP-316 ƒe payload ƒe didime ƒe sewo me o. Afɔ 3: Ɖe padding ɖa eye nàkpɔ HRP la Hafi woaƒo eƒe ƒoƒo la, encoder la kplɔ byte 16 siwo me HRP le ɖe eŋu, eye wòtsɔ zero wo ƒe afɔŋu. Ɖe byte 16 mamlɛtɔwo ɖa le unscrambling megbe. Kpɔ be HRP si le eme la sɔ kple network si wole mɔ kpɔm na (u alo utest). Esia naa be testnet ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo mekpɔ mɔ le mainnet dzi le vodada me o. Afɔ 4: Ɖe receiverwo me Payload si susɔ la tso (typecode, length, content) entries me, afi si woɖo typecode kple didime la ɖe compact-size integerwo me (byte ɖeka na value suewo). Receiver ƒe typecode siwo míenya: Typecode Receiver ƒe ƒomevi Emenyawo ƒe didime :------- :------------------ :------------- 0x00 Nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi (P2PKH) Byte 20 0x01 Nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi (P2SH) Byte 20 0x02 Sapling Byte 43 0x03 Orchard Byte 43 Le esiawo megbe la, ZIP-316 ɖo range bubu eve ɖe eŋu na ŋgɔyiyi ƒe wɔwɔ: 0xC0–0xDF (metadata si MUST-understand menye eŋuti o): Ele be consumerwo nagbe metadata ƒe item siwo womanya le range sia me. 0xE0 kple 0xE1 (metadata si woɖo na MUST-understand): ZIP-316 ƒe registry si le fifia ɖo esiawo na gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ƒe expiry ƒe teƒe kple ɣeyiɣi. Ele be consumerwo nase item siawo gɔme alo woagbe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi la. 0xE2–0xFC (metadata si woɖo na MUST-understand gake womeɖo o): Ele be

title: Nukpɔsafui [Viewing Keys]
description: Ɣaɣla gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo na wò nàwɔ gaɖoɖo le Zcash gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu [blockchain] dzi eye nàɖe nu vi aɖe ko fia. Ke aleke wòawɔ ne èhiã be nàfia ame…
text: Nukpɔsafui [Viewing Keys] Ɣaɣla gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo na wò nàwɔ gaɖoɖo le Zcash gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu [blockchain] dzi eye nàɖe nu vi aɖe ko fia. Ke aleke wòawɔ ne èhiã be nàfia ame aɖe si tɔxɛ nu si le asiwò alo nu si nèdɔ ɖa? Nukpɔsafui [viewing key] na mɔ be ame nàxlẽ nu, gake mena mɔ be wòazã ga o. Nukpɔsafuiwo nɔ xoxo ɖe Sprout ta; Sapling kpe ŋusẽ bubuwo ɖe eŋu, abe ale si wòate ŋu anya ne wozã didienu si woɖo ɖa xɔ la ene. ZIP 310 nye nyatakaka ƒe tata si na ɖase le Sapling nukpɔsafuiwo ƒe dedienɔnɔ ŋuti, menye mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ si tsɔ nukpɔsafuiwo va la o. Nukpɔsafui nye dɔwɔnu na nyatakaka tɔxɛ ɣaɣla [selective disclosure]: wòe tia ame siakɛ nakpɔ nu si, eye mètsɔ gazazãsafui [spending key] na ame aɖeke be wòawɔe o. Nu si wòle vevie Nukpɔsafui na mɔ na nuxexlẽ ko le ɣaɣla Zcash gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi alo akɔunt ƒe nusiwo wɔna me: ame si le esiwɔ ate ŋu akpɔ gaɖoɖowo siwo va (eye, ne enye nukpɔsafui blibo, gaɖoɖowo siwo do go hã), gake mate ŋu azã ga le ɣeyiɣi aɖeke me o. Nu si wònye: Nyatakaka tɔxɛ ɣaɣla [selective disclosure] ƒe dɔwɔnu le ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒowo me, eye eƒe ŋutete vovototo le gaƒuƒoƒo kple safui ƒe ƒome kple ƒome me. ZIP 310 ɖe nu si Sapling nukpɔsafui blibo [full viewing key] aɖe fia kple nyatakaka siwo wòɖo kplikpaa, siwo wometsɔ kpɔ ɖe edzi o, siwo meɖe fia o, alo siwo womafia o. Nu si wòna mɔ na: Ga siwo va ƒe kpɔkpɔ (uivk… incoming keys) alo akɔunt ƒe nukpɔkpɔ blibo si va eye si do go (uview… unified full viewing keys), kple xoxo Sapling zxviews… keys. Nu si wòmena mɔ na o: Ga zazã ƒe mɔ. Nu aɖeke si ame si le nukpɔsafui aɖe si wɔ la mate ŋu aɖe ga yi o. Afisi wòwɔ dɔ egbe: Dɔdɔdɔ go/dzɔdzɔ le Zallet (v0.1.0-beta.2+, zexportviewingkey / zimportviewingkey) me, kple watch-only akɔuntwo le gakotokuwo abe Zkool ene; kpɔ Gakotokuwo ƒe axa na kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe nɔnɔme si le fifia. Nusi wòle be nàɖo ɖe susu me: Zã safui si le eŋutɔ me wu si ate ŋu aɖo biabia si wobia la ŋu, eye nàɖo ŋku edzi be safui si nètsɔ na ame la mate ŋu agatrɔ ava ŋuwò o — ga la ko ate ŋu ado go le eŋu ne nètsɔe yi afi bubu. --- Nu ka ta wòazã nukpɔsafui? Electric Coin Company ƒe ŋlɔŋlɔ tso nya sia ŋu ɖe nɔnɔme siwo dze ŋgɔ wu gɔme, eye woe nye nɔnɔme siwo dzea ŋgɔ wu egbe hã: Gatrɔƒe aɖe le ga siwo va kpɔm. Gatrɔƒe la tsɔ incoming viewing key de ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ aɖe si le intanɛti ŋu be wòate ŋu akpɔ asitsɔla ƒe ga siwo va ɖe ɣaɣla gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi aɖe, eye gazazãsafui la nɔ hardware si mekpena ɖe network la ŋu o. Ga ƒe dzɔlawo le woƒe nu siwo le asi wɔnɛ be woakpɔ. Ga ƒe dzɔla la tsɔ nukpɔsafui blibo na auditor aɖe na ɣaɣla gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi sia tɔxɛ wo katã. Auditor la ate ŋu akpɔ balance siawo eye wòakpɔ dɔ siwo va ɖe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo siawo dzi kple siwo do go le woŋu, gake mate ŋu awɔ nu bubu o. Nusi woakpɔ le ame si wòwɔa dɔ kplii ŋu. Ne gatrɔƒe aɖe hiã be woakpɔ asitsɔla ƒe ɣaɣla history le due diligence si le sesẽ wu me, ate ŋu woabia nukpɔsafui la ɖe ga la ŋu teƒe. Nu si nukpɔsafui fia kple nu si mefia o Safui ƒomevi tsitotsito li, eye vovototo si le wo dome lae ɖoa nusi nàtsɔ na ame gɔme. Safui Prefix Nu si wòna mɔ na --- --- --- Unified full viewing key (UFVK) uview… Ekpɔ gaɖoɖo siwo va eye siwo do go le gaƒuƒoƒo sia tɔxɛ si le akɔunt la me Unified incoming viewing key (UIVK) uivk… Ekpɔ gaɖoɖo siwo va ko le gaƒuƒoƒo sia tɔxɛ si le akɔunt la me Sapling extended full viewing key zxviews… Ekpɔ gaɖoɖo siwo va kple siwo do go le Sapling ƒe dɔwɔwɔ me na safui la ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo Safui siawo katã mate ŋu azã ga o. Wo katã li ɖaa le mɔ si le vevie me: safui si nètsɔ na ame la mate ŋu agatrɔ ava ŋuwò o, ga la ko ate ŋu ado go le eŋu ne nètsɔe yi akɔunt si ƒe safuiwo ame bubu la mele asi o. Nyatakaka ƒe afɔku eve li si ele be nànya hafi nàma nu aɖeke. Incoming menye be wòxɔ ƒeƒe sue o. Unified incoming viewing key ɖe akɔunt blibo la ŋu, menye gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ɖeka si wobia tso asiwò la ŋu o. UIVK dɔdɔdɔ go na Sapling gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ɖeka hã na mɔ be woakpɔ ga siwo va le gaƒuƒoƒo sia tɔxɛ si le akɔunt la me, eyata efia nu geɖe wu gaɖoƒe ƒe dze

title: Nu si gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe [block] didzila atekpɔ le Zcash dzi
description: Zcash wɔa gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi [address] ƒomevi eve.
text: Nu si gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe [block] didzila atekpɔ le Zcash dzi TL;DR Le Bitcoin dzi la, gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe didzila atekpɔ fia nu gbogbo: dɔla, xɔla, kple gaƒe. Le Zcash dzi la, esia nyo na nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi [transparent] (t-address) ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ko. Didzila atekpɔ ate ŋu akpɔ be ga ge ɣaɣla [shielded] gaƒuƒoƒo [pool] me eye wòdo tso eme, gake mate ŋu akpɔ nu si dzɔ le eme o. Ɣaɣla blibo (z yi z) gaɖoɖowo [transactions] mefia dɔla aɖeke o, xɔla aɖeke o, alo gaƒe aɖeke o. Dukɔ bliboa ƒe "ɣaɣla ƒe rate" ƒe nɔmba ɖe anyi, elabena dɔwɔwɔ si le ɣaɣla blibo me la menye nukpɔkpɔtɔ na ame si le gota o. --- Gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ƒomevi eve Zcash wɔa gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi [address] ƒomevi eve. Nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi dzea egɔme kple t eye wowɔa dɔ abe Bitcoin gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ene. Balance kple fexexe [payment]wo le dukɔ bliboa ƒe nukpɔkpɔ me. Ɣaɣla gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi dzea egɔme kple z eye zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛ [proof]wo naa wò ɣaɣla. Network la ate ŋu akaka be ɣaɣla fexexe nyo, gaɖe dɔla, xɔla, alo gaƒe o. Elabena gaɖoƒe ƒomevi eve li la, asixɔxɔ ate ŋu ayi mɔ ene: nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi yi nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi (t yi t), nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi yi ɣaɣla (t yi z, woyɔna be shielding), ɣaɣla yi nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi (z yi t, woyɔna be deshielding), kple ɣaɣla yi ɣaɣla (z yi z, ɣaɣla blibo). Nu si didzila atekpɔ ate ŋu akpɔ Dukɔ bliboa ƒe didzila atekpɔ abe ZecBlock ene ate ŋu axlẽe nyuie: Nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi blibo (t yi t) fexexe sia fexexe. Ga si ge ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo me (nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi ƒe akpa kple gaƒe). Ga si do tso ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo me (nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi ƒe akpa kple gaƒe). ZEC ƒe ƒomevi blibo si le ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo sia sia me, si le dukɔ bliboa ƒe nukpɔkpɔ me be network la nate ŋu aɖe kpeɖeŋu be womewɔ ga aɖeke tso naneke me o. Le nyagɔme me la, ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo ƒe toƒo mewo le nukpɔkpɔ me. Àte ŋu akpɔ asixɔxɔ si le ge me kple dodom. Nu si didzila atekpɔ mate ŋu akpɔ o Dukɔ bliboa ƒe didzila atekpɔ mate ŋu axlẽe o: Ɣaɣla blibo (z yi z) gaɖoɖowo. Dɔla, xɔla, kple gaƒe la le ɣaɣla me. Dɔla alo xɔla si le ɣaɣla fexexe sia sia megbe. Ɣaɣla gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ɖeka ƒe balance. Nu si dzɔna na ga le gaƒuƒoƒo la me vɔ. Bia nyatakakawo ŋutɔ eye ɣaɣla dɔla kple xɔla ƒe fieldwo trɔ gbɔna kple aƒe. Didzila atekpɔ la meɣlana esia ɖe aga o. Womede wò ɖo dukɔ bliboa ƒe ɖoɖonu [chain] dzi kpɔ gbeɖe le nɔnɔ si me wòate ŋu axlẽe o. Wona nyatakakawo ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ [encryption], eye ame si si nukpɔsafui [viewing key] nyuitɔ ko ate ŋu axlẽe. Nu ka tae esia xɔ asi Wò ƒe ɣaɣla [privacy] tso cryptography me, menye tso company aɖe dzi ƒe dzideƒo me o. Nyatakaka ƒe provider aɖeke mate ŋu akpɔ ɣaɣla gaɖoɖo ƒe eme o, togbɔ be wòdi be yeawɔe hã. Dukɔ bliboa ƒe ɣaɣla-rate nɔmbawo mesea ɣaɣla ƒe katã o. Nudzɔdzɔlawo ate ŋu akpɔ nu si va to dukɔ bliboa ƒe liƒo ko, eyata ɣaɣla dɔwɔwɔ ƒe katã si le nyateƒe me la sɔ kple nu si wogblɔ la le esime sia me, eye zi geɖe wu ema. Ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo gãtɔ dea amesia ame. Ame geɖe siwo zãna ɣaɣla gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi la, esia na amewo ƒe ha si me ɣaɣla fexexe ɖeka ɣlana la gãna. Ɣaɣla gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi zãzã dea wò kple ame bubu siwo katã le gaƒuƒoƒo la me. Wɔe le wò ŋutɔ ƒe agbe me Zã gakotoku [wallet] si naa ɣaɣla gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi wɔa dɔ le gɔmedzedze me, abe ZODL alo Zingo! ene. Ne nèxɔ ZEC le nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi dzi la, tsɔe yi ɣaɣla gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi me hafi nàzãe. Ƒe fexexe na ɣaɣla gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi afi si nàte ŋu. Nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi fexexe sia sia le dukɔ bliboa ƒe nukpɔkpɔ me; ɣaɣla fexexe menɔ eme o. Nudzɔdzɔwo Zcash: ɣaɣla kple dedienyui ƒe aɖaŋuwo Ɣaɣla ƒe nɔnɔme (Electric Coin Company) Ale si Zcash technology wɔa dɔe ZecBlock Axɔ nuku siwo Zcash ƒe gɔmedzedze nyawo Gakotokuwɔwo Ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒowo zk-SNARKs --- Nèdi be nàtsɔ nu aɖe kpee alo nàɖe asi le wiki axɔ nuku sia ƒe tɔtrɔwo ŋu ɖa la, mekpɔ ɖe ZecHub GitHub repo dzi eye nàɖo pull request.

title: Z3 Ƒoƒo
description: Z3 Ƒoƒo nye Zcash Foundation ƒe ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ ƒe platform si woɖo ɖe nu me: Zebra (ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo) + Zallet (ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo ƒe gakotoku…
text: Z3 Ƒoƒo Z3 Ƒoƒo nye Zcash Foundation ƒe ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ ƒe platform si woɖo ɖe nu me: Zebra (ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo) + Zallet (ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo ƒe gakotoku [wallet]), kple Zaino indexer si wòte ŋu atia. Eyae wole be wòaxɔ teƒe na zcashd ƒe dɔwɔwɔ si tɔ ɖe eɖokui ŋu, esi ƒoa gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi [consensus] kple gakotoku ƒo ƒu le binary ɖeka me eye wòva de agbe ƒe nuwuwu le 18 July 2026. Nɔnɔmetata si wotsɔ de dɔ me nye Docker Compose ƒe dɔa le github.com/ZcashFoundation/z3. --- TL;DR Z3 menye gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi ƒe client yeye o. Eyae nye ale si nàtsɔ adzi zcashd megbe ƒe ƒoƒo la katã le ɖeka me: Zebra dea ɖoɖonu la ƒe nyateƒe me eye wòkpɔa eŋu, Zallet léa krɔŋlɔwo me eye wònaa gakotoku RPC, eye Zaino (ne wòdi) doa lightwalletd gRPC ƒe mɔ nu. zcashd ƒoa ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ kple gakotoku ƒo. Z3 maa dɔmawo ƒe teƒewo. Gatrɔƒewo, nukuku gaƒuƒoƒowo, kple ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo ƒe gakotoku ƒe dɔwɔlawo trɔa yi ƒoƒo sia gbɔ ɖe teƒe na be woayi Zebra ɖe eɖokui ŋu. Compose ƒe dɔa atọ si me woɖe ɖe mɔ me ate ŋu adu du le host ɖeka dzi: mainnet, testnet, kple regtest. Mainnet ƒe sync gbãtɔ xɔa gaƒoƒo 24–72 eye wòhiãa 300 GB kple eŋu. Regtest dzea agbe le sekondi aɖewo me eye nye teƒe nyuitɔ si nàsrɔ ƒoƒo la le. Zallet ƒoa Zaino ƒe indexer ƒe librarywo ɖe eŋu eye wòdoa nu na Zebra to JSON-RPC dzi. Zaino ƒe subɔsubɔ si tɔ ɖe eɖokui ŋu hiã ko ne èdi be endpoint si sɔ kple lightwalletd nanye na gotagakotokuwo. Zallet le beta me. Tɔtrɔ gãwo ate ŋu ahe be woatu gakotoku la eye woawɔe ake. Mègabu be enye asikplɔ-dzralá ƒe software si blibo na ga gãwo o. --- Nu ka tae Z3 li Le Zcash ƒe agbe ƒe akpa gã aɖe me la, zcashd nye nɔnɔmetata ƒe ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo kple ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo ƒe gakotoku si wotsɔ wɔa dɔ le production me ɖeka pɛ. Ɖoɖo siae nye nu si gatrɔƒewo, gaƒuƒowo, kple asikplɔ-dzraláwo tsɔ wɔa dɔ. zcashd dze le agbe me o azɔ. Gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi va yi Zebra gbɔ (eye azɔ hã yi Zakura gbɔ). Gakotoku si woƒo ɖe eŋu la va yi Zallet gbɔ. Gotagakotoku ƒe subɔsubɔ le trɔm tso lightwalletd gbɔ yi Zaino gbɔ. Nu atọ siawo le repository vovovowo me, release train vovovowo me, kple config vovovowo me. Z3 nye glue la: image si woɖo ƒe version ɖe afi, health check si wòna gakotoku la nɔ anyi va se ɖe esi ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ la sync, portwo kple volume vovovo na network vovovowo, kple mɔ si woŋlɔ ɖe agbalẽ me na dɔwɔlawo. Ŋkɔa nye ecosystem ƒe nuƒoƒo gbɔe — Zebra, Zaino, Zallet — togbɔ be Compose ƒe file si wotsɔ dea dɔ gɔme la dzea Zebra kple Zallet ko. Zaino nye Compose ƒe profile, menye dɔwɔwɔ etɔ si wòle be wòanye o. --- Ɖoɖo Akpa Eƒe dɔ le Z3 me Wòle be wòanye? --- --- --- Zebra Wòsync ɖoɖonu la eye wòdea eƒe nyateƒe me, gossip, JSON-RPC, health endpoint Ee Zallet Ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo ƒe gakotoku. Wòƒoa Zaino ƒe librarywo ɖe eŋu. Wòdoa nu tẽ na Zebra JSON-RPC. Wòmedoa nu na Zaino ƒe container si tɔ ɖe eɖokui ŋu o Ee Zaino Indexer si tɔ ɖe eɖokui ŋu. lightwalletd-si sɔ kple gRPC na gotago clientwo, kple JSON-RPC proxy na explorerwo kple ga suewo nanaƒewo Ao — --profile indexer Z3 ƒoa image ƒe versionwo ɖe afi le docker-compose.yml me. Trɔe kple Z3ZEBRAIMAGE, Z3ZAINOIMAGE, alo Z3ZALLETIMAGE ne tag bubu hiã wò. --- Ale si esɔ kple zcashd vovoe zcashd Z3 --- --- --- Gbegbɔgblɔ C++ (Bitcoin ƒe fork) Rust ƒe subɔsubɔwo, si woɖo le Docker Compose me Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe mɔ Binary ɖeka: ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ + gakotoku ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ kple gakotoku container vovovowo Gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi Woɖe le dɔ me (EOS 18 July 2026) Zebra (alo ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ bubu si sɔ kplii) Gakotoku wallet.dat si wònɔ eme Zallet, datadir si woɣa ɣa kple age Gotago clientwo Zi geɖe nye lightwalletd si le vovo Zaino profile si wòte ŋu atia Config zcash.conf File vovovowo na network le config/ / te kple Compose env ƒe filewo Network geɖewo le host ɖeka dzi Portwo ƒe dzreɖoƒe sesẽ Woɖoe nyuie: z3-mainnet, z3-testnet, z3-regtest Ne zcashd gakotoku le asiwò hã la, zã ZecHub ƒe migration guide kple Zallet ƒe migrate-zcashd-wallet command ɖe teƒe na be nàtsɔ wallet.dat akɔpi ayi Z3 ƒe volume me. --- Network

title: ZAP1 Ɖaseɖigbalɛ ƒe Ɖoɖo
description: ZAP1 nye open-source attestation protocol na Zcash. Eŋlɔ agbenɔnɔ ƒe nudzɔdzɔwo siwo woɖo ɖe ɖoɖo me ɖe BLAKE2b Merkle ti me, eye wòde ti la ƒe ke ɖe ɖoɖonu…
text: ZAP1 Ɖaseɖigbalɛ ƒe Ɖoɖo ZAP1 nye open-source attestation protocol na Zcash. Eŋlɔ agbenɔnɔ ƒe nudzɔdzɔwo siwo woɖo ɖe ɖoɖo me ɖe BLAKE2b Merkle ti me, eye wòde ti la ƒe ke ɖe ɖoɖonu dzi [on-chain] to Orchard ɣaɣla [shielded] nya kpui [memo]wo me. Ame sia ame ate ŋu akpɔ ɖaseɖigbalɛ [proof]wo ƒe nyateƒe. Nudzɔdzɔ ƒe datawo nɔ ɣaɣla me. Ale si wòwɔa dɔe Dzikpɔlawo ŋlɔ nudzɔdzɔ ƒomeviwo (deploymentwo, fexexewo [payments], transferwo, kple bubuawo) eye woɖo wo ɖe ZAP1 instance aɖe me. Nudzɔdzɔ sia sia wɔa leaf hash aɖe kple domain-separated BLAKE2b-256. Leafwo ƒoa nu ɖe Merkle ti me. Ne woɖo teƒe si woɖo ɖa la, woɖe ti la ƒe ke ɖe ZAP1:09 nya kpui me eye woɖe eƒe teƒe ɖe Zcash me le ɣaɣla gaɖoɖo [transaction] aɖe me. Ame sia ame si le leaf hash aɖe asi la ate ŋu aɖo kpekpeɖeŋu blibo tso leaf la dzi yi ti la ƒe ke gbɔ, eye tso afima yi ɖo ɖoɖonu [chain] dzi ƒe anchor gbɔ, evɔ mekpɔ dzikpɔla la dzi o. Nɔnɔme veviwo Application-agnostic: Zcash dzikpɔla sia sia ate ŋu aɖo eya ŋutɔ ƒe nudzɔdzɔ ƒomeviwo kple personalization stringwo ɣaɣla-wɔwɔ: Woha nudzɔdzɔ ƒe payloadwo hafi woade wo ƒe teƒe ɖe ɖoɖonu dzi. Hashwo koe yina ɖe ɖoɖonu dzi. Ame bubuwo hã ate ŋu akpɔe ƒe nyateƒe: Ɖasekpe la kple ɖoɖonu ƒe mɔɖoƒe koe hiã na verification. Dzikpɔla ƒe dzikpɔkpɔ mele mkpa o. ZIP 302 compatible: ZAP1 le ɖoɖo ɖe ZIP 302 partType aɖe ŋu na attestation payload la Nu siwo le eme Reference implementation (Rust, MIT licensed) Verification SDK le crates.io (Rust + 83KB WASM) JavaScript SDK le npm Universal memo decoder (eɖea ZAP1, ZIP 302 TVLV, text, binary, kple nya kpui si me nu aɖeke mele o) Conformance kit kple API check 29 kple protocol check 14 FROST 2-of-3 threshold signing design na amehawo ƒe anchor broadcasting ZIP draft PR #1243 le review me Mainnet anchor 4 kple leaf 14 le March 2026 me Architecture Dzikpɔla sia sia wɔa eya ŋutɔ ƒe ZAP1 instance kple eya ŋutɔ ƒe keywo, Merkle ti, kple anchorwo. State aɖeke mele dzikpɔlawo dome o. Afi si nàsrɔ nu ge ɖe eme akpɔ Source: github.com/Frontier-Compute/zap1 Verification SDK: crates.io/crates/zap1-verify Memo decoder: crates.io/crates/zcash-memo-decode Protocol spec: ONCHAINPROTOCOL.md ZIP draft: PR #1243 Live API: pay.frontiercompute.io/protocol/info Operator guide: OPERATORGUIDE.md

title: zecd — Ɣaɣla-Dzidzime Gakotoku Server
description: zecd nye ɣaɣla-dzidzime gakotoku server na Zcash, wo tu ɖe librustzcash dzi eye wo ɖe fia to Bitcoin Core ƒe JSON-RPC ƒe mɔnu me. Enaa mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔlawo kple…
text: zecd — Ɣaɣla-Dzidzime Gakotoku Server zecd nye ɣaɣla-dzidzime gakotoku server na Zcash, wo tu ɖe librustzcash dzi eye wo ɖe fia to Bitcoin Core ƒe JSON-RPC ƒe mɔnu me. Enaa mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔlawo kple fexexe ƒe ɖeɖeamewɔlawo API si woma nyuie eye si sɔ kple Bitcoin na woatsɔ ado go kple Zcash — eye wòwɔe be Orchard (gaƒuƒoƒo ɣaɣla kekeake) nanɔ anyigba la dzi. zec.rockse wɔe, eye wo ɖo zecd be wòaxe teƒe na zcashd ƒe gakotoku ƒe dɔwɔwɔ le cloud-native ƒe ɖoɖowɔwɔ yeye me. Version si le fifia: 0.5.0-rc3 (July 13, 2026) — kple Ironwood (NU6.3) ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu. Ɖo eƒe mɔnu to cargo install zecd dzi alo zã Docker ƒe image si wòɖo. --- Nyawo ƒe ƒometɔ zecd nye gakotoku daemon (server) — menye ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo o. Ewɔ dɔ kple key, scan, proof, kple RPC eye wòmegblɔ Zcash P2P protocol o. Egblɔ Bitcoin Core ƒe JSON-RPC ƒe mɔnu: method ƒe ŋkɔ ma ke, field ƒe nɔnɔme, auth, kple error code — Bitcoin RPC ƒe client geɖewo ate ŋu awɔ dɔ kple Zcash enumake. Orchard (ɣaɣla) gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo nye dzidzime; nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi (t-address) kple Sapling ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu hia be woaɖo e ɖe gakotoku sia gakotoku dzi. Eɖo eɖokui kple wò ŋutɔ ƒe Zebra ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo to local JSON-RPC dzi — lightwalletd mele be wòahiã o. State mele o le eƒe nɔnɔme nu: woate ŋu agbugbɔ gakotoku blibo tso gadzraɖoɖi nya ko me, eya ta data ƒe directory ate ŋu anye nu si woate ŋu atsɔ aɖe gbe. Menye zcashd ƒe teƒe-ɖeɖe tɔxɛ o: ewɔ Zcash RPC ƒe method ƒe akpa aɖe ko, kple tɔxɛ si woɖo kple ta na ɣaɣla kple dedie. Adzɔwo ɖo ɖe ZIP-317 dzi (adzɔ ƒe akɔntaɖoɖo si me tɔtrɔ mele o); wogbe adzɔ si zãla ɖo la gbɔ. Ekpe ɖe ɣaɣla nya kpuiwo (ZIP-302) ŋu to Bitcoin RPC ƒe nɔnɔme si woma nyuie dzi. --- Ka Nyae zecd Gbɔna? zcashd nye Zcash ƒe dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ kple gakotoku si woƒo ƒu le gɔmedzedze me — woɖe eƒe mɔnu tso Bitcoin ƒe C++ codebase me le 2016. Ɣeyiɣi me la, esia he fũfũ vɛ: code la sesẽ be woanɔa eŋu, gakotoku la ɖo kple dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ la ɖe asi, eye woɖe nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo fia abe ti siwo le xɔseme ɖeka me kple ɣaɣla tɔwo ene. zecd ma wɔ gakotoku ƒe dɔ kple gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi ƒe dɔ ɖeka o. Enye gakotoku ƒe ɖoɖo si woɖe ɖe eɖokui si nɔ applicationwo kple Zebra ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo dome, eye wòtsɔ esiawo vɛ: Rust ƒe dɔwɔwɔ yeye, dzadzɛ si woɖo ɖe librustzcash dzi (library ma ke nye si ɖena ŋusẽ na Zodl kple Zingo) Ɣaɣla-le-anyigba-dzidzime ƒe ɖoɖo (Orchard gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo ne woɖo e bubu o) Bitcoin-sɔkpe RPC ƒe interface si ɖe Zcash-tɔxɛ dɔwɔnu srɔ̃srɔ̃ ƒe hiaɖeɖe ɖa State mele o, eye woate ŋu agbugbɔe tso gadzraɖoɖi nya me, si sɔ na container kple cloud ƒe ɖoɖowɔwɔwo --- Ɖoɖowɔwɔ zecd wɔa dɔ le ɖoɖo ƒe akpa etɔ me: zecd doa go kple Zebra to local JSON-RPC ko dzi — peer-to-peer network mele o, third-party indexerwo mele o, lightwalletd mele o. Woɖo Zebra ƒe kadodo la be wòawɔ dɔ le afi-a ko: zecd agbe be yeado credential ɖe host si woate ŋu akpɔ le xexeame blibo me o, negbe woɖoe ɖe tunnel si woɣla le mɔ bubu nu (abe WireGuard alo SSH ene) ta. --- Nɔnɔme Veviwo Ɣaɣla-Dzidzime, Orchard Le Dzidzime zecd zãa Orchard Unified Addresswo abe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ƒe leƒoƒo dzidzime ene. Sapling kple nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi (t-address) gaƒuƒoƒowo hia be woaɖo wo ɖe gakotoku sia gakotoku dzi. Ɖoɖo sia ɖea afɔ ku ɖe nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi ƒe dɔdɔ ɖe vodada me ƒe agbale ŋu — ɣaɣla ƒe afɔku si dzɔna zi geɖe le Zcash ƒe dɔwɔnu xoxoawo me. Woate ŋu aɖo ɣaɣla ƒe se ɖe call sia call dzi alo le [spend] privacypolicy me le xexeame blibo: Se Nɔnɔme -------- ---------- AllowRevealedRecipients (dzidzime) Eɖea mɔ na dɔdɔ ɖe nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi ƒe ame xɔlawo gbɔ; eɖea asɔme kple ame xɔla fia ɖoɖonu dzi AllowRevealedAmounts Eɖea mɔ na dɔdɔ si dzea gaƒuƒoƒo dome (Sapling↔Orchard), gake egbea nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi ƒe ame xɔlawo gbɔ FullPrivacy Ɣaɣla blibotɔ ƒe dɔdɔ ko le gaƒuƒoƒo ɖeka me; egbea nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi ƒe ame xɔlawo kple dɔdɔ si dzea gaƒuƒoƒo dome gbɔ AllowFullyTransparent Eɖea mɔ na t→t ƒe dɔdɔ si woƒe nu tso nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi UTXOwo me hã Bitcoin Core RPC Ƒe Sɔkpe zecd wɔa Bitcoin Core ƒe JSON-RPC ƒe mɔnu, eye wòsɔ kple e

title: Zaino Nyatakaka ƒe Xexlẽla
description: Zaino nye Rust nyatakaka ƒe xexlẽla na Zcash gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu [blockchain]. Etsɔ ɖoɖonu [chain] ƒe nyatakakawo xlea tso Zebra ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo…
text: Zaino Nyatakaka ƒe Xexlẽla Zaino nye Rust nyatakaka ƒe xexlẽla na Zcash gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu [blockchain]. Etsɔ ɖoɖonu [chain] ƒe nyatakakawo xlea tso Zebra ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo [full node] me, eye wòtsɔ nyatakaka si gakotokuwɔ [wallet], explorers, ga suewo nanaƒewo [faucet], kple dɔwɔƒe bubuwo hia naa wo, menye be Zebra ŋutɔ nanɔ agbagba be yea wòanɔ client ƒe ŋgɔ ƒe xexlẽwo katã wɔ. Nyatakaka Kpuie Zebra dea Zcash ƒe ɖoɖonu dzi. Zaino xlea Zebra ƒe ɖoɖonu ƒe nyatakakawo eye wòna API siwo le client ƒe ŋgɔ. Zallet nye gakotoku ƒe akpa le Z3 ƒe ɖoɖo me. Le Z3 ƒe ɖoɖo si wowɔ do ŋgɔ la me, Zallet ƒoa nu kple Zebra tẽ, eye wòmehia be woawɔ Zaino dɔwɔƒe si le eƒe ŋutɔ. Zaino dɔwɔƒe si le eƒe ŋutɔ la wɔnɛ na dɔwɔlawo ne wohia gRPC ƒe teƒe si sɔ kple lightwalletd, JSON-RPC ƒe proxy, alo ɖoɖo na gakotoku siwo me, explorers, ga suewo nanaƒewo, kple dɔwɔƒe siwo sɔ kple wo. Zaino nye ɖoɖo si le dɔ wɔm fifia, gake dɔwɔlawo ele be woakpɔ Zaino kple Z3 ƒe nyatakaka si le zãm fifia hafi woawɔe le production me. Nu Si Zaino Wɔna Zaino nɔa Zebra kple client ƒe mɔ̃wo dome. Zebra nye gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi [consensus] ƒe ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ [node]: ewɔ download, ekpɔ ɖoɖonu ƒe nyateƒe, eye wòzɔ ɖe Zcash gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu dzi. Zaino zãa Zebra abe eƒe ɖoɖonu ƒe nyatakaka ƒe teƒe ene, eye wòdzra nyatakaka si woexlẽ ɖo be client ƒe applicationwo ate ŋu abiabia wo bɔbɔe. Mama wɔnɛ be dɔwɔƒeawo ƒe dɔwo nɔ kɔ: Akpa Eƒe Dɔ :-- :-- Zebra Ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo kple nyateƒe ƒe kpɔla Zaino Nyatakaka ƒe xexlẽla kple API dɔwɔƒe si le client ƒe ŋgɔ Zallet Gakotoku ƒe dɔwɔƒe lightwalletd Gakotoku si me ƒe server xoxotɔ si Zaino woɖoe be wòatsɔ teƒe na alo wòakpe ɖe eŋu Zaino naa dɔwɔnu na nyatakaka si hiã ƒe mɔwo [light client], client blibowo alo gakotokuwɔ, kple gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe [block] ƒe explorers. Ena mɔ woakpɔ ɖoɖonu si wowɔ ɖo, ɖoɖonu nyuitɔ si womede ɖo haɖe o, kple mempool ƒe nyatakaka si Zebra le ɖasi. Ale Si Wòle Le Zcash Ƒe Ɖoɖo Si Le Zãm Fifi La Me Z3 ƒe ɖoɖo si le zãm fifia tu ɖe Zebra, Zallet, kple Zaino si wòate ŋu anya la dzi. Le Z3 ƒe ɖoɖo si wowɔ do ŋgɔ la me, Zebra kple Zallet wɔa dɔ ɖekae. Zallet va ɖe Zebra tẽ, eyata dɔwɔla si le gakotoku ƒe ɖoɖo le eƒe teƒe ko wɔm la mehia be wòadzɔ Zaino dɔwɔƒe si le eƒe ŋutɔ o. Woɖea Zaino kpe ɖe eŋu ne dɔwɔla di be yeana dɔ na client siwo le afima. Le Z3 me, wɔa dɔ le indexer Compose profile megbe eye wòkpea ɖe eŋu be: GRPC ƒe teƒe si sɔ kple lightwalletd na gakotoku si me ƒe clientwo JSON-RPC ƒe proxy na explorers, ga suewo nanaƒewo, kple service backendwo Xexlẽla ƒe database si to vovo na Zebra ƒe ɖoɖonu ƒe nɔnɔme Eya ta Zaino le vevie na gakotoku ƒe backendwo, dɔwɔla siwo le dukɔ blibo ƒe ɖoɖo wɔm, explorers, ga suewo nanaƒewo, kple mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔlawo [developer] siwo le dɔwɔƒe siwo hia Zcash ƒe ɖoɖonu nyatakaka si woexlẽ ɖo la dometɔwo kpɔm. Zaino Kple lightwalletd lightwalletd nye gakotoku si me ƒe server gãtɔ. Zaino nye mɔ si doa ɖe Rust dzi na dɔ sia. Eƒe taɖodzinu nye be wòana API siwo sɔ kple wo le afi si wòate ŋu, ale be gakotokuwɔ kple dɔwɔƒeawo nate ŋu atrɔ va eŋu mekpɔ be woagblẽ wo katã gake ɖe kɔkɔe. Esia mefia be lightwalletd ƒe ɖoɖowo katã trɔ va Zaino dzi xoxo o. Dɔwɔlawo ele be woakpɔ Zaino abe Zebra-based ɖoɖo si le zãm fifia ƒe akpa ene, eye woakpɔ project ƒe nyatakaka yeyewo, releases, kple service ɖoɖowo ƒe ɖoɖowo ƒuƒopé [dashboard] hafi woatia nu si woawɔ. Dɔwɔla Ƒe Nɔteƒe Nyatakakawo Mɔ bɔbɔe si wɔa dɔ le authority me na deployment nye Z3 ƒe repository. Z3 tsɔa Zaino dea eme abe service si wòate ŋu anya ene: Wɔ Z3 ƒe ɖoɖo si wozãa ɣea gbã do ŋgɔ, eye nɔ anyi ne Zebra ade sync hafi nàdzɔ dɔwɔƒe siwo ɖe eŋu le mainnet alo testnet dzi. Zaino ɖea network dɔwɔƒe ƒomevi eve fia. GRPC ƒe dɔwɔƒe nye API si le lightwallet ƒe ŋgɔ. JSON-RPC ƒe dɔwɔƒe la wotu eɖe loopback alo private network siwo wobɔ ŋu ko, negbe be akpa bubu nana dzɔdzɔe. Mègana JSON-RPC ƒe teƒe si me authentication alo encryption mele o nado go ɖe public internet dzi o. Nɔnɔmetata Aɖewo Siwo Fia Ale Si Zaino Wɔa

title: Zakura Ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ
description: Zakura nye ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo [full node] ƒe dɔwɔwɔ si nye fɛɛ, eye wode eƒe source code ɖe go, si woɖo na dzidzime kɛkɛ; wodee ɖe Zcash ta. Woɖe eƒe afã…
text: Zakura Ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ Zakura nye ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo [full node] ƒe dɔwɔwɔ si nye fɛɛ, eye wode eƒe source code ɖe go, si woɖo na dzidzime kɛkɛ; wodee ɖe Zcash ta. Woɖe eƒe afã tso Zebra me, eye Valar Group kple Project Tachyon wɔe ɖe ɖekawɔwɔ me. Zakura na sync va yɔ wu aɖeŋu, eƒe gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe [block] ƒe ƒeƒeɖeɖe le eƒe me, eye wòwɔ be xoxo zcashd ƒe dɔwɔnuwo nasɔ ɖe eŋu. Woɖe version 1.0.0 ɖe go le July 15, 2026. --- TL;DR Zakura nye consensus-compatible [consensus-compatible] Zcash ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo — eya nye Zebra kple zcashd ƒe fli, si woɖe tso Zebra me. Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu [blockchain] ƒe sync yɔ wu Zebra ƒetɔ teƒe 5; snapshot ƒe bootstrap wowɔe le miniti 2 me o. Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe ƒeƒeɖeɖe si le eƒe me na dɔwɔlawo ŋu woatsɔ disk ƒe teƒe sue ŋutɔ awɔ ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo (snapshot si woɖe ɖeɖi ƒe 11 GB vs. 300 GB na Zebra ƒe ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo). zcashd RPC ƒe mɔnu si wòkplɔ xoxo nu na gakotokuwo kple ɖekawɔwɔwo siwo le xoxo la nɔ dɔ wɔm ntle be woatrɔ naneke. P2P ƒe gbeɖoɖo ƒe akpa si wonɔ kpɔm (woɖe wòwɔwɔ le eƒe gɔmedzedze me) di be gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe gbeɖoɖo nava le 500ms te, kple gossip si ƒe DoS mate ŋu awɔ nu na. Wòdo ɖeka kple Ironwood (NU6.3), Zcash ƒe mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ [network upgrade] si dze egɔme le 2026 ƒe titina me. Zakura Common (v1.3.0, August 2026) wɔ be cryptography si gakotokuwo zazãna tsɔ wɔ gaɖoɖo ɣaɣla na yɔ wu: tso sekondi 3 wu dzi va ɖe 200 ms te le nyawo geɖe me, ɖe Zakura ƒe benchmarkwo nu. Sean Bowe (Zcash ƒe hadɔwɔkplɔla, Project Tachyon) kple Dev Ojha (Valar Group) kplɔa eƒe dɔ dzi. --- Zakura nye nu kae? Zakura nye Zcash ƒe ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo si woɖo tso eƒe gɔmedzedze me be wòanɔ klalo na dɔwɔwɔ le dzidzime kɛkɛ me. Togbɔ be wòdo ɖeka le consensus [consensus] me kple Zebra — esia fia be wòxɔa eye wòkplɔa Zcash ƒe protocol se mawo — Zakura tsɔ mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖo ƒe nyuitɔ geɖewo va, siwo ƒe ta nye be ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo Zcash ƒe dɔwɔwɔ nagbɔ na amewo. Dɔa nye ɖekawɔwɔ le Project Tachyon (Sean Bowe, si nye Zcash ƒe cryptography mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔla [developer] gbãtɔwo dometɔ ɖeka, kplɔe dzi) kple Valar Group (Dev Ojha kplɔe dzi) dome. Ɖekae woƒoa ŋku Zcash ƒe protocol ƒe nyuitɔ siwo tso dzidzime yeyee me ŋu, eye Zakura nye ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ si wotsɔa ɖo dɔa ma ƒe kpɔɖeŋu. --- Nɔnɔme Veviwo Ɖoɖonu ƒe Sync Yɔ Wu Teƒe 5 Zakura wɔa gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu ƒe sync yɔ wu teƒe 5 sɔ kple Zebra. Esia wɔe be wòanɔ bɔbɔe na dɔwɔlawo siwo hia be woawɔ ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ le zã ɖeka me alo woagbugbɔ tso dɔtsiɖi me. Snapshot ƒe Bootstrap Zakura ɖea ɖoɖonu ƒe snapshot si woɖo ɖi xoxo ɖe go, siwo ɖea sync ƒe gɔmedzedze ƒe gaƒoƒo kpɔtɔ: Bootstrap Mɔnu Gaƒoƒo ----------------- ------ Archive snapshot 37 miniti Snapshot si woɖe ɖeɖi Miniti 2 te Zebra (sync blibo) awa 20 Snapshot si woɖe ɖeɖi la le 11 GB te, eye esia na ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ ƒe bootstrap yɔ wu teƒe 680 sɔ kple sync si dze egɔme tso genesis. Gaɖoɖowo Ƒuƒoƒe Ƒe Ƒeƒeɖeɖe Si Le Eƒe Me Zakura xɔa gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe ƒeƒeɖeɖe si wòte ŋu woawɔ ƒe ɖoɖo, na ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ ƒe dɔwɔlawo ŋu woaɖo ɖoɖonu ƒe ŋutinya ƒe akpa si woakpɔ ɖeɖi. Esia wɔe be woate ŋu awɔ ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo le hardware si ƒe nutome le sue dzi — eƒe nyuie na validators, mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔlawo, kple infrastructure ƒe nudzɔdzɔlawo siwo mehia ɖoɖonu ƒe ŋutinya blibo o. zcashd RPC Ƒe Mɔnu Si Wòkplɔ Xoxo Nu Zakura ƒe mɔnu si wòkplɔ xoxo nu le eŋu, si gbugbɔna xoxo zcashd JSON-RPC ƒe interface. Gakotokuwo, gatrɔƒewo [exchange], kple ɖekawɔwɔwo siwo ɖoa ɖoku ɖe zcashd RPCwo ŋu ate ŋu atrɔ va Zakura gbɔ ne code ƒe tɔtrɔ aɖeke mele o. P2P Ƒe Gbeɖoɖo Ƒe Akpa Si Wonɔ Kpɔm Zakura va kple peer-to-peer gbeɖoɖo ƒe akpa si tso dzidzime yeyee me, si woɖe wòwɔwɔ le eƒe gɔmedzedze me. Ne wowɔe la, eƒe tame nye: Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe gbeɖoɖo si ƒe vɔ̃ wu katã meva le 500ms te le network blibo me Mempool ƒe nuƒoƒo be gaɖoɖo ƒe gbeɖoɖo nasɔ nyuie wu Gossip protocol si ƒe DoS mate ŋu awɔ nu na, be network ƒe sesẽsesẽ nasɔ nyuie wu Akpa sia nye Zcash ƒe network ƒe nyuitɔ siwo wogbeŋu

title: Zallet
description: Zallet nye ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo Zcash gakotoku [wallet] si woŋlɔ kple Rust. Enye gakotoku si ɖo teƒe na esi nɔ zcashd me tsã. Le esime zcashd va ɖo eƒe…
text: Zallet Zallet nye ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo Zcash gakotoku [wallet] si woŋlɔ kple Rust. Enye gakotoku si ɖo teƒe na esi nɔ zcashd me tsã. Le esime zcashd va ɖo eƒe Kpekpeɖeŋu Nuva Kaka le 18 July 2026 le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe [block] ƒe kɔkɔme 3417100 la, womama gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi [consensus] kple gakotoku ƒe dɔwo: Zebra alo Zakura dea ɖoɖonu [chain] la dzi, eye Zallet lée safuiwo me, le didienuwo [note] ŋuti, eye wòna gakotoku JSON-RPC la. Zallet Le beta me fifia. Womema kpe ɖe eŋu bliboa o. Tɔtrɔ siwo agbã nu ate ŋu abia be woatu gakotoku [wallet] la ɖa eye woawɔe azɔ. Mègawɔe abe asikplɔ-dzralá si le dɔ wɔm na ZEC geɖe o ne mèxlẽ dedienyawo tso ŋgɔ le Zallet Ƒe Agbalẽ me o. --- TL;DR Zallet nye ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo RPC gakotoku, menye mobile nyatakaka si hiã [light client] gakotoku o, eye menye gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi ƒe ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ o. Ewɔ ɖe teƒe na zcashd ƒe gakotoku akpa. Ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ akpa la nye Zebra alo Zakura. Woŋlɔe kple Rust, eye wòle MIT / Apache-2.0 mɔgbale eve te, eye woɖea eŋu le zcash/zallet me. Taɖodzinu si woɖe tsoe le August 2026 ƒe nuwuwu nye: v0.1.0-beta.3. Etsɔa mɔ eve dometɔ ɖeka ƒe megbeŋu kpɔa ɖoɖonu ƒe nyatakakawo: zebra-state (ReadStateService si tso teƒe ɖeka yi teƒe bubu le zebrad si le afi me) alo Zaino. Ena zcashd-sɔ JSON-RPC ƒe akpa aɖe. Mɔ aɖewo trɔ; wometsɔ aɖewo de eme ɖe ŋutinya ta. Woɣaɣla safui ƒe nuwo ɣesiaɣi kple age. Gaɖoɖo ƒe ŋutinya, gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo, kple nukpɔsafuiwo [viewing key] nɔa kɔkɔe le wallet.db me. Eɖea binary atọ le archive si wode asi ɖo dzi ɖeka me: zallet (dzedzenu), zallet-zebra, kple zallet-zaino. Nyagbalẽ siwo tso wɔnawo gbɔ: The Zallet Book. --- Nu ka ta Zallet li zcashd tsɔ Bitcoin Core-me gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ kple gakotoku wɔa dɔ le process ɖeka me. Mɔɖoɖo ma megali o. Dɔ Tsã ƒe stack Fifia ƒe stack ------ ----------- --------------- Gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi / P2P zcashd Zebra (zebrad) alo Zakura Gakotoku / safuiwo / balance zcashd wallet.dat Zallet (wallet.db) Nyatakaka si hiã ƒe indexer lightwalletd Zaino alo lightwalletd Esime woɖe gakotoku la tso ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ la me la, eƒe gɔme nye: Wòate ŋu atrɔ ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ ƒe software (Zebra kpe Zakura) ne womeɖe safuiwo o. Gakotoku ƒe didienuwo ŋuti lekpɔkpɔ kple gaɖeɖe ƒe ŋusẽ nɔa process si wòate ŋu aɖo dedie ɖe eɖokui ŋu me. RPC ƒe gɔmesese ate ŋu anɔ yiyim ɖe ZIP 32 accounts, Unified Addresses, kple PCZTs ŋu, le teƒe be wòanɔ zcashd ƒe nɔnɔ ɖeɖeawo me ɣeaɣi. Zallet nye gakotoku si woɖo ɖe wɔnɔlawo ta, ame siwo tsɔa zcashd wɔa hot gakotoku, gatrɔƒe [exchange] ƒe megbeŋu, ga suewo nanaƒe [faucet], alo nukuku [mining] ƒe fetu nana gakotoku tsã. --- Nɔnɔ Zallet le beta me. Nu si esia gɔmee le wɔwɔ me lae nye: Tsoɖoɖo siwo ŋu woate ŋu agbã ate ŋu ava le beta ɖe sia ɖe me. Ate ŋu ahia be nàtutu nyatakaka ƒe agbadɔ la eye nàdze egɔme ake. Wometsɔ zcashd gakotoku RPC ɖe sia ɖe va o. Mɔ siwo woɖe va ƒe gɔmesese aɖewo to vovo na zcashd tɔ. Ele be integrationwo naxlẽ altered-semantics page. Cratewo le dzidzime eye womekpɔ wo blibo o. Zallet menye Rust library o. Meli be wòaxɔ ɖoɖo ɖe eŋu abe library ene o. Nàɖo numekukuwo ɖe GitHub issues alo #wallet-dev channel le Zcash R&D Discord dzi. Woɖoe be nɔnɔ si le tsitre ate ava emegbe ne RPC ƒe ƒome si woɖo ɖe eme la ŋutɔ li. Le ɣeyiɣi ma me la, woalé mɔ na ame siwo yɔa eŋu be woatrɔ yi Zallet ƒe mɔwo dzi, kple gɔmesese ƒe vovototo siwo woŋlɔ ɖe agbalẽ me. --- Ɖoɖoɖo Zallet mamãe le Cargo workspaces atọ dome be ɖoɖonu ƒe megbeŋu eve la nɔ dependency graphs vovovo ŋu. Binary atọ katã ʋua wallet.db ma ke. Dzedzenu la tia megbeŋu le esime wòle dɔ wɔm; mele be nàɖo eɖokui ake be nàtrɔ o. Ɖoɖoɖo si wowɔa zi geɖe: Zallet nye ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo gakotoku: exɔa ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ si dea ɖoɖonu la dzi si le afi me. Menye nyatakaka si hiã o. Na gakotoku siwo le keklẽ kple compact-block serverwo la, kpɔ Zaino kple Lightwallet Nodes. Zcash Foundation ƒe Z3 compose stack la na Zebra kple Zallet wɔa dɔ kpeɖeŋu, kple Zaino si ate ŋu anɔ eɖokui ŋu na nyatakaka si hiã siwo tso afima. --- Accountw

title: Zcash Ɣaɣla ƒe Nudzɔdzɔwo [Shielded Assets]
description: Zcash Ɣaɣla ƒe Nudzɔdzɔwo (ZSA) nye protocol ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu si wo đề be wòana nudzɔdzɔwo siwo menye ZEC o — stablecoinwo, dziɖuɖu tokenwo, alo nudzɔdzɔ si wòate…
text: Zcash Ɣaɣla ƒe Nudzɔdzɔwo [Shielded Assets] Nu Vevi Keke Zcash Ɣaɣla ƒe Nudzɔdzɔwo (ZSA) nye protocol ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu si wo đề be wòana nudzɔdzɔwo siwo menye ZEC o — stablecoinwo, dziɖuɖu tokenwo, alo nudzɔdzɔ si wòate ŋu adze ɖe wò ŋutɔ ŋu — nɔ Zcash ƒe ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo me, eye woaɣla ame si dɔe ɖa, ame si xɔe, kple ga si woɖo. Nu si wònye: ERC-20 ƒe ƒomevi me nudzɔdzɔ siwo wòate ŋu adze ɖe wò ŋutɔ ŋu, gake woɣaɣla wo tso gɔmedzedze. Ame siwo le eƒe tutu wɔm: QEDIT, le ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu tso Zcash Foundation me ƒe te, eye woƒoa dɔ ɖekae kple Electric Coin Company. Ale si woɖe eƒe sewo le: ZIP 226 (tsɔtsɔ kple tɔtɔ) kple ZIP 227 (dɔwɔwɔ). Nɔnɔme: Menɔ agbe le mainnet dzi o, eye menye Network Upgrade 7 (NU7) ƒe akpa o. ZIP 259, si ɖea nu sia nu si NU7 ade dɔme afia la, mekpɔ ZIP 226 alo ZIP 227 o, eye womede ZSA ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ŋkeke ɖo haɖe o. Adzɔwo: Woɖea wo ɖe ZEC me ɣe sia ɣi, togbɔ be nudzɔdzɔ kae wole tsɔm o. --- Gɔme Nya Vevi Zcash Ɣaɣla ƒe Nudzɔdzɔwo (ZSA) nye ɖoɖo si wo đề be woatsɔ akpe ɖe Zcash protocol la ŋu, si ana wòaŋu adze nudzɔdzɔ siwo wòate ŋu adze ɖe wò ŋutɔ ŋu, atsɔ wo, eye wòatɔ wo le Zcash ɖoɖonu dzi. Ne nènya ERC-20 token ƒe standard le Ethereum ƒe gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu dzi la, ZSAwo le Zcash ŋu abe ale si ERC-20 tokenwo le Ethereum ŋu ene. Zcash Ɣaɣla ƒe Nudzɔdzɔwo ana wòate ŋu adze token siwo wòate ŋu adze ɖe wò ŋutɔ ŋu le Zcash gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu dzi, eye woana token siwo menye ZEC o nakpɔ ɣaɣla kple ɣaɣla gaɖoɖowo ƒe nyuiwo le Zcash gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu dzi. ZSA ƒe dɔwɔwɔ si ate ŋu anye vevi ŋutɔ aɖe nye be woado stablecoinwo ɖe Zcash protocol la dzi. Stablecoinwo nye crypto ga siwo doa woƒe asixɔxɔ ɖe fiat ga, abe US Dollar alo Euro ene, ŋu. Egbe la, stablecoin siwo le amewo dome tsɔtsɔ geɖe wu la aɖewo nye ERC-20 tokenwo abe USDC kple Dai ene. ZSA ƒe dɔwɔwɔ bubu si ate ŋu anye nye be woado dziɖuɖu tokenwo. Le kpɔɖeŋu me, ZecHub (wiki sia ƒe tata) nye Decentralized Autonomous Organization (DAO), eye wòate ŋu adze ZSA aɖe na eƒe membrewo be woatsɔ akpe ɖe ɖoɖowo kple dziɖuɖu ƒe nya me. QEDIT le ZSAwo ŋutɔ wɔm le ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu gã tso Zcash Foundation me ƒe te, eye woƒoa dɔ ɖekae kple Electric Coin Company. Esi wole dɔ sia ŋutɔ wɔm ha la, woɖoa yeye nyawo ɖe kakaka sia me le Zcash forum la dzi. ZSA ƒe ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe biabia si QEDIT wɔ la le Zcash Foundation ƒe ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe website dzi. --- Nɔnɔmetata / Ɖeɖeɖe Agbalẽ ƒe agbado si woƀɔ Bu Zcash ɣaɣla gaɖoɖo aɖe ɖe agbado bɔbɔe si woƀɔ, eye woƒoe ɖe post ƒe agbadonu me le amewo kata ƒe ŋkume. Ame sia ame ate ŋu akpɔ be woƒo agbado aɖe ɖa. Ame aɖeke mate ŋu akpɔ ame si dɔe ɖa, ame si xɔe, alo nu si le eme o — eye agbadowo katã nɔna abe wo nɔewo ene. Egbe la, agbado aɖe le Zcash network dzi ate ŋu atsɔ nu ɖeka ko: ZEC. ZSA metrɔ agbado la o. Etrɔ nu si wòle mɔ na wòanɔ eme. Le ZSA megbe la, agbado bɔbɔe ma ke ate ŋu atsɔ stablecoin, DAO dziɖuɖu token, alo dɔwɔƒe ƒe nudzɔdzɔ si wotsɔa dea amewo dzi, eye le gota la, anɔ abe agbado bubu sia bubu le network la dzi ene. Nya ɖeka si wòle be nàɖo ɖe dzi me nye esi: Woɖea post ƒe adzɔ la ɖe ZEC me ɣe sia ɣi, togbɔ be nu kae le agbado la me o. Nu si ame si le gota ate ŋu akpɔ Nu si ame si le gota ate ŋu akpɔ... ERC-20 le Ethereum dzi ZSA le Zcash dzi --- --- --- Ame si dɔe ɖa Dze ɖe amewo ŋkume Ɣaɣla Ame si xɔe Dze ɖe amewo ŋkume Ɣaɣla Ga si woɖo Dze ɖe amewo ŋkume Ɣaɣla Ame ɖeka ƒe ga siwo le esi Dze ɖe amewo ŋkume Ɣaɣla Nudzɔdzɔ la ƒe xexlẽme katã Dze ɖe amewo ŋkume Dze ɖe amewo ŋkume — le ta aɖe ta Ga si woɖea adzɔ le eme ETH ZEC Nu ka ta xexlẽme ƒe fli menye vodada o Tebɔ dzi fli eveawo le kplɔlɔ̃ la me nye afi si ZSA ƒe vevie gɔme ɖe. ZIP 227 ɖoe be dɔwɔwɔ nɔa nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi, be woate ŋu akplɔ nudzɔdzɔ sia sia ƒe xexlẽme si le amewo dome ɖe ɖoɖonu dzi. Ame ɖeka ƒe ga siwo le esi kple fexexewo nɔa ɣaɣla me; token siwo le anyigba dzi ƒe xexlẽme katã menɔa ɣaɣla me o. Na stablecoin ƒe dodola aɖe la, ƒomevi sia nye ta la, menye nyagblɔɖi o. Woate ŋu adzro reservewo akpɔ wo akplɔ ɖe xexlẽme si

title: Zcash Gakotoku [Wallet] Ƒe Sync Wɔwɔ
description: Zcash zãa zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛwo [proofs] be wòaɣla gaɖoɖo ƒe nyawo na ame siwo menye mɔ na wo o. Ɣaɣla [privacy] sia na sync wɔwɔ sesẽ na gakotoku…
text: Zcash Gakotoku [Wallet] Ƒe Sync Wɔwɔ TL;DR Elabena ɣaɣla [shielded] Zcash gaɖoɖowo [transactions] ɣla woƒe nyawo la, server aɖeke mate ŋu adi gakotoku ƒe balance le bɔbɔe abe ale si wòate ŋu awɔe na nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi [transparent] coins abe Bitcoin kple Ethereum ene o. Gakotoku suewo [Light wallets] ƒea gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe suewo "compact blocks" tso server tɔxɛ aɖe (lightwalletd) gbɔ, eye wodecrypt data si le bubu me la woaŋutɔ kple woƒe private keys. Compact blocks siawo ƒe decrypt kple processing bia ɣeyiɣi, eyata gakotokuwɔlawo zãa sync mɔ kabalakabala be nàte ŋu azã wò ga le ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe me. Mɔ siwo nye vevi: Warp Sync (YWallet), Spend-before-sync (Zcash Mobile Wallet SDK V2), Blaze Sync (Zecwallet), kple DAGSync si wotsɔe va gblɔ. Zi geɖe, mɔ siawo trɔ memory alo processing power bubu aɖe na sync kabalakabala. Nya Vevi Ƒe Gɔmesese Ale si Zcash sync wɔa dɔe Zcash zãa zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛwo [proofs] be wòaɣla gaɖoɖo ƒe nyawo na ame siwo menye mɔ na wo o. Ɣaɣla [privacy] sia na sync wɔwɔ sesẽ na gakotoku suewo, elabena wometsɔ gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu [blockchain] blibo la ɖe woƒe teƒe me o, ke boŋ wodea asi server aɖe ŋu be wòatsɔ nyawo siwo hia na wo. Kple Bitcoin alo Ethereum la, serverwo ate ŋu aɖe blockchain la ƒe index eye woatsɔ account data ava kabalakabala. Ke kple Zcash la, server la mate ŋu akpɔ gaɖoɖo ƒe nyawo o. Eya ta, aleke gakotoku sue aɖe ate ŋu async eƒe balance kple eƒe ŋutinya ne metsɔ blockchain blibo la ƒe download kple decrypt wɔ eya ŋutɔ o? Zcash ɖɔ nya sia kple mɔ vovovowo ƒe ƒoƒo. Eƒe server tɔxɛ, lightwalletd, dea data ɖa tso ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo [full node] aɖe me eye wòle esi si hia na gaɖoɖo ƒe dzesi wɔwɔ koe ɖe asi. Woyɔ data sia be compact blocks, eye wònye sue wu gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒewo [blocks] gɔmedzedzeawo. Gakotoku suewo gbãna ƒea compact blocks siawo tso lightwalletd server la gbɔ eye woɖea wo decrypt kple woƒe private keys. Hã, compact blocks siawo ƒe decrypt kple processing ate ŋu axɔ ɣeyiɣi geɖe, vevie ne gaɖoɖowo geɖe le block sia block me. Eya ta gakotokuwɔlawo zãa mɔ vovovowo be woakpɔ sync ƒe kabalakabala eye woana nàzã wò ga le ɣeyiɣi si le ema wu. Nuku Ƒe Nɔnɔmetata / Sɔsɔ Bu blockchain la be wonye posuƒe gã aɖe si me bokisi siwo woɖe ɖe ga me le. Kple nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi coin aɖe la, posuƒe ƒe dɔwɔla ate ŋu axlẽ labelwo eye wòagblɔ na wò enumake bokisi kae nye wòtɔ. Kple Zcash la, woɣla labelwo — eyata wò gakotoku hia be wòatsɔ eƒe keywo akpɔ bokisiwo ɖokui be wòakpɔ esiawo si wòate ŋu aʋu. Sync mɔ siwo le ete la nye mɔ vovovo siwo wɔa bokisi siawo ƒe kpekpe kabalakabala. Nya Ƒe Kpɔkpɔ Kɔkɔe Warp Sync Warp sync nye YWallet ƒe feature si dzoa compact block sia compact block ƒe decrypt kple processing ƒe afã titinae, eye wòyi ɖe nu mamlea tẽ. Be wòawɔe la, ezãa mathematics kple cryptography be wòabu nu mamlea me, eye wòmato afɔ sia afɔ me o. Warp sync ate ŋu awɔ blocks akpe geɖe le sekondi ɖeka me, eye wòkaba wu sync mɔ si wozãna zi geɖe. Esia fia be YWallet ƒe zazãlawo ate ŋu akpɔ dɔwɔwɔ kabalakabala kple dɔwɔwɔ ɖeɖe, hã ne gaɖoɖowo akpe alafa geɖe kple didienuwo [notes] siwo woxɔ le woƒe accountwo me. Tso afɔdzo mɔ sia gbɔ la, YWallet ate ŋu awɔ blocks geɖe ɖe ɣeyiɣi ma ke me, eye wòmama dɔ la na wò hardware siwo le asiwò me be wòakpɔe kabalakabala wu. Xlẽ Nya Geɖe tso Warp Sync Ŋu Wogblɔ Warp sync le afisia be enye sync ƒe mɔ aɖe. Ywallet ŋutɔ wometsɔ dɔ wɔm o eye womatsɔe ava yeye na Ironwood o, eyata menye gakotoku si nàɖo egbe o. Spend-before-sync Spend-before-sync nye feature yeye le Zcash Mobile Wallet SDK V2 me si na zazãlawo ate ŋu azã woƒe ga enumake ne woʋu woƒe gakotoku, eye womaxɔe ase be gakotoku la ƒe sync blibo nawɔ wu o. Feature sia kaba gakotoku la ƒe balance si wòate ŋu azã ƒe kpɔkpɔ eye wòna zazãla ƒe nɔnɔ nyo wu. Spend-before-sync wɔa dɔ kple compact-blocks sync algorithm si wɔa blocks tso lightwalletd server la gbɔ le ɖoɖo si menye tẽ o me. Esia fia be, ɖe teƒe be gakotokuwo nɔ anyi be block ɖeka ƒe processing blibo nawɔ wu hafi woayi edzi la, wòate ŋu azã memor

title: Zebra Ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo [Full Node]
description: Zebra nye Zcash ƒe ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ gbãtɔ si woŋlɔ blibo le Rust me. Enɔ le Zcash peer-to-peer network la dzi, afi si wòna dzesi eye wòɖe gaɖoɖowo ɖe go, eye…
text: Zebra Ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo [Full Node] Nu Vevi Kpuie Zebra (zebrad) nye Zcash ƒe ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo si woŋlɔ le Rust me, eye Zcash Foundation kpɔa e ŋu. Ena dzesi gaɖoɖowo ƒe gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒewo kple gaɖoɖowo, lée ɖoɖonu ƒe nɔnɔme me, eye wòdo go kple ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ bubuwo to peer-to-peer network la dzi. Zebra kple zcashd wɔ protocol ma ke eye woate ŋu adɔ ɖe ewo nɔewo ŋu. Tso zcashd ƒe dzidzimegagbe me la, Zebra tsɔ gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi [consensus] ƒe dɔa yi. Mɔ eve si wòate ŋu atsɔ awɔe: zfnd/zebra Docker image, alo asrɔ̃ tso source me. Hardware si woɖo to nye CPU cores 4, RAM GB 16, kple disk GB 300. Esi le egɔme keke nye cores 2 kple RAM GB 4, eye disk GB 300 ma ke. Nudzidzɔ Gɔmeɖeɖe Zebra nye Zcash ƒe ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ gbãtɔ si woŋlɔ blibo le Rust me. Enɔ le Zcash peer-to-peer network la dzi, afi si wòna dzesi eye wòɖe gaɖoɖowo ɖe go, eye wòléa blockchain [gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu] ƒe nɔnɔme me. Dɔwɔwɔ si le ɖokuibɔbɔ me bubu ta la, network ƒe nuɖoɖo medze ɖe codebase ɖeka ko ŋu o. Zebra kple zcashd Zcash ƒe ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ gbãtɔ, zcashd, Electric Coin Company ye wɔe tso Bitcoin ƒe codebase me. Woŋlɔ Zebra tso gɔmedzeƒe me le Rust me, si nye gbe si dea ŋku memory ƒe dedie ŋu, eye woɖe asi le dzadzra kple dɔwɔwɔ nyuie ŋu. Dɔwɔwɔ eveawo katã zãa protocol ma ke, eyata woate ŋu ado go kple nɔewo eye woawɔ dɔ ɖekae. zcashd va ɖo eƒe End-of-Support ƒe tɔtɔ 18 July 2026, eye megadzɔna o, si na Zebra kple Zakura koe nye ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo siwo le dɔ wɔm fifia. Kpɔ Ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔwo blibo be nàkpɔ nɔnɔme bliboa. Zebra Ƒe Dɔwɔwɔ Àte ŋu awɔ Zebra kple Docker image, alo nàtu e ɖokuiwò. Taflatse kpɔ System Requirements ƒe akpa. Docker Ƒe Zazã Be nàwɔ release yeyetɔ eye nàsync e ɖo tip la, wɔ sedede sia: Na fiafia bliboa, yi Docker ƒe agbalẽdzɔɖoɖo gbɔ. Zebra Ƒe Tututu Zebra ƒe tututu hia Rust, libclang, kple C++ compiler. Kpɔ be Rust ƒe stable version yeyetɔ le asiwò, elabena Zebra koe woɖoa teƒe kple e. Build dependencies siwo hia la dome nye: libclang (woayɔe hã be libclang-dev alo llvm-dev) clang alo C++ compiler bubu (abe g++ na platforms katã alo Xcode na macOS ene) protoc (Protocol Buffers compiler) kple --experimentalallowproto3optional flag, si woɖe egɔme le Protocol Buffers v3.12.0 me (woɖe e go le May 16, 2020). Ɖo Eye Dze Egɔme Le x8664 alo aarch64 Linux kple glibc 2.34 alo esi wu enu dzi (Ubuntu 22.04+, Debian 12+, RHEL 9+, Amazon Linux 2023) la, àte ŋu adzo build dependencies la me eye nàɖo binary si woɖo asidede agbalẽ te [signature]: Woatsɔ binaries ma ke de GitHub ƒe release sia sia ŋu abe zebrad- - .tar.gz ene, eye SHA-256 checksum, Sigstore build-provenance attestation, kple Cosign signature le woƒe sia sia ŋu. Le platforms xoxowo dzi la, zã Docker image alo tu tso source me. Be nàtu tso source me la, xɔ code la eye nàtu release binary: Dze ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ la gɔme kple: Ɖoɖoɖe ƒe mɔfiame: zebra.zfnd.org/user/install.html Ɖoɖoɖewo Kple Features Siwo Menye Dzi Vevi O ƉoɖoƑe ƒe Agbalẽ Ƒe Gɔmedzedze Wɔ configuration file kple sedede sia: Woatsɔ zebrad.toml si wo wɔ la ade Linux ƒe preferences directory si woɖo le gɔmedzeƒe. Na OS ƒe teƒe bubuwo, kpɔ agbalẽdzɔɖoɖoa. Progress Bars Ƒe Ɖoɖoɖe Ɖo tracing.progressbar ɖe wò zebrad.toml me be nàfia metrics veviwo le terminal me kple progress bars. Dzesi: Nya si woanya lee nye be progress bar ƒe estimate ate ŋu akpɔ gɔme akpe. Nukuku Ƒe Ɖoɖoɖe Àte ŋu aɖo Zebra na nukuku [mining] kple MINERADDRESS kple port mapping le Docker me. Nya geɖe le Nukuku ƒe support agbalẽdzɔɖoɖo me. Build Features Le Wò Ɖokui Ƒe Nuwo Nu Ɖe Zebra ƒe dɔwɔwɔ keke kple Cargo features bubuwo abe Prometheus metrics, Sentry monitoring, experimental Elasticsearch support, kple bubuwo ene. Ƒo features geɖe nu kple woƒe xexlẽ ɖe --features flag ƒe parameters me le installation me. Woɖe debugging kple monitoring features aɖewo le release builds me be woanɔ dɔ wɔm nyuie. Na experimental kple mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔla [developer] features ƒe xexlẽ bliboa, kpɔ API ƒe agbalẽdzɔɖoɖo. System Ƒe Hiahiawo Kple N

title: ZKP & ZK-SNARKS
description: Ɖaseɖigbalɛwo nye matematiki katã ƒe gɔme. Ɖaseɖigbalɛ nye nya si wòdi be nàɖe kpe na alo teorem, kple nyawo ƒe ɖeɖe wɔwɔ si wozã be woagblɔ be woɖe kpe na…
text: ZKP & ZK-SNARKS TL;DR zk-SNARKs = Zero-Knowledge Succinct Non-Interactive Arguments of Knowledge Woɖe mɔ na ame aɖe wòaɖe kpe be ye nya nu aɖe ne wòmegblɔ nya la ŋutɔ o Zcash zã zk-SNARKs be wòaɖe kpe be gaɖoɖo aɖe le nyuie (ga ƒe hãhãwo le nyuie, ga siwo wometsɔ zu o) ke wòmegblɔ ame si dɔ ga la, ame si xɔe la, alo ga ƒe home o "Succinct" fia be ɖaseɖigbalɛ la sue ŋutɔ eye wòle bɔbɔe be woatsɔ akpɔe ɖe asi, ke ne nyawo le sesĩe hã Orchard gaƒuƒoƒo zã Halo 2, si nye zk-SNARK ƒe ɖoɖo si me mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖo xexlẽnuwo mele be woahiã o --- Nu ka nye ɖaseɖigbalɛ? Ɖaseɖigbalɛwo nye matematiki katã ƒe gɔme. Ɖaseɖigbalɛ nye nya si wòdi be nàɖe kpe na alo teorem, kple nyawo ƒe ɖeɖe wɔwɔ si wozã be woagblɔ be woɖe kpe na teorem la. Amedzro aɖe kaɖe ate ŋu akpɔe ɖe asi be, le kpɔtɔ aɖe me, anglewo katã ƒe xexlẽme nye 180° (ame si kpɔa nu ɖe asi). Ɖaseɖigbalɛwo Ame si ɖea kpe ---> Gblɔ nya ---> Ame si kpɔa nu ɖe asi tia ---> Xɔe/Agbe o (Ame si ɖea kpe kple ame si kpɔa nu ɖe asi la woƒe eve nye algorithmwo) Le kɔmpiuta ƒe nusrɔ̃me me la, woyɔ ɖaseɖigbalɛwo siwo woate ŋu akpɔ ɖe asi enumake be wonye NP ɖaseɖigbalɛwo. Woate ŋu akpɔ ɖaseɖigbalɛ kpuie siawo ɖe asi le polynomial ƒe ɣeyiɣi me. Gɔme vevi lae nye be "Fifi la, fɔfɔ aɖe le teorem aɖe ŋu eye woɖo fɔfɔ la ɖe ame si kpɔa nu ɖe asi la ŋu be wòakpɔe ɖe asi" Le NP-gbegbe me la, ɖoɖo eve siawo katã mele be woava eme: Completeness: Woaxɔ nyagblɔɖiwo siwo nye nyateƒe la (esia na ame siwo ɖea kpe le nyateƒe me la be woava ɖeɖeɖe eme) Soundness: Ɖaseɖigbalɛ aɖeke manɔ nyagblɔɖi siwo nye alakpa ŋu o (le mɔ sia mɔ sia si ame si di be wòanɔ aɖaŋu atsa la, mate ŋu aɖe kpe be alakpa ƒe nyagblɔɖi aɖe nye nyateƒe o). Ɖaseɖigbalɛ si me woaɖo nu kple Ɖaseɖigbalɛ si dze ɖe nasiaɖi ŋu Nuɖoɖo: Le ɖaseɖigbalɛ la ƒe xexle ko gbɔ o la, ame si kpɔa nu ɖe asi la doa nu kple ame si ɖea kpe la va yi le duɖoɖowo ƒe akpa geɖe me. Nasiaɖi: Ame si kpɔa nu ɖe asi ƒe biabiawo na ame si ɖea kpe la tsoa nasiaɖi me, eye ame si ɖea kpe la mele be wòaɖo ŋu na wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe nyuie. Ne wotsɔ nuɖoɖo kple nasiaɖi wɔ dɔ ɖekae la, woate ŋu aɖe kpe na nyagblɔɖi aɖe na ame si kpɔa nu ɖe asi si mekpena o le Probabilistic Polynomial Time (PPT) me. Ɖaseɖigbalɛ si me woaɖo nu ate ŋu akpɔ nu geɖe ɖe asi nyuie wu NP ɖaseɖigbalɛwoa? NP Ɖaseɖigbalɛwo kple IP ɖaseɖigbalɛwo: Nyagblɔɖi NP IP -------------- ----------- -------- NP ɛ̃ ɛ̃ CO-NP ao ɛ̃ #P ao ɛ̃ PSPACE ao ɛ̃ NP - Fɔfɔ aɖe le nyagblɔɖi aɖe ŋu CO-NP - Ɖeɖe kpe be fɔfɔ aɖeke mele nyagblɔɖi aɖe ŋu o #P - Xexlẽ be fɔfɔ nenie le nyagblɔɖi aɖe ŋu PSPACE - Ɖeɖe kpe na nyagblɔɖi vovovowo ƒe ɖoɖo Nu ka nye Zero Knowledge? Nu si ame si kpɔa nu ɖe asi la ate ŋu akpɔ le nuɖoɖo megbe la sɔ kple nu si wòate ŋu aɖe kpe na hafi nuɖoɖo la dze egɔme. Nuɖoɖo si va yi le duwo geɖe me le ame si ɖea kpe kple ame si kpɔa nu ɖe asi dome la medze ame si kpɔa nu ɖe asi la ƒe kɔmpiuta ŋusẽ yi dzi o. Paradigm ƒe Simulation Nunu sia le cryptography blibo me. Eɖea "Nukpɔkpɔ Vavã" kple "Nukpɔkpɔ si Woɖe Wɔ" fia. Nukpɔkpɔ Vavã: Ŋutinya siwo katã ate ŋu anɔ nuɖoɖowo ŋu le Ame si Ɖea Kpe kple Ame si Kpɔa Nu Ɖe Asi (P,V) dome Nukpɔkpɔ si Woɖe Wɔ: Ame si kpɔa nu ɖe asi la ɖea nuɖoɖo siwo katã ate ŋu anɔ le Ame si Ɖea Kpe kple Ame si Kpɔa Nu Ɖe Asi dome wɔ Polynomial-time distinguisher aɖe doa ŋusẽ be yeadze sii be ɖe ye kpɔa nukpɔkpɔ vavã alo nukpɔkpɔ si woɖe wɔ, eye wòbia kpɔɖeŋu tso wo evea siaa gbɔ zi geɖe. Wogblɔ be nukpɔkpɔ evea "wo sɔ le kɔmpiuta ƒe akpa me" ne distinguisher algorithms/strategies katã la, ke esi woxɔ kpɔɖeŋu polynomial ƒe xexlẽme tso vavã alo nukpɔkpɔ si woɖe wɔ me hã la, dzidzɔ be wòaɖo to >1/2. Zero-Knowledge Ɖeɖe Kpe Na Nyanya Nuɖoɖo si me woaɖo nu (P,V) nye zero-knowledge ne simulator (algorithm) aɖe le afi ma, ale be na probabilty polynomial-time ame si kpɔa nu ɖe asi siaa (ne teorem la nye nyateƒe), dzidzɔ ƒe mama siwo tso nukpɔkpɔ vavã kple nukpɔkpɔ si woɖe wɔ me ƒe mama me la sɔ le kɔmpiuta ƒe akpa me. Nuɖoɖo siwo me woaɖo nu la wɔnɛ nyuie ne ame ɖeka ko kpɔa nu ɖe asi. Kpɔɖeŋu aɖe nye

title: Zcash Ƒe Nudzɔdzɔ
description: Be nàte ŋu azã Zcash le gaɖoɖo (transaction) ɣaɣla me la, ele be ZEC nanɔ asiwò. Be nàkpɔ ZEC la, ele be nàƒlee. Àte ŋu aƒle ZEC tso gatrɔƒe vovovowo gbɔ, eye…
text: Zcash Ƒe Nudzɔdzɔ TL;DR Ne wòate ŋu la, ƒle ZEC le gatrɔƒe (exchange) si doa asi ɖe ɣaɣla (shielded) ƒe gahehe ŋu (Gemini, BitcoinVN, flyp.me) Gatrɔƒe gã siwo katã wɔnɔa te ɖe ame geɖe ƒe asi me (Coinbase, Kraken, Binance) doa asi ɖe nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi (transparent) ƒe gahehe ŋu ko — ƒo ɣaɣla na wò ZEC le esi nèkplɔe vɔ megbe Ha nuɖo agni (decentralized) ƒe gatrɔƒewo na ɖɔli ɖɔli (swap) si me asikplɔ-dzralá (custodial) mele o, gake zi geɖe wohe ga ɖe nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi ƒe gaɖoƒe dzesiwo dzi Ele be nàƒle ZEC blibo o — akpaŋkekewo hã wɔa dɔ nyuie --- Be nàte ŋu azã Zcash le gaɖoɖo (transaction) ɣaɣla me la, ele be ZEC nanɔ asiwò. Be nàkpɔ ZEC la, ele be nàƒlee. Àte ŋu aƒle ZEC tso gatrɔƒe vovovowo gbɔ, eye míaxlɔ wo ɖe anyi le afisia. Woɖe eƒe aɖaŋu be nàzã gatrɔƒe si doa asi ɖe ɣaɣla ƒe gahehe ŋu. Àte ŋu akuku (mining) ZEC hã, gake zi geɖe mègava dzɔ nametɔxɛlawo o. Nu geɖe le eŋu afisia kple afisia. Gatrɔƒewo siwo doa asi ɖe ɣaɣla ƒe gahehe ŋu Gemini Gemini nye cryptocurrency gatrɔƒe si wode se ɖe eŋu, gakotoku, kple asikplɔ-dzralá si wɔnɛ be wòatsɔ ZEC, Ether, kple cryptocurrency bubuwo afle bɔbɔe kple dedie. Àte ŋu aƒle ZEC kple fiat alo cryptocurrency bubuwo. BitcoinVN BitcoinVN nye gatrɔƒe si me asikplɔ-dzralá mele o, eye wòate ŋu awɔ ɖɔli ɖɔli enumake; wòdoa asi ɖe ɣaɣla (z-address) ƒe gaɖeɖe kple gahehe na ZEC ŋu — enye gatrɔƒe ʋɛ aɖewo dome le xexeame katã siwo katã doa asi ɖe z-address ŋu. Esi wòdze dɔ le 2014 me la, àte ŋu atsɔ BTC, ETH, USDT, kple cryptocurrency bubuwo aɖɔli na ZEC tɔŋ, ahenae ɖe wò gakotoku ɣaɣla me. flyp.me flyp.me nye crypto gatrɔƒe si me wòle be nàŋlɔ ŋkɔ o. Enye mɔ dedie kple ɣaɣla tɔxɛ wu geɖe si woatsɔ atrɔ cryptocurrency 30+ tɔŋ ahenae ɖe wò gakotoku me. Àte ŋu aƒle ZEC kple cryptocurrency bubuwo. Gatrɔƒewo siwo doa asi ɖe nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi ƒe gahehe ŋu Gatrɔƒe gã siwo katã doa asi ɖe Zcash ŋu. Kpɔ xexlẽme detɔ aɖe le afisia: afisia. Coinbase Ha nuɖo agni ƒe Gatrɔƒewo siwo doa asi ɖe nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi ƒe gahehe ŋu Gatrɔƒe siawo doa asi ɖe nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi ƒe gahehe ŋu. Esia fia be ne nèhe ZEC ɖe wò gakotoku me la, ele be nàhe ɖe wò nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi ƒe gaɖoƒe dzesi me, wò dukɔ bliboa ƒe ZEC gaɖoƒe dzesi. Zi afisia be nàkpɔ nyatakaka bubuwo. text: Zcash Asigame ƒe Gaƒuƒoƒowo [Value Pools] Nyatakaka kpuie Zcash fifia le asixɔxɔ ƒe gaƒuƒoƒo 5: Sprout (xoxo), Sapling, Orchard (atsɔe axɔ asi ko), Ironwood, kple Nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi. Tso Orchard yi Ironwood ƒe trɔtrɔ le edzi yim, eye turnstile le kpɔkpɔe kple ame sia ame ƒe nukpɔkpɔ. Zcash Asigame ƒe Gaƒuƒowo ƒe Gɔmesese Zcash ma ga siwo le eme la ɖe xexlẽ ƒe ɖoɖo vovovowo me, siwo woyɔna be asigame ƒe gaƒuƒoƒowo. Gaƒuƒoƒo ɖe sia ɖe ƒe eya ŋutɔ ƒe crypto sewo kple ɣaɣla ƒe nɔnɔwo le, ke hã protocol la le asigame blibo si le yiyi le wo dome la ƒe kpɔkpɔ wɔm. Egbe la, gaƒuƒoƒo vevitɔ atɔ̃ le network la me: Nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi — Le ɖoɖonu dzi [on-chain] le amewo katã ƒe ŋkume, eye wòɖe fia blibo. Sapling — Ɣaɣla ƒe gaƒuƒoƒo modern gbãtɔ si amewo zã akpa gã, eye wòle dɔ wɔm haɖe. Orchard — Ɣaɣla ƒe gaƒuƒoƒo vevitɔ si nɔ anyi tsã, si fifia wòate ŋu azã ko. Eli le esi woɖe gbegblẽ aɖe fia le Orchard ƒe ɖaseɖigbalɛ [proof] wɔwɔ ƒe ɖoɖo me le dama 2026. Ɖase aɖeke mele be wozãe kpɔ o, gake gbegblẽ la fia be ɣaɣla ƒe asigame ƒe nyateƒe mate ŋu ana ɖase ɖekaɖeka ko atia o. Le teƒe si woatsɔ akpɔe le eƒe nɔƒe la, network la wɔ gaƒuƒoƒo yeye aɖe si me circuit sɔsɔ le, eye wòtsɔ asigame va to turnstile aɖe me, si le gaɖekaɖeka ƒe xexlẽ wɔm le amewo katã ƒe ŋkume. text: Kaƒomɔ ƒe gaɖoɖo (Top-ups) kple Zcash Ɖo ga ɖe kaƒomɔ si wòxe fe ɖo ŋgɔ la me kple ZEC, eɖanye wòwɔ akɔnta alo mewɔe o. Kpuie ko (TL;DR) Àte ŋu aƒle kaƒomɔ ƒe gaɖoɖo si woxea fe ɖo ŋgɔ kple ZEC le internet dzi fiase siwo dzraa nunana kaɖwo, abe Coinsbee kple CardsRelay ene. Coinsbee bia akɔnta. CardsRelay ya bia email gaɖoƒe ko hena kpeɖodzi la. Wo ame evea siaa ɖea ZEC ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ si tututu kple fexexe (payment) ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi (address) fiana wò le fexeƒe. Ɖo agbɔsɔsɔ ma tututu hafi fexexe ƒe agbalẽ la nayi ɖe enu. Nya kpuiwo (memos) ɖoa gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ɣaɣlawo (shielded) gbɔ ko. Ne fexexe ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi nye nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi (transparent) tɔ la, nya kpui la maɖo afi aɖeke o, eya ta dzra wò ɖoɖo ƒe ID ɖo ne àbia be woatrɔ ga la na wò. Zi geɖe la, kaƒomɔ ƒe gaɖoɖo wɔa dɔ na kaƒomɔ xexlẽdzesi siwo woxea fe na ɖo ŋgɔ ko. Kpɔ xexlẽdzesi la kple network la ɖa hafi naxe fe. Nyakpɔkpɔ Vevitɔ Kaƒomɔ ƒe gaɖoɖo tsɔa nuƒoƒo ƒe ga alo data ƒe ga kpena ɖe kaƒomɔ xexlẽdzesi si woxea fe na ɖo ŋgɔ ŋu. Fiase geɖe siwo dzraa nunana kaɖwo ɖe crypto teƒe la dzraa kaƒomɔ ƒe gaɖoɖo hã na kaƒomɔ network alafa geɖe le xexeame godoo, eye wo dometɔ aɖewo xɔa ZEC. Mɔnu la sɔ le afisiafi: tia dukɔ la kple network la, ŋlɔ kaƒomɔ xexlẽdzesi la kple agbɔsɔsɔ la, xe fexexe ƒe agbalẽ la ƒe fe kple ZEC, eye nàlala be ga la nava ɖo. Mɔnu eve le ete: Coinsbee (ehiã akɔnta) kple CardsRelay (akɔnta mehiã o). Mɔnu 1: Coinsbee (ehiã akɔnta) Wɔ akɔnta Yi Coinsbee.com eye nàwɔ akɔnta. Tia wò dukɔ kple wò network Tia wò dukɔ le dzigbe miame dzogoe, tia kaƒomɔ ƒe ga, eye nàtia network si dzi nèdi be yeaɖo ga ɖo (le kpɔɖeŋu me, MTN). App la kple NEAR Intents siaa dzroa gakotokuwo me be yewoalé se siwo le anyi la me ɖe asi. --- Nusiwo Le Vevie Ŋuti Ɖeɖefia encrypt.trade nye Solana app si JMD Labs Inc. wɔa dɔ kplii. Eɖea mɔ na wò be nàwɔ ɖɔli ɖɔli [swap] SOL alo USDC le Solana dzi wòazu Zcash (ZEC). Gbã la, wotsɔa wò token siwo nye ga ƒe dzesi siwo le blockchain dzi la blana ɖe ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ [encryption] me be woaɣla gaƒuƒowo le Solana dzi, emegbe wowɔa ɖɔli ɖɔli wo wozua ZEC to NEAR Intents me. Ɖɔli ɖɔli la le ɣaɣla me le mɔ aɖewo nu, gake menye mɔ katã nu o. App la ŋutɔ ƒe nuxlɔ̃amewo gblɔ be wò ha kple ɖoɖonu la menye togbɔbe o: amewo ate ŋu akpɔ be wò gakotoku [wallet] zã app la, gake womate ŋu akpɔ ga si nètsɔ va o. ZEC hã va ɖo gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi [address] si le nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi me, ale eanɔ ʋuʋuɖi le Zcash ɖoɖonu la dzi va se ɖe esime nàɣaɣlae. --- Nu Si Wòle Be Nànya Hafi Nàwɔ Ɖɔli Ɖɔli Solana ƒe akpa. Ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ na gaƒuƒowo ɣaɣla, gake wò gakotoku ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi kple eƒe zãzã na app la le ʋuʋuɖi me. Eƒe nɔnɔme nyuiwo de dzesi be nu bɔbɔe si nye aɣaɣla, awɔ ɖɔli ɖɔli, eye aɖe ɣaɣlae na wò gaɖoɖo [transaction] la nava si woate ŋu akplɔe. Ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ. Woawɔ dɔ kple gaƒuƒo siwo woŋlɔ kple ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ le ɖoɖonu megbe le hardware enclave (TEE) me. Mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔlawo ƒe agbalẽ gblɔ be esia ɖe TEE ƒe blibonyenye, key dzikpɔkpɔ si woawɔ kple ame geɖe kple cloud ƒe attestation root ŋu, menye cryptography ko ŋu o. Ɖoɖonu geɖe dome ƒe akpa. Woatsɔ ɖɔli ɖɔli la ayi ZEC to NEAR Intents me, afi si solvers siwo le ɖokuiwo te ŋu wɔa order la. Zcash ƒe akpa. NEAR Intents dea ZEC ɖe eme be wozãe kple gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi siwo le nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi me ko, eye ZEC ƒe afi le encrypt.trade dzi xɔ gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi siwo le nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi me (t1 alo t3) ko esime woɖe mɔfiafia sia kpɔ le September 2026 me. Gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi si le nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi me fia eƒe balance kple ga siwo va ɖo eme le ame katã ƒe ŋkume va se ɖe esime nàɣaɣlae. Dɔmekpɔkpɔ. App la kpɔ gakotoku siwo geɖo ɖe eŋu la ɖe databasewo siwo nenye TRM kple Chainalysis ŋu, eye eƒe dɔmewɔwɔ ƒe axa gblɔ be woate ŋu akpɔ record siwo woŋlɔ kple ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ me ne se ƒe tata nyuitɔ le. NEAR Intents hã wɔa eŋutɔ ƒe dɔmekpɔkpɔ. --- Afɔ 1: Ɖe Wò Solana Gakotoku Ɖe Eŋu Yi encrypt.trade dzi kple Chrome alo Firefox, eye nàɖe wò Phantom, Solflare, alo Slope gakotoku ɖe eŋu. Kpɔ be SOL si sɔ na gas adzɔwo [fee] kple tokenwo si nèdi be nàwɔ ɖɔli ɖɔli kple le wò gakotoku me. Ne wòɖe eŋu vɔ la, èdi be nàɣaɣla wò nuwo. --- --- Afɔ 2: Ɣaɣla Wò Tokenwo Yi Wrap ƒe akpa. Tia SOL alo USDC, ŋlɔ gaƒuƒo la, eye nàɖo kpe edzi. App la de wò nuwo ɖe te, eye wotsɔ wɔnɔƒe siwo woŋlɔ kple ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ (eSOL alo eUSDC) na wò. Ne nèɣaɣla gaƒuƒo bubu tso esi nèwɔ ɖɔli ɖɔli kplee ŋu la, ena wò kpekpe be womakpɔ eƒe nɔnɔme sɔsɔ kple gaƒuƒo la o, gake mena wò gakotoku ƒe app la zãzã nava ɣaɣla o. --- --- Afɔ 3: Ɖo Wò ZODL Gakotoku ɖo Download ZODL, Zcash gakotoku si ZODL kpɔa dzi. Le Receive ƒe screen la dzi, kopia wò Zcash Transparent Address (eɖea egɔme kple t1). Encrypt.trade mexɔa gaɖoƒe siwo woɣaɣla alo unified addresses na ZEC fifia o. Dzra wò gadzraɖoɖi nya [seed phrase] ɖe afi dedi me hafi nàyi edzi. --- Afɔ 4: Wɔ Ɖɔli Ɖɔli Trɔ yi encrypt.trade me, eye nàyi Swap. Tia eSOL/eUSDC -> ZEC, ɖe wò ZODL gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi si le nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi me ɖe eme, kpɔ nyatakakaawo me, eye nàɖo kpe

title: Gatrɔƒe Siwo Menye Asikplɔ-Dzralá O
description: Le cryptocurrency ƒe asitsɔasitsɔ xexeme si trɔna ɣesiaɣi me la, gatrɔƒe siwo menye asikplɔ-dzralá o, siwo yɔa be Decentralized Exchanges alo DEXs hã, na…
text: Gatrɔƒe Siwo Menye Asikplɔ-Dzralá O Nya Vevi Kpuie Gatrɔƒe si menye asikplɔ-dzralá o na wò ɖɔli ɖɔli ga tso wò ŋutɔ ƒe gakotoku [wallet] me. Èlé wò asisi kpuie, eye gatrɔƒe ƒe akonta aɖeke melé wò ga o. Wò asisiwo ƒe kplɔɖeŋu dea wò ɖe gatrɔƒe ƒe nuŋuŋu kple gbegblẽwo ŋu. Ɣaɣla [privacy] nye biabia bubu. Ga si nàɖo tso ɖoɖonu bubu dzi, abe Solana alo Ethereum ene, le dɔme kple ɖoɖonu ma dzi. Ɖɔli ɖɔli ƒe dɔwɔƒe la hã kpɔa wò gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo kple wò kadodo ƒe nyawo. Ɖɔli ɖɔli mɔ aɖewo doa ZEC ɖe nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi dzi, si le dɔme. Wò ZEC zu ɣaɣla ne wònɔ ɣaɣla gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi me. Ɣaɣlae le wò ŋutɔ ƒe gakotoku me hafi nàzãe. Nɔnɔmetata ƒe Gɔmeɖeɖe Zcash Gatrɔƒe Siwo Menye Asikplɔ-Dzralá O Le cryptocurrency ƒe asitsɔasitsɔ xexeme si trɔna ɣesiaɣi me la, gatrɔƒe siwo menye asikplɔ-dzralá o, siwo yɔa be Decentralized Exchanges alo DEXs hã, na zãlawo ƒe asitsɔasitsɔ woƒe ga mede gatrɔƒe ƒe akonta me o. Èlé wò ŋutɔ ƒe asisiwo, gake esia menye be ame bubu aɖeke menye akpa le eme o. Le mɔ la nu la, ɖɔli ɖɔli aɖe ate ŋu ato website alo gakotoku ƒe app, mɔ-dɔwɔƒe, mɔ̃ŋlɔ ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo [smart contracts], solvers kple ga ƒe lẽwo [bridges] me. Gatrɔƒewo siwo wogblɔ ƒe nu le dzi la na wò nàxɔ eye nàtsɔ Zcash atsɔa tso wò ŋutɔ ƒe gakotoku me. Ale si ɖɔli ɖɔli aɖe le ɣaɣla me la ɖe dɔwɔƒe la, ɖoɖonu si dzi nèfexea ga tsoe, kple be wò ZEC va ge ɖe ɣaɣla gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi dzi la ŋu. Akpa siwo le ete la ɖe vovototo la me. Gatrɔƒe Siwo Menye Asikplɔ-Dzralá O Ƒe Gɔmesese Gatrɔƒe siwo menye asikplɔ-dzralá o, siwo yɔa be Decentralized Exchanges (DEXs) hã, nye platform siwo wɔa cryptocurrency ƒe asitsɔasitsɔ ne womedi be zãlawo nade woƒe ga ɖe gatrɔƒe la ŋutɔ me o. Le esia teƒe la, zãlawo léa woƒe asisiwo eye wotsɔa ga tsoa woƒe ŋutɔ ƒe gakotokuwome. Ɖɔli ɖɔli siwo va yi ɖoɖonu geɖe dome [cross-chain] hã doa ŋu ɖe ame bubuwo ŋu be woana asiɖeɖe, wɔ mɔ, eye woatsɔ asitsɔasitsɔ la ava nu (kpɔ ete). Esia ate ŋu ana dedienɔnɔ nakɔ ɖe edzi, elabena zãlawo mele gatrɔƒe la dzi be wòalé woƒe nudzɔdzɔwo o, si ɖea nuŋuŋu alo dzidzɔ ƒe kplɔɖeŋu. Emeɖe ɖɔli ɖɔli aɖe ɣaɣla le eɖokui me o. Gaɖoɖowo le gatrɔƒe siwo menye asikplɔ-dzralá o dzi zãa mɔ̃ŋlɔ ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo zi geɖe, siwo le dɔme, eye dɔwɔƒe si nèzã la ate ŋu akpɔ wò gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo kple kadodo ƒe nyawo hã. Gatrɔƒe siwo menye asikplɔ-dzralá o ƒe nyui vevitɔ aɖe le asi si nɔa zãlawo me le woƒe nudzɔdzɔwo ŋu. Esi gatrɔƒe siawo meléa nudzɔdzɔwo o ta la, zãlawo xɔa wɔnɔ ŋutɔ kple dziɖuɖu blibo ɖe woƒe ga siwo le digital me ŋu. Gatrɔƒe Siwo Menye Asikplɔ-Dzralá O Kple Gatrɔƒe Siwo Nye Asikplɔ-Dzralá ƒe Vovototo #1 Dedienɔnɔ: Gatrɔƒe siwo menye asikplɔ-dzralá o wɔe be mele be woalé ga le gatrɔƒe akonta aɖe me o. Zãlawo léa woƒe asisiwo, si ɖea nuŋuŋu, ame si le eme ƒe aɖaŋu kple platform ƒe gbegblẽ siwo gatrɔƒe asikplɔ-dzraláwo ate ŋu akpɔ la ƒe kplɔɖeŋu. Ɖɔli ɖɔli siwo va yi ɖoɖonu geɖe dome ate ŋu agaɖo le deposit gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi alo ga ƒe lẽ me hena ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe hafi asitsɔasitsɔ la ava nu. #2 Ɣaɣla: Ɖɔli ɖɔli siwo menye asikplɔ-dzralá o medi gatrɔƒe akonta zi geɖe o, eyata zi geɖe mèŋlɔa ŋkɔ kple email alo ID o. Esia menye be wòŋkɔ menya o. Deposit si nèɖo le gɔmedze ɖoɖonu dzi (le kpɔɖeŋu me, Solana alo Ethereum) le dɔme le ɖoɖonu ma dzi, eye dɔwɔƒe la ate ŋu akpɔ wò gakotoku ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo, IP gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi kple ɖɔli ɖɔli ƒe nyawo hã. Ɣaɣla le Zcash ƒe akpa la ɖe afi si wò ZEC dze la ŋu (kpɔ ete). #3 Ha Nuɖo Agni: Gatrɔƒe siwo menye asikplɔ-dzralá o sɔ kple cryptocurrency ƒe ha nuɖo agni ƒe nɔnɔme wu. Zãlawo xɔa wɔnɔ kple dziɖuɖu geɖe le woƒe asitsɔasitsɔ ƒe dɔwo ŋu, le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu [blockchain] teknoloji ƒe gɔmeɖoɖowo kple. Ne míeɖo gatrɔƒe siwo nye asikplɔ-dzralá ŋu la, ha nuɖo agni ƒe nɔnɔme la do le edzi ŋutɔ o le gatrɔƒe keskesi geɖe me, si na gatrɔƒe ƒe ha alo dɔdzikpɔlawo kpɔa zãla ƒe nyawo alo numeɖeɖewo le gatrɔƒe la dzi. #4 Nɔnɔme ƒe Ɖeɖe Ɖe Asi Le Se Siwo Trɔna Ŋu: Gatrɔƒe siwo menye asikplɔ-dzralá o tea ŋu ɖe se ƒe nɔnɔme siwo trɔna ŋu zi geɖe. Esi womelé zãla ƒe

text: Zcash Fexexe ƒe Mɔwɔlawo Mɔ siwo dzi woate ŋu axɔ ZEC abe asitsalá ene, woɖe wo ɖe eme kple wo nɔ anyi kpɔ. Menye asikplɔ-dzralá o fia be woyia ɖe gakotoku si wò nèdzra la me. Ɣaɣla ZEC nye ne woate ŋu axe wò ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo me. Nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi ko fia be asixɔxɔ la kple gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo katã le ƒeƒe le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu dzi. Ɖo wò ŋutɔ ƒe host nye ne nàte ŋu awɔ software la wò ŋutɔ, company aɖeke manɔ titina o. Asitsalá ƒe adzɔ mekpɔ Zcash network adzɔwo o, ame aɖe xe wo le nu sia nu me. Afisi provider aɖe metsɔ nu aɖe ɖe go o la, entry la gblɔ "wometsɔ fia o" alo "wometsɔ ɖe agbalẽ me o" le nuteƒe me, eye menya eƒe susu o. Esia menye "ao" o. Ame ka nàtia Ne èdi ɣaɣla kple dzikpɔkpɔ sɔŋ wu la, zã BTCPay Server, CipherPay si wò ŋutɔ nèɖo host, alo Zcash Payment Service ne nàte ŋu akpe code sue aɖe ɖe wò asaŋuti ŋu. Wo katã nye ɣaɣla, open source, eye womelè ga na wò o. Ne èdi be nàxɔ fexexewo le fiadze me le internet dzi ke o la, zã Flexa. Ne èdi hosted gateway afi si nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi fexexewo wɔa dɔ la, zã NOWPayments alo Plisio. Nu vevi aɖe si woagblɔ ake: processor si xɔa nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi ko ɖea fexexe sia fexexe ƒe asixɔxɔ kple gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ɖe gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu dzi. Eye kple hosted processor siawo katã siwo menye asikplɔ-dzralá o la, nèna wò nukpɔsafui na wo, ale be company la ate ŋu akpɔ wò fexexewo togbɔ be mate ŋu axɔ wo o. Wò ŋutɔ ƒe hosting ko nye mɔ si ate ŋu aɖe esia ɖa. ZGo service ƒe nyagblɔɖi, 29 July 2026. ZGo backend le api.zgo.cash la trɔ HTTP 503 ɖe endpoint sia fexexe ŋu esi wokpɔ agbalẽ sia ƒe nyateƒe. Wometsrɔ project la o, eye eƒe maintainer la nɔ dɔ wɔm le community la me le ɣleti sia me, gake kpɔ be service la le dɔ wɔm hafi nàtsɔe akpɔ dzi. --- CipherPay Kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe ƒomevi: Ɣaɣla (Orchard, to Unified Addresses) Nuxlɔɖi: Xɔ Zcash le minuti dzi, menye asikplɔ-dzralá o, asitsɔla ƒe data aɖeke mele o, titina ame aɖeke mele o. text: Ɣaɣla [Shielded] Nyadzɔdzɔgbalẽ [Newsletter] Ðo markdown didienu [note] ɖe ɣaɣla gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo ƒe xexlẽme abe Zcash nya kpui [memos] ene, esi wozã Zallet. Amesiwo ƒe xexlẽme kple didienua menɔa nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi [transparent] gaɖoƒe dzi o. Ɣaɣla nyadzɔdzɔgbalẽ enye ɣaɣla gaɖoɖowo [transactions] ƒe dzidzime. Dɔwɔwɔ sia dzea ga sue aɖe ɖe xɔlila ƒe Unified Address dzi eye wòtsɔa didienua ƒe akpa si gbɔna ɖea nya kpui ƒe teƒe me. Zallet wɔa eye wòdɔa gaɖoɖowo siawo ɖa. Zebra kple Zaino dekae nana ɖoɖonu [chain] ƒe nyawo. Scriptwo le site/tutorials/shieldedNewsletter. Woŋlɔ wo na Zallet ƒe gɔmedzedze ƒe tɔtrɔ aɖe, eye menye dedie be woazã wo ale si wònɔ ene kple tɔtrɔ si le egbea o. Axa siae nye mɔ si woɖo yeyee. Wodo kpe ɖe Zallet v0.1.0-beta.3 kple Zallet ƒe agbalẽ ŋu le 7 October 2026 dzi. Nu si wòhiã Zebra si de sync blibo, esi RPC bla ɖe localhost. Zaino si de sync kple Zebra ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ [node] ma. Zallet v0.1.0-beta.3 alo yeyetɔ, gakotoku [wallet] ƒe tutu, esi wòƒe RPC bla ɖe localhost. Agbalẽ la fia be woɖo zsendmany wɔ. Woagbe adzɔ [fee] si nye xexlẽme: ne nàtsɔ fee ava la, ele be wòanye null, elabena Zallet zãa ZIP 317 adzɔ ɣesiaɣi. Akawunt si me ga le, si ƒe Unified Address ate ŋu atsɔ ɣaɣla ga awɔ nu. Xɔlila ƒe Unified Addresswo. Nya kpui si le nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi [address] dzi nye vodada. Mègatsɔ gaɖoƒe si me ga le alo cookie aɖe ade wiki me alo script si wòde asi ɖo ŋu me o. txBuilderFromFile.sh si le fifia la ƒe Unified Address woŋlɔ ɖe eme ɖe eɖokui ŋu. Trɔe le wòƒe teƒe eye mègade asi ɖoe o. Ðo Zallet ɖe ɖoɖo nu Wɔ config kple Zallet si nèle zãm, eye nàfia Zebra kple Zaino. Kpɔɖeŋu si le gɔmefiafia xoxo me zãa asofversion = "0.0.0" kple aƒeme mɔ si nye ame ŋutɔ tɔ. Bu file ma be enye ɣeyiɣi ƒe nɔnɔ ƒe nɔnɔmetata, menye kpɔɖeŋu na nàdze ɖoɖo nu o. rpc help ele be wòaxlẽ zsendmany, zgetoperationstatus, kple zgetoperationresult. Bla RPC ɖe 127.0.0.1 ko. Xɔlilawo ƒe xexlẽme Unified Address ɖeka le fli sia fli dzi, nyagblɔɖiwo manɔe o, fli ƒuƒluwo manɔe o. Script la xlẽa daoAddresses.md. Readme xoxo la gblɔa daoAddress.md. File ma mele repo me o, eye ŋkɔawo sɔ o. Dɔ nya kpui ɖeka ɖa zsendmany menye dɔ si wowɔ enumake o. Wòtrɔa operation id aɖe. Kpɔ zgetoperationstatus va se ɖe esi nɔnɔa anye success alo vodada ava. Dɔlalaƒe 5 ƒe ŋuŋɔ, si nye nu si script la wɔna, na wòbu emetsonu ne tutu la ɖea ŋgɔ na ɣeyiɣi didi. zgetoperationresult ɖua operation la, eyata mègayɔe hafi nɔnɔa naɖo eƒe nuwuwu o. Wometsɔ adzɔ o. Zallet bu ZIP 317. Mègatsɔ xexlẽme aɖe o. Nya kpui ƒe teƒea nye hex si me woŋlɔ nu kplikplikpli, byte 512 koe wòate ŋu akpɔ ɖe edzi. ascii2hex trɔa ASCII ko. Didienu si me non-ASCII ƒe nɔnɔaɖe le la agbe o. xxd alo python3 -c 'import sys; sys.stdout.write(sys.stdin.buffer.read().hex())' dea asi UTF-8 ŋu. Ɣaɣla [Privacy] ƒe ɖoɖo ɖe edzi gɔmedze le FullPrivacy. Esia nye ɖoɖo nyuitɔ na ɣaɣla xɔlila. Mègatsɔ AllowFullyTransparent o. Scriptwo ƒe vodadawo Esiawo le ati la me le 8 October 2026 dzi. Mègawɔ shieldNewsletter.sh hafi woaɖo wo ɖe eɖo o. [[ bytesInFile -lt 512 ]] mehiã $ o. Akpa si dɔa nya kpui ɖeka la mewɔa dɔ o. Akpa si mama wɔa chunkwo la ɖea hex ɖo, eye hex2ascii trɔe ɖe megbe, eye txBuilderFromFile.sh trɔe ɖe hex me ake. Wometsɔ chunk mamlɛtɔ la ɖa ne fli si gbɔna meva wu 512 o. Womama fli didi aɖe ɖe akpawo me o. Wodɔe blibo eye wòate ŋu awu nya kpui ƒe byte 512. txBuilderFromFile.sh yɔa ./zallet rpc menye kple config ƒe mɔ aɖe o, eye wòlala be binary la nanɔ directory si me wòle fifia me. Zã zallet -c rpc. toCurl.sh doa gbe na Zebra le port 8232 kple cookie, eye wòyɔa getinfo kple sendmany. Zallet menana sendmany o. Mine-wait ƒe akpa la hã zãa [[ chainHeight -gt temp ]] manɔ kple $ o, eyata melala o. Woɖea zgettotalbalance 0 true abe positional arguments bubuwo ene. Kpɔ rpc help zgettotalbalance le binary si nèle zãm la dzi hafi nàzã yɔyɔ ma. Chunk sia sia dɔa 0.0001 ZEC ɖe xɔlila sia sia ŋu. ZIP 317 adzɔ le eƒe dzi. Didienu didi si wòdɔ ɖe gaɖoƒe dzesi geɖe ŋu la ɖua ga geɖe wu dust ƒ

text: Teƒewo Nàtsɔ ZEC Aƒle Nu Le Egbe, esi ŋkulélelé (woyɔe be transparency) zu nu si dzi woƒoa asi le dzikpɔlawo kple ganyawo me la, ɣaɣla [privacy], abe amegbetɔ ƒe gomeɖokpe ene la, abe be womebugbɔa ŋku edzi o. Gake le ganyanya ƒe mɔ yeyeawo ŋu la, ame siwo le dɔ wɔm abe Zcash ene be woakpɔ wò dedienɔnɔ kple ɣaɣla ta, elabena wole vevi. Zcash kple ZEC na ɣaɣla kple dedienɔnɔ ƒe nɔnɔme siwo sɔ wu. Ke hã, afɔgbã gbãtɔ le woƒe zazã kple wɔwɔ me nye be bizinis, afitsɔƒe, kple ame geɖe wu nabia be woawɔ ZEC abe fexexe [payment] ƒe mɔ ene. Nu ka ta wòaxɔ ZEC? Ne asitsɔƒe le asiwò alo nèle nu alo dɔ geɖe dzram la, àdi be nàxɔ Zcash. Nu ka ta? Le afisia la, míeɖe susu geɖe kple viɖe siwo ta nàtsɔe awɔ wò fexexe ƒe mɔ la fia. Nàsɔ ɣaɣla gbɔ. To vovototo na fexexe ƒe mɔ xɔasiwo kple blema mɔwo, Zcash, le zk-SNARKs ta la, dea wò gaɖoɖowo [transaction] dzi ɣaɣla to ɣaɣla (womakpɔe kple amewo katã o) le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu [blockchain] dzi, eye nyatakakawo siwo le gaɖoɖowo me la le vevi na, eye woƒe nɔnɔme kple, ame si dɔ ga ɖa kple ame si xɔe koe. Fexexe ƒe mɔ si wɔna kaba kple asɔ gbɔ wu. ZEC gaɖoɖowo nye tete ɖe ame si xɔe la gbɔ, eye ame etɔ̃ manɔa titina o (abe bankiwo ene), eyata wɔwɔ ƒe gaƒoƒo kpui wu eye adzɔ [fee] hã bɔbɔ wu na fexexe ƒe mɔ blemawo. Ale nàte ŋu nàŋlɔ Paypal ɖi. Azɔ nènya be menye tiɖo ƒe mɔ aɖeke o. Nàna wò asitsɔlawo nasɔ gbɔ. Ne èxɔ ZEC la, wò asitsɔƒe / nu alo dɔ ate ŋu ahe ame geɖe siwo lɔ̃a be yewoatsɔ cryptocurrencies azã ava. Nàdo asitsɔla ƒe nɔviɖoɖo kple dzidzɔ kpɔtɔ. Ne ège ɖe asitsɔla ƒe ha sia me eye nàna amewo nanya be wò teƒe la xɔa ZEC la, ate ŋu ana wòakpɔ wò ati na asitsɔla xɔasiwo kple siwo ate ŋu ava, siwo ava gbɔwò ɣesiaɣi si woahiã be woatsɔ woƒe ZEC aƒle nu la. Nàwɔ vovototo abe nu yeyewo ƒe wɔnɔla ene. Ne èɖo ŋku be nàxɔ ZEC le wò afitsɔƒe, bizinis, alo ne èle taxi ƒe dɔ wɔm hã la, àte ŋu nàɖo wò ɖe ame siwo lɔ̃a ganyanya, fexexe kple vivina ƒe mɔ bubuwo ƒe dome.
