title: Aleke nàwɔ Zebra le Akash Network dzi
description: Mɔfiame kple mɔfiame ƒe mɔfiame na Zebra Zcash ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo kple Akash Console.
text: Aleke nàwɔ Zebra le Akash Network dzi Mɔfiame kple mɔfiame ƒe mɔfiame na Zebra Zcash ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo kple Akash Console. Nusi Nèle Aɖoƒe Zebra ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo aɖe si ana: -> Wòaɖo ɖe Zcash gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu [blockchain] blibo dzi (100GB+ na mainnet, 40GB na testnet) -> Wòaxɔ dɔlawo ƒe $15 le ƒeɖeɖe me, le AKT token ƒe asiwo nu -> Wòaxɔ gaƒoƒo geɖe alo ŋkeke geɖe be wòaɖo blibo -> Wòawɔ dɔ kple 4 vCPU, 16GB RAM, 350GB nudzraɖoƒe na mainnet, alo 2 vCPU, 8GB RAM, 50GB na testnet Vevi: Port ƒe Ɖoɖo le Akash Dzi Ne nàɖe port aɖe fia le Akash dzi (kpɔe be, port 8233 na Zebra P2P), womakplɔe ɖe port ma tututɔ dzi le provider ƒe public IP dzi o. Le esime ma ƒe teƒe la, provider la ana port didi maʋɛ aɖe (abe 31234 alo 42567 ene) eye wòawɔ reverse-proxy kple eya ɖe wò container ƒe port 8233 dzi. Wowɔ esia le ɖoɖo me - providers wɔa deployments geɖe, eye nuɖeɖe ava wɔn dome ne ame sia ame nadi be yeazã port 8233 tɔxɛ. Nusi esia fia wòe nye: -> Nàɖo port 8233 le SDL me (Zebra ƒe P2P port si wozãna) -> Akash ana URI si le abe provider.com:31234 ene wò -> Zcash ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ bubuwo akplɔ ɖe eŋu le provider.com:31234 -> Le wò container me, Zebra gale 8233 ƒe nuteƒe Wotsɔ mɔ si wɔ esia le eɖokui si. Zã URI si Akash na wò ko. Nuwo Si Wòele Be Nàxɔ Do Ŋgɔ Keplr Wallet browser extension si wode le Chrome/Brave/Firefox me AKT tokens - Xɔ AKT 50-100 tso gatrɔƒe [exchange] aɖe gbɔ (Coinbase, Kraken, Osmosis) Minuti 5 be nàzi Console UI la me Afɔ 1: Ɖe Wò Gakotoku Kple Eŋu -> Yi https://console.akash.network -> Zi "Connect Wallet" le dziƒe ƒe ɖeɖeƒe -> Tia Keplr (alo wò Cosmos gakotoku) -> Ɖe mɔ na kadodo la ne Keplr do ɖa Wò AKT ƒe balance ava dze le dziƒe ƒe ɖeɖeƒe. Ne eƒe asixɔxɔ nye zero la, yi nàɖo ga ɖe wò gakotoku me gbã. Afɔ 2: Wɔ Deployment -> Zi "Deploy" button (button gã blu si le axɔa ƒe titina) -> Tia "Build your template" (alo yi ɖe SDL ƒe upload dzi tẽ) Ɖoƒe A: Ɖe SDL File Ɖo (Wòle Be Nàtia) Ɖoƒe B: Zã SDL Editor Ne èdi be nàtsɔ asi aɖe the SDL: -> Kopi zebra-akash.yml ƒe emenyawo -> Ɖe ewo ɖe SDL editor la me -> Trɔe le esi wòhiã (kpɔ configuration ƒe akpa si le ete) -> Zi "Create Deployment" Afɔ 3: Kpɔ Deposit La Ɖa Eye Nàɖe Mɔ Nɛ Console la afia wò: -> Deployment deposit: 5 AKT (wòaɖo esia ɖe wò gbɔ ne nètsɔ deployment la ɖe aga) -> Ƒe asi si wole be nàxɔ: Wole wò SDL ƒe asiwo nu Zi "Approve" eye nàde asi ɖe gaɖoɖo [transaction] la ŋu le Keplr me. Afɔ 4: Tia Provider Aɖe Le sekondi 30 ƒe me la, nàkpɔ bids siwo tso providers gbɔ. Bid ɖesiaɖe afia: -> Asi na gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe [block] ɖeka (le AKT alo USDC me) -> Ƒe asi si wole be nàxɔ le ƒeɖeɖe me -> Provider ƒe nyawo (dɔwɔƒe ƒe ɣeyiɣi, nutome, kple bubuwo) Mègatia esi mexɔ asi o ko. Kpɔ: -> Dɔwɔƒe ƒe ɣeyiɣi % (to 95% dzi alo wu) -> Nutome (esi le te ɖe ŋuwò la ana kadodo ƒe gaƒoƒo nyo, gake emexɔ vevie na blockchain ƒe ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔwo o) -> Audited ƒe nɔnɔ (dzesi gbɔdzɔ = wòle be wòakpɔ dzi ɖe eŋu wu) Zi "Accept Bid" le provider si nètia la ŋu eye nàde asi le Keplr me. Afɔ 5: Lala Na Deployment La Console la awɔ: -> Wòawɔ lease kple provider si nètia -> Wòaɖo manifest la ɖa (esi gblɔ na provider la nusi wòawɔ) -> Wòadze wò container la Esia xɔ minuti 1-2. Nàkpɔ nɔnɔ ƒe yeyeɖeɖewo le UI la me. Afɔ 6: Ɖe Kpɔ Be Ele Dɔ Wɔm Ne woɖo eƒe teƒe vɔ la, nàkpɔ: -> Services tab: Efia wò zebra service kple eƒe nɔnɔ -> Logs tab: Container ƒe logs si wole dɔ me -> Leases tab: Nyawo ku ɖe wò deployment ŋu (DSEQ, provider, asi) Kpɔ Logs Lɔ Zi Logs eye ele be nàkpɔ Zebra le dɔ gɔme: Ɖoɖoɖo la axɔ gaƒoƒo geɖe va se ɖe ŋkeke geɖe le network la nu. Lé ŋku ɖe: -> Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe kɔkɔe siwo gbedze yi dzi -> Kadodo kple peers (ele be peers 10-30 nanɔ) -> Vodada siwo megatrɔ ɖo o Afɔ 7: Xɔ Wò Ɣaɣla Dzesi Ŋɔŋlɔ Ƒe Gaɖoƒe Ƒe Dzesi Zi Leases tab, eye yi URIs. Nàkpɔ nane abe: Esia nye wò ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ ƒe public P2P endpoint. Zcash ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ bubuwo akplɔ ɖe ŋuwò le gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi sia dzi. De dzesi port ƒe ɖoɖo la ŋu: Nèɖo port 8233 le SDL me, gake Akash na port publ

title: Zcash Avalanche RedBridge
description: Zcash Avalanche RedBridge nye ga ƒe lẽ ha nuɖo agni, si na ƒomeviwo ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ɖe Zcash (ZEC) kple Avalanche (AVAX) gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖunuwo dome. Wode ga ƒe…
text: Zcash Avalanche RedBridge Zcash Avalanche RedBridge nye ga ƒe lẽ ha nuɖo agni, si na ƒomeviwo ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ɖe Zcash (ZEC) kple Avalanche (AVAX) gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖunuwo dome. Wode ga ƒe lẽ sia ŋu be wòana ZEC ƒe keke ɖe Avalanche gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu dzi nasɔ gbɔ, eye wòazã Avalanche ƒe dɔwɔwɔ geɖe, adzɔ sue, kple gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi si me xexeame ƒe nuwo menɔa vɔ̃ o, esi wòle Zcash ƒe ɣaɣla ƒe nɔnɔme vevieawo hã ɖe asi. RedBridge doa alɔ̃ zã nyawo geɖe, abe ɖoɖonu geɖe dome ha nuɖo agni ga ƒe dɔwɔwɔ (DeFi), ɣaɣla gaɖoɖowo, kple tsiƒoƒo ƒe mama ene, eye wòna Zcash ƒe tɔwo mɔ geɖe be woage ɖe Avalanche ƒe nuto me. Ga ƒe lẽ sia dɔa ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ ha nuɖo agniwo kple oracle, si woyɔna be ZavaX, ƒe mɔnu dzi; esia na nyatakakawo ƒe keke kple asiɖeke me nɔmanɔme ƒe kpɔɖeŋu dome ɖe Zcash kple Avalanche dome nanyo akpa. Nɔnɔme Veviwo Ɣaɣla ƒe Nɔnɔme Ƒe Ƒomevi Dɔwɔwɔ: Ena Zcash ƒe zazãlawo be woalé woƒe ɣaɣla me esi wole DeFi ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo zãm le Avalanche dzi. Ha Nuɖo Agni Oracle ZavaX: Etsɔ oracle ƒe ɖoɖo de eme be wòana ZEC/AVAX ƒe asiɖeke me nɔmanɔme ƒe nyatakaka nadzɔ, eye wòana ɖoɖonu geɖe dome dɔwɔwɔ si me mɔxɔse menye be woahiã o. Dɔwɔwɔ Kpɔtɔ Kple Xexeame Ƒe Nuléle: Ezã Avalanche ƒe gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi ƒe mɔnu, eye wòna gaɖoɖowo nava kabakaba kple xexeame ŋu vɔ̃ɖi sue. DeFi Kple DApps Ƒe Kpekpeɖeŋu: Zcash ƒe tɔwo ate ŋu ava de DeFi ƒe platform vovovowo me le Avalanche dzi, esi woƒe ɣaɣla menɔa afɔku o. Mɔ̃ŋlɔ Ƒe Akpaawo Ha Nuɖo Agni ZavaX Oracle Nuxlɔɖi: ZavaX Oracle le vevie na ga ƒe lẽ sia, elabena ena asiɖeke me nɔmanɔme ƒe nyatakaka le ɖoɖonuwo dome, eye wòna ZEC ƒe trɔtrɔ yi AVAX me si me mɔxɔse menye be woahiã o. Oracle Ƒe Ƒomevi Mɔ Ɖoɖonu Geɖe Dome Ga Ƒe Lẽ Ƒe Mɔ̃ŋlɔ Ƒe Dɔwɔwɔ Nuxlɔɖi: Mɔ̃ŋlɔ ƒe dɔwɔwɔ si de asi na Zcash Avalanche ga ƒe lẽ, eye wòkpɔa deposits, trɔtrɔwo, kple ZEC ƒe tata ɖe go. Ɣaɣla Ƒe Akpa Ƒe Ƒomevi Dede Nuxlɔɖi: Ena be Zcash ƒe ɣaɣla ƒe nɔnɔmeawo nanɔ anyi le ga ƒe lẽ ƒe dɔwɔwɔ blibo la me, eye wòna ɖoɖonu geɖe dome ɣaɣla gaɖoɖowo nadzɔ. Dɔwo Kple Agbalẽwo Zcash Elastic Subnet Bridge le Avalanche: Ga ƒe Kpekpeɖeŋu Ƒe Ɖoɖoɖo Dɔ veviwo kple mɔ̃ŋlɔ ƒe nuɖoɖowo si wowɔ na Zcash Avalanche RedBridge ƒe dɔa nye esiwoe: Dɔ 1.1: PoC gɔmedzedze si doa alɔ̃ be woabia testnet Zcash gaɖoɖowo tso testnet Avalanche subnet me kple CLI, eye wodo eɖe GitHub, kple node ɖeka subnet le Avalanche testnet dzi. https://github.com/red-dev-inc/redbridge-oracle Dɔ 2.1: Ɖoɖoɖo ƒe Nɔnɔme Dzidzimekpɔkpɔ 3 March 31, 2024 Dɔ 3.1 wu enu, eye wòtsɔ míaƒe xexlẽɖeŋu na tso FROST ƒe zãm ɖe BLS nu na threshold signatures le ZavaX ga ƒe lẽ me. Trɔtrɔ sia zã agbalẽdzraɖoƒe si wowɔ audit na tso Zcash Foundation me, eye wòna ƒomevi dede kple dedie nyuie wu. https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/frost Dɔ 3.2 UX kple UI ƒe ɖoɖo na GUI wu enu, eye wòɖe míaƒe dedie ƒe ɖeɖeawo fia na ZavaX Oracle subnet, si penetration testing ƒe emetsonuwo de asi. Na nyatakaka geɖe, si me server ƒe ɖoɖo kple dodokpɔ ƒe emetsonuwo hã le la, Dedie Ƒe Kpɔkpɔ Audit Ƒe Nyaŋlɔɖi Kpe ɖe eŋu la, team la trɔ woƒe ŋkɔ tso ZavaX yi redbridge, eye wotrɔ woƒe ga ƒuƒoƒo token tso ZAX yi RBR. Dzidzimekpɔkpɔ 4 April 30, 2024 Dɔ 4.1 Ɖoɖoɖo si dɔa blibo ɖe Zcash kple Avalanche testnetwo dzi, kple validators 3 ƒe Subnet, kple CLI ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu Dzidzimekpɔkpɔ 5 May 31, 2024 Dɔ 5.1 GUI: ga ƒe lẽ ƒe ƒomevi dede ɖe Core alo Webapp me Dzidzimekpɔkpɔ 6 June 30, 2024 Dɔ 6.1 Software audit ƒe nusiwo katã wɔ nyuie Dɔ 6.2 Audit si wowɔ ƒe source code la ƒe tata ɖe GitHub repo si amewo katã ate ŋu akpɔ Kpɔ GitHub ƒe nudzraɖoƒe la ɖeka Na mɔ̃ŋlɔ ƒe nyatakaka geɖe, wode asi na zazãlawo be woaxlẽ RedBridge ƒe dɔa ƒe repository kple agbalẽwo be woatsɔ woƒe ŋku akpɔ ƒomevi dede ƒe nyatakakaawo, dodokpɔ ƒe frameworkwo, kple dedie ƒe mɔnuwo. Dɔwo: Le Q1 2025 me la, team la ƒo red·bridge demo website ƒe dede ƒe nya, afi si ame sia ame ate ŋu ado ŋku zazãla ƒe numekpɔkpɔ la, ana nuƒoƒo, eye wòaɖo ɖeɖeawo. description: Mɔfiame sia dea afɔ ɖe afɔ ƒe mɔfia tso ale si nàwɔ asi geɖe ƒe dzesi ƒe gaɖoɖowo kple Zkool ene. Eme le akɔntawo ƒe ṣẹwɔwɔ, ga ɖoɖo alo xexlẽ, kple kiyiwo ƒe…
text: Zkool Asi geɖe ƒe dzesi [Multisig] ƒe Mɔfiame Mɔfiame sia dea afɔ ɖe afɔ ƒe mɔfia tso ale si nàwɔ asi geɖe ƒe dzesi ƒe gaɖoɖowo kple Zkool ene. Eme le akɔntawo ƒe ṣẹwɔwɔ, ga ɖoɖo alo xexlẽ, kple kiyiwo ƒe dede le ƒome ƒe mɔnu me [Distributed Key Generation (DKG)] ƒe ɖoɖowɔwɔ na asi geɖe ƒe dzesi. Woɖe foto le afɔ vevi ɖe sia ɖe ta. Nufiamɔ Akɔnta Ƒe Ŋutinu Wɔwɔ Ʋu Zkool ƒe app la, eye nàyi New Account. Ŋlɔ Account Name (kpɔɖeŋu, Anabelle). Ne ele be wòhia la, trɔ Use Internal Change alo Restore Account yi. Ne wòwu nu la, akɔnta la ado go le wò Account List me. Ga Xexlẽ Akɔnta ɖe sia ɖe wɔa gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ƒomevi geɖewo: Gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi si ƒo ƒu [Unified Address] Orchard koe ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi Sapling ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi Nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi Tia ƒomevi si wòdi be yàzã, eye nàmae na amewo be woɖo ga ɖe eme. Ga Ɖoɖo Yi ɖe Recipient ƒe akpa. Ɖe ame si wòle ga ɖo ge nɛ ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi la ɖe eme. Ɖo ga home la kple nya kpui si wòate ŋu akpe ɖe eŋu. Kpɔ gaɖoɖo la ƒe nyawo katã me, eye nàɖe edzi. Ne wòwu nu la, ga si le akɔnta la me atrɔ le wò akɔntawo ƒe xexlẽ la me. Asi Geɖe Ƒe Dzesi Ƒe Gaɖoɖowo Wɔwɔ: Kiyiwo Ƒe Dede le Ƒome Ƒe Mɔnu Me Ɖoɖowɔwɔ (Asi Geɖe Ƒe Dzesi) Asi geɖe ƒe dzesi le Zkool me zãa Kiyiwo ƒe Dede le Ƒome Ƒe Mɔnu Me (DKG) be ame geɖe nanɔ akɔnta ɖeka ƒe dzikpɔkpɔ me. Afɔ 1: DKG Ƒe Gɔmedzedze Tia Ŋkɔ na gakotoku si woma ƒo ƒu (kpɔɖeŋu, Anabelle). Ɖo Haxɔlawo Ƒe Xexlẽ. Tia wò Haxɔla Ƒe ID. Ɖo Ame siwo ƒe Asiwo Wɔa DƆ Ƒe Xexlẽ (Threshold). Tia Akɔnta si ƒe Ga Wozãa. Afɔ 2: Haxɔlawo Ƒe Gaɖoƒe Ƒe Dzesiwo Kpe Ɖe Eŋu Ɖe haxɔla ɖe sia ɖe ƒe Gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi si ƒo ƒu la ɖe eme (wodea aɖaŋu). Nudzɔdzɔ: Ne wozã Orchard koe alo Sapling koe ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi la, asi geɖe ƒe dzesi la anɔ gaƒuƒoƒo ma koe me (Orchard alo Sapling). Esia fia be gakotoku si woma ƒo ƒu la mate ŋu axɔ ga tso gaƒuƒoƒo bubuwo me o. Be wòakpɔ mɔ na nuzãzã kple tɔtrɔ geɖe wu la, zã Gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo siwo ƒo ƒu ɣesiaɣi. Afɔ 3: Wɔ DKG Ƒe Ƒoƒowo Lalae ne haxɔlawo katã wɔ ƒoƒo 1 kple ƒoƒo 2 ƒe paketiwo ƒe maxlẽ ɖe wo nɔewo dome. Afɔ 4: Wu Gaɖoƒe Ƒe Dzesi si Woma ƒo Ƒu la Nu Ne wòwu nu la, woawɔ gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi si woma ƒo ƒu. Nuƒoƒo Kple Zkool, àte ŋu: awɔ akɔntawo, aɖo ga kple axɔ ga, eye nàɖo asi geɖe ƒe dzesi ƒe gakotoku wɔ kple Kiyiwo Ƒe Dede le Ƒome Ƒe Mɔnu Me. Esia nana dedie kpɔkpɔ si sesĩe wu kple ga ƒe dzikpɔkpɔ si woma wɔ ɖekawɔwɔ kple ɣaɣla me.

title: Ywallet FROST ɖeɖefia
description: Woɖe asi le Ywallet dzadzra me o. Eƒe mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔla ƒo nu ɖe edzi be woamaɖe yeye na Ironwood (NU6.3) o, eyata mate ŋu adze ɖoɖonu [chain] yome o, eye…
text: Ywallet FROST ɖeɖefia Woɖe asi le Ywallet dzadzra me o. Eƒe mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔla ƒo nu ɖe edzi be woamaɖe yeye na Ironwood (NU6.3) o, eyata mate ŋu adze ɖoɖonu [chain] yome o, eye womate ŋu awɔ afɔɖeŋu siwo le ete o le mainnet dzi. Woɖe axa sia ɖe afi ma na woakpɔe. Zkool, si tso mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔla ma ke gbɔ, nye esi woɖoa ɖe edzi fifia eye wòde FROST multisig kpɔ. Ɖo FROST bins GitHub ƒe kaɖedzi Zã repo si le etame eye nàwɔ esiwo woɖe fia tso ɖoɖo me: Bins anɔ target ƒe folder me. Wɔ FROST UA ./generateFROSTUA.sh Ɖe UFVK ɖe Ywallet me Accounts -> Zi + eye nàtsɔ ufvk si tso afɔɖeŋu si le etame la nàde eme. Wɔ gaɖoɖo [transaction] kple Ywallet De UA aɖeke eme eye nàɖo tx. Dzra file la ɖo. Dze FROST ƒe asidede agbalẽ te [signature] wɔwɔ gɔme ./signFROSTtx.sh rawtxs/mytx signedtxs/mysignedtx Nudɔɖoɖo gbãtɔ nye raw tx si tso afɔɖeŋu si le etame la ƒe teƒe. Nudɔɖoɖo evelia nye teƒe kple ŋkɔ na asidede agbalẽ te [signed] tx si nèle be yeawɔ broadcast na. Afisiae nègblɔ na FROST gaɖoɖo [transaction] kae nèle be ame gbogbo nasɔ asidede agbalẽ te na. Dze Coordinator gɔme ./runCoordinator.sh Esia wɔ ame sia ame ƒe asidede agbalẽ te [signature] ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu eye wòwɔ hadome ƒe asidede agbalẽ te [group signature]. Na Participant sia ame nasɔ asidede agbalẽ te na gaɖoɖo sia Wu asidede agbalẽ te [signed] Gaɖoɖo la nu Le coordinator ƒe fesre me, kɔpi hadome ƒe asidede agbalẽ te si do go la eye nàtsɔ ade FROST ƒe asidede agbalẽ te ƒe fesre me. Esia awu FROST ƒe asidede agbalẽ te wɔwɔ la nu eye wòado 'mysingedtx' go. Wɔ Broadcast na wo ƒe Gaɖoɖo kple Ywallet Zi 'More' le Ywallet ƒe goame ɖe mia ƒe ɖusime eye nàdi 'Broadcast'. Di 'mysignedtx' eye nàzi ok. Ne nu gbogbo dzɔ la, nàxɔ transaction ID :)

title: Gaɖoɖowo Ƒuƒoƒo Ƒe Ɖoɖonu Ƒe Kpɔlawo
description: Le asiatsotso ƒe xexeme la me la, gaɖoɖo [transaction] sia kple sia si wowɔ la ƒe asiatsotso ƒe ɖaseɖigbalɛ [proof] le eme. Nenema kee, le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe…
text: Gaɖoɖowo Ƒuƒoƒo Ƒe Ɖoɖonu Ƒe Kpɔlawo Gɔmedzedze Le asiatsotso ƒe xexeme la me la, gaɖoɖo [transaction] sia kple sia si wowɔ la ƒe asiatsotso ƒe ɖaseɖigbalɛ [proof] le eme. Nenema kee, le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu [blockchain] ƒe xexeme la me la, zazã aɖe xɔ digital asiatsotso le gaɖoɖo ƒe ID ƒe nɔnɔme me na gaɖoɖo sia kple sia si wowu. Gakotoku [wallet] geɖe ana esia na wò. Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu ƒe kpɔlawo nye dɔwɔnu [tools] ko siwo na ame ŋu wòakpɔ nu si dzɔ xoxo le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu aɖe dzi. Woxɔna gaɖoɖo ƒe ID, gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi [address], alo gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe hash abe wɔnɔewo ene, eye wofia nu si dzɔ la kple mɔkpɔkpɔ. Medekpɔwo Bitcoin: c839b44a7052393f4672cdc4ec79f8f15d3036565e13bede0fab91f674506a7c Ethereum: 0x43117fc201f8d3c09a72d42ab4a048003f348917771b9ace64b8944a91807320 Cosmos: D0587C76E7689A9EFBDDA587DDB450F6C6E972FCEEA37DD8DA9AF95C23CF8170 Zcash (duƒe bliboa): 8dd212847a97c5eb9cee5e7e58c4d9e739f4156273ae3b2da1a4ff79ad95ff82 Zcash (sia le ame ŋutɔ ƒe asi): 19a4be270089490ece2e5fe7a6c9b9804af3c7ed43e1fb1b744b0fb29070fa5d Kpɔ Zcash gbɔ ale si gaɖoɖo evelia ƒe nyatakakanu veviwo katã le ɣaɣla [shielded] me, esia le vevi eye eŋu nya gãwo le le digital xexeme me. Gaɖoɖowo Ƒuƒoƒo Ƒe Ɖoɖonu Ƒe Anyigbatatawo Eya ta míaƒe digital asiatsotsoe nye agbalẽdzidzenu didi sia, nu ka wòanɔ? Afisiae mía zãna gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu ƒe kpɔla, alo anyigbatata, be wòakpe ɖe mía ŋu míase nu si dzɔ le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu la dzi. Kpɔ ale si ɖoɖonu sia kple sia si le eƒe gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu ƒe kpɔla le afima. Ele vevi be nàse egɔme be gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu ƒe dɔwɔwɔ projɛkiti siawo katã nye open source software ƒe medekpɔwo. Esia fia be ame sia kple sia ate ŋu akpe ɖe code la ŋu alo awɔ fork na eƒe dzidzɔ nu. Ne nèse esia gɔme la, projɛkiti sia kple sia katã tsɔa eɖokui dea teƒe vovovowo me eye wotrɔa gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu ƒe kpɔla la be wòasɔ kple projɛkiti ma ƒe hiãhiãwo. Gaɖoɖowo Ƒuƒoƒewo Wodea gaɖoɖowo ɖe gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒewo [blocks] me. Ne woku alo woda ɖase na gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe aɖe la, woda ɖase na gaɖoɖo sia kple sia si le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ma me eye wowɔa gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe hash. Hash sia kple sia si wowɔ la, woate ŋu aɖe eŋu ɖe gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe kpɔla aɖe me. Ɖe wòkpɔ CEXwo kpɔ le ɖaseɖigbalɛwo [confirmations] ƒe xexlẽ aɖe bi hafi woda wò ga la ɖe asi, esiae nye dzidzenu si wozãna be woakpɔ be wowu wò gaɖoɖo la ɖe egbe. Aleke gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu la ƒoa ta be gaɖoɖo kae awɔ ɖoɖo ge ɖe gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe si gbɔna me? Esia nye nyadzɔdzɔ ƒe nudzɔdzɔ si sesẽ, gake ɖoɖonu yeyeawo dometɔ geɖe zãa adzɔwo [fees] ƒe susu be woatsɔ atia ame si anɔ fliƒe gbãtɔ me. Ne adzɔ la le dzidzedze wu la, ekema wòƒe mɔ be nàyi fliƒe gbãtɔ me le fli la me la le dzidzedze wu. Gaɖoƒe Ƒe Dzesiawo Mɔ dzidzɔ aɖe si mɔkpɔkpɔ me nàsrɔ gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu ƒe kpɔlawo nye be nàɖe gaɖoɖo aɖe si wòtia ɖe asi ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi la ɖe eme. Emegbe nàte ŋu ayi megbe le ɣeyiɣi me eye nàkpɔ afi si ga la tso! Gaɖoɖo sia kple sia ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi si tsoa eme kple si yia eme le. Ne ame aɖe le nyatakaka sia ŋu la, ate ŋu ayi ŋgɔ kple megbe bɔbɔe tso gaɖoɖo sia kple sia si wozã xoxo. Na ame siwo lɔ̃a nudzɔdzɔwo la, esia nye digital nudzɔdzɔ gã aɖe si le ga ŋu, eye woate ŋu azãe na nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi [transparent] ƒe ta. Ne wòzã gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu ƒe kpɔla la, menye be wòanɔ bɔbɔe be nàkpɔe ko o, ke boŋ efia kple dzesi be gaɖoɖo ƒe ɣaɣla [privacy] le vevi. Ne mèzã ɣaɣla Zcash o la, àte ŋu awɔ esia kple gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu sia kple sia si nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi le: BTC, ETH, ATOM, DOGE, VTC, kple bubuwo ... . Nu sia le vevi ŋutɔ na ame sia kple sia si zãa gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu dedie le mɔ si yia digital ko ƒe etsɔme. Ga Ƒe Ɖeƒewo Nenema kee abe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo siwo le etame ene la, gaɖoɖo sia kple sia si le duƒe blibo ƒe gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu dzi la, woɖea ga ƒe ƒeƒewo fia ame sia kple sia. Esia ƒoa ga ƒe ƒeƒe siwo le gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi si tsoa eme kple si yia eme me na gaɖoɖo sia kple sia. Nu ɖeka si vovo le esia me nye ne wòtia be

description: Brave Wallet nye crypto gakotoku [wallet] si le dzidzedze me, eye woɖe wò ɖe Brave browser me - medi be nàtsɔ extensions o.
text: Aleke Nàdzo Eye Nàxɔ ɣaɣla [Shielded] Zcash (ZEC) Kple Brave Wallet: Afiɖoɖo ƒe Fiafia Le ɣaɣla [Privacy] Ŋu Brave Wallet nye crypto gakotoku [wallet] si le dzidzedze me, eye woɖe wò ɖe Brave browser me - medi be nàtsɔ extensions o. Nu Ka Ta ɣaɣla [Shielded] ZEC ƒe Kpekpeɖeŋu Le Vevi Zcash nye crypto gaƒomekpuie aɖewo dome, siwo na ɣaɣla [privacy] le gɔmedzedze me kple ɣaɣla [shielded] gaɖoɖowo [transactions]. Brave Wallet tše Orchard ɣaɣla [shielded] ZEC dzi fifia, eye wòna ame ŋu wɔ gaɖoɖowo [transactions] siwo le ɣa me, esi womehia third-party software o. Azɔ, zazãwo ate ŋu adzo/xɔ ZEC tanpa be woafia woƒe balance alo metadata o - katã le Brave browser me. Fiafia Akpa 1: Ɖo Brave Wallet Ɖe Teƒe Afɔɖewo siwo woƒo: Ʋu Brave Browser (desktop ko le fifia) Zi Wallet ƒe icon dzi alo yi brave://wallet Ɖo wò gakotoku [wallet] ɖe teƒe (wòawɔ yeye alo wòaɖo wɔnɛ) Kpɔ crypto ɖoɖowo ƒuƒopé [dashboard] la Akpa 2: Ɖe Zcash (ZEC) Kpe Brave Wallet Ŋu Afɔɖewo siwo woƒo: Le Wallet ɖoɖowo ƒuƒopé [dashboard] la me, zi "Manage Assets" dzi Di ZEC eye na mɔ nɛ ZEC do go le wò gakotoku [wallet] me fifia Akpa 3: Xɔ ɣaɣla [Shielded] ZEC (Unified Address) Afɔɖewo siwo woƒo: Zi ZEC dzi le wò assets me Tia "Receive" Brave wɔ Unified Address (UA) na wò - gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi [address] ɖeka si tše ɣaɣla [shielded] kple nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi [transparent] gaɖoɖowo [transactions] evea Kɔpi alo scan QR code la Na wò UA la ame si adzoa nɛ Akpa 4: Dzo ɣaɣla [Shielded] ZEC Le ɣa Me Afɔɖewo siwo woƒo: Tia ZEC -> Send Ɖe ame si axɔe la ƒe Unified Address alo ɣaɣla [shielded] gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi [address] la Ɖe gaƒe la Ɖo kpe gaɖoɖo [transaction] la ƒe nyawo ŋu Zi Send dzi - azɔ, woɖo ga la le ɣa me, kple Orchard gaƒuƒoƒo [pool] la Gaɖoƒe Ƒe Dzesi [Address] Ƒomeviwo Efiafia le Zcash gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi [address] ƒomevi ɖe sia ɖe ŋu: t-addr (t1...) - Nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi [Transparent] gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo wɔ dɔ abe Bitcoin gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo ene, si fia be gaɖoɖowo [transactions] le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu [blockchain] la dzi le ame sia ame ƒe nukpɔkpɔ me. Wɔwɔ wɔn kple gakotokuwo si menye Zcash tɔ o le bɔbɔe, gake womena ɣaɣla [privacy] o. z-addr (zs...) - Ɣaɣla [Shielded] gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo zã Zcash ƒe ɣaɣla [privacy] ƒe mɔnu (Sprout/Sapling) be woaɣla ame si dzoe, ame si xɔe, kple gaƒe la. Nukpɔsafuiwo [viewing keys] alo etɔ aɖe ko ate ŋu aɖe nyawo fia. UA (u... or QR) - Unified Addresses ƒo gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi [address] ƒomevi geɖewo (nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi [transparent], ɣaɣla [shielded], Orchard) ɖe ɖeka me. Esia na mɔnu si wòate ŋu awɔ dɔ kple nu geɖewo, eye wòɖo ɣaɣla [privacy] dzi fifia si wòate ŋui. Nunya ƒe Nuwo Ƒoƒoƒo: Wòate Ŋu Azã ɣaɣla [Privacy] Le Ŋutɔ Me Kple Brave Wallet kple ɣaɣla [shielded] ZEC, ɣaɣla [privacy] le ame sia ame ƒe asi me fifia - special software alo nyanya didi mele be wòahiã o. Enyo na nyadzɔdzɔŋlɔlawo, activists, alo amewo siwo tsɔ ɣaɣla [privacy] de asi. Mekpɔ be nàwɔ wòƒe ɣaɣla [shielded] gaɖoɖo [transaction] gbãtɔ egbe le Brave me! Nànɔ ɣa me. Nànɔ ablɔɖe. Dzo ZEC le ɣa me kple Brave Wallet.

text: BTCPay Server kple Zcash ƒe Kpekpeɖeŋu: Ɖoɖo Blibo kple Ƒoƒoƒo Ƒe Mɔfiame BTCPay Server na akpaɖe ƒe dzidzimebizniswo ƒe mɔ woaxɔ crypto fexexewo tẽ, manɔ haƒomevi alo ga dzralawo ŋu o. Mɔfiame sia akplɔ wò to BTCPay Server ƒe ɖoɖo blibo me kple Zcash ɣaɣla [shielded] fexexewo ƒe dzidzi ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu. Numenyalɔlɔ sia ɖe Zcash ƒe ƒoƒoƒo kple wò BTCPay Server ƒe instance ŋu. Eƒe kpekpeɖeŋu le ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo (Zebra) kple lightwalletd-based ƒe ɖoɖowo siaa ŋu. --- Nusiwo Le Eme Nu Ta Nàzã BTCPay Server kple Zcash Ale Si BTCPay Server Wɔa Dɔe Afika Wodzra Gawo ɖo? Ame Ka Wɔa Dzi Ƒe Kɔkɔe Ƒe Sɔkewordwo Dzi? Ale Si NàƉo BTCPay Server ɖe Zcash ƒe Xɔxɔ Ta BTCPay Server Ƒe Ɖoɖo kple Zcash ƒe Kpekpeɖeŋu Wò Ŋutɔ Zcash ƒe ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo ƒe Dudu (Zebra + lightwalletd) Ƒoƒoƒo kple Xɔtame lightwalletd ƒe ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ (Ɖoɖo Si Wò Ŋutɔ Nàtia) BTCPay Server Ƒe Dzɔdzɔ Le Aƒeme kple Cloudflare Tunnel Zcash Plugin ƒe Ɖoɖo Le BTCPay Server ƒe Web Ƒe Nɔnɔmetata Me BTCPay Server ƒe Ƒoƒoƒo kple Wò Nyatakakadzraƒe API Ƒe Ƒoƒoƒo API Ƒe Sɔkeword Ƒe Dzadzra Mede Mɔ: Invoice Ƒe Wɔwɔ To API Me Webhook Ƒe Ɖoɖo CMS Ƒe Ƒoƒoƒo Fexexe Ƒe Button Alo Iframe Nuƒoƒo Nukpekpewo --- Nu Ta Nàzã BTCPay Server kple Zcash Dzidzime ƒe asitsotso xɔa crypto fexexewo sɔ gbã. Eƒe mɔ le kabakaba, ele xexea katã me, eye wòate ŋu awɔ dɔ manɔ bankiwo ŋu o. Esia doa vi na asitsotso wɔlawo kple asitsiwo siaa. Ke nyatakaka vevi aɖe li si ame geɖewo mekpena ɖe eŋu o. Ne wòle order ɖom la, zi geɖe asitsi la naa ame ŋutɔ ƒe nyatakakawo: ŋkɔ, nuɖoƒe si woatsɔ nu yi, kple telefon ƒe xexlẽme. Ne wowɔ fexexe la kple public gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu [blockchain] abe Bitcoin, Ethereum, alo stablecoinwo siwo le Ethereum alo Tron dzi ene la, gaɖoɖo [transaction] la doa ɖe go tegbee be woate ŋu asrɔ̃e. Ame sia ame ate ŋu, esi wòmenya nu si woxɔ o hã, awɔ esia: Anya ɣeyiɣi kple ga home nenie woxe Atia afika ga la tso kple afi si woyi Aƒo crypto gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi [address] kple ame ŋutɔ ne ɖekawɔwɔ aɖe li, abe email si do go alo ame si ƒe ŋkɔ le nu tsɔtsɔ ƒe dzesi dzi ene Esia fia be nu si asitsi aɖe xɔ ko ate ŋu aɖe eƒe ga ƒe ŋutinya blibo afia. Eye ewɔa dɔ le mɔ ma ke dzi hã. Ne asitsotso wɔla ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi va dze ɖoɖonu dzi kpɔ la, woakpɔe nyuie. Hoho ƒe ameawo kple ame bubuwo ate ŋu atia fexexe ƒe ga home, nu dzodzrolawo ƒe dɔwɔwɔ, kple biznis ƒe ga ƒe zɔzɔ ƒe ɖoɖo. BTCPay Server kple Zcash ƒe ƒoƒoƒo ate ŋu aɖo kuxi sia. BTCPay Server nye ɖoɖo mamle ga o, eye wòle ha nuɖo agni [decentralized], si woazã axɔ crypto fexexewo. Menye fexexe ƒe haƒomevi o, eye wòmetsɔa ga aɖeke ɖo o. Fexexewo katã yia tẽ ɖe asitsotso wɔla ƒe gakotoku [wallet] me. Esia ate ŋu anye ame ŋutɔ ƒe gakotoku alo multisig ƒe ɖoɖo le habɔbɔ aɖe me. Server la wɔa dɔ le ɖoɖo ƒe dɔwo ŋu: Ewɔa gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi tɔxɛ na order sia sia Etsɔa ŋku ɖea ɣeyiɣi si woxɔ fexexe la dzi, eye wòƒoa eƒo kple order la Ena receipt kple nyanyuiwo Ena fexexe ƒe nɔnɔme na asitsi la Nu katã dzea asitsotso ƒe owner ƒe dzikpɔkpɔ te, manɔ subɔsubɔ bubuwo ŋu o. Zcash nye crypto ga si wowɔ tso zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛ [proof] wo dzi. Eƒe kpekpeɖeŋu le gaɖoɖo ƒe nɔnɔme si le ɣaɣla blibo me ŋu. Ne wozã ɣaɣla gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo (tso fifia yi ŋgɔ, míayɔ wo be "gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo" ko) la, wometsɔa ame si dɔ ga la, ame si xɔe, kple gaɖoɖo la ƒe ga home aɖe go le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu dzi o. Na dzidzime ƒe asitsotsrowo la, esia fia be: Nuƒola la ate ŋu awu fexexe la enu manɔ eƒe ga ƒe ŋutinya ɖe go o Asitsotso wɔla xɔa fexexe manɔ eƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi, asitsotso ƒe ga home, alo gaɖoɖo ƒe ɖoɖo ɖe go o Ame si mele gota la mate ŋu aƒo fexexe la kple order la alo asitsi ƒe nyatakakawo o Mede Mɔ Si Wozãa Dɔe Zãla aɖe ɖoa order, eye wòtia Bitcoin alo USDT be woazã awɔ fexexe. Nyatakakadzraƒe la wɔa fexexe ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi eye wòfia ga home la. Ne wowɔ fexexe la vɔ la, woaɖo gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi sia ɖe ɖoɖonu dzi, eye wòzu nu si ame katã ate ŋu akpɔ. Ame si di be yeawɔ vɔ̃ la hiã be wòaƒo order ɖeka ko kple gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi la be wòakpɔe ƒe gaɖoɖo

title: Zcash Network Ƒe Nɔnɔmetata
description: Esia nye mɔfiame tso ale si nàwɔ Ziggurat 3.0 Crawler na Zcash kple ɖoɖowɔwɔ siwo do ɖeka kplii, Crunchy kple P2P-Viz, le Ubuntu 22.04 dzi be nàxɔ eye nàɖe…
text: Zcash Network Ƒe Nɔnɔmetata Esia nye mɔfiame tso ale si nàwɔ Ziggurat 3.0 Crawler na Zcash kple ɖoɖowɔwɔ siwo do ɖeka kplii, Crunchy kple P2P-Viz, le Ubuntu 22.04 dzi be nàxɔ eye nàɖe Zcash network ƒe nyatakakawo fia. Video si ƒe link le ete la wɔa mɔnu ma ke. ---------------- Ɖo Hiahiãwo: Rust -> https://rustup.rs/ Esi Wodi O: jq -> https://jqlang.github.io/jq/download/ (be nàɖe json nyatakakawo fia le terminal me) curl -> https://everything.curl.dev/install/linux.html (be nàbia nyatakaka tso crawler RPC dzi) npm (kple nvm) -> https://medium.com/@iamvinojan/how-to-install-node-js-and-npm-using-node-version-manager-nvm-143165b16ce1 (be nàɖe P2P-Viz fia le browser me) ---------------- ---------------- Ziggurat 3.0 Ƒe Repository https://github.com/runziggurat Crawler Ƒe Repo https://github.com/runziggurat/zcash.git Crunchy Ƒe Repo https://github.com/runziggurat/crunchy.git P2P-Viz Ƒe Repo https://github.com/runziggurat/p2p-viz.git ---------------- Dze egɔme kple update siwo wozãna ɣesiaɣi. Wɔ seɖoɖowo: ---------------- Zcash Network Crawler Zcash Crawler le folder si woyɔ be 'zcash' me, eyata anyo be nàwɔ directory yeye hafi nàclone crawler la (runziggurat/zcash repo). Tso /Home directory me, wɔ seɖoɖowo: Yi browser me ɖe https://github.com/runziggurat/zcash/blob/main/src/tools/crawler/README.md Alo ʋu readme le '/runziggurat/zcash/src/tools/crawler/README.md' Axa sia me nya le ale si nàzãe tɔxɛ. ---------------- --seed-addrs \ --dns-seed nye argument si wodi ɖeka pɛ, eye ele be gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi Ɖeka aɖe nàɖo ɖe eme hafi wòate ŋu adu. ---------------- Seɖoɖo 'cargo run --release --features crawler --bin crawler -- --help' nye seɖoɖo tututɔ si nadzɔ, eye wòaɖe kpekpeɖeŋu menu si wowɔ fia la afia. Wɔ seɖoɖo Esia aɖo program la ƒe akpa siwo hiã eye wòaɖe kpe edzi be nu sia nu le dɔ wɔm nyuie. Be nàdu Crawler la, ele be nàtsɔ '--seed-addrs' flag akpe ɖe seɖoɖo si dzɔna la ŋu, si me gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi Ɖeka le sue wu, si le vavã, si nye Zcash ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ ƒe IP gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi. Ele be nàna Crawler la naƒo du ɣeyiɣi si nam akpa be nàxɔ emetsonu si sɔ. Àte ŋu akpɔ ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ ƒe IP gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ƒe kpɔɖeŋu aɖewo le https://mainnet.zcashexplorer.app/nodes. Be nàxɔ nyatakaka tso Crawler la gbɔ esi wòle dɔ wɔm la, ele be nàtsɔ '--rpc-addr' flag akpe ɖe seɖoɖo si dzɔna la ŋu. Menye be ele vevie be nàwɔ esia hafi Crawler la aɖe du o, gake ne mèwɔe o la, ele be nàtɔ Crawler la (ctrl+c alo SIGKILL) hafi àte ŋu aɖe nyatakaka aɖeke fia. Wɔ seɖoɖo Crawler la ade asi adi alɔ̃lɔ̃ kple network la (le ɣeyiɣi 20 sia 20 me le gɔmedzedze me) eye wòaxɔ network ƒe nyatakaka. Àte ŋu aɖe nyatakaka tso Crawler la gbɔ afia ne nàzã curl abia ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ la (esia hia jq be nàɖe nyatakaka ma fia). Crawler RPC ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi le kpɔɖeŋu sia me nye '127.0.0.1:54321' Le Terminal bubu me, wɔ seɖoɖo Esia aɖe '.protocolversion' ƒe nyatakaka si woƒo ƒu fifia le '.result' field me afia. '.result' field la gã ŋutɔ, eyata wòanyo be nàyɔ eƒe akpa tɔxɛwo ɖe eteƒe. Nyatakaka ƒe ƒomevi bubu siwo hã naa viɖe nye '.numknownnodes', '.numgoodnodes', '.useragents' kple bubuwo. Kpɔ metrics ƒe akpa le Afisia ---------------- ---------------- Be nàdu Crunchy kple P2P-Viz, ele be nàtsɔ '.result' la aɖo .json file me. Wɔ seɖoɖo Esia awɔ 'latest.json' file le directory si me nèle fifia. Wozã 'latest.json' file sia kple Crunchy. Le afi sia la, àte ŋu atɔ Crawler la kple 'ctrl+c' ne mèhia nyatakaka bubu o. Crawler la aɖe nyatakaka siwo naa viɖe afia le terminal la me. ---------------- Crunchy Wohĩa Crunchy be woaƒo output json file la ƒe nyatakaka ƒu be P2P-Viz nate ŋu azãe. Be nàtu Crunchy, yi wò '/runziggurat' folder me Be nàclone ɖe Crunchy repo me, wɔ seɖoɖowo Kpɔ 'latest.json' file la ɖe 'crunchy/testdata/' folder me. Wɔ seɖoɖowo Esia awɔ Zcash ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ si woƒe ŋutinya wotia ƒe 'state.json' file le 'crunchy/testdata/' folder me, si wozãna kple P2P-Viz. ---------------- P2P-Viz Be nàtu P2P-Viz, ele be npm nanɔ asiwò. Be nàɖo npm kple nvm, wɔ seɖoɖowo: Tu ter

title: Zcash ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo [addresses] ƒe nɔnɔmetata
description: Ne wò le Zcash srɔ̃m zi gbãtɔ la, àkpɔe enumake be gaɖoɖo (transactions) ƒomevi eve li siwo ate ŋu adzɔ: nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi (transparent) kple ɣaɣla (shielded).
text: Zcash ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo [addresses] ƒe nɔnɔmetata Ne wò le Zcash srɔ̃m zi gbãtɔ la, àkpɔe enumake be gaɖoɖo (transactions) ƒomevi eve li siwo ate ŋu adzɔ: nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi (transparent) kple ɣaɣla (shielded). Gawu la, ne èle ŋku ɖom ŋgɔyiyi yeyetɔwo ŋu le Zcash ƒe xexeame la, ɖewohĩ èsrɔ̃ nu tso Gaɖoƒe ƒe Dzesi Ɖekawɔwɔwo (Unified Addresses), alo UA-wo ŋu. Ne amewo le Zcash ƒe dɔwɔƒe me ƒo nu tso ɣaɣla gaɖoɖowo ŋu la, wole gaɖoɖo siwo me gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi siwo wotrɔ asi le na sapling alo orchard protocol-wo le la ŋu ƒom. Wowɔ UA-wo be woaƒo gaɖoɖo ɣaɣla alo nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi ƒomevi ɖesiaɖe nu ƒu ɖe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ɖeka me. Ɖekawɔwɔ sia nye safui si ana UX nava bɔbɔe le etsɔme. Mɔfiame sia ƒe taɖodzinu enye be wòakpe ɖe ŋuwò nàse UA-wo gɔme nyuie to nɔnɔmetata ƒe kpɔɖeŋu siwo me kɔ la dzi. Zcash ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo ƒe ƒomeviwo Fifia la, gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ƒe ƒomevi vevi atọe wonɔ zazã me va se egbe. Esiwoe nye nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi sapling Hãkɔntɔ Gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi (Bliboa) Nu gbãtɔ si wòanɔ ŋku ɖe eŋu lae nye be gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ƒe ƒomevi siawo katã ƒe didime vovotɔ. Àte ŋu akpɔ esia kple ŋku to ŋɔŋlɔdzesi siwo le gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ƒe ka me ƒe xexlẽme alo ne èkpɔ QR code siwo kplɔe ɖo la me. Ne gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ƒe didime le dzedze la, QR code la hã nɔa agbɔgbɔ ɖe megbe, eye wòtsɔ data geɖe ɖoa akpa ene la me. t1goiSyw2JinFCmUnfiwwp72LEZzD42TyYu didi ɖe ŋɔŋlɔdzesi 35 zs1cpf4prtmnqpg6x2ngcrwelu9a39z9l9lqukq9fwagnaqrknk34a7n3szwxpjuxfjdxkuzykel53 didi ɖe ŋɔŋlɔdzesi 78 u1ckeydud0996ftppqrnpdsqyeq4e57qcyjr4raht4dc8j3njuyj3gmm9yk7hq9k88cdkqfuqusgpcpjfhwu3plm2vrd32g8du78kzkm5un357r4vkhz4vhxd4yfl8zvszk99cmsc89qv4trd7jzkcs8h6lukzgy25j8cv76p0g603nrrg6yt6cxsh2v8rmkasskd69ylfyphhjyv0cxs didi ɖe ŋɔŋlɔdzesi 213 Nu evelia si wòanɔ ŋku ɖe eŋu lae nye be gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ƒe ka siawo ƒe gɔmedzedze vovotɔ -- nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi tɔwo dzena kple t, sapling tɔwo kple zs, eye mlɔeba la UA-wo kple u1. Ele vevi be wòanya be: "Orchard ƒe fexexe [payment] gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo ƒe ka si tsi tre ɖeka mele o. Le ema te la, míeɖo "hãkɔntɔ gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo" siwo ate ŋu aƒo gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ƒomevi vovovowo ƒoƒu, siwo me Orchard hã le. Hãkɔntɔ gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo ƒe Amewo-kate ŋu axlẽ Akpa nye "u" le Mainnet, esime woadze kple "u1". " Hãkɔntɔ Gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ƒe nuxɔla Ale si woƒo nu tsoe le afi sia la, ameteŋu atso nuxɔla vovovowo me atu UA-wo -- nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi, sapling, kple orchard gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ƒomeviwo ƒe ƒoƒome. Kpuie ɖe UA bliboa ŋu la, esiwo nye siwo wòakpɔ zi geɖe le afimae: nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi + sapling nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi + orchard sapling + orchard orchard Nu gbãtɔ si wòanɔ ŋku ɖe eŋu lae nye be UA siawo katã tsoa private key ɖeka me! UA-wo ƒe ŋusẽe nye tiatia si wowɔ hena nuwɔlaawo. Ne hiã be protocol yeye naɖe eŋgɔ me la, UA-wo anɔ klalo be woawɔ dɔ. title: Zcash Devtool
description: Zcash Devtool nye platform si wozãna be woawɔ dɔ le Zcash ŋu. Mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔlawoe wɔe na mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔlawo, be woaɖe kpɔ eye woatsɔ aɖa Zcash ƒe dɔwɔwɔ yeye…
text: Zcash Devtool Nu ka nye zcash-devtool? Zcash Devtool nye platform si wozãna be woawɔ dɔ le Zcash ŋu. Mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔlawoe wɔe na mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔlawo, be woaɖe kpɔ eye woatsɔ aɖa Zcash ƒe dɔwɔwɔ yeye; eye womele be woatsɔe awɔ dɔ le production me o. Command line API si dɔwɔnu sia doa fia la ate ŋu atrɔ eye wòatrɔ ɣe sia ɣe manɔ woɖeŋugbeɖeŋu o. MEGATSƆ ga gã aɖo zcash-devtool gakotoku si le eme la ƒe dzikpɔkpɔ me o. Video fiala tso Zcash Devtool ŋu: Kris Nuttycombe (@nuttycom) fia dɔwɔnu sia le ZconVI me. --- Ne woaɖo ɖoɖoɖoɖo me fiafia tso ale si nàdze egɔme atsɔ dɔwɔnu siawo azã la ta, kpɔ fiafia sia. Eɖe mɔ blibo fia ale si woaɖo zcash devtool tooling eye woazãe. Wode eŋu be wòanye fiafia na ale si nàɖo wò ɖokui eye nàtsɔ wò ŋutɔ ƒe dɔwɔwɔ akpe ɖe dɔwɔnu la ŋu. Gɔmedzedze kabakaba Woɖe kpɔ sededewo siwo le ete la kple zcash-devtool main (commit 5a26ee8, August 2026). Dɔwɔnu la trɔna manɔ woɖeŋugbeɖeŋu o, eyata wɔ --help le sedede aɖeke ŋu ne nu si le afisia megale ɖe sia ɖe kplee o. Ɖo Binary si woɖo ɖe ŋgɔgɔme mele o. Ɖo Rust, eye nàtu tso source me: Ŋutinya siwo le ete la yɔ binary si woɖo, target/release/zcash-devtool. cargo run --release -- ... hã wɔ dɔ ale kee. Wɔ testnet gakotoku Dzɔ le testnet dzi. Testnet coins (TAZ) me xɔasi aɖeke mele o. -w nye gakotoku ƒe directory. Etsi le wallet megbe eye le subcommand la ŋgɔ. -i nye age ƒe identity file. Woɣaɣla gakotoku la ƒe mnemonic phrase na e, eye woawɔ file la ne menɔ o. Ɖe asi ɖe eŋu: send, shield kple spending ƒe sedede bubuwo hia e be woaɖe seed la ƒe ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ. -n nye network la: test alo main. -s tia light wallet server la. Default la, zecrocks, ƒoa ɖe zec.rocks server la ŋu na network si wotia. Be nàtrɔ gakotoku si le asiwò xoxo la, zã restore-mnemonic ɖe init teƒe. Ebi phrase la tso asiwò. balance ɖe gaƒuƒoƒo sia sia fia le eɖokui me, kple Ironwood: Wɔ zcash-devtool wallet -w ./my-wallet list-addresses be nàkpɔ gakotoku la ƒe unified address, eye nàtsɔ testnet funds nadzoe tso ga suewo nanaƒe aɖe gbɔ. Na mainnet, tsɔ -n main na init. Zã ga si nàte ŋu abu ne wòbu ko. Do ga eye nàɣaɣlae Gaƒeƒewo le zatoshis me (1 ZEC = 100,000,000 zatoshis). propose fia gaɖoɖo si send aɖo, ke wòmeɖoa eɖa o. list-tx kple list-unspent fia gakotoku la ƒe ŋutinya kple didienuwo. Sedede aɖeke si ƒoa nu kple server hã xɔ --connection tor, si tsɔa kadodo la to Tor client si le eme la me. Kpɔ gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo, keys kple gaɖoɖowo me nyuie inspect gɔmeɖea Zcash ƒe data le offline: gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo, keys, kple raw transactions. Tsɔ --lookup kpee be nàxɔ nyatakaka geɖe tso ɖoɖonu la me, abe gaɖoɖo aɖe le eƒe ID nu ene. Ironwood didienuwo wodɔa wo ɖe Orchard receiver ma ke gbɔ le unified address me, eyata gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo metrɔ kple NU6.3 o. Tu gaɖoɖowo le afɔɖeɖewo me kple PCZTs PCZT (Zcash gaɖoɖo si wo wɔ ƒe akpa) maa gaɖoɖo tutu la yi afɔɖeɖe vovovo me: wɔe, ɖe kpeɖeŋu fia, de asi ɖe eŋu, eye nàdɔe. Afɔɖeɖe sia sia ate ŋu adzɔ le mɔ̃ aɖe ŋu, abe hardware signer si lɔ̃ Keystone ene. pczt ƒe sedede sia sia xlẽa PCZT tso file aɖe alo stdin me eye wòŋlɔa e ɖe file aɖe (--output) alo stdout me, eyata woate ŋu aɖo afɔɖeɖewo ɖe pipe me: zcash-devtool pczt --help ƒoa afɔɖeɖe bubuwo hã, kple inspect, redact, combine, extract kple shield. Tsɔ ga tso Orchard yi Ironwood Tso NU6.3 dzi, Orchard ƒe gawo ate ŋu ayi gakotoku la ŋutɔ ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo ko gbɔ. migration ƒe sededewo tsɔa wo yi Ironwood me: plan fia didienu ƒe mamawo kple transfer ƒe ɣeyiɣiɖoɖo ɖe ŋgɔ, eye metrɔa naneke o. commit tua eye wòde asi ɖe preparation gaɖoɖo gbãtɔwo ŋu ɖe ŋgɔ. Tsɔ --external kpee be nàɖe wo ƒe asiɖeɖe le aƒe me na signer bubu aɖe abe Keystone ene. status fia migration la ƒe ŋgɔyiyi kple afɔɖeɖe si kplɔe ɖo. advance dea kpeɖeŋu fia na gaɖoɖo si kplɔe ɖo, si ƒe anchor le dzadzɛ. Migration ƒe sededewo li ɖe tutum dzi ha. advance tɔ le gaɖoɖo gbãtɔ si dzadzɛ be woaɖe afia me la ŋu, elabena womewɔ broadcasting ɖe dɔwɔnu la me ha o. Na zãzã le ŋkeke sia ŋkeke me, tsɔ gakotoku si tše Ironwood na be nàtsɔ ga. Kpɔ Ɣaɣla Ga

title: Zcash ƒe nuɖoɖo ƒe ɖeɖe gbedasiwo
description: Zcash ƒe nuɖoɖo ƒe ɖeɖe gbedasi (ZIP) nye aɖaŋu ƒe agbalẽ si na nyatakaka Zcash ƒe hadome, alo si ɖe ŋutinya yeye aɖe ƒe nɔnɔme fia na Zcash kple eƒe wɔwɔwo…
text: Zcash ƒe nuɖoɖo ƒe ɖeɖe gbedasiwo Nu ka nye ZIP Zcash ƒe nuɖoɖo ƒe ɖeɖe gbedasi (ZIP) nye aɖaŋu ƒe agbalẽ si na nyatakaka Zcash ƒe hadome, alo si ɖe ŋutinya yeye aɖe ƒe nɔnɔme fia na Zcash kple eƒe wɔwɔwo alo eƒe nɔƒe. ZIP la ele be wòana ŋutinya la ƒe teknikal ƒe nyatakaka kpui aɖe kple ta si ta woɖo ŋutinya la. Míedi be ZIPs nanye mɔ vevi si me woaɖo ŋutinya yeyewo ƒe gbedasi, woaƒo hadome la ƒe nyawo nu le nya aɖe ŋu, eye woaŋlɔ aɖaŋu ƒe nyadzɔdzɔwo siwo woɖo le Zcash ŋu. ZIP ƒe Owner(s) (zi geɖe la, eƒe ŋlɔla(s)) wɔnawo nye be woatu gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi le hadome la me eye woaŋlɔ susu siwo wometsɔ ɖo. Elabena woɖea ZIPs ɖe le nyagbalẽwo me le nudzraɖoƒe si me versionwo li, woƒe tɔtrɔ ƒe ŋutinyawo nye ŋutinya la ƒe gbedasi ƒe blema ŋutinyawo. -> zips.z.cash ZIP ƒe Nudzɔla Na ZIP sia sia si va la, ele be wòato dzodzro ƒe mɔnu me. ZIP ƒe nuŋlɔlawo ƒe dɔe nye be woaɖe ŋku le ZIP sia sia ƒe nɔnɔme kple emenyawo ŋu, be wòana nyagblɔɖiwo, susu si ta wòwɔe, kple teŋuŋutinya ƒe tɔtrɔwo ƒe nudzɔdzɔ fia nyuie. ZIP siwo ƒe ŋutinya le vevie fifia Wokpɔ nɔnɔme kple tanya siwo le ete la ɖe ZIP ƒe index le zips.z.cash le 18 August 2026. ZIP ƒe nɔnɔme trɔna le ɣeyiɣi me, eyata wɔ index la abe nyateƒe ƒe dzɔƒe ene. Draft: Nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi ƒe Zcash ƒe tsɔtsɔ kpeɖeŋuwo Draft: Zcash ɣaɣla ƒe assetwo ƒe trɔtrɔ kple dzadzra Draft: Zcash ɣaɣla ƒe assetwo ƒe nana Withdrawn: Woɖe gaɖoɖo ƒe nɔnɔme ƒe version 6 ɖa — ZIP 229 ɖe eƒe teƒe, si fifia gblɔa gaɖoɖo ƒe version 6 ƒe nɔnɔme. Kpɔ NU6.3 ƒe xexlẽ si le ete la. Draft: Gaɖoɖo ƒe dzesi ƒe digestwo kple asidede agbalẽ te ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu na nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi ƒe Zcash ƒe tsɔtsɔ kpeɖeŋuwo Draft: Nya kpui ƒe field ƒe nɔnɔme si woɖo ɖeɖe Draft: Sapling ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ƒe asidede agbalẽ tewo Draft: Nyatakaka si hiã ƒe mɔ ƒe protocol na fexexe ƒe dzedze Draft: Sapling ƒe nukpɔsafuiwo ƒe dedienɔnɔme ƒe nɔnɔmewo Active: Gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ƒe ƒome aɖe ƒe gblɔɖoɖo, si me woate ŋu aɖo ga ɖo le nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo ko me Draft: Gakotoku.dat ƒe nɔnɔme NU6.3 (Ironwood) ƒe ZIPs Woɖe NU6.3 ƒe nyatakaka ɖe ZIP 258 me, kple ZIP bubu siwo woƒe xexlẽ le afisia. Woɖe candidate ƒe ƒuƒo blibo la ɖe ZIP ƒe index dzi. Draft: NU6.3 ƒe mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ ƒe dzeɖoɖo Draft: Gaɖoɖo ƒe version 6 ƒe nɔnɔme Draft: Orchard yi Ironwood ƒe trɔtrɔ Draft: NU6.3 ƒe ƒometɔwo na gakotokuwo Proposed: Ironwood ƒe quantum ƒe agbɔgbɔɖeŋu Reserved: Gaɖoɖowo ƒe dede ɖe Orchard gaƒuƒoƒo me ƒe xexlẽ ZIP etɔ siwo va do ŋgɔ la hã wɔ tɔtrɔ na NU6.3: ZIP 209, ZIP 213 kple ZIP 317.

title: Z3: (zebrad)(zaino)(zingo-cli)
description: zingo-cli : Zcash ƒe command line zaino-proxy client (Zingolib ƒe akpa)
text: Z3: (zebrad)(zaino)(zingo-cli) zebrad : Zcash ƒe ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo [full node] zaino : Zcash gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu [blockchain] ƒe indexer zingo-cli : Zcash ƒe command line zaino-proxy client (Zingolib ƒe akpa) Video Nɔnɔmetata Gã System ƒe ƒoƒoɖoɖo Zcash Wò ƒo alo ɖo Zingolib, si na wò mɔ be wòakpɔ zingo-cli. Wòate ŋu aɖo alo axɔ ZEC ɣe sia ɣe si wòahiã. zingo-cli do ɖe zaino ŋu le teƒe sia me alo to kana dedie me le internet dzi (Zcash wòmehiã be wòanya ale si esia wɔa dɔ o!) Zaino na mɔ be woakpɔ zebrad alo zcashd Ne zebrad wɔ sync blibo la, eyae nye nyateƒe ƒe dzɔƒe (gakotoku [wallet] aɖeke megali afi sia o!) Ɖoɖo Wòahiã be wòaɖo nu 3 be esia nawɔ dɔ nyuie. Meɖe asi le screen alo nu si sɔ kplee ŋu hã be nàkpɔ screenwo dzi nyuie. sudo apt install screen zebrad Dzi be wòadi (wɔ screen session na zebrad) Nudzɔdzɔ: Esia hiã be wòawɔ sync blibo! zaino Dzi be wòadi (wɔ screen session na zaino) zingo-cli Dzi be wòadi (wɔ screen session na zingo-cli) Nudzɔdzɔ: Esia hiã be wòawɔ sync blibo, abe ale si lightwalletd wɔe ene. Meɖe asi le drive le gota ŋu be nàhe gaɣeyiɣi. :) Wɔwɔ Dɔ Ne wòle esiawo wɔm le screen sessions me la, screen -r afia screen sia screen si wòate ŋu ayi ɖo ɣe sia ɣe si woahiã

title: Zenith GUI ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo [full node] gakotoku [wallet] ƒe ɖoɖo
description: src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/zu8nvr4FlXE"
text: Zenith GUI ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo [full node] gakotoku [wallet] ƒe ɖoɖo Video ƒe Nufiafia --- Ɖo Haskell curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://get-ghcup.haskell.org sh Ɖo Rust curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs sh Ɖo Zebra sudo apt install libclang-dev cargo install --git https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra --tag v2.1.0 zebrad zebrad generate -o /.config/zebrad.toml nano /.config/zebrad.toml Lele RPC ƒe biabiawo ŋu le localhost dzi listenaddr = "127.0.0.1:8232" Zã CPU ƒe akpa geɖe le ɣeyiɣi ɖeka me le eɖokui si parallelcputhreads = 0 enablecookieauth = false Ɖo Zenith Wɔ tar.gz ƒe download eye nàtae ɖe wò home directory me wget https://code.vergara.tech/VergaraTech/zenith/archive/0.7.2.0-beta.tar.gz tar -C -xvzf 0.7.2.0-beta.tar.gz cd zenith rmdir zcash-haskell git clone https://code.vergara.tech/VergaraTech/zcash-haskell.git Ɖo Nusiwo Hiã sudo apt install libssl-dev libgmp-dev libsecp256k1-dev libtinfo-dev libsdl2-dev libfreetype-dev libglew-dev gdk-pixbuf-tests raspi-config cargo install cargo-c stack install c2hs mousepad /.bashrc export PATH="/home/zebra5/.local/bin:$PATH" source /.bashrc Trɔ asi le source ŋu na aarch64 nano configure Trɔ triple la ɖe: "aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu" le fli evea siaa dzi. nano Setup.hs Trɔ asi le Setup.hs ŋu le zcash-haskell ƒe folder kple zenith ƒe folder me siaa Ƒo ƒu ./configure cabal build mkdir /Zenith cd /Zenith mkdir assets cp /zenith/dist-newstyle/build/aarch64-linux/ghc-9.6.5/zenith-0.7.2.0/build/zenith/zenith /Zenith cp /zenith/zenith.cfg /Zenith cp -r /zenith/assets /Zenith/assets Trɔ asi le zenith.cfg ŋu nodeUser = yourusername nodePwd = superSecret nodePort = 8234 dbFileName = zenith.db zebraHost = 127.0.0.1 zebraPort = 8232 cd /Zenith Raspi-config download latest gldriver-test sudo dpkg - gldriver-test0.15all.deb sudo raspi-config Yi ɖe advance eye nàtia opengl => GL (Full KMS) Gbugbɔ mɔ Ƒo zenith du ./zenith gui or ./zenith tui or ./zenithserver RPC-wo howto

title: Zero Knowledge kple Decoy ƒe Nɔnɔme Wo
description: "Cryptocurrency ɖe wò ga zãzãwo katã fia amewo be woakpɔ, elabena enye abe Twitter le wò Bank konto ŋu ene eye esia nye nuxaxa gã aɖe si wòle be woaɖɔe to…
text: Zero Knowledge kple Decoy ƒe Nɔnɔme Wo "Cryptocurrency ɖe wò ga zãzãwo katã fia amewo be woakpɔ, elabena enye abe Twitter le wò Bank konto ŋu ene eye esia nye nuxaxa gã aɖe si wòle be woaɖɔe to ɣaɣla [privacy] le ɖoɖonu dzi ƒe wɔwɔ me." - Ian Miers le Devcon4. Crypto dɔwɔwɔ aɖewo nyo ɖe amewo me le woƒe ɣaɣla-centered mɔnuwo ta. Zcash nye nusi wòwɔa Zero Knowledge Proofs (ZK) be wòana gaɖoɖo [transaction] ƒe asɔŋwo kple gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo nanɔ ɣaɣla me. Monero nye nusi dze ŋgɔ le Decoy-based amedzro ƒe ɣaɣlatsɔtsɔ kple ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ [encryption] ƒe mɔnu bubuwo ƒe zãzã me, be wòawɔ be zãlawo ƒe ɣaɣla nanɔ gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu [blockchain] dzi. ZK ƒe Ɖaseɖigbalɛwo kple Decoy ƒe Nɔnɔme Wo Ƒe Gɔmesese Zero Knowledge Proofs nye cryptographic nɔnɔme siwo na ame aɖe (ɖasefiaŋlɔla) ƒe mɔnu be wòaɖe nyateƒe ƒe nyaa ƒe vavã afia ame bubu (kpekpeɖeŋuŋlɔla), ke menye be wòaɖe nyatakaka aɖeke si le nya la ŋutɔ ƒe te afia o. Le Zcash ƒe nɔnɔme me la, wo zãa ZK ƒe ɖaseɖigbalɛ [proof]wo be woakpe ɖe gaɖoɖo ƒe vavã ŋu, menye be woaɖe gaɖoɖo ƒe nyatakaka, abe DƆLILA, XƆLA alo gaɖoɖo ƒe GA ƒe NENEME ene, afia o. Esia nana be zãla ƒe ɣaɣla nanɔ anyi, elabena gaɖoɖo la nɔa ɣaɣla me hã, eye woakpe ɖe eƒe vavã ŋu hã. Woɖo technology sia be wòaɖe gaƒe gaɖoɖowo ƒe ɣaɣla ŋu le Zcash network dzi. Le Decoy-based nɔnɔme siwo le abe RingCT ene la, woaɖea gaɖoɖo geɖe kple wo nɔewo, eyata sesẽ be ame aɖe akpɔ gaƒe ƒe dzeƒe kple afi si wòyi la. Algorithm la tsɔa decoy ƒe geɖewo kple dodoƒewo kpe ɖe gaɖoɖowo ŋu, eye wòzãa gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo si wo zãna abe geɖe ene ƒe ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ, eye wòzãa Range proofs be wòakpe ɖe eŋu be ga si woɖo la ate ŋu akpɔ zãm. Mɔnu sia wɔa gaɖoɖo ƒe mɔ la be menya o. Decoy ƒe geɖewo ƒe zãzã wɔa be wòasesẽ na ame aɖeke si le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu la dzrom be wòanya dɔlila vavã, xɔla, alo gaɖoɖo ƒe ga neneme la. Nya Vevi: Ɖoɖonu dzi ƒe gaɖoɖo si kpɔ ɣaɣla la ƒe mɔnu sia gale fiaa geɖe siwo woɣa ɣi (woŋlɔ ɣa) le zãla katã ƒe gaɖoɖowo me. Metadata abe GAƉOƉOWO ƑE YIYI le zãlawo dome le network la dzi la ate ŋu woaƒo nu ƒu hã. Ne futɔ aɖe le gaɖoɖowo wɔm le network la dzi actively la, ekema wòwɔa be zãla bubuwo ƒe decoy ƒe geɖewo ƒe ame-manyamanya nanɔ anyi o. ZK Ƒe Nyonyo Le Decoy Ƒe Nɔnɔme Wo Ŋu Zcash kple Monero siaa nye cryptocurrency siwo ɖo ta ɖe ɣaɣla ŋu, gake wo katã wɔnɛ to mɔ vovovowo dzi. Nyonyo aɖewo le Zcash ƒe zero-knowledge ƒe ɖaseɖigbalɛwo (ZK) ŋu le Monero ƒe decoy ƒe nɔnɔme ŋu: 1) Nyatakaka Tɔxɛ Ɣaɣla: Kple Zcash ƒe ZK ƒe ŋutinyaƒu la, zãlawo ate ŋu aɖe gaɖoɖo ƒe nyatakakawo afia ame siwo tututu woatia Xlẽ ECC Blog tso Nyatakaka Tɔxɛ Ɣaɣla ŋu. Le Zcash me la, ɣaɣla [shielded] gaɖoɖowo ƒe nu siwo woŋlɔ ɣa la na amewo be woate ŋu aɖe nyatakaka tso gaɖoɖo aɖe me afia ame siwo woatia. Kpe ɖe eŋu la, woate ŋu atsɔ nukpɔsafui [viewing key] ana be wòaɖe gaɖoɖo katã siwo tso ɣaɣla gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi aɖe ŋu la afia. Ŋutinya sia na be woate ŋu awɔ seawo ƒe de dzi kple audit, ke network la ƒe ɣaɣla katã makpɔ fu o. Esi Monero ƒe decoy algorithm (ring signature) kpena ɖe ɣaɣla ŋu hã la, menana nyatakaka tɔxɛ ɣaɣla le mɔ ma ke nu o. 2) Nukpɔkɔ Ƒe Tiaɖoɖo: Zcash na zãlawo be woatia gaɖoɖo siwo nye nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi [transparent] (menye private o) kple ɣaɣla (private) gaɖoɖowo dome. Esia fia be Zcash na zãlawo ablɔɖe be woakpɔ woƒe ga ƒe nyatakaka ɣaɣla me, alo woaɖe eƒe nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi me eye amewo katã nakpɔe, abe gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu bubu geɖe ene, abe ale si woɖe gɔme le Zcash official website. Ɣaɣla si wòle be zãla naɖo tae ɖokuiwɔe sia na ablɔɖe gã kple business/organizational zã nyawo [use case] siwo dze egbe, elabena gaɖoɖo aɖewo hia ɣaɣla sue be amewo nakpɔ woaɖoe, ke bubuwo ƒe nyonyo le ɣaɣla gã me. 3) Ame Manyamanya Ƒe Ƒuƒoƒo: anonymity set si le zero knowledge ƒe ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo [pool]wo me la wɔe tso gaɖoɖo katã siwo va yi ɣeaɖeɣi aɖeke me la. Esia gã wu ɖoɖonu dzi ƒe mɔnu bubu geɖe siwo wɔna be gaɖoɖowo ƒe kadodo manɔ anyi [unlinkable]. Nyaŋlɔɖi: Esia dze gaɖoɖo siwo le ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo ma ke me ko ŋu. Decoywo ƒe zãzã naa

title: Akpa zcashd ɖe Akash to Console dzi
description: Woɖe eƒe dzi. Mègatsɔ mɔfia sia azɔ akpa ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ si nèdi be yeazã o.
text: Akpa zcashd ɖe Akash to Console dzi Woɖe eƒe dzi. Mègatsɔ mɔfia sia azɔ akpa ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ si nèdi be yeazã o. zcashd va ɖo eƒe End-of-Support ƒe tɔtrɔ le July 18, 2026. zcashd ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ si woakpa egbea la masync kple ɖoɖonu ƒe nuwuwu o, eyata akpaɖeɖe la axɔ ga wò le ƒe sia ƒe ƒe dzi eye masɔ nu aɖeke o. Kpɔ Zebra ɖe ete: Aleke nàwɔ Zebra le Akash Network dzi, si ƒe Akash Console ƒe dɔwɔmɔe nye ma ke eye wòhia disk ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia ko. Ne èle akpaɖeɖe si li xoxo dometɔ miaɖe teƒe, kpɔ zcashd ɖo Zebra kple Zallet ƒe miaɖe teƒe mɔfia. Woɖe axa sia ɖe anyi abe zcashd akpaɖeɖe ƒe blema ƒe ŋkɔdzi ene. Mɔfia na zcashd Zcash ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo (Electric Coin Co ƒe dɔwɔwɔ) ƒe akpaɖeɖe kple Akash Console. Video ƒe mɔfia aɖe le ete. Mɔfia si kpɔ nu me tsɔ wu le ete. Nu Si Nèle Akpa Dom zcashd ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo si ana: -> Wòasync Zcash gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu katã (350GB+ na mainnet, 40GB na testnet) -> Wòaxɔ ga abe $15/leɣi ene, le AKT token ƒe asiwo ŋu -> Wòaxɔ gaƒoƒo geɖe va se ɖe ŋkeke geɖe ŋu hafi wòasync blibo -> Wòazã 4 vCPUs, 16GB RAM, 350GB nuɖoƒe (mainnet) alo 2 vCPUs, 8GB RAM, 50GB (testnet) -> Wòatsɔ cryptographic parameters aɖo le zi gbãtɔ si wòawɔ dɔ la ( 2GB, zi ɖeka ko) zcashd kple Zebra: -> zcashd nye Zcash ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ ƒe dɔwɔwɔ gbãtɔ si Electric Coin Co wɔ, si tɔ le July 18, 2026 me -> Zebra, tso Zcash Foundation gbɔ, nye ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo si woɖe le dɔ me egbea -> Zebra ko yɔna ɖoɖonu si li fifia; zcashd ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ mate ŋu aɖo nuwuwu o -> Woɖe zcashd ƒe gakotoku teƒe kple Zallet -> Zã zcashd ne gakotoku ƒe dɔwɔwɔ alo RPC APIs aɖe le wò hia Nuxɔxlɔ̃ ƒe nu: Port ƒe Map wɔwɔ le Akash Ne nèɖe port aɖe fia le Akash (kpɔɖeŋu, port 8233 na zcashd P2P), emeblɔ be wòawɔ bind ɖe port ma tututɛ le provider ƒe public IP dzi o. Le teƒe ma, provider la atsɔ port kɔkɔe aɖe si le dziƒe (abe 31234 alo 42567 ene) ana eye wòawɔ reverse-proxy na wò container ƒe port 8233. Wole esia wɔm kple ta - providers wɔna akpaɖeɖe geɖe, eye ƒomevi akanɔ wo dome ne ame katã di be yeazã port 8233 tẽ. Nu si esia gblɔ na wò: -> Nàɖo port 8233 le SDL me (zcashd ƒe P2P port si woɖo ɖe eŋu) -> Akash ana URI si abe provider.com:31234 ene na wò -> Zcash ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ bubuwo atsɔ wɔnɔ ɖe wò ŋu le provider.com:31234 -> Le wò container me, zcashd gale 8233 ƒoƒo Woɖo esia ɖe eme le eɖokui si. Zã URI si Akash na wò ko. Nu Si Woahiã Hafi -> Keplr Wallet browser ƒe extension si wòɖo (Chrome/Brave/Firefox) -> AKT tokens - Xɔ AKT 50-100 tso gatrɔƒe aɖe gbɔ (Coinbase, Kraken, Osmosis) -> Minuti 5 be nàtsɔ atsi le Console UI me Afɔ 1: Ɖo Wò Gakotoku Ƒo -> Yi ɖe https://console.akash.network -> Zi "Ɖo Gakotoku Ƒo" le dzesiƒe si le gome ɖe mia ƒe dzi -> Tia Keplr (alo Cosmos gakotoku si nèlɔ̃ wu) -> Ɖe mɔ na connection la ne Keplr do goe Wò AKT ƒe balance ana eɖe fia le gome ɖe mia ƒe dzi. Ne e nye zero la, yi nàtsɔ ga ade wò gakotoku me gbã. Afɔ 2: Wɔ Akpaɖeɖe -> Zi "Akpa" button (button blue gã si le axa la ƒe titina) -> Tia "Wɔ wò template" (alo dzo tẽ ɖe SDL ƒe upload me) Mɔ A: Ɖo SDL Fael Ɖe Eme (Si Woɖo Afi) Button sia akpa ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ si tɔ. Wòaxɔ wò AKT balance ƒe ga na ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ si mate ŋu async o. Zã Zebra mɔfia ɖe ete. Mɔ B: Zã SDL ƒe Editor Ne nèdi be yéaɖe SDL la ɖe eme kple asi: -> Ɖe nu siwo katã le zcashd-akash.yml me -> Ɖe ewo ɖe SDL editor la me -> Trɔe ale si wòhiã (kpɔ configuration ƒe akpa si le ete) -> Zi "Wɔ Akpaɖeɖe" Afɔ 3: Kpɔe ɖa Eye Ɖe Mɔ na Deposit Console la afia na wò: -> Akpaɖeɖe ƒe deposit: 5 AKT (nàxɔe atrɔe ne nètu akpaɖeɖe la) -> Ga si woabu be wòaxɔ: Le wò SDL ƒe asiwo ŋu Zi "Ɖe Mɔ" eye nàsign gaɖoɖo la le Keplr me. Afɔ 4: Tia Provider Aɖe Le sekondi 30 vɛ la, nàkpɔ bids tso providers gbɔ. Bid ɖe sia ɖe afia: -> Ga na gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ɖe sia ɖe (le AKT alo USDC me) -> Leɣi ɖeka ƒe ga si woabu -> Provider ƒe nyatakaka (uptime, region, kple bubuwo) Mègatia si me xɔa ga o ko. title: Va ƒo ƒu ɖe Crosslink Feature Net ŋu
description: Wodoe kpɔ kple Feature Net version 14 le Windows 11 (version 10.0.26200.9550) dzi, tso 8 va 10 October 2026. Software la nye dodokpɔnu eye wotrɔe le release…
text: Va ƒo ƒu ɖe Crosslink Feature Net ŋu Nusi Wòle Ve Vie Feature Net nye Shielded Labs ƒe dukɔƒe dodokpɔ network si le ƒe Crosslink, nuwuwu ƒe keke si wotsɔ ga ƒuƒoƒo [staking] kpe ɖe Zcash ƒe dɔwɔ si me wokpɔ ɖaseɖigbalɛ [proof-of-work] ŋu. Eƒe dɔ wɔna kple dodokpɔ ga, cTAZ. Nusi aɖeke si nàwɔ ɖe eŋu mate ŋu aɖe mainnet ZEC yi alo aɖe afɔku ɖe eŋu o. Desktop app ɖeka koe nye ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ [node], nukula [miner], gakotoku [wallet], kple nuwuwu dɔwɔla [finalizer]. Eƒe nukuku [mining] cTAZ le gɔmedzedze me, eye ga suewo nanaƒe [faucet] ƒe button le esi. Ga ƒuƒoƒo, ga ƒe heɖeɖe kple ga ƒe xexlẽ le dɔ wɔm ko le "Staking Day" me, ŋkeke ɖeka le ŋkeke etɔ sia etɔ me. Ne wòɖe eŋu la, nàlala be esia nate ŋu ava. Be nàtsɔ ga ƒo ƒu la, nàtsɔ nuwuwu dɔwɔla ƒe amenyenye nam kple nàdzi ga ƒe kadodo ŋu. Mɔfiame sia zãna ZecHub ƒe nuwuwu dɔwɔla abe kpɔɖeŋu ene. RPC yɔyɔ eve fia afi si nèle: walletstakingpositions kple gettflrecencystatus. Wodoe kpɔ kple Feature Net version 14 le Windows 11 (version 10.0.26200.9550) dzi, tso 8 va 10 October 2026. Software la nye dodokpɔnu eye wotrɔe le release sia release sia me. Ne nusi nèkpɔ to vovo tso axa sia ŋu la, xɔ wò ŋutɔ ƒe dodokpɔ dzi eye mèlekuku ɖe PR ŋu. Nusi Feature Net nye Crosslink nye ɖoɖo, menye akpa si le Zcash me egbe o. Shielded Labs ƒe Crosslink FAQ gblɔ be "ele be wòato dzɔdzɔme ƒe Zcash dziɖuɖu [governance] mɔ nu" hafi wòate ŋu ava mainnet dzi. Crosslink Protocol axa la ɖe ɖoɖo la ƒe nɔnɔ fia. Be woado ɖoɖo la kpɔ kple amewo la, Shielded Labs wɔa nusi woyɔna be incentivized feature nets: "incentivized testnets ƒe xexlẽ". Dɔwɔla ƒome etɔ le network la dzi, eye desktop app la ate ŋu awɔ wo katã ƒe dɔ: Dɔwɔla ƒome Nusi wòwɔna --- --- Nukula Wɔa proof-of-work gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe [blocks], abe ale si wòle Zcash dzi egbe ene Staker Ƒo cTAZ ɖe delegation ga si wode ɖe asi [bond] me eye tsoa eŋu ɖe nuwuwu dɔwɔla ŋu Nuwuwu dɔwɔla Ɖoa akɔ be woana gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe nuwuwu. Eƒe akɔ ƒe ŋusẽ nye ga si wode ɖe asi si wotsɔ de asi nɛ Repository si le emegbe la dze egɔme kple nyagblɔɖi si le vevie be nàxlẽ hafi nàɖo nu aɖeke: eɖe be "ele afi sia be wòaɖe susuwo ƒe nyateƒe fia, menye be wòafia production engineering o" eye "menye code si woate ŋu azã le production me o" (README). Zãe ɖe mɔ̃ si dzi esia nye nu si wòate ŋu axɔ. Nusi version 14 trɔ Version 14 do go le 1 October 2026. Eƒe network dze egɔme abe proof-of-work koe ene eye wòtsɔ Crosslink va le afɔ etɔ me (source, woɖee fia hã le ctaz.cash): Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe Nusi dzɔna --- --- 20,736 Ga ƒuƒoƒo ƒe mɔ ʋu 34,560 Wotsɔ ga si wode ɖe asi le ɖoɖonu [on-chain] dzi wɔa nuwuwu dɔwɔlawo ƒe xexlẽ gbãtɔ 36,288 BFT nuwuwu dze egɔme, eye ga ƒuƒoƒo ƒe fetu hã dze egɔme Ga ƒuƒoƒo ƒe fetuwo dze egɔme le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe mamlɛtɔ la dzi. Ga si wode ɖe asi si wowɔ tsã la mexɔ naneke va se ɖe esime o (source). Release ma ke la tsɔ nuwuwu dɔwɔlawo si ga geɖe wu le wo ƒe asi gbɔ keke 12 (source), eye abe ale si woŋlɔ le eƒe release notes me ene, wona commission na wo: "PoS Rewards katã ƒe 10% si le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe aɖe me yi commissions siawo gbɔ, eye 90% yi ga si wode ɖe asi si le ga ƒuƒoƒo me katã gbɔ". cTAZ kple ZEC vavã cTAZ ("Crosslink TAZ") nye Feature Net ƒe dodokpɔ ga. Nàtsɔ cTAZ ƒo ga ƒu, menye ZEC o. ZEC vavã va le nuwuwu ko. Shielded Labs de 500 ZEC ɖe aga na feature nets la, eye release notes gblɔ be wonaa e "le amesiame ƒe akpa nu, le cTAZ si participant sia participant sia xɔ to nukuku alo ga ƒuƒoƒo me ko nu". Nu eve va tso eme: Ga suewo nanaƒe ƒe ga mekɔ o. cTAZ si wona wò, tso ga suewo nanaƒe alo amesi bubu gbɔ, mexɔ naneke esi wòle wò gakotoku me o. Ga si wòxɔ tso nukuku kple ga ƒuƒoƒo ƒe fetu ko wɔnɛ. Wole fetuwo bia, menye be wova wɔnɛ le woŋutɔ o. Shielded Labs gblɔa round sia round sia le forum thread me. Le Round 2 me la, wobia be participants natsɔ wo gakotoku ƒe nukpɔsafui [viewing key] kple mainnet gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi [address] na wo hafi 4 October 2026 (post 94). title: Livestreaming on Free2Z
description: Míado go, alekee? ZecHub wɔa dɔ nyuie ŋutɔ ne wòle wikiwo ƒe nya me. Egbe la, míele dzidzɔ ŋutɔ be míama nyɔnu yeye aɖewo tso Free2Z ƒe platform la ŋu na wò…
text: Livestreaming on Free2Z Míado go, alekee? ZecHub wɔa dɔ nyuie ŋutɔ ne wòle wikiwo ƒe nya me. Egbe la, míele dzidzɔ ŋutɔ be míama nyɔnu yeye aɖewo tso Free2Z ƒe platform la ŋu na wò. Ne mèse nya tsoe kpɔ o la, mɔfiafia sia ana nàse platform la kple ale si wòwɔa dɔe gɔme. Nu kae nye Free2Z? Free2Z do go abe ɣaɣla [privacy] ƒe nɔnɔme si wotu be wòana ŋusẽ nusiwo wogbɔna be woafia woƒe emetsonu na xexeame katã eye woaxɔ kpekpeɖeŋuwo kple Zcash, ga si le dzesi be eƒe ɣaɣla ƒe nɔnɔmewo menye abe bubuawo ene o. Aleke mawɔ akpɔ Community la ƒe xɔa me? Gbãtɔ la, wɔ akawunt le woƒe nyatakakadzraɖoƒe https://free2z.cash. dzi. Di ge ɖe login ƒe dzesi la le axa ƒe dzesiƒe gome le page la ƒe dziƒe. Ɖo wòƒe nyatakakawo ɖe eme. Àte ŋu awɔ akawunt kple wò email gaɖoƒe alo X ƒe akawunt hã. Míele kafuwòm ŋutɔ be èzu community la ƒe akpa! Fifia yae nye ɣeyiɣi be nàwɔ wòƒe profile la ɖe wò ŋutɔ ƒe nɔnɔme nu, to avatar, banner, kple nya si fia ame si nènye kple dɔ si nèwɔa ƒe dɔwɔwɔ me. Kpɔ be nàtsɔ wòƒe Zcash gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi aɖe ɖe gakotoku ƒe afi si nye na kpekpeɖeŋuwo kple tips tso wòƒe alɔ̃lawo gbɔ. NU SIWO WÒATE ŊU AWƆ ZPages: ZPages na nusiwo wogbɔna mɔ be woama woƒe nuŋɔŋlɔwo na community gã aɖe. Nu si na nuŋɔŋlɔ le platform sia dzi nɔa dzidzɔe ŋutɔ enye be wòƒe ametsitsia ate ŋu akpe ɖe wòƒe dɔ ŋu to kpekpeɖeŋuwo me, si nye mɔ nyui aɖe be woafia woƒe akpedada. Nànya 2Zs gɔme Esiae nye point siwo ƒe asi le $0.01 le platform la dzi. Kple 2Zs, ameawo ate ŋu akpe ɖe woƒe nusiwo wòlɔ̃ wu ŋu to kpekpeɖeŋuwo kple subscriptionwo me. Woate ŋu hã akpɔ gome le community la ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo me abe vote, nyaɖoɖo le ZPages dzi, emetsonu ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu, kple livestream ƒe nɔnɔmewo ene. To kpekpeɖeŋuwo, subscriptionwo, kple live stream si womefia ƒe nu o hafi wòaxe ga la me la, àte ŋu axɔ 2Zs. Àte ŋu hã aƒle point aɖewo kple ZEC to wò QR code la ƒe scan ɖeko me. Aleke Nàdze Livestream Gɔme Zi wòƒe profile ƒe icon dzi, eye dropdown ƒe list aɖe ava do go. Tia "Stream" eye ele be nàkpɔ livestream ƒe tiatia ene. Tia ɖeko esi dze wòƒe hiahiãwo nyuie eye nàzi start stream ƒe button la dzi. Ɖe mɔ na Free2Z be wòazã wòƒe camera kple microphone. Free2Z bia tso asiwò be nàŋlɔ nickname si nèlɔ̃ be nàzã le live stream la me. Emegbe la, zi Join ƒe button la dzi be nàdze live stream la gɔme. Wòƒe subscribers ate ŋu akpɔ live stream la ƒe xɔa me. Àte ŋu akɔpi live stream la ƒe URL tso wòƒe browser me eye nàmae na xɔlɔ̃wo be woakpɔe ƒe xɔa me. https://free2z.cash/Cjfrankie/broadcast Private Beta Tiatia sia ƒo ƒe laylayla be wòana end-to-end ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ [encryption], kuxiwo siwo menye ame bubu ƒe nyawo o, kple kuxi ƒe link tɔxɛ aɖe si woate ŋu aɖo ɖe eme na ame siwo woaxe wɔnɛ. Nu ka bubu nàte ŋu axɔ tso livestream me? Free2Z livestream na viɖe tɔxɛ aɖewo, abe polls na nyametrɔtrɔ kple plugins abe document ƒe mama kple whiteboard ene, siwo dze presentations, screen ƒe mama, chatwo, kple nu bubu geɖe ŋutɔ! Esiae nye ale si livestream ƒe session aɖe nɔna le Free2Z dzi

title: Ledger Ɣaɣla [Shielded] ZEC Zãla ƒe Mɔfia
description: Lé, xɔ eye dɔ ɣaɣla (ɣaɣla) ZEC kple wò Ledger asikplɔwo dzra mɔ le Ledger Wallet Desktop me.
text: Ledger Ɣaɣla [Shielded] ZEC Zãla ƒe Mɔfia Lé, xɔ eye dɔ ɣaɣla (ɣaɣla) ZEC kple wò Ledger asikplɔwo dzra mɔ le Ledger Wallet Desktop me. Nu si le eme kpuie Ɣe 23 September 2026 dzi, Ledger Wallet Desktop doa alɔ ɣaɣla [shielded] ZEC. Zcash account ɖeka si ƒe nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi [transparent] balance kple asitsotso ƒe balance le Ironwood gaƒuƒoƒo me. Desktop ko wozã fifia. Woɖe gbe be mobile ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu "va kpɔe tso ɣeyiɣi kpui me". Ele be wòanye kple Nano S Plus, Nano X, Stax alo Flex (menye Nano S gbedoxɔtɔ la o), Ledger Wallet Desktop 4.21+ kple Zcash app yeyetɔ. Zi Ɖo ɣaɣla dzi [Enable shielded] zi ɖeka: wò Ledger doa nukpɔsafui [viewing key] ɖe go ale be desktop app la nakpɔ wò asitsotsowo. Gazazãsafui [spending key]wo medoa mɔkeke la dzi kpɔ o. Xɔe ɖe asitsotso ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi (u1...) dzi ne wòate ŋu. Ɖe ZEC tso wò nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi balance me yi asitsotso me la ate ŋu awɔ dɔ, gake ekɔ ɖe eveawo. Woate ŋu akpɔ gaɖoɖo ɖe sia ɖe dzi eye woaɖe asi ɖe eŋu le Ledger screen dzi. Kpɔ gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo ɖe afi ma, agbalẽ ƒe dzesi ɖe sia ɖe. Gɔmeɖeɖe Vevi [Core Explanation] Zcash ƒe balance ƒomevi eve le. Nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi [transparent] ZEC (t1 gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo) wɔa dɔ abe Bitcoin ene: Ga ƒe home kple gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo le dukɔ ƒe ŋkume. Ɣaɣla [shielded] ZEC nɔa ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo [pool] me, afi si ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ [encryption] le ame si dɔe, ame si xɔe kple ga ƒe home la dzi ɖoɖonu dzi [on-chain]. Ledger dzra wò gazazãsafuiwo ɖe asikplɔ dzi. Be nàfia ɣaɣla balance, Ledger Wallet Desktop hia Unified Full Viewing Key (UFVK). Asikplɔ la ɖe e go zi ɖeka, eye desktop app la tsɔe le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu la me di wò ɣaɣla didienuwo. Nukpɔsafui [viewing key] ate ŋu akpɔ wò ɣaɣla ŋutinya, gake mate ŋu azã ga o, eyata nàbu e be enye nya si wòle ŋutɔ. Afɔku siwo gbɔna la ƒe nuye nye be wòaɖo Zcash app la, nàtsɔ account aɖe akpe ɖe eŋu, nàna ɣaɣla [private] balance la nadɔ, nàxɔ ga, nàɣaɣla nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi ZEC eye nàdo ga tso ɣaɣla balance la me. Nukpɔkpɔ gbogblo Le September 23, 2026 la, Ledger tsɔ ɣaɣla ZEC si wòle eŋutɔ me kpe ɖe Ledger Wallet Desktop ŋu. Azɔ Zcash ƒe akɔnt ta ɖeka me le nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi ƒe balance kple ame ŋutɔ ƒe balance le Zcash ƒe Ironwood gaƒuƒoƒo [pool] me. Wò ame ŋutɔ ƒe sarɔ̃wo nɔ anyi le wò Ledger dzi, eye woɖea gaɖoɖo [transaction] ɖe asi, dea kpɔe, eye wɔnɔa dzesi le mɔkeke la dzi. Desktop koe. Ledger ƒe gbeɖeɖe gblɔ be ɣaɣla ZEC "le ŋuɖoɖo na Ledger Wallet Desktop koe. Mobile ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu mele o le ɣeyiɣi sia me, gake edzɔna kpɔ." Desktop app la hã fia nyatakaka ma. Woɖe kpɔ le October 15, 2026. Dzadzraɖo Ledger mɔkeke si wɔa Zcash app la: Nano S Plus, Nano X, Stax alo Flex. Zcash app yeyetɔ la womede ɖe Nano S gbedoxɔtɔ la ta o. Ledger Wallet Desktop 4.21 alo esia wu, si wòkplɔ tso ledger.com ko. Mɔfia sia zã version 4.24.0. Zcash app yeyetɔ le wò Ledger dzi (3.9.4 le ɣeyiɣi si woŋlɔ mɔfia sia). ZEC sue aɖe si wòatsɔ ado akpɔe. Woɖe afɔ siwo katã le ete la wɔ le mainnet dzi kple 0.001 ZEC. Gaɖoɖo ɖe sia ɖe xɔ network ƒe adzɔ [fee] sue aɖe (0.00015 ZEC le míaƒe dodokpɔ me). Wò nya 24 si tsɔa ŋkuɖoɖo gbɔ la nɔ anyi le agbalẽ dzi. Mègblɔe na komputer alo mẹmae na ame aɖeke o. Afɔ le Afɔ ƒe Mɔfia (Ledger Wallet Desktop) 1. Ðo alo le Zcash app la ɖe yeyetɔ me Ʋu Ledger Wallet, tsɔ wò Ledger kpe ɖe eŋu eye nàʋu eƒe mɔ, eye nàʋu My Ledger. Na mɔkeke la naɖo kpeɖeŋu la dzi. Di Zcash le app ƒe agbalẽ me, eye nàzi Install, alo Update ne woɖoe xoxo. Ʋu Zcash app la le wò Ledger dzi. Screen la gblɔ be "Zcash app la le dzadzraɖo". Yi ɖe mia me va App info be nàkpɔ version la. 2. Kpe Zcash akɔnt aɖe ɖe eŋu Le Ledger Wallet me la, tia Add account. Le Select asset me la, di Zcash eye nàtia Zcash (ZEC), menye token si woɖe kuɖe eŋu abe Binance-Peg Zcash Token ene o. Ne Zcash app la le ʋuʋu me le wò Ledger dzi la, Ledger Wallet afɔ wò akɔnt. De dzesi le eŋu le Select the accounts you want to add te, eye nàzi Confirm. Akɔnt ƒe axa la fia Available balance, Transparent balance, kple Private balance, kpe ɖe Enable shielded ƒe button aɖe ŋu. 3.

title: Ɖeɖe mɔfia: Tso zcashd yi Zebrad/Zallet
description: Nusi wɔna tsã zcashd ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo [full node], si Electric Coin Company (ECC) / Zodl kpɔa dzi la, Zebra kple Zallet wɔ ɖe eteƒe. zcashd ƒe…
text: Ɖeɖe mɔfia: Tso zcashd yi Zebrad/Zallet Nusi wɔna tsã zcashd ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo [full node], si Electric Coin Company (ECC) / Zodl kpɔa dzi la, Zebra kple Zallet wɔ ɖe eteƒe. zcashd ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe nuwuwu va 18 July 2026, eye wòmegale dɔ wɔm o. Zebra nye Rust ƒe ɖeɖeɖoɖo yeye si wɔ Zcash ƒe mɔɖoɖo, si Zcash Foundation wɔ Zallet nye gakotoku [wallet] fafã si wotu be wòawɔ dɔ kple Zebra ƒe ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔwo hãlii, si Zodl wɔ Mɔfia sia akplɔ wò to ɖeɖe tso zcashd yi Zebrad kple Zallet me, eye wòaxɔ ɖoɖo, gakotoku ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu, kple ɖeɖe na ɖeɖe ƒe kuxi siwo dzɔna zi geɖe. --- zcashd tɔ dɔwɔwɔ le 18 July 2026 Nusi esia fia zcashd ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe nuwuwu va le 18 July 2026. Wòmagale asɔ ɖo ɖoɖonu [chain] ƒe dzogbe o, eye wòmate ŋu aɖo ga alo axɔ ga o. Esia wu vavã, menye nu si wole ɖoɖom be woawɔ o. zcashd ƒe dɔ eve la mama ƒe te: zebrad nye ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo, eye Zallet nye gakotoku. Zallet le beta me. Tso ɖeɖe aɖe me yi bubu me la, tɔtrɔ siwo gbãa nu ate ŋu ava, eye zcashd ƒe JSON-RPC mɔnu aɖewo mede bɔ o haɖe. Kpɔ mɔnu ƒe nɔnɔ ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe kɔkɔe hafi nàtsɔ yɔyɔ aɖe si tututu na wò. Ne Sprout ƒe ga le asiwo haɖe la, xlẽ nyagblɔɖi si le afɔ 6 me gbã. Zallet mekplɔa Sprout gaƒuƒoƒo [pool] o, eye mɔ si woɖua zi geɖe be woatsɔ ga mawo ayi la bia be zcashd nanɔ dɔ wɔm. Nu ka ta wòawɔ ɖeɖe - Le Ɖeɖeɖeƒeƒe wu Ne míede ɖeɖeɖeƒeƒe ɖa la gɔ̃ hã, tata siwo sesẽ le eŋu be wòatso ayi: Dedie Kple Sesẽ: Rust ƒe ŋkuɖododze ɖe memory dedie kple dɔwɔnu yeye woaɖe afɔ le kuxi ƒe mɔwo ŋu. Wɔwɔ Nyui Kple Dzedze: Woɖo Zebrad ɖeɖeɖe be wòawɔ dɔ geɖe ɖe ƒeɖeɖe me, wòatsɔ nu siwo le asi nɛ awɔ dɔ nyuie, eye wòawɔ sync kabakaba. Ɖoɖoƒe Ƒe Nɔnɔ Ƒe Mama: Ɖeɖe ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ ƒe dɔ (Zebrad) tso gakotoku ƒe UI (Zallet) gbɔ na dzidzime ƒe towo kɔ nyuie eye wòana mɔ nyuie na ɖeɖe. Mɔ Si Ɖo Kple Ecosystem Ƒe Mawuɖoɖo: Dɔwɔnu, nyonyo, kple Zcash ƒe ecosystem ƒe akpa bubuwo aɖe ŋku ɖe Zebrad/Zallet ŋu geɖe. Dziɖoɖo: Mègaxɔ mɔ be nàle component si woɖe ɖa eye womakplɔa dzi o ƒe dɔwɔwɔ me o. Azɔ míayi ɖe Ɖeɖe mɔfia me 1. Wɔ backup na nu sia nu Wɔ backup na wò wallet.dat (alo gakotoku ƒe faɛl bubu aɖe / safui ƒe nudzraɖoƒe) tso wò zcashd ƒe ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ me. Dzra wò zcash.conf kple ɖoɖo siwo nèwɔ ɖe wò ŋutɔ ŋu ɖo. Ɖe RPC script alo automation si nètsɔna ƒe kopi aɖe ɖa. Kpɔ be wò backupwo le nyuie (kpɔe le nɔnɔ bubu aɖe me, abe be nàte ŋu aʋu alo akpɔ wo me ene). Kpɔ JSON-RPC mɔnu siwo nèle tsɔm fifia. Sɔ kple mɔɖoɖo ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu si Zcash ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe asiti dzra ɖo Dzra ɖo na tɔtrɔwo alo mɔnu siwo mele o (aɖewo ate ŋu ahia mɔ bubu alo trɔtrɔ). 2. System ƒe Hiãhiãwo Kple Disk Ƒe Teƒe Disk ƒe teƒe nye hiãhiã si amewo mekɔna ɖe eŋu o. Zcash ƒe ɖoɖonu va le 270 GB wu le August 2026 me, eyata na teƒe blibo 300 GB le asiwo, le SSD dzi ne nàte ŋu. Kpɔ be network, CPU, kple RAM si le wò mɔkeke dzi la le sesĩe. Internet ƒe kadodo aɖe Ne èɖo ɖe edzi be yòawɔ compilation tso source me la, na Rust kple Cargo nanɔ asiwo. 3. Ɖo / Ɖoɖo Zebrad Àte ŋu aɖe binary si woɖo ɖo xoxo alo nawɔe tso source me. Zcash Foundation dea releases kple binaries ɖe go na Zebra. Abe kpɔɖeŋu ene la, àte ŋu atsɔ install script alo aɖe binary si dze wò OS ŋu. Ɖo ŋku edzi be le Zebra ƒe versions yeyewo me la, RPC endpoint la mele enabled le Docker me le gɔmedzedze o. Mɔ A: Ɖo to binary si woɖo ɖo xoxo me Le Linux/macOS dzi: Esia doa zebrad ƒe version sesẽ si yeyee ɖe mɔ. Mɔ B: Wɔe tso source me Le wɔwɔ megbe la, tsɔ binary la de wò path me: 4. Ɖoɖo Kple Dɔ Ƒe Gɔmedzedze Wɔ config si le gɔmedzedze ɖe mɔ: Trɔ zebrad.toml ɖe wò dɔmenyui nu (mɔ si wòasẽ to, ports, state ƒe teƒe, caching). Dze ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ la gɔme: Ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ la adze sync wɔwɔ gɔme tso genesis me - eƒe wɔwɔ ate ŋu axɔ gaƒoƒo geɖe (alo wu nenema) le hardware kple network nu. 5. Ɖo / Ɖoɖo Zallet (Gakotoku) Zallet wotu be wòaxɔ zcashd ƒe gakotoku ƒe akpa ƒe teƒe. Kpɔ Zallet ƒe GitHub / release axa na binaries. Alo wɔe tso source me: Dze GUI alo CLI gɔme (abe ale si wò ƒe ɖoɖo na wɔm ene). Ɖoɖoe be wòakado

title: Nukuku [Mining] kple ga ƒuƒoƒo [staking] ƒe ɣaɣla [privacy]
description: Wò nukula [miner] ƒe fetu xɔxɔ kple wò nuwuwu dɔwɔla [finalizer] menye nu ma ke o. Ɖoɖonu [chain] la meɖea wo dome kpɔ o.
text: Nukuku [Mining] kple ga ƒuƒoƒo [staking] ƒe ɣaɣla [privacy] Wò nukula [miner] ƒe fetu xɔxɔ kple wò nuwuwu dɔwɔla [finalizer] menye nu ma ke o. Ɖoɖonu [chain] la meɖea wo dome kpɔ o. Nukula Nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi [Transparent] fetu xɔxɔ Coinbase ƒoa fetu na Zcash gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi [address]. T-gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ƒe ŋutinya le dukɔme. Nuwuwu dɔwɔla zfinv1 kɔkɔe E nye ed25519 kɔkɔe. Etsɔa asi ɖe akɔmeɖeɖewo ŋu. Menye Zcash gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi o. Ga si wode ɖe asi Ɣaɣla [Shielded] ga ƒuƒoƒo Ele ga ƒuƒoƒo ƒe gaƒuƒoƒo [pool] me. Eɖoa dzesi nuwuwu dɔwɔla si woɖo taɖodzinu na. Ɖoɖo si le vevie 1 Ɖe nukuku → 2 Ɖe ɣaɣla → 3 Ɖe ga ɖe asi Ne nèle ɣaɣla ƒe afɔ la tsoe la, dɔ si le ɣaɣla me va eme o. Ga si wode ɖe asi meɖea nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi coinbase ɖa o. Nu si le dukɔme Nu Le dukɔme? Nu ka ta --- --- --- Nukula ƒe t-gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi kple coinbase ƒe ŋutinya Ẽ Nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi ƒe output wɔnɔa gbɔgbɔ Nuwuwu dɔwɔla ƒe kɔkɔe kple zfinv1 Ẽ, ne wotsɔe de xexlẽme ko Ele be wòanɔ ale, be woate ŋu ada akɔmeɖeɖewo ƒe nyateƒe Akɔmeɖeɖe ƒe ŋusẽ kple fetu ƒe bank Ẽ Woaɖe eƒe nyatakakawo fia le nuwuwu dɔwɔla ƒe kɔkɔe ŋu, be woate ŋu akpɔ ga ƒuƒoƒo ƒe mamã kpɔ Nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi si tso ga si wode ɖe asi me Ao, le ɣaɣla megbe Ga si wode ɖe asi la zaa ɣaɣla didienuwo [notes] Kadodo tso wò nukula gbɔ yi wò nuwuwu dɔwɔla gbɔ Menye ɖoɖonu dzi o Naneke mele protocol la me si ŋlɔa esia o Wofia ga si woƒu ƒo ɖe asi la ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ ta. Moɖoɖo la hiã be ame sia ame nate ŋu akpɔ ga si woƒu ƒo ɖe asi katã kple mamã si le nuwuwu dɔwɔlawo dome. Quantization (10 ƒe ŋusẽwo) kple ga ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɣeyiɣi si woɖo ɖe anyi la dea alɔ ɖe alesi ame ƒe ɣeyiɣi alo nɔnɔme ƒe nyatakaka geɖe adzudzɔ le eme ŋu, ke hã wɔa be wòate ŋu awɔ kpɔkpɔ ma. Orchard ƒe balance si mewoƒu ƒo ɖe asi o la nɔa ɣaɣla me; ga ƒuƒoƒo nye nyatakaka fiafia si woɖo taɖodzinu na. Ɖe ga ɖe asi na ɖokuiwò, alo na ame bubu Ɖe ga ɖe asi na wò ŋutɔ ƒe nuwuwu dɔwɔla Eyae le bɔbɔe wu. Nèle dɔwɔla ƒe nɔƒe kple ga si wode ɖe asi la ɖe asi. Kpɔla aɖeke mate ŋu aɖe kpeɖeŋu be t-gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi kple zfinv1 nye ame ɖeka tɔ tso ɖoɖonu ƒe nyatakakawo ko me o. Ɖe ga ɖe asi na hata ƒe ame bubu Akɔmeɖeɖe ƒe ŋusẽ aɖe eɖokui fia le woƒe kɔkɔe te. Woxɔa 10% active-finalizer commission. Èle 90% si ƒoa nu le ga si wode ɖe asi la ŋu. Esia tsena ɖe ame ƒe susu ɖa be nukula si xɔa nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi fetu la nye ame ma ke si wɔa nuwuwu dɔwɔla ƒe dɔ la. Hata aɖe ate ŋu awɔ nukuku le fetu xɔxɔ ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi vovovowo dzi, aɖe wo ɖe ɣaɣla me, eye wòaɖe ga ɖe asi le hata ƒe amewo dome. Esia wɔa be nya sia be "nukula sia nye nuwuwu dɔwɔla sia" nana wòsesẽ be ame aɖe aɖe kpeɖeŋu tso ɖoɖonu ƒe nyatakakawo me. Menye nuwuwu dɔwɔlawo ƒe ameame wɔa ɣaɣla o, eye menye nukuku hã wɔa ɣaɣla o. Nu si esia mewɔ o Mewoa ɣaɣla o Ame siwo nye nuwuwu dɔwɔlawo Akɔmeɖeɖe ƒe ŋusẽ si ame sia ame si le Wò nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi nukuku ƒe ŋutinya Kadodo si nèwɔ le ɖoɖonu me o: IP ɖeka, fetu xɔxɔ ƒe nɔnɔme ɖeka, dɔwɔla ɖeka zfinv1 si woɖo taɖodzinu na la le ga ƒuƒoƒo ƒe nufiafia la me. Ɣaɣla le afisia nye gaawo ƒe tete gbɔ, menye be woaɣla taɖodzinu ƒe kɔkɔe o. Nya kpui aɖe Wɔ nukuku. Ɖe ɣaɣla. Emegbe la, ɖe ga ɖe asi. Nukula ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi kple nuwuwu dɔwɔla ƒe kɔkɔe manya wo nɔewo o, negbe wò ŋutɔ nàtsɔ wo akɔ ɖe nɔewo ŋu.

title: Nye Zcash Dɔwɔwɔ Agbalẽ Gbãtɔ
description: Nye Zcash Dɔwɔwɔ Agbalẽ Gbãtɔ nye nusɔsrɔ̃ ƒe dɔwɔwɔ agbalẽ si wo wɔ be wòakpe ɖe nusɔsrɔ̃la yeyeawo, vevietɔ ɖe ɖeviwo kple ame siwo gblɔ crypto me va yi o la…
text: Nye Zcash Dɔwɔwɔ Agbalẽ Gbãtɔ --- Gɔmedzedze Nye Zcash Dɔwɔwɔ Agbalẽ Gbãtɔ nye nusɔsrɔ̃ ƒe dɔwɔwɔ agbalẽ si wo wɔ be wòakpe ɖe nusɔsrɔ̃la yeyeawo, vevietɔ ɖe ɖeviwo kple ame siwo gblɔ crypto me va yi o la ŋu, be woase Zcash, ga ƒe ɣaɣla [financial privacy], digital ga, kple ɖoɖo siwo le teknɔlɔdzi la megbe ƒe gɔme. Ame siwo tso Zcash ƒe xexeme katã ƒe haxɔsetɔ ƒe hatsotso me, eye wo le dzidzɔ me na dɔa, wɔe; wo ƒo software ƒe mɔ̃ɖoɖo, aɖaŋunana, numekpɔkpɔ, nusɔsrɔ̃, kple ɣaɣla ƒe ɖeɖefia ƒu. Mɔfia sia ƒe dɔe nye be yeana dɔwɔwɔ agbalẽ la ƒe nusɔsrɔ̃ ƒe mɔ veviwo ƒe kpɔɖeŋu, si wo mae ƒe akpa gã asieke. Menye agbalẽ la ŋutɔ ƒe teƒeɖola o, ke boŋ enye kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ si ƒo nusɔsrɔ̃ ƒe mɔ la nu, eye wòfia nyatakaka vevi na nufiala, nusrɔ̃la, kple haxɔsetɔ ƒe nufialawo. Wòate ŋu awɔ dɔwɔwɔ agbalẽ la ƒe PDF ƒe download bliboa: Taɖodzinuŋlɔ GitHub Repo --- Nu kae nye Zcash? Akpa gbãtɔ sia ɖo ame si xlẽe la ɖe digital ga ƒe gɔme kple nu si ta ɣaɣla [privacy] le vevie le digital hamea me egbea ŋu. Etsɔa ga ƒe ɖoɖo blemawo sɔa kple nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu [blockchains], eye wòfia be ga ƒe nyawo ƒe agbale gã siwo katã ate ŋu akpɔ la doa ezãla ƒe nudzɔdzɔwo fiana zi geɖe. Wo ɖe Zcash fia abe digital ga si dea ɣaɣla te la ene, si na ezãlawo ate ŋu awɔ gaɖoɖo [transaction] dedie, eye womefia wo ƒe ameŋutilawo ƒe ga nyawo o. Dɔwɔwɔ agbalẽ la ɖe fia be ɣaɣla menye nu vɔ̃ ƒe ɣlaɣla o, ke boŋ enye ame mamlɛawo ƒe dzadzra tso fifi le ame ƒe ŋkume, ŋkuɖodzinu, kple nyatakaka ƒe zazã vɔ̃ ŋu. Wo kplɔa nusrɔ̃lawo to kpɔɖeŋu bɔbɔewo me be woakpɔ ale si wɔ Zcash be wòana amewo nakpɔ wɔnawo ƒe ga ƒe agbenɔnɔ dzi kpɔkpɔ vavã, kple ale si gaɖoɖo [transactions] mamlɛawo fiana ameŋuti nyatakaka geɖe wu ale si míebu la. --- Ame Kae Wɔ Zcash, Eye Nu Ka Ta Wònɔ Anyi? Akpa sia gblɔ Zcash ƒe gɔmedzedze ƒe nya to science ƒe numekpɔkpɔ kple kriptografi ƒe ŋku me. Eɖo zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛ [proofs], vevietɔ "zk-SNARKs", fia abe teknɔlɔdzi yeye si wɔe be ɣaɣla gaɖoɖo [transactions] nate ŋu ava enyɔ la ene. Dɔwɔwɔ agbalẽ la gblɔ Zcash ƒe dzeɖeɖe ƒe xexlẽme, eƒe gɔmeɖoɖo gbãtɔwo, kple xexeme katã ƒe haxɔsetɔ si le ɖoɖoa dzɔm eye wòle kpekpeɖeŋu nam egbea la ƒe nya hã. Wo ɖo dɔmefia la ɖe ame sia ame ƒe ŋusẽɖeɖe, digital ga si ƒe mɔ womate ŋu atsi o ƒe mɔɖeɖe, kple ɣaɣla ƒe teknɔlɔdzi ƒe nyagãɖe yi ame sia ame gbɔ ŋu. --- Ale Si Zcash Wɔa Dɔ Akpa sia ma Zcash protocol la ƒe tekniki ƒe gɔmeɖoɖowo me kple gbe bɔbɔe si amewo ate ŋu ase. Nya veviwoe nye: Nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi kple ɣaɣla gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo Nukpɔsafuiwo kple nyatakaka ƒe fiafia si wòate ŋu akpɔ dzi Nukulawo/nyatakaka ƒe asedzilawo ƒe dɔ Ale si zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛwo dea gaɖoɖo [transactions] ƒe nyateƒe fia Ale si wodea ɣaɣla te, esi wòle be network la nanɔ ha nuɖo agni eye wòanɔ dedie hã Nɔnɔmetatawo kple nukpɔkpɔ ƒe kpɔɖeŋuwo le dɔwɔwɔ agbalẽ la me be woana nya siawo nanɔ bɔbɔe na amesiwo le gɔmedzedze me. --- Zcash Ƒe Zazã Le Gbegbe Agbe Me Akpa ene lia ŋku ɖe zazã ƒe kpɔɖeŋu vavãwo ŋu. Eɖea fia ale si ame aɖe ate ŋu azɔ Zcash azɔa mobile gakotoku [wallets] me, ale si QR codewo wɔa fexexe [payments] bɔbɔe, kple ale si ezãlawo zãa ɣaɣla gaɖoɖo [transactions] na wo ŋutɔ ƒe dzadzra, asi ƒe nyatakaka ƒe ɣlaɣla, alo dukɔwo dome gaɖeɖe. Kpɔɖeŋuwo fia nɔnɔme vavãwo, abe ga na haƒoƒola, ga ɖeɖe na ƒometɔwo siwo le dukɔ bubu me, NGO ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu le ɣlaɣla me, alo Zcash ƒe zazã abe ɖevi ƒe digital ga si nye eya tɔ ko ene. --- Tutu Kple Zcash Akpa sia fia ale si mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlawo [developers], aɖaŋunala, numekpɔlawo, kple nufialawo ate ŋu atu nu ɖe Zcash dzi. Eɖea nya siawo ƒe gɔme fia: Zcash gakotokuwo [wallets] Mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋla ƒe SDKwo Haxɔsetɔ ƒe dɔwɔwɔ hatsotsowo Ame siwo kpena ɖe open-source mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖo ŋu ƒe dɔ Ale si Zcash ƒe mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ [network upgrades] nana protocol la ƒe nɔnɔ nɔ nyuie Nuxlẽlawo kpɔa ale si Zcash trɔna le ɣeyiɣi me kple ale si xexeme katã ƒe ame siwo kpena ɖe dɔa ŋu la na dɔwɔnu [tools], ɖoɖonu, applicationwo, kple nusɔsrɔ̃ ƒe nuŋlɔwo ƒe tsitsi. --- Dedie

title: Raspberry Pi 4 Ƒe Mɔfiame Na Zebra Ƒe Dudu
description: Ne nàdzu Zebra ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ [node] ƒe software le Raspberry Pi 4 dzi la, eana wò nàkpɔ gome le Zcash ƒe network me abe ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ si le gbegbɔgblɔ…
text: Raspberry Pi 4 Ƒe Mɔfiame Na Zebra Ƒe Dudu Ne nàdzu Zebra ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ [node] ƒe software le Raspberry Pi 4 dzi la, eana wò nàkpɔ gome le Zcash ƒe network me abe ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ si le gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi [consensus] kple wo ene. Mɔfiame sia akplɔ wò to afɔwo me be nàɖo Zebra ɖe wò Raspberry Pi 4 dzi eye nàdzue. Nusiwo Hiã Raspberry Pi 4 (2GB RAM alo nu si sɔ wu wo wòanye nyuie). MicroSD card (16GB alo nu si sɔ wu wo wòanye nyuie) si wotsɔ Raspberry Pi OS (Raspbian) de eme. Internet ƒe kadodo si le anyi. Keyboard, mouse, kple monitor (na gɔmedzedze ƒe ɖoɖo). SSH client (ne èdi be nàge ɖe eŋu tso didime). Dede Eme Trɔ Wò Ƒe Nɔnɔme Yiyi Ʋu terminal alo ge ɖe wò Raspberry Pi ŋu to SSH dzi eye nàkpɔ be wò ƒe nɔnɔme le nyuie to esiawo ƒe dudu me: sudo apt update sudo apt upgrade De Nusiwo Hiã Eme Ele be nàde nusiwo hiã na Zebra ƒe tutu kple dudu eme: sudo apt install build-essential cmake git clang libssl-dev pkg-config Wɔ Zebra ƒe Repository ƒe Kɔpi Ʋu terminal eye nàwɔ Zebra ƒe repository ƒe kɔpi ɖe wò Raspberry Pi dzi: git clone https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra.git cd zebra Tu Zebra Be nàtu Zebra la, zã sededewo: cargo build --release Ƒomekɔkɔ sia ate ŋu axɔ ɣeyiɣi aɖe. Kpɔ be wò Raspberry Pi kɔ le nyuie, elabena compilation ate ŋu awɔ dzodzo. Ɖoɖo Wɔ configuration file na Zebra. Àte ŋu azã default configuration abe gɔmedzeƒe ene: cp zcash.conf.example zcash.conf Trɔ asi le zcash.conf file ŋu be nàwɔ wò ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ ƒe ɖoɖowo ɖe wò ŋutɔ ƒe lododo nu. Àte ŋu aɖo network, na nukuku [mining] nadze, ɖo peer ƒe kadodowo, kple bubuwo. Dze Zebra Dzi Fifia àte ŋu adze Zebra dzi kple wò ɖoɖo si nèwɔ: ./target/release/zebrad -c zcash.conf git comment Sedede sia adze Zebra ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ dzi, eye wòadze sync wɔwɔ kple Zcash ƒe gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu [blockchain]. Kpɔe ɖa Àte ŋu akpɔ wò Zebra ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ ƒe ŋgɔyiyi kple nɔnɔme ɖa to web browser ƒe tutu kple yiyiyi ɖe http://127.0.0.1:8233/status. Nusiwo Ɖe Mɔ Ne nàdo go aɖe le Zebra ƒe tutu alo dudu me la, kpɔ Zebra ƒe documentation be nàkpɔ mɔfiamewo na fukpekpewo ɖɔɖɔ kple nyatakakawo bubu. Kpɔ be wò Raspberry Pi le kɔkɔe, elabena ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ ƒe dudu ate ŋu awɔ dzodzo. Àte ŋu adi be nàzã nu si wɔa kɔkɔe, abe fan alo heat sink ene. Nuŋɔŋlɔ Ne nèdze mɔfiame sia yome la, ele be nèɖo Zebra ɖe wò Raspberry Pi 4 dzi eye nèdze eŋu le dzidzedze me. Fifia nèle kpekpeɖeŋu na Zcash ƒe network abe ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ si le eɖokui ŋutɔ ene, le ɣaɣla [privacy] si le Zcash ƒe gaɖoɖowo [transactions] me ƒe dedie wɔm.

title: ShapeShift kple Zcash: Ɣaɣla ŋgɔ me ha nuɖo agni ƒe asitsɔtsɔ
description: Ɣaɣla [Privacy] kple woawo ŋutɔ ƒe nudzrala nyanyui nye cryptocurrency ƒe gɔmeɖoɖo veviwo, ke hã zazãla geɖewo gale gatrɔƒe siwo nye tɔɖoƒe ƒe asi me la dzi…
text: ShapeShift kple Zcash: Ɣaɣla ŋgɔ me ha nuɖo agni ƒe asitsɔtsɔ --- Gɔmedzedze Ɣaɣla [Privacy] kple woawo ŋutɔ ƒe nudzrala nyanyui nye cryptocurrency ƒe gɔmeɖoɖo veviwo, ke hã zazãla geɖewo gale gatrɔƒe siwo nye tɔɖoƒe ƒe asi me la dzi, siwo bia ame ƒe nyanyuinu ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu eye woaɖe zazãla ƒe ga le asi. Ƒomekpekpe si le ShapeShift kple Zcash dome la ƒoa gatrɔƒe ƒe nɔnɔme si nye ha nuɖo agni bliboa kple cryptocurrency siwo dzra ɣaɣla ɖe edzi wuwo dome, eye ena mɔ na zazãlawo be woatsɔ ZEC awɔ asitsɔtsɔ kple woaɣe woƒe ɣaɣla alo woƒe nudzrala ƒe dziɖuɖu o. Nyatia sia ƒe gbeɖeɖe nye be ShapeShift nye nu kae, ale si Zcash wɔa dɔe, ale si nàte ŋu aɖɔli ɖɔli ZEC le ShapeShift dzi, kple nu si ta ƒomekpekpe sia le vevie na gaƒeɖeɖe si nye ɣaɣla eye wònye ha nuɖo agni ƒe etsɔme. --- ShapeShift nye nu kae? ShapeShift nye cryptocurrency ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu si nye ha nuɖo agni eye wòƒe nudzɔwɔwo le amewo katã si, si na zazãlawo ate ŋu awɔ asitsɔtsɔ, adze digital assetwo ŋu, eye woakpɔ wo dzi le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu geɖewo me, ne woawɔ account, ana amenyanyuinu ƒe nyatakakawo, alo atsɔ woƒe ga ƒe nudzrala na bubu o. Eƒe ƒe ƒe ŋkeke kpui aɖe ShapeShift ƒe gɔmedzedze le 2014 me Erik Voorhees wɔe abe cryptocurrency ƒe gatrɔƒe si nye tɔɖoƒe ƒe asi me, eye wòle Switzerland. Kpekpeɖeŋu sia zu dzidzɔna kaba tso eƒe interface bɔbɔe ta, si na zazãlawo ate ŋu aɖɔli cryptocurrency ɖeka kple bubu ne woawɔ account o. Le 2021 me, ShapeShift wɔ tɔtrɔ gã aɖe. Ƒomea gbugbɔ eƒe corporate structure eye wòtrɔ yi Decentralized Autonomous Organization (DAO) me, si FOX token ƒe dzilawo wɔa dziɖuɖu [governance] le edzi. Abe tɔtrɔ sia ƒe akpa ene la, woɖe FOX token miliɔn 340 ƒe mɔxexe na zazãla miliɔn ɖeka kple afã wu, eye wòzu airdrop gãwo dometɔ ɖeka le crypto ƒe ŋutinyawo me. Tso ɣeyiɣi ma dzi yi edzi la, woaɖo dzidzedze gãwo katã tso kpekpeɖeŋu la ŋuti to community dziɖuɖu ƒe gbedasiwo kple vote me. Nɔnɔme veviwo Nudzrala mele bubu ƒe asi me o: Zazãlawo wɔa asitsɔtsɔ tẽ tso woawo ŋutɔ ƒe gakotoku [wallet] me. ShapeShift metsi woƒe ga le asi kpɔ o. KYC Mele Hia O: Ame ƒe nyanyuinu ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu mele o, account wɔwɔ mele o, eye ametsitsiwo ƒe nyatakaka ƒuƒoƒo mele o. Ɖoɖonu Geɖe ƒe Kpekpeɖeŋu: Mɔ le asset 10,000 wu le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu 15+ dzi, siwo me Bitcoin, Ethereum, Cosmos, kple Zcash le. DEX ƒe Ƒuƒoƒo: ShapeShift na asitsɔtsɔwo to kpekpeɖeŋu siwo nye ha nuɖo agni abe THORChain, 0x, kple bubuwo dzi be wòakpɔ asixɔxɔ nyuitɔwo. Ɖoɖonu Geɖe Dome Ɖɔli Ɖɔliwo: Ɖɔli assetwo le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu vovovowo dome tẽ, ne nàzã token si woƒo xlãe alo ga ƒe lẽ siwo nye tɔɖoƒe ƒe asi me o. Le Ame Katã Ƒe Asi Bliboa: Kpekpeɖeŋu bliboa, si mobile app la hã le eme, le ame katã ƒe asi eye backend si nye ame ŋutɔ ƒe tɔ mele o, negbe gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu ƒe nyatakakawo ko. --- Ale Si Zcash Wɔa Dɔe Zcash (ZEC) nye cryptocurrency si wotu ɖe cryptography ƒe gɔmeɖoɖo sesẽwo dzi, siwo na zazãlawo mɔ be woawɔ gaɖoɖo le ɣaɣla me. Woɖe Zcash gbe le 2016 me eye wònye Bitcoin ƒe fork, si kpe ɣaɣla ƒe teknolojia sesẽwo ɖe eŋu, gake wòle Bitcoin ƒe ga miliɔn 21 si ƒe xexlẽme mele tɔtrɔ o kple proof-of-work gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi [consensus] la ɖe asi. Ɣaɣla ƒe Gaɖoɖowo kple Zero-Knowledge Ɖaseɖigbalɛwo Zcash ƒe nutetee vevitɔe nye eƒe zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛwo [proofs] zazã, vevie ɖaseɖigbalɛ ƒe ƒome si woyɔna be zk-SNARKs. Cryptography ƒe ɖaseɖigbalɛ siawo na mɔ na ame ɖeka be wòana ɖase na bubu be nya aɖe nye nyateƒe, ne wòaɖe nyatakaka bubu aɖeke afia wu nya la ŋutɔ ƒe nyateƒenye o.
