title: Zcash Ƒe Tatawo Ƒe Ɖaseɖiɖi
description: Woɖe ɖase kpɔ tso Zebra v6.3.0 kple Zallet v0.1.0-beta.2 dzi le 2026-08-18.
text: Zcash Ƒe Tatawo Ƒe Ɖaseɖiɖi TL;DR Zcash binary ƒe kɔɖeɖe mele abe esiwo projekti la dze le gome ene o. Ɖaseɖiɖi nye ale si nàte ŋu aɖe vovototo la. Checksum dea ɖase be file la va de nyuie. Asidede agbalẽ te [signature] dea ɖase be ame kae wɔe. Èhiã wo evea, eye checksum ɖeka koe meɖea ɖase geɖe o. Zebra doa SHA256SUMS file kple Sigstore bundle, si ƒoa tata la kple GitHub Actions workflow, tag kple commit aɖe ɖe te — key ƒe kpɔkpɔ mele be wòawɔ o. Zallet doa GPG asidede agbalẽ te siwo woƒo ɖe eŋu (.asc) kple SLSA provenance kple SBOM. Zcash ƒe asidede agbalẽ te ƒe key trɔ le 2026 tso Electric Coin Company yi Zcash Open Development Lab (ZODL). Ne nèɖe tata xoxowo ƒe ɖase kpɔ la, èhiã key yeye la — eye handover statement la wode asidede agbalẽ te ɖe eŋu kple key evea, ale nàte ŋu aɖe key ƒe trɔtrɔ la ŋutɔ ƒe ɖase. gpg gblɔa subkey si de asidede agbalẽ te file aɖe ŋu, menye primary key si woŋlɔ ɖe announcementwo me o. Fingerprint si wòkpɔ abe eƒe nɔnɔ mesɔ o ene la enye subkey zi geɖe, menye attack o. Ne ɖaseɖiɖi la gbã la, megbe binary la o. Woɖe ɖase kpɔ tso Zebra v6.3.0 kple Zallet v0.1.0-beta.2 dzi le 2026-08-18. Nu ka ta esia le vevie wu na Zcash Gakotoku [wallet] binary si woɖe asi ɖe eŋu ate ŋu afia gazazãsafui [spending key] alo nukpɔsafui [viewing key] ɖe ame bubu. To vovototo na password si woɖe asi ɖe eŋu la, esia ƒe buabu la nye mamateŋu: trɔtrɔ megale o, gaɖeɖe megale o, eye kpekpeƒe si dea kpe ɖe ame ŋu hã mele o. Ɣaɣla [shielded] gaɖoɖowo [transactions] kpɔa nu si wɔm le ɖoɖonu dzi [on-chain] laa — gake woɖea ŋu kpɔɣe aɖeke o ne software si nèle zaza la wotrɔe hafi wòva de asiwò. Esia nye attack ƒe mɔ viwo dometɔ aɖe si me protocol la ƒe ɣaɣla [privacy] ƒe laylayawoa mehia le gbeɖeka o. Ɖaseɖiɖi nye layer si kpɔa eŋu. Attack ƒe model — nu si ɖaseɖiɖi dea kple nu si wòmede o Edea: Mirror si woɖe asi ɖe eŋu alo file si wotrɔ eye wowɔe tso afi aɖe si menye projekti la ƒe release axɔme o. Ame si tsia le download ƒe mɔ dome wɔa ɖɔli ɖɔli [swap]. CDN si woɖe asi ɖe eŋu alo distribution host si woɖe asi ɖe eŋu. Nɔnɔ gbegblẽ si dzɔ le mɔ dzi. Mede o: Maintainer si dea asidede agbalẽ te code vɔ̃ ŋu. Asidede agbalẽ te la aɖea ɖase nyuie; ede ɖase be eƒe afi kae wòtso, menye be eƒe taɖodzinu nyo o. Build host si woɖe asi ɖe eŋu wɔa artifact si wode asidede agbalẽ te ɖo, gake wòvɔ̃. Esia tae reproducible builds kple provenance attestations li be woakpɔe ɖe anyi. Key si nèkplɔ tso afi ma ke si woɖe asi ɖe eŋu binary la tso. Ne attack wɔla aɖe le file la kple key si nèle kpɔm ɖe eŋu la evea ƒe dziɖuɖu me la, ɖaseɖiɖi megblɔ naneke na wò o. Nu mamlɛtɔ siae nye esi guide geɖewo metsoa o. Afi si nèkplɔ key la tso le vevie abe command la ƒe wowɔ ene. --- Akpa 1 — Zebra: checksums kple Sigstore Zebra doa asset siawo le release ɖe sia ɖe ta: Asset Taɖodzinu --- --- zebrad- - .tar.gz binary archive la zebrad- - .tar.gz.sha256 checksum si le file ɖe sia ɖe ta SHA256SUMS checksumwo na architecturewo katã SHA256SUMS.sigstore.json Sigstore bundle si dea asidede agbalẽ te SHA256SUMS ŋu Afɔ 1 — Kɔe Afɔ 2 — Kpɔ checksum la Output vavã: --ignore-missing hiã le afisia elabena SHA256SUMS ku ɖe architecturewo katã ŋu eye wòkɔ ɖeka ko. title: Gaɖoɖo Ƒe Historia Ƒe Kpɔtso ɖe Eme Tso Viewing Key Me
description: Gakotoku [wallet] ƒe kpɔtso geɖe ko le. ZODL ƒe akɔnta ƒe kpɔtso, le kpɔɖeŋu me, naa wò ŋkekeawo, gaƒomekukuwo kple adzɔwo na kalenda ƒe ƒe si va yi, gake…
text: Gaɖoɖo Ƒe Historia Ƒe Kpɔtso ɖe Eme Tso Viewing Key Me Gakotoku [wallet] ƒe kpɔtso geɖe ko le. ZODL ƒe akɔnta ƒe kpɔtso, le kpɔɖeŋu me, naa wò ŋkekeawo, gaƒomekukuwo kple adzɔwo na kalenda ƒe ƒe si va yi, gake gaɖoɖo ƒe ID aɖeke mele o, nya kpui aɖeke mele o, eye gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi aɖeke hã mele o. Ema mede asi na akɔnta ƒe ŋlɔɖiɖi, gakotoku ƒe trɔtrɔ ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu, alo fexexe aɖe ƒe nusi dzɔ ƒe kaɖiɖi o. Mele be wòatsɔ wò gadzraɖoɖi nya [seed phrase] ana be nàkpɔ nusiwo katã ta o. Unified full viewing key (UFVK, si ƒe gɔmedzedze le uview1) ate ŋu akpɔ gaɖoɖo siawo katã siwo ge ɖe eme kple siwo do go le akɔnta aɖe me, eye dɔwɔnu eve ate ŋu atrɔ ema zu faɛl si nàdzra: Zkool GraphQL server kple zingo-cli. Mɔfiafia sia ƒo mɔ siwo tso forum ƒe nyati sia me eye wotrɔe ɖe version yeyewo nu. Woda kpɔe le September 2026 me kple Zkool 6.30.0 kple zingo-cli tso zingolib 6.0.0 me. Hafi nàdze egɔme Ele be nàkpɔ nu eve: UFVK na akɔnta la. Nukpɔsafuiwo gblɔ nusi wòfia kple ale si woatsɔ akpɔe. Dzigbe ƒe teƒe, gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe si woatsɔ adze scan gɔme le. Zã teƒe aɖe si le wò gaɖoɖo gbãtɔ ŋgɔ. Ne nàɖoe ɖe dzi akpa aɖe, historia xoxo aɖewo bu tsɔe to ɣaɣla me. Ne nàɖoe ɖe anyi akpa aɖe, scan la ƒe ɣeyiɣi koe adidi. Sapling ƒe dzeɖeɖe (419200) dzɔna ɣeaɣi eye scan ate ŋu axɔ gaƒoƒo geɖe. Nàdze e ɣaɣla me Nukpɔsafui aɖe mate ŋu aƒe ga o, gake eɖe wò historia blibo la fia ame si kee wòle si. Mègblɔe le website alo gaɖoɖowo ƒe mɔkpɔla aɖe dzi o. Ɖoe ɖe software si wò ŋutɔ nàwɔ la me. Server si wòle sync wɔm tso la kpɔ wò IP gaɖoƒe kple gaɖoɖo siwo nètsɔe vɛ blibo. Dɔwɔnu eve siwo le anyi la katã wɔ wò gaɖoɖo ɖe ID me be woaxle nya kpuiwo kple adzɔwo, eye ZIP 307 de ŋku edzi be esia gblɔ na server la be gaɖoɖo siwo nye tɔwòe. Sync si tso wò ŋutɔ Zebra ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ [node] kple Zaino alo lightwalletd magblɔ esia o. Zingolib kple Zaino Tutorial fia ale si woawɔ ɖoɖo aɖe. zingo-cli 6 ɖoa fexexewo ɖe Nym mixnet dzi, gake eƒe sync lia server la kple mɔ dzĩ, eya ta nyati si le dzi la ku ɖe eŋu hã. Na dɔwɔnu siawo nukpɔsafui, megaɖe gadzraɖoɖi nya na wo o. Zkool GraphQL server ƒe gegeɖeɖe manɔ anyi le gɔmedzedze me o, eye eƒe API agbugbɔ gadzraɖoɖi nya na akɔnta siawo katã si wo wɔ tsoe me, eye wòate ŋu aɖo ga. Dzra server la le wò ŋutɔ ƒe mɔkeke dzi. Docker sedede si le anyi la se to ɖe 127.0.0.1 koe. Dɔwɔnu eve siawo dzra safui la kple wò historia ɣe ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ [encryption] me o. Tutui dɔ ƒe data la ne wowu, eye nàdzra kpɔtso la le teƒe si woŋlɔ ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ le. Tia 1: Zkool GraphQL zkoolgraphql nye Zkool ƒe gakotoku ƒe mɔdɔwɔla le server si tsi tre ɖeka me. Eya nye program bubu tso Zkool app la. Mɔ bɔbɔe si woatsɔ awɔe nye Docker image (amd64 kple arm64). Linux x86-64 binary hã le Zkool ƒe releases axa dzi; ele be glibc 2.38 alo si wu ema nanɔ asinye, eya ta Ubuntu 24.04 wɔ dɔ, gake Debian 12 mewɔ o. Dze server la gɔme Ewɔ sync tso https://zec.rocks me ne mètsɔ --lwd-url kpe ɖe eŋu kple wò ŋutɔ server o. Le egɔmedzedze gbãtɔ me la, eɖea Sapling parameters (le 50 MB ƒe ta) vɛ. Ne esia megbe o la, docker start zkool-export ate ƒe wɔ geɖe. Ʋu http://127.0.0.1:8000/graphiql le browser me. Àte ŋu aɖo afɔ siwo va yi ɖe eƒe eme eye nàwɔ wo. Ɖo safui la ɖe eme Egbɔna kple akɔnta yeye la ƒe ID, si nye 1 le server yeye aɖe dzi. Ɖo birth ɣesiaɣi. Ne mèɖoe o la, Zkool adze egɔme tso gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe si le fifia eye makpɔ naneke o. useInternal: true na Zkool nakpɔ nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi [transparent] ƒe trɔtrɔ ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo hã. Dzrae ɖe eme na safui siwo tso ZODL me, si nye ɖoɖo ma ke Ga Ƒe Gbugbɔxɔxɔ zãna na ZODL gadzraɖoɖi nyawo. Wɔ sync Esia dzi yi va se ɖe esi sync la awu. Mègatsɔ fast: true kpe ɖe eŋu o. Ewɔ be womaɖea gaɖoɖowo blibo vɛ o, si nye afi si nya kpuiwo, adzɔwo kple outputs tso. Xexlẽme si wogbugbɔna nye teƒe si wòɖo ta be yia, menye ɖaseɖigbalɛ be wòva ɖo afi ma o. Network ƒe vodada aɖe ate ŋu awu sync la doŋgɔ be magblɔ naneke o, eya ta kpɔ: Ne akɔnta la ƒe height le currentHeight megbe la, wɔ sync la ake. Egaɖo edzi tso afi si wòtsɔ. Kpɔe tso ɖe e

title: Mɔfiame Si Wɔa Dɔ Kple: Zcash Node RPC kple Blockchain Ƒe Nudzodzro
description: Axa sia nye nuɖuɖu ƒe agbalẽ na alesi nàdo go kple Zcash full node si le dɔ wɔm to JSON-RPC me, eye nàtsɔ indexer aɖe akpe ɖe eŋu be gakotokuwo siwo le keklẽ…
text: Mɔfiame Si Wɔa Dɔ Kple: Zcash Node RPC kple Blockchain Ƒe Nudzodzro Axa sia nye nuɖuɖu ƒe agbalẽ na alesi nàdo go kple Zcash full node si le dɔ wɔm to JSON-RPC me, eye nàtsɔ indexer aɖe akpe ɖe eŋu be gakotokuwo siwo le keklẽ me kple nusiwo dzroa nuwo kpɔna ate ŋu adi biabia tso eŋu. Menye aƒoƒo ƒe mɔfiame evelia o. Ne èdi be nànya ale si nàna post-zcashd stack la nadze egɔme (Zebra + Zallet, Zaino si wòate ŋu atia, portwo, volumeawo, boot ƒe akpa eve), zã Z3 Stack axa kple Z3 repository. Na nyamedzesi ŋɔŋlɔ ƒe gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi [consensus] me nyawo, kpɔ Full Nodes kple Zebra Full Node. zcashd wɔ eƒe agbenɔnɔ nu le 18 July 2026. Operator ƒe dɔ yeye woɖo be wòatsɔ Zebra (alo Zakura) kple gakotoku alo indexer awɔ, menye zcashd o. --- Nyagbegbe JSON-RPC nye mɔ si dzi operators kple gakotokuwo bia biabia ɖe ɖoɖonu [chain] ƒe tip, xɔlɔwo, kple (le gakotoku ƒe process aɖe dzi) balancewo ŋu. Le Z3 dzi la, Zebra dea node RPC; Zallet dea gakotoku RPC. Regtest nye teƒe si nyo be nàsɔ srɔ̃a calls la. Z3 ƒe rpc-router si le http://127.0.0.1:8181 xɔa zebra / zebra eye wòɖoa node methods yi Zebra gbɔ, eye wòɖoa gakotoku methods yi Zallet gbɔ. Mainnet kple testnet zã cookie auth le Zebra. Mègatsɔ regtest ƒe username/password ade public node aɖe ŋu o. Indexing nye dɔ bubu tso validation gbɔ. Zebra wɔa validation. Zaino (Z3 --profile indexer) dea lightwalletd-compatible gRPC. Ztreamer nye Zakura-backed indexer; menye nusi Z3 dea la o. Zaino JSON-RPC kple Zebra ƒe indexer gRPC si wòate ŋu atia la nye loopback alo network si wòka ɖe dzi ƒe tanya. Mègana woanɔ public internet dzi, eye authentication manɔ o. --- Process kae ƒoa ŋu xɔa call sia? Nusi nèdi Ɖo go kple Z3 mainnet host port Nudzɔdzɔwo --- --- --- --- Ɖoɖonu ƒe tip, xɔlɔwo, getblockchaininfo Zebra JSON-RPC 8232 Cookie auth Gakotoku ƒe balance, gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo, dɔm Zallet RPC 28232 Process bubu; beta software Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe [block] siwo wòkpekpe na gakotoku siwo le keklẽ me Zaino gRPC 8137 Kpoe le --profile indexer kple; plaintext h2c Explorer / ga suewo nanaƒe [faucet] JSON-RPC proxy Zaino JSON-RPC 8237 Network si wòka ɖe dzi ko Sɔ nunyawo katã fiafia me, sync manɔmee Z3 regtest rpc-router 8181 Username zebra / password zebra Port ƒe matrix kple Compose project ƒe ŋkɔwo: Z3 Stack kple z3-contract.yaml. --- Ƒo regtest me gbã Tso Z3 checkout aɖe me, le ./scripts/regtest-init.sh kple docker compose --env-file .env.regtest up -d megbe: getblockchaininfo ƒe emetsonu si le nyuie me la ƒoa "blocks" kple "upgrades" map aɖe. Ne curl nɔ kame la, router la menɔ dzi o; ne èxɔ 401 la, èle Zebra gbɔ kplee tẽ ɖe router la teƒe (Zebra si le regtest me kplee tẽe nye 29232, eye wògale router credentials la dzi ƒo ka hã, ne mètrɔ wo o). Regtest ƒe dɔwɔwɔ blibo, si me activation ƒe gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒewo nukuku [mining] hã le: Z3 docs/regtest.md. --- Mainnet / testnet JSON-RPC (cookie auth) Le mainnet kple testnet dzi la, Zallet kple Zaino service si wòate ŋu atia la xlẽa cookie volume si woƒo ƒu. Woyea cookie sia le boot me; menye backup ƒe taɖodzinu o. Mègatsɔ Zebra JSON-RPC ade public internet dzi o. Ɖo eŋu tso Compose network me (zebra:8232) alo tso host la dzi ko ne ètsɔe de loopback ŋu. Operator ƒe nudzɔdzɔ siwo wozãna zi geɖe le Zebra le /ready megbe: getblocktemplate / getmininginfo nye nukuku RPCs. Gaƒuƒoƒowo [pools] siwo gaxɔa zcashd process ɖeka ko la hia Zebra (alo Zakura) na templates, kple gakotoku sia sia si wozãna na coinbase. Kpɔ Zcash Mining Pools kple migration guide. --- Ɖe indexer aɖe kpee Validation kple indexing nye dɔ vovovowo. Zaino (nusi Z3 dea) Zaino xlẽa Zebra eye wòdea lightwalletd-compatible gRPC API kple JSON-RPC proxy. Zallet mehia standalone Zaino container o; wòtsɔ Zaino libraries ɖe eme eye wòɖoa go kple Zebra to JSON-RPC me. Dze standalone Zaino egɔme ne èdi be gakotoku siwo le keklẽ me le gota, explorers, alo ga suewo nanaƒewo nàzã: Lala va se ɖe esime Zebra async hafi nàtsɔ clients afia Zaino. Bulk indexer si le catch-up me kple fetch concurrency si kɔ la ate ŋu ana Zebra ƒe

title: Afisi na wòatsɔ kpekpeɖeŋu na ZEC
description: Woɖe kpɔmlɔe le anyi: Ɖeasi 27, 2026, le habɔbɔ siawo ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu axa gbɔ. Gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo trɔna, eyata axa sia do ƒometɔawo ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu axawo ƒe kadodo…
text: Afisi na wòatsɔ kpekpeɖeŋu na ZEC Ame si dze egɔme - Minuti 5 Woɖe kpɔmlɔe le anyi: Ɖeasi 27, 2026, le habɔbɔ siawo ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu axa gbɔ. Gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo trɔna, eyata axa sia do ƒometɔawo ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu axawo ƒe kadodo ɖe anyi, eye menye be woakpɔ gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo akpɔ ɖe eme o. Ɖe sia ɖe sia, kpɔ gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi la tso habɔbɔ la ƒe axa ŋutɔ dzi. Nudzɔdzɔ ƒe dzesiwo nye nu si habɔbɔ ɖe sia ɖe gblɔ tso eɖokui ŋu, menye nudzɔdzɔ ƒe aɖaŋu o. TL;DR Ɖeviwɔwɔkpɔwo asieke fia ZEC gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi [address]. Wo dome atɔ zã ɣaɣla [shielded] gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi, ale wò ƒe nunana anɔ ɣaɣla ɖoɖonu dzi [on-chain] Ɖeviwɔwɔkpɔ siwo amewo ka ŋutɔ kpɔ xɔ ZEC ɖe nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi [transparent] gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi dzi ko: EFF, Freedom of the Press Foundation, Tor Project kple Internet Archive Kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe dzraɖoƒewo abe The Giving Block kple Every.org ene xɔ ZEC na dɔwɔwɔ ƒe habɔbɔ akpewo, gake wo dometɔ aɖeke megblɔ be yexɔ ɣaɣla ZEC o Ne èhia nudzɔdzɔ ƒe kpeɖeŋu, kpɔ habɔbɔ ɖe sia ɖe ƒe nyaŋlɔɖi si le ete la gbɔ hafi nàtsɔ nu na Ame kae wòwɔe na? ZEC ƒe nɔviwo siwo di be woatsɔ nu na ta si wɔnɔ dɔwɔm ɖo Nunana wɔnala siwo di be wo ƒe nunana nanɔ ɣaɣla Ame sia ame si di habɔbɔwo ƒe xexlẽme si wòate ŋu akpe ɖe ZEC dzi Ne èwɔ dɔ le ƒomeviwɔwɔkpɔ aɖe me eye nèdi be nàxɔ ZEC, kpɔ Exɔ Ɣaɣla Nunanawo abe US Ƒomeviwɔwɔkpɔ ene. Ɣaɣla alo nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi: Nu ka ta wòle vevie Ne nàɖo ZEC tso ɣaɣla gakotoku [wallet] aɖe me yi ɣaɣla gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi aɖe dzi la, ga ƒe asime, ame si dɔe kple ame si xɔe la katã anɔ ɣaɣla. Ne nàɖo nu yi nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi aɖe dzi la, nunana la ado go le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu [blockchain] la dzi: ame sia ame ate ŋu akpɔ ga ƒe asime, ɣeyiɣi si wòva ɖo kple habɔbɔ la ƒe ga ƒe asime. Wò ƒe ɣaɣla gakotoku la ƒe dɔwɔwɔ bubuwo anɔ ɣaɣla, gake nunana la ŋutɔ ado go. Kpɔ Gaɖoɖowo ƒe xexlẽdzikpɔɖeƒe be nànya nu si doa go ne ZEC dzo le ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo [pool] aɖe me. Wo katã de asi ɖe habɔbɔ la ƒe dɔa dzi. Ɣaɣla la koe na nunana la nɔ ɣaɣla. Ƒomeviwɔwɔkpɔwo siwo xɔ ɣaɣla ZEC Habɔbɔ Nu si wòwɔ Kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe axa Gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi Nyaŋlɔɖiwo --- --- --- --- --- Zcash Foundation US ƒomeviwɔwɔkpɔ si wɔ Zcash ƒe dodokpɔnuwo abe Zebra kple FROST ene Nunana ƒe fomu Ɣaɣla (Unified) Egblɔ be enye 501(c)(3) eye ZEC ƒe nunanawo ate ŋu aɖe nudzɔdzɔ. Fomu la bia ŋkeke, asime kple USD ƒe asime ne èdi be nàxɔ kpeɖeŋu Mothers Against Cruel Sentencing US ƒe ha si le dɔ wɔm tsɔa ɖe gaxɔxɔ ƒe dɔvɔ̃wo ŋu Tsɔ nu na Ɣaɣla (Unified) Egblɔ be enye 501(c)(3) eye nunanawo ate ŋu aɖe nudzɔdzɔ ZecHub Hamea ƒe nusɔsrɔ̃ ƒe nuto si le wiki sia megbe Tsɔ nu na Ɣaɣla (Unified) Mewɔ nudzɔdzɔ ƒe nɔnɔme aɖeke ɖe go o Open Privacy Research Society Canada ƒe ƒomeviwɔwɔkpɔ si le Cwtch, nyaɖoɖo ƒe mɔxɔla si le ɣaɣla, megbe Tsɔ nu na Ɣaɣla (Sapling) Canada ƒe ha aɖe; egblɔ be nunanawo mate ŋu aɖe nudzɔdzɔ o. Gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi la nye Sapling, menye Unified o Shielded Labs Switzerland ƒe habɔbɔ si nunanawo kpena ɖe eŋu eye le dɔ wɔm le Zcash protocol la ŋu Kadodo ƒe fomu Ɣaɣla Eƒe axa me gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi aɖeke mele o eye ebia be nunana wɔnalawo nakpɔ kadodo kplii. Woɖe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo ɖe ƒoƒoƒe me le 2023; kpɔ egbe kplii hafi nàɖo nu Ƒomeviwɔwɔkpɔwo siwo xɔ nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi ZEC ko Habɔbɔ Nu si wòwɔ Kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe axa Nyaŋlɔɖiwo --- --- --- --- Electronic Frontier Foundation (EFF) US ƒe digital dukɔme ƒe ablɔɖe ƒomeviwɔwɔkpɔ Mɔ bubuwo si dzi nàtsɔ nu na (Cryptocoin Donations ƒe akpa) Egblɔ be mate ŋu ana nudzɔdzɔ ƒe kpeɖeŋu, nunana alo habɔbɔ ƒe xɔseɖeŋu na crypto nunanawo o Freedom of the Press Foundation US ƒe ƒomeviwɔwɔkpɔ si le nyadzɔdzɔ wɔnɔviwo dometɔwo ƒe ɖeɖefia kpɔm, si le SecureDrop megbe Cryptocurrency Ne èhia nudzɔdzɔ ƒe kpeɖeŋu la, kpɔ kadodo kplii hafi nàtsɔ nu na The Tor Project US ƒe ƒomeviwɔwɔkpɔ si le Tor kple Tor Browser megbe Cryptocurrency Egblɔ be enye 501(c)(3). Na kpeɖeŋu, ɖo wò gaɖoɖo [transaction] ƒe nyawo na wo le email me le wò nunana megbe. Eƒe BTCPay mɔ la xɔa ga le BTC me, eyata zã ZEC gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi la Internet Archive US ƒe digital agbalẽdzraƒe, Wayb

title: Dash Integration of Zcash Orchard
description: In February 2026, the Dash network announced the integration of Zcash's Orchard shielded pool into the Dash Evolution chain. This marked one of the most significant cross chain privacy collaborations in the cryptocurrency space, as Dash ado
text: Dash Ƒe Ƒo Ƒu Kple Zcash Orchard Gbedodoɖa Le 2026 ƒe Dzove me la, Dash network gblɔ be woƒe Zcash ƒe Orchard ɣaɣla [shielded] gaƒuƒoƒo [pool] wotsɔ kpe ɖe Dash Evolution ɖoɖonu [chain] la ŋu. Esia nye ɖoɖonu geɖe dome [cross-chain] ɣaɣla [privacy] ƒe wɔwɔ kpeɖeŋu gã aɖe le cryptocurrency ƒe xexeme, elabena Dash tsɔ Zcash ƒe zero-knowledge ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ [encryption] si nye yeyetɔ kekeake va kpe ɖe eƒe CoinJoin-based ɣaɣla ƒe mɔ si nɔ anyi xoxo la ŋu. Ƒoƒo sia ɖo kpe ɖe Zcash ƒe nɔƒe abe ɣaɣla ƒe mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔla [developer] gã aɖe ene ŋu, eye wòʋu agbalẽ yeye aɖe na ɖoɖonu geɖe dome ɣaɣla ƒe wɔwɔ kpeɖeŋu. Agbalẽ sia ɖe nu me tso Orchard protocol si nye nu la, ale si Dash le wɔm ɖo la, nu si ta esɔ ŋu na ecosystem eve la, kple nu si wòfia tso ɣaɣla coin ƒe xexeme blibo la ŋu. Nu Nenye Zcash Orchard Protocol? Orchard nye Zcash ƒe ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo si nyo wu, eye wodzi edzi kple Network Upgrade 5 (NU5) le 2022 ƒe titina. Eƒo ƒu le crypto ƒe nusrɔ̃lawo ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ƒe geɖe, si wòwɔ le Electric Coin Company (ECC) kple Zcash ƒe hamea me. Dɔwɔnu ƒe Nɔnɔme Gbegbe: Halo 2 Orchard wotu ɖe Halo 2 ƒe ɖaseɖigbalɛ [proof] wɔwɔ ƒe ƒoƒo dzi, si nye zk-SNARK ƒe dɔwɔwɔ si wɔ dɔ kabakaba eye wòŋlɔ le Rust me. Halo 2 va kple ŋgɔyiyi gã eve: Mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖo xexlẽnuwo [trusted setup] Meli O: Zcash ƒe ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒowo tsã (Sprout kple Sapling) nɔ ŋu ɖo le ame geɖe ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ƒe kɔnuwo dzi be woawɔ crypto ƒe parameterwo. Ne woŋlẽ agbeɖeɖe si nye kɔkɔe gblẽ ("toxic waste") tso kɔnu siawo me me nyuie o la, anye be ame aɖe ate ŋu atsɔe awɔ ɣaɣla token si menye etɔ o. Halo 2 ɖe hiãhiã sia ɖa blibo to mɔ aɖe si woyɔ be nested amortization, si tsɔ kuxi sesẽwo ƒe nɔnɔme geɖe ƒu ɖe eɖokui me le elliptic curves ƒe ɣeyiɣiwo dzi, ale be calculation ƒe ɖaseɖigbalɛwo ate ŋu asusɔ tso woaŋutɔ ŋu. Ɖaseɖigbalɛ ƒe Ƒoƒoƒo si Me Ɖo Ɖe Eɖokui Ŋu: Ɖaseɖigbalɛ ɖeka ate ŋu aɖe asi ɖe ɖaseɖigbalɛ bubuwo ƒe nyateƒe si menye kakaɖedzi o la ŋu, eye wòtsɔ calculation gã aɖe ɖe teƒe sue aɖe si woate ŋu akpɔ ɖa. Esia hiã na nu ƒe dziyiyi [scaling] kple mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ [network upgrade] siava va megbe. Ale Si Orchard Ƒe Ɣaɣla Wɔ Dɔe Le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu [blockchain] ƒe gaɖoɖo [transaction] blema aɖe me la, amesi dɔ ga, amesi xɔe, kple ga ƒe home katã le ŋkɔ me le ɖoɖonu dzi [on-chain]. Le Orchard ƒe ɣaɣla gaɖoɖo aɖe me la, zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛwo ɖe kpe ɖe edzi le mathematics me be: Gaɖoɖoa le nyateƒe me (nu siwo ge ɖe me sɔ kple nu siwo doa go, token aɖeke medi tso afi aɖeke o) Amesi dɔ ga la si ga de Gaɖoɖo ƒe wɔwɔ zi eve mede anyi o Wokpɔ esia katã ɖa menye be wòafɔ amesi dɔ ga, amesi xɔe, alo ga si wotrɔ la ƒe home o. Abe Dash CTO Samuel Westrich gblɔe ene la, le gaɖoɖo ƒe mɔwo ƒe vovototo to mixing me teƒe la, zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛwo na nyateƒea nye be "mɔ aɖeke meli be woaɖe ŋku ɖe eŋu tso gɔmedzedzea me o." Actions Ɖe Inputs Kple Outputs Teƒe Orchard va kple Actions ƒe susu be wòaɖe input/output ƒe mɔ blema la teƒe. Action ɖeka ƒo gaɖeɖe kple gaɖodo ƒu, si ɖe gaɖoɖo ƒe metadata si doa go la gbɔ. Esia na wòsesẽ na amesiwo le kpɔm be woawɔ traffic analysis alo heuristic attacks le ɣaɣla gaɖoɖowo ŋu. Nu Nenye Dash Evolution Ɖoɖonu? Be nàse ƒoƒo sia gɔme la, ele vevie be nàse Dash ƒe architecture gɔme. Ɖoɖonu Eve Ƒe Architecture Dash wɔ dɔ kple ɖoɖonu eve ƒe system: Dash Core (Layer 1): Proof-of-work gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu gbãtɔ, nukulawo [miner] kple masternodeswo le dzram ɖe eŋu. Afisiae DASH token le, eye afisiae CoinJoin ƒe ɣaɣla mixing wɔ dɔe. Dash Evolution (Platform Layer): Ɖoɖonu evelia si wotu kple Core, si kpe ɖe mɔ̃ŋlɔ ƒe dɔwɔwɔ [smart contract], ha nuɖo agni [decentralized] dɔwɔƒewo, kple ameƒe nyateƒe ƒe dzidzi ŋu. Evolution zã Tendermint consensus ƒe mɔ si wotrɔ, si woyɔ be Tenderdash, eye Evolution Masternodeswoe le ƒoɖo be ɖoɖonu evea siaa nakpɔ dzidzɔ le ɣeyiɣi ɖeka. Evolution ɖoɖonue nye afi si Orchard ƒoƒoa le dzɔm. Nɔnɔme sia ƒe tiam na Dash ƒe mɔ be wòatsɔ crypto ƒe ɣaɣla si nyo ŋutɔ ava, esi wòatrɔ Core ɖoɖonu si woɖo kpe ɖe edzi xoxo la o. A

title: FROST & Nukpɔsafui [Viewing Keys]: Zcash/Dash ƒe Dɔwɔwɔ Ƒomeƒome Ƒe Nudzodzro ƒe Nyaƒoƒo
description: Woɖoe na ZecHub · Woɖe eƒe tɔtrɔ le 27 September 2026 · Woɖe nyaɖeɖe gbogbo ƒe kpọƒe fia le eme
text: FROST & Nukpɔsafui [Viewing Keys]: Zcash/Dash ƒe Dɔwɔwɔ Ƒomeƒome Ƒe Nudzodzro ƒe Nyaƒoƒo Woɖoe na ZecHub · Woɖe eƒe tɔtrɔ le 27 September 2026 · Woɖe nyaɖeɖe gbogbo ƒe kpọƒe fia le eme Nya veviwo ƒe ƒometɔ ZecHub ƒo biabia sia le esi wotsɔ ɣaɣla [shielded] DASH kpe ɖe wiki ƒe nunana ƒe mɔ dzi: ɖe Zcash ƒe nukpɔsafui, alo FROST ƒe xexlẽme asidede agbalẽ tewo ate ŋu atu ɖe Dash dzi oa? Nudzodzro la trɔ nya la. Nukpɔsafuiwo menye biabia si womeɖo ŋu ha o — Dash tsɔ Zcash Orchard ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo pool de eƒe Evolution ɖoɖonu [chain] me, eye Orchard ƒe safuiwo ƒe dzidzime ƒe ɖoɖo me la, nukpɔsafuiwo le eme tso gɔmedzedze. Dash ƒe mɔɖoɖoɖeƒe ŋuti mɔɖoɖo de wo ɖe nudzralawo ƒe nyatakaka fiafia kple Travel Rule ƒe sewo dzi. Woɖo kpo sia dzi xoxo, menye nu si wole mɔm na o. FROST nye afi si gbɔgbɔme ƒe vovo le. Dash xɔ BLS xexlẽme asidede agbalẽ tewo to Masternode ƒe Hati Si Nɔa Agbe Ɖeɖe Ŋkeke Gbogbo Me dzi xoxo, gake woawɔ dɔ na network ƒe gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi [consensus] — ChainLocks kple InstantSend. ZIP 312 le nu bubu ŋutɔ dim: xexlẽme me gazazãsafui [spending key] ƒe mɔɖoɖo na ɣaɣla akɔnt si ame geɖe aɖewo ƒe safuiwo le. Nu eve siawo mate ŋu atrɔ teƒe na wo nɔewo o. Eye esi ZIP 312 gale Draft ha, ɖoɖoŋlɔla ƒe dɔwɔwɔ si woatsɔ aɖe kple ɖoɖonu siawo me le o, eya ta awɔ dɔ yeye na ame sia ame si atu wo. --- Ɣeyiɣi ƒe ɖoɖo: nu ka ta tsatsametsɔtsɔ sia le tɔxɛ fifia ɣaɣla-gaƒuƒoƒo ƒe nudzɔdzɔ eve va eme le keke aɖewo me le 2026 ƒe titina. Zcash do le Orchard dzi. Nudzrolaa Taylor Hornby fia circuit ƒe vodada le Orchard me si woate ŋu azã atsɔ akeke ga ƒe ƒuƒoƒe kekeake si womate ŋu akpɔ o. Zcash ɖo eŋu to Ironwood (NU6.3) dzi le 28 July 2026, eye wotsɔ ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo yeye va, kple gaɖoɖowo ƒe xexlẽdzikpɔɖeƒe [turnstile] ƒe ƒome tso teƒe aɖe yi bubu me. Dash de ɖe Orchard dzi. Dash gblɔ ɖoɖo la le 19 February 2026 — "Míele mɔ kpɔm be míate ŋu adze ɣaɣla gaɖoɖowo [transaction] gɔme enumake, le dzadzraɖoɖo ƒe kpɔkpɔ kple code ƒe nudzodzro bubuwo ta." Dash ƒe mɔɖoɖoɖeƒe ŋuti mɔɖoɖo ɖe Shielded Balances fia be woɖo eŋu le July 2026 kple Dash Platform v4.0, eye Dash do "Shielded transactions le agbe le Dash Evolution mainnet dzi" le 4 August 2026. Nya aɖe tso ƒomeƒome ŋuti. Nyaƒoƒo aɖewo de Dash ƒe mainnet dɔwɔwɔ gɔmedzedze le 17 July 2026, si ana wòanɔ ŋgɔ na Ironwood. Ɣeyiɣi ma kpɔtɔ be etso nyadzɔdzɔ gblɔɖeɖe tso nyatakaka la ŋuti, ke menye dɔwɔwɔ gɔmedzedze o. Le Dash ŋutɔ ƒe nyaƒe dzi la, woɖo feature la le July me eye wogblɔ be ele agbe le 4 August — le Ironwood megbe. Ɖoɖonu eve siawo ƒe mɔwo kpe ɖe nɔewo ŋu le keke aɖewo me; ƒomeƒome si tututu le eme la ɖo ɖe dzesi si woexlẽ, eye nyaƒoƒo sia megblɔ be ɖeka le ŋgɔ o. Vevi ŋutɔ la, Dash mexɔ vodada la o. Woƒe gblɔɖeɖe la le kɔkɔe: "Míetsɔ Orchard ƒe version si me akeke ga ƒe ƒuƒoƒe kekeake ƒe vodada si míanya le o la wɔ dɔ. Version si va yi la me vodada le si woate ŋu azã atsɔ akeke Zcash ƒe ga ƒe ƒuƒoƒe kekeake si womate ŋu akpɔ o." Eya ta fifia Dash le cryptography si ƒe patched fork Zcash ŋutɔ do le eme le teƒe gɔme, ke Zcash ƒe gaƒuƒoƒo ƒe generation yeye (Ironwood) kple gazazã mɔɖoɖo ƒe ɖoɖo yeye (FROST) woƒe alẽ si woɖo la ƒe ɖeka va le agbe yeye, eye bubu la gale Draft. --- Nukpɔsafuiwo: woɖo eŋu xoxo, menye nudzodzro ƒe vovo o Dash ƒe ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo nye Orchard, si woɖo ɖe Halo 2 zk-SNARKs dzi, si me mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖo xexlẽnuwo [trusted setup] mele o. Orchard ƒe safuiwo ƒe dzidzime ƒe ɖoɖo me la, Full Viewing Keys kple Incoming Viewing Keys nɔ tso eƒe ɖoɖo gɔmedzedze, menye nu si woɖe kpe ɖe eŋu o — eya ta mɔ la va kple code la, menye nu si ɖoɖonu aɖe wòle be wòanɔ ƒoƒo tso bubu me o. Dash ƒe mɔɖoɖoɖeƒe ŋuti mɔɖoɖo gblɔ ta la kɔkɔe: "To vovo na ɣaɣla ƒe system siwo me wole be wòawɔe la, siwo kpɔ gatrɔƒe [exchange] ƒe tata kple sewo ƒe nuhiãhiã, Shielded Balances ɖe mɔ na nyatakaka tɔxɛ ɣaɣla [selective disclosure] to view keys dzi — ena zãlawo kple asitsɔdzraƒewo mate ŋu ama gaɖoɖo ƒe nyawo nudzralawo alo wɔnɔa Travel Rule ƒe sewo dzi ne woahiã, si mekpe ɖe ɣaɣla ŋu o le ŋkeke sia ŋkeke ƒe z

text: Grayscale Zcash ETF (ZCSH) Zcash mede ETF o. Grayscalee mede, to fund si wònɔ dzim tso 2017 me trɔe. Zcash nye protocol — company, gadzraɖoƒe [treasury] alo board aɖeke mele eŋu si ate ŋu ato fund aɖe o. Grayscale nye asset manager si le eƒe ŋutɔ dzi, eye wòƒlea ZEC le asime abe ame bubuwo katã ene. Vovototo siae nye nu si ame geɖe gɔmeɖe medzɔ le ZCSH ŋu wu, eye afimae axa sia dze egɔme. Le 25 August 2026, fund la de asi wɔwɔ me le NYSE Arca dzi abe The Zcash ETF ene, si nye US spot Zcash exchange-traded product gbãtɔ, eye fifia enye ZEC ƒe dzɔlawo ƒe ame ɖeka siwo xɔe sɔgbɔ le xexeame. Fund ma ke, ƒomevi etɔ̃ Ɣe ka me Nu kae trɔ --- --- October 2017 Edoe abe private placement ene, accredited investors ko ƒe October 2021 Woɖe shares la ƒe asi le OTCQX dzi kple ticker ZCSH, eye wònɔ asime le NAV te 25 August 2026 Wòtrɔ zu ETP si woate ŋu axɔ atrɔ le NYSE Arca dzi, eye wòɖe "Trust" ɖa le ŋkɔa me 2026 ƒe afɔɖeɖe la menye nu si mekpɔna ko o. Trust si woɖe eƒe asi le OTC me la, redemption mechanism mele eŋu o, eyata eƒe shares ate ŋu adzo ayi le premium alo discount me tso assets siwo le eyome ƒe asixɔxɔ gbɔ, zi aɖewo nenye vevie — esiae va dzɔ le 2021 kple 2026 dome. Exchange-traded product si me creation kple redemption le dɔ wɔm me la, arbitrage mɔ le eyome si naa share ƒe asixɔxɔ lea ɖe net asset value ŋu. Trɔtrɔ tso ɖeka me yi bubu me trɔa nu si nu la wɔ abe security ene. Ame si wɔ nu sia nu Dɔ Ƒome --- --- Sponsor Grayscale Investments Sponsors, LLC Trustee CSC Delaware Trust Company Administrator kple transfer agent The Bank of New York Mellon Prime broker Coinbase, Inc. — ena ZEC na trust la Authorized participants Jane Street, Virtu — wowɔa shares eye woɖea woaƒe ga na ame Marketing agent Foreside Fund Services Custodian Coinbase Custody Trust Company, LLC — afi ɖeka si ZEC vavã le Ƒome siawo dome ɖeka hã menye fund la o. Ɖoɖoɖo [arrangement] si le wo domee nye fund la, eye esiae diagram si le dzi la ɖe fia. Dɔ siawo dome geɖe bu alo woɖe wo gɔme vɔ̃ le nyadzɔdzɔwo me le listing ƒe ɣeyiɣia me; xexlẽsẽ si le afisia ɖoa eɖokui ɖe Grayscale ƒe Form S-3 registration statement si le EDGAR dzi ŋu. Ale si wowɔa shares eye woɖea woaƒe ga na ame Authorized Participants ko — broker-dealers siwo ŋkɔwo le register me, eye wode agreement kple Sponsor la ƒe asi — ate ŋu awɔ alo aɖe shares ƒe ga na ame, eye woate ŋu awɔe le 10,000 ƒe ƒuƒoƒewo me ko, siwo woyɔna be Baskets. Investor si nye ame gbãtɔa mate ŋu awɔ dɔ sia o; ele shares siwo li xoxo la ƒle kple woƒe dzidzi le gatrɔƒe [exchange] la dzi abe listed security bubu ene. Mechanism la nye cash fifia, menye in-kind o. Authorized Participant aɖe ɖoa cash ɖe cash account me, alo wòxɔa cash tsoe me, eye third-party liquidity provider aɖee nye ame si va xɔa alo dze ZEC ɖa vavã. Registration statement la gblɔ in-kind process aɖe hã, si me Authorized Participant aɖe aɖo ZEC tẽ ɖe Trust la gbɔ alo axɔ ZEC tsoe gbɔ — gake egblɔe kpuie be "In-Kind Regulatory Approval has not been obtained," eye womeate ŋu axɔe gbeɖe o. Woxɔa adzɔ [fee] le ZEC me Sponsor ƒe adzɔ nye 2.5% le ƒe ɖeka me, abe ale si wònɔ le listing ŋkeke la ene. Woxɔa eƒe akontabu gbesiagbe abe net asset value ƒe percentage ene, eye abe filing la gblɔe ene, "payable in ZEC to the Sponsor daily in arrears." Share menye ZEC ƒe quantity si mele woƒom ɣe sia ɣe o; enye claim si le nu si le viem vie la ŋu. title: Namada Privacy Best Practices
description: Practical, actionable guidance for achieving maximum privacy on Namada and understanding exactly where its protections end.
text: Namada Ɣaɣla [Privacy] Ƒe Nɔnɔme Kɔkɔewo Fiƒi ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu siwo wòate ŋu awɔ la, eye woana nàkpɔ ɣaɣla si le Namada dzi kple afisi eƒe dzodzrowo va se tututu. Ɣaɣla nye amegbetɔ ƒe gomegã vevi aɖe. Namada wotu tsitre vevie be wòaɣlae to zero-knowledge cryptography ŋu. Mɔfiafia sia ƒo nɔnɔme kɔkɔe siwo amewo kple mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔlawo zãna be woaɣla wo ŋutɔ ƒe nuwo kple woƒe ŋusẽ katã. --- Ale Si Namada Ɣea Wò Ɣaɣla Namada nye gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu [blockchain] si woɖo ɣaɣla tsã na, eye wòɣlana gakotoku [wallet] ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo, gaɖoɖo ƒe asimewo, kple balans wo to zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛwo [proofs] (zk-SNARKs) ŋu. Ɣaɣla Ƒe Nɔnɔme Veviwo Ɣaɣla Gaɖoɖowo [Shielded Transactions] - Ɛɣlana sedzila, xɔla, kple asimewo blibo. Nu Geɖe Ƒe Ɣaɣla Gaƒuƒoƒo [Multi-Asset Shielded Pool] (MASP) - Ɣaɣla me ƒe gaɖoɖowo, ɖɔli ɖɔli, kple ga ƒe lẽdodo le nu sia nu ƒe dome. Ðoɖonu Geɖe Dome Ɣaɣla [Cross-Chain Privacy] - Ɣaɣla me ƒe ga ƒe lẽdodo to IBC dzi (Ethereum kple Solana ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu ava enumake). Ɣaɣla Ƒe Dzidzɔ Ƒe Fetuwɔwɔ Ƒe Nunana - Xɔ NAM tokens to gaɖoɖowo ɣaɣlaɣaɣla ko ta. Adzɔ Suewo - Ɣaɣla sesẽ si me zãzã ƒe bɔbɔe menɔ o. --- Dzodzro Veviwo Ɣaɣla si seseŋu wu le ɖoɖonu dzi hã ate ŋu agbã to ezãla ƒe nɔnɔme alo nu siwo le ɖoɖonu me o ta. Namada meɣlana wò tso nu siawo gbɔ O: Kakaɖedzi si me VPN alo Tor mele o (wò IP address doa ɖe go) Ɣaɣla gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo zãzã zi geɖe Nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi (matsɔ ɣaɣla na o) gaɖoɖowo wɔwɔ Wò Namada gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ƒoƒo kple social media alo wò amegbetɔ ƒe nɔnɔme le xexeme KYC gatrɔƒe siwo le amesia ame ƒe dzikpɔkpɔ te zãzã na gaɖoɖo alo gaɖeɖe --- Nɔnɔme Kɔkɔewo Na Ɣaɣla Si Seseŋu Wu Gbegbe Ƒe Gɔmeɖeɖewo Zã ɣaɣla gaɖoɖowo na wɔwɔ sia wɔwɔ. Mègazã ɣaɣla gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo na ta vovovowo o. Nàtsi ɣaɣla kple nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi ƒe nudzɔdzɔwo ƒe tsɔtsɔ ƒu le keke ɖeka me o. Nuwo Ƒe Ga Ƒe Lẽdodo Zã nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi aɖe ko na ga ƒe lẽwo siwo va ge ɖo. Ɖo nuwo ɣaɣla enumake ne woɖe ga ƒe lẽ va ge ɖo. Nàwɔ ga ƒe lẽ adzo tso Namada me vie ne wòate ŋu. MASP (Nu Geɖe Ƒe Ɣaɣla Gaƒuƒoƒo) Dzro nuwo katã ɖe MASP me le gɔmedzedze me. Bu wò MASP balans be enye wò gakotoku si tɔxɛ le ɣaɣla me. Nukpɔsafuiwo Na nukpɔsafuiwo ko amewo siwo dzi wòka ɖe blibo. Mègblɔ nukpɔsafuiwo le ame katã ƒe ŋkume alo nàtsɔ wo ade internet dzi o. Gaɖoɖo Ƒe Dzadzɛnyenye Trɔ ɣeyiɣi kple asimewo le gaɖoɖowo dome. Ƒo gaɖoɖo geɖewo ƒu ne wòate ŋu. Nàtsi ga ƒe asime blibo alo asime siwo amewo ate ŋu aka ɖe ame aɖe ŋu o. Dɔwɔwɔ Ƒe Dedienɔnɔme Zã VPN ɣesiaɣi (vevie Tor) ne nèle gakotokuwo alo dApps zãm. Mègana screenshot siwo me gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo alo balanswo le o. Zã gakotoku vovovowo na dɔwɔwɔ vovovowo (asitsɔasitsɔ, nunana, ŋutɔ ƒe zãzã). --- Ɣaɣla Ƒe Nudzodzro Didime Ɖo ɣaɣla ɖe nuwo ŋu ɣesiaɣi gbã - tsɔ nuwo ge ɖe MASP me hafi nàwɔ gaɖoɖo. Trɔ ɣaɣla gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo ɣesiaɣi na zã nyawo vovovowo. Ɖe ga ɖe ɣaɣla gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo dzi tẽ tso gatrɔƒewo me ne wòate ŋu. Trɔ gaɖoɖo ƒe ɣeyiɣi be nàtsrɔ nɔnɔme siwo amewo ate ŋu akpɔ. Zã asikplɔwo dzra mɔ na nu siwo sɔ ga geɖe. Na software nadzɔ ɣeyiɣi sia ɣeyiɣi - zã Namada client yeyeetɔ ɣesiaɣi. Ɖe wò mɔdziƒe ɖe dzidzedze me kple ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ sesẽ kple nyagblɔɖeƒe dzikpɔlawo. Kpɔ eŋu vevie ŋutɔ le metadata ƒe ɖeɖe go le dzeɖoɖo alo ŋkume ƒe logwo me ŋu. --- Ɖe Asi Kpee Ðe nɔnɔme kɔkɔe bubuwo alo nyaɖeɖe le asiwòa? Va ɖo nya le Discord dzi --- Woɖe egbe: March 2026

title: Unveiling the Dark Side: Navigating the Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) Odyssey Amidst Financial Shadows
description: In the ever shifting landscape of global finance, a new chapter is unfolding—one that raises more than a few eyebrows. Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDCs) emerge not just as protagonists but as potential agents of financial upheaval, ca
text: Dɔdzikpɔ ƒe Aƒe Mame: Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) ƒe Mɔzɔzɔ Le Gakpɔkpɔ Ƒe Vovototo Me Si ŋlɔe : [Abhishek Tiwari] Le xexeme katã ƒe gakpɔkpɔ ƒe nɔnɔme si le trɔtrɔ ɣesiaɣi me la, ta yeye aɖe le dzɔm—eye esia do ŋusẽ na amewo be woaɖe ŋku le eŋu. Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDCs) va dzɔ menye abe ŋutinyaŋlɔ̃lawo ko ene o, ke boŋ abe nu si ate ŋu awɔ gakpɔkpɔ ƒe dzedzeƒoƒo ene, eye wodo vovototo ɖe ga ƒe gɔmesese blema la ŋu, eye wɔa ɣaɣla [privacy], amekpɔmewɔwɔ, kple dutoƒe ƒe asitɔtɔ ŋu fifi. Bu xexeme aɖe si me gakpɔkpɔ ƒe gaɖoɖowo [transactions] de asiɖeɖe si mate ŋu agbɔ o ɖe digitɔl xexeme me la ŋu, xexeme si CBDCs va kplɔ va—nunana yeye siwo doa laylay na tɔtrɔ gã, ke woɖe dzesi be gakpɔkpɔ ƒe nɔnɔme vɔ̃ aɖe hã ate ŋu ava. CBDCs Ƒe Gɔmesese Mawu: Kpɔɖeŋu Le Digitɔl Avɔdzi Ƒe Megbe Le digitɔl trɔtrɔ sia ƒe titina la, CBDCs ƒe gɔmesese le, gɔmesese si, ne eɖe dzidzɔ le ame ŋu hã, hea dzesi vɔ̃wo. Bu wò dukɔ ƒe ga si trɔ zu digitɔl xexeme ƒe binary code, afi si Central Bank tsɔ eɖokui wɔ titina le gakpɔkpɔ ƒe kpɔɖeŋu si mekɔ o me. CBDCs megale pepa ga kple kɔsiwo ƒe nɔnɔme ŋu ko o, ke boŋ wozu ŋusẽ siwo le nyuie, siwo wɔa etsɔme si me ame ŋutɔ ƒe ɖeɖeɖe kple dutoƒe ƒe asitɔtɔ ƒe fifiwo le. Ke mɔzɔzɔ sia me, ame siwo medi le eŋu o le. Esi CBDCs le agbagba be woagbã mɔxewo la, biabia la va: Ɖe woe nye teƒe siwo xɔ ame katã loo, alo Trojan horses siwo gbãa gakpɔkpɔ ƒe ɣaɣla? Ame katã ƒe xɔxɔ ƒe laylay zu nu si ƒe afã eve le, esi gaɖoɖo siwo woate ŋu ado to la ƒe vovototo le tsɔtsɔm, eye wode amewo ɖe digitɔl kekeli me. Esi míele zɔzɔ le digitɔl anyigba sia dzi la, CBDCs aɖewo ɖea nunya menye ko o, ke boŋ woɖea Pandora ƒe aɖaka si me nu vɔ̃wo le hã. Wɔate ŋu awɔ contractwo, awɔ gakpɔkpɔ ƒe gaɖoɖowo le eɖokui si, eye woawɔ ɖe programmable money ƒe ha dzi. Biabia la va: Ɖe esia nye ŋgɔyiyi ƒe kekeli loo, alo dzodzo vɔ̃ aɖe yi gakpɔkpɔ ƒe anyigba si womanya o me? Kuxiwo: Zɔzɔ Le Gakpɔkpɔ Ƒe Vodada Ƒe Minefield Me Ke abe mɔzɔzɔ gã siawo katã ene la, kuxiwo sɔ gbɔ, eye vovototo siwo CBDCs wɔ la zu gã wu. Gaɖoɖowo ƒe ƒoɖoɖo kɔkɔe amea ɣaɣla ƒe gɔmesese vevie. Esi gaɖoɖowo zu nu si woate ŋu ado to la, gakpɔkpɔ ƒe amekpɔmewɔwɔ ƒe ɣeyiɣi yeye va, eye amewo zu ame siwo ate ŋu akpɔ ŋkudɔdɔ si mewobia o. Le cyber security ƒe anyigba me la, hero si womanya o zu ŋutinyaŋlɔ̃la si medi o. CBDCs ƒe gbɔgbɔkpɔkpɔ ŋu cyber ameaƒuwo zu míaƒe nya si míele gblɔm ƒe akpa aɖe. Esi míede asi digitɔl mɔzɔzɔ sia ŋu la, nu siwo le dzodzo me la xɔ asi, eye ame ŋutɔ ƒe data ƒe kpɔkpɔ zu nu vevietɔ. Eye blema bank ƒe ɖoɖowo ya? Nɔnɔme si míenya le ƒe geɖewo me la kpɔ dzedzeƒoƒo siwo ate ŋu ava, eye blema bankwo ƒe gɔmeɖoƒewo le yiyi esi CBDCs va. Esi Central Banks zu fexexe [payment] subɔsubɔ ƒe providerwo ƒe asitɔtɔtɔwo la, bankwo ate ŋu abɔ woƒe gaɖeɖe. Nenema kee, investment ƒe mɔ yeyeaɖe ate ŋu ana amesiwo ƒe depositwo bia geɖe o. Le eƒe teƒe me la, esia ate ŋu aɖe bank ƒe gadada na xexeme katã ƒe ekonomia kple ekonomi ƒe gɔmeɖeɖe. Egblẽ be nye ahatsotso le innovation kple gakpɔkpɔ ƒe madeɖeanyi ƒe vɔvɔ̃ dome, afi si nu si ava me nya o haɖe. HRF ƒe Central Bank Digital Currency Tracker si woɖe gɔme fifi la ɖea dukɔ sia dukɔ si le afɔɖeɖe ɖe CBDC ŋu fia, eye wotsɔ mɔƒe aɖe kplɔa esiawo ɖe dukɔ ma ƒe ame ƒe gomekpɔkpɔ kple dzikpɔkpɔ vɔ̃ ƒe nyawo ŋu. Esi HRF wɔ tracker la, wokpɔe be "diktatɔr dutoƒewo le kplɔm le CBDC ɖeɖe dzi." HRF bua be ame 3.7 billion – xexeme ame ƒe 46% – le diktatɔr dutoƒewo te siwo le CBDCs ƒe dodokpɔ wɔm. CBDCs le gbɔgbɔkpɔkpɔ me na elektrik ƒe tɔtɔ kple internet ƒe kadodo si mesɔ o CBDCs ƒe wɔwɔ zu míaƒe hero ƒe dɔ, mɔzɔzɔ si me tekniki, sewo, kple nuwo ƒe ɖoɖo ƒe kuxiwo le. Yɔyɔ be woawɔ digitɔl ga menye innovation ko o, ke boŋ ate ŋu anye dutoƒe ƒe asitɔtɔ kple amegbegblẽ ƒe kɔkɔe ɖe gakpɔkpɔ ƒe ɖoɖo me. title: Social Media Data Collection
description: Currently, it is difficult to find a person who is not exposed to the reach of social networks. They have become popular for their ease of use and their speed and effectiveness in spreading a message.
text: Social media ƒe nyadzɔdzɔ ƒoƒo Egbe la, xɔxɔe be nàkpɔ ame si social network ƒe ɖoɖo mekpɔ o. Wozu be ame geɖe lɔ̃ wo, elabena wozɔna bɔbɔe eye wotsɔna kabakaba kple ŋusẽ ƒoa gbeɖeɖe. Le gbɔgbɔ me la, esia ƒe bɔbɔe hã wɔ be mí, abe zazãlawo ene, mímeɖe ŋku le nyadzɔdzɔ si social media ƒe platformwo ƒoa tso mí ŋu kple nu si woate ŋu awɔ kpli o, alo nu si ame etɔ̃ vɔ̃ aɖe ate ŋu awɔ ne wòkpɔ mɔ ge ɖe eme. Azɔ la, míagblɔ nyadzɔdzɔ si platform siawo ƒoa tso mí ŋu, nu si wowɔ kpli, kple nu ka ta esia ate ŋu azu afɔku na mí ƒe ɣaɣla [privacy] kple, ɖewohĩ, míƒe ame ŋutɔ alo ƒome ƒe dedienɔnɔ. Discord ------- Ele be míadzi gɔme kple Discord elabena enye gbeɖeɖe ƒe app si mízãna "le aƒeme." Discord ɖe vi na kpekpeɖeŋu be nàkpɔ community gã aɖe le nya vovovowo ŋu, ke boŋ wòwɔ vodada abe bubu geɖe ene le míƒe ame ŋutɔ ƒe nyadzɔdzɔ ƒe vi kpɔkpɔ me. Nyadzɔdzɔ Si Discord Ɖona ɖe Le eƒe ɣaɣla ƒe ɖoɖo nu la, Discord ƒoa nyadzɔdzɔ siawo tso mí ŋu: Agbalẽ ƒe gbeɖeɖewo (kple draftwo), gbe ƒe gbeɖeɖewo, foto siwo ana be live streamwo ƒe aʋawɔwɔ nadze anyi, xɔlɔ siwo nàtsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu alo zazãla siwo kplɔ wò nàwɔ nu kpli, fefewo siwo nèle fiam, serverwo alo community siwo me wòŋlɔ ɖe, nu siwo nèle fle alo dzra to app la me, kple ŋuɖoɖo siwo nèwɔ ne nèle content kpɔm ɖe asi. Wometsɔa wò video alo wò live stream ƒe video ɖea anyi o, ke woɖe mɔ ɖi be woatrɔ ŋuɖoɖo sia le ŋgɔ. Wofɔa nyadzɔdzɔ aɖewo hã le wo ŋutɔ ƒe mɔ nu, abe IP address si dzi nèle kadom, browser si nèzãna, kple wò operating system ene. Ale Si Wozãna E Nu geɖe si wowɔ kple míƒe nyadzɔdzɔ la, ame ate ŋu akpɔ be wòle eteƒe, abe zazãla ƒe nɔnɔ nyui wɔwɔ, nɔnɔ si wotu ɖe ame ƒe hiãhiã ŋu ƒe nana, kple community ƒe sewo ƒe dzadzra ene. Ke hã, woate ŋu azã wò nyadzɔdzɔ be woado woƒe subɔsubɔwo ɖe ŋgɔ, eye woate ŋu ama eƒe aƒe aɖe na ame etɔ̃wo be woado woƒe subɔsubɔwo ɖe ŋgɔ alo woakpɔ company la ƒe tsitsi ɖa. Wogblɔ hã be woate ŋu azã nyadzɔdzɔ la be woana wo authority siawo katã si ate ŋu abiae to court ƒe se aɖe dzi. Twitter ------- Abe Discord ene la, Twitter hã ɖona nyadzɔdzɔ geɖe ɖe eƒe serverwo dzi. Ekpɔa direct messagewo, ame siwo nèkplɔna, kple ame siwo kplɔ wò nàwɔ nu kpli hã (post siwo wòɖoa ɖe asi, nu siwo nèlɔ̃), eye le nyateƒe me la, woƒe ɖoɖowo sɔ gbeɖeka, kple wò nyadzɔdzɔ mamama na ame etɔ̃wo kple authoritywo. Meta ---- Meta ƒe appwo ƒe ha, si me Facebook, Instagram, kple Threads le fifia, yi ɖe ŋgɔ wu, elabena lista si me nyadzɔdzɔ si nàna wo le la ŋu kekeake be ame mate ŋu aɖe eƒe nyawo katã ɖe eme o. Eme le wò postwo katã, kple gbe ƒe didienuwo, foto siwo nèɖe kple wò device ƒe "camera" dɔwɔwɔ alo eƒe gallery, ad siwo nèkpɔna, ɣeyiɣi si nèzãna kple wo kpɔkpɔ, eye va se ɖe esiwo nètsɔa ɖe aga o. Eme le metadata tso wò messagewo me, abe teƒe, ŋkeke, gaƒoƒo, kple device ene. Eme le ɣeyiɣi si nèzãna le app la ƒe dɔwɔwɔ vovovowo katã ŋu hã, eye ne se mele wò ƒom o la, wò subɔsubɔ ƒe xɔsewo, filosofia ƒe xɔsewo, ame siwo nèlɔ̃na kple wò sex ƒe ɖoɖo, eye va se ɖe union ƒe habɔbɔ me nɔnɔ. Ke woɖo ŋgɔ wu, to woƒe Pixel si amewo de ŋkɔ na la dzi, Meta ate ŋu anya nu si nèwɔ le Facebook ƒe gota: website siwo nèyina, ɣeyiɣi si nèzãna le wo dzi, fefe siwo nèle fiam, nu siwo nèflea, eye va se ɖe nyadzɔdzɔ siwo sɔ abe wò sukukpɔkpɔ ƒe level ene. Eye hã, nyadzɔdzɔ siwo ku ɖe wò device ƒe teknik me, abe IP address, operating system, browser, kple bubuwo ene, ne wòɖo ɖe Facebook me alo mèɖo ɖe eme o. Nu Ka Ta Melesi Be Maxɔ Ʌe? ------------------ "Menye nu aɖeke si matso ɖeɖe" nye nya si amewo gblɔna tsã be woagblẽ nyadzɔdzɔ sia katã ƒe vevi si platform siawo ƒoa tso mí ŋu la. Ke hã, ne nu si nèle wɔm mele se vɔ̃ o la, nyateƒeɖeɖe nyuiwo li be nàxɔ nublanui na nu si company siawo nya tso wò ŋu. Political activist aɖe ate ŋu akpɔ veve gã ne organization sesẽ aɖe si wòtsɔa eɖokui ɖe anyi tsɔa nu si wòwɔna be enye "nu vɔ̃" eye wobia nyadzɔdzɔ tso ame sia ŋu le company siawo dometɔ aɖe gbɔ, si woana kplɔkplɔ manɔmee. title: Tracking Early On-chain & Social Signals for Zcash (ZEC)
description: This research article analyzes how early on chain signals for Zcash, especially whale movements and social sentiment signals on platforms like X have important implications on the momentum of ZEC. Zcash is a privacy focused cryptocurrency d
text: Ɖoɖonu Dzi [On-chain] Kple Hamea ƒe Dzesi Gbãtɔwo ƒe Ŋkuléle na Zcash (ZEC) Gɔmedzedze Nunyaŋlɔɖi sia le eme be wòle dzodzro wɔm tso ɖoɖonu dzi [on-chain] dzesi gbãtɔwo ƒe nu, na Zcash, vevietɔ tɔxɛwo ƒe zɔzɔ kple hamea ƒe susu dzesiwo le mɔwo dzi abe X ene, siwo wɔnɔa ŋusẽ gã aɖe ɖe ZEC ƒe dzodzro dzi. Zcash nye crypto ga si ɣaɣla [privacy] le eme, eye wòdze Bitcoin ƒe code ƒe gɔme, kple eƒe yame tɔxɛ vevi si nye ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ [encryption] ƒe ledger si wotsɔ zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛwo [proofs] kpe ɖe eŋu. Messari ZEC Ɖoɖowo ƒuƒopé [Dashboard] kple X me ƒe dzeɖeɖeawo ƒe dzodzro nye dɔwɔnu [tools] si wozãna be woakpɔe be Zcash ƒe zɔzɔ gãwo ɖe ka kple tweet geɖe kple amewo ƒe dzidzɔ ɖe internet dzi. Nusi bubu siwo hia lae nye ale si Zcash ƒe hamea ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo, abe gakotokuwo [wallets], nudzɔdzɔwo kple mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔla [developer] ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ene, wɔnɔa ŋusẽ ɖe Zcash ƒe zɔzɔ le asime dzi. Wole ZEC ƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo siwo va yi la ŋkɔm hã eye wonoa tsitre kple ɣaɣla ga bubuwo; ale si ame vovovowo kple asitsotsoƒewo wɔnɔa esia dzi kple woƒe dzixɔse le eme la naa nɔnɔme na asime ƒe zɔzɔwo. Menye ɖe amegbe bubuwo ƒe ZEC ƒe asiga ƒe nudzɔdzɔ ɖe nutome o alo be woawɔ nyagblɔɖi bɔbɔe o, ke boŋ dzesiwo ƒe dzodzro gbãtɔ be woafia dzidzɔ si le dzidzɔm, tɔtrɔ gãwo alo hamea ƒe dɔwɔwɔ hafi amehawo akpɔ wo. Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu [blockchain] ƒe mɔ̃nana wɔa dɔ le mɔ yeyee me, eye dɔwɔwɔwo le crypto ga me naa nusrɔ̃ɖi si dzi. Tso ale si gaɖoɖowo [transactions] wɔna va se ɖe ale si wɔnaa tɔtrɔ gãwo le asime ƒe nɔnɔme kple amewo ƒe susu me la, womate ŋu asrɔ asime ƒe dzodzro nyuiwo; gaƒoƒo kple gaɖeɖe ƒe nusrɔ̃ɖiwo nye nusi amewo kpɔna kple wo ŋutɔ woƒe ŋkuwo. Ɖoɖonu dzi ƒe metriksi gbãtɔwo le dɔwɔwɔ me nye dzesi gbãtɔwo kple metriksi ŋusẽtɔwo dome, si fiaa asime ƒe mɔ kple zɔzɔ, kple asigaɖola ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo kple tɔtrɔ siwo ate ŋu ava le crypto xexeame me enumake. Azɔ hã, ne wokpɔ dzesi siawo le ɣeyiɣi nyui me la, wòate ŋu akpe ɖe asigaɖolawo ŋu be woaxɔ vi, vevietɔ ne wotsɔ wo kpe ɖe ɖoɖonu me menɔ [off-chain] nuwo abe hamea ƒe media me susu dzodzro ene ŋu. Le Messari ZEC Ɖoɖowo ƒuƒopé nu, Coin Metrics kple Blockchair, ZEC ƒe network dɔwɔwɔ ƒe dzodzro naa numeɖeɖe si wòate ŋu wɔe be woakpɔe be tɔxɛwo ƒe zɔzɔ gãwo ɖe ka kple hamea ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ƒe keke le tweet ƒe xexlẽ kple dzidzɔ le internet dzi. Tɔtrɔtɔe la, Messari ƒe chartwo fiaa dzedze gã le gaɖoɖo ƒe xexlẽ le ɖoɖonu dzi kple gatrɔƒe [exchange] ƒe ga gege le ŋkeke sia ŋkeke me tso July 1 va se ɖe 22, 2025, eye wòva se ɖe eƒe dzidzenu le July 22; eya de ɣeyiɣi ma ke me kple hamea ƒe dzeɖeɖe kple asiga ƒe zɔzɔ. Blockchair ƒe data fia be ZEC si le ɣaɣla gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo me ƒe akpa dzi tso 18 % kple 20 % le ɣeyiɣi ma me, si fia be amewo le ɣaɣla [privacy] ƒe gaɖoɖowo zãm geɖe. (Kpɔ Nɔnɔnɔ 1) Nɔnɔnɔ 1. ZEC Ƒe Akpa Si Le Ɣaɣla Gaɖoƒe Ƒe Dzesiwo Me - July 2025 (Dzɔɖoƒe: Blockchair (2025). Ɣaɣla ƒe supply ƒe percentage na July 1-22, 2025.) Azɔ hã, Coin Metrics ƒe dukɔ network ƒe serieswo ɖe gbeɖe be gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi siwo wɔ dɔ le ŋkeke sia ŋkeke me kple ɣaɣla-supply ƒe metriksiwo katã dzedza yi dzi le July ƒe titina, si na wòate ŋu anoe tsitre ɖe ɖoɖonu dzi ƒe nɔnɔme kple hamea ƒe dzesiwo ŋu le xexlẽ me. title: ZIP 218: Nu siwo Gaɖoɖowo Ƒuƒoƒe Ƒe Sekondi 25 Ƒe Ɣeyiɣi Trɔna Ŋutɔ

text: ZIP 218: Nu siwo Gaɖoɖowo Ƒuƒoƒe Ƒe Sekondi 25 Ƒe Ɣeyiɣi Trɔna Ŋutɔ Le NU7 gaƒeɖila ƒe akɔɖeɖe si wòwu le 14 September 2026 la me, ame 2,397,669 ZEC kloe na ZIP 218, eye ame 141.6 ZEC kloe ɖe eŋu, si nye 99.9% ƒe nuxɔxɔ. Nyadzɔdzɔ geɖe ɖo eŋu kple nya sia: "Zcash gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe [blocks] wɔna kabakaba." Esia nye nyateƒe, gake eɖe nu geɖe si ɖoɖo sia wɔna kple nu geɖe si wòle be wòanɔ ale kee la ɖa. Axa sia me ɖe ZIP 218 ƒe gɔme le eŋutɔ ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ me: nu si trɔna, nu si menɔa trɔm o, kple nɔnɔme si wòxɔna. Nya kpui aƒe tata Egbe Le ZIP 218 megbe --- --- --- Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe Ɣeyiɣi ƒe taɖodzinu Sekondi 75 Sekondi 25 Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe le ŋkeke ɖeka me 1,152 3,456 Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu (fetu ƒe afãmama [halving] ƒe ɣeyiɣi si li fifia) 1.5625 ZEC 0.52083333 ZEC ZEC yeye le ŋkeke ɖeka me Metɔ o Metɔ o Fetu ƒe afãmama ƒe mama Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 1,680,000 Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 5,040,000 Ɣaɣla [shielded] nudzɔdzɔwo ƒe katã si ate ŋu anɔ gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ɖeka me Aɖeke mele o (2 MB ƒe lolome ƒe se koe li) Katã 330, kple gaƒuƒoƒo siawo ƒe sewo Orchard ƒe nudzɔdzɔ ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ (gaɖoɖo si me nudzɔdzɔ 2 le) Ƒo abe 2.9 le sekondi ɖeka me ene Ƒo abe 6.6 le sekondi ɖeka me ene Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe teƒe etɔ̃e sɔgbɔ, eye ɖeka ɖe sia ɖe xɔ fetu ƒe akpa etɔ̃ lia. Gaƒe ƒe ɖoɖo nɔ teƒe si wònɔ ɖaa. Nu ka ta woatrɔ gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe ɣeyiɣi Ta vevitɔtɔe nye lalaɣeyiɣi ƒe ɖeɖe kpui. Egbe, fexexe [payment] ɖeka lana sekondi 75 le avɔme be wòaxɔ eƒe kpeɖeŋu gbãtɔ, network ƒe kɔkɔme menye nu o. Le sekondi 25 me la, esia ɖea ɖe sekondi 25 le avɔme. ZIP yɔ afi si woƒlea nu, gatrɔƒe [exchange] ƒe gaɖekpɔkpɔwo kple ɖoɖonu geɖe dome [cross-chain] ga ƒe lẽwo [bridges] be wonye nusiwo sese esia wu. Nu eve si tso ZIP me hia be nàɖo ŋku edzi: Emegblɔ be ame aɖeke nana kpeɖeŋu vɛvi o. Na zazãlawo siwo le wɔnɔƒe ma ke le nuɖeɖe megbe trɔtrɔ ƒe afɔku ŋu abe egbe ene la, ZIP bua be kpeɖeŋu ƒe ɣeyiɣi nanyo dze le etɔ̃ te vɛ. Menye teƒeɖeɖe na nuwuwu ƒe dɔ o. ZIP ƒo eɖokui be wòle dɔ wɔm kple nuwuwu ƒe mɔwo abe Crosslink ene. Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe siwo wɔna kabakaba le gɔmeɖoƒe me kpena ɖeŋu, ne woatsɔ nuwuwu ƒe akpa aɖe kpe ɖe eŋu emegbe alo o. ZIP hã gblɔ be wònye be woate ŋu akpɔ nudzɔdzɔ ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ dzɔtɔ kple gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe lolome gãtɔ. Lalaɣeyiɣi tae woatia gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe siwo ɣeyiɣi kpui. Nu siwo trɔna Gaƒe tata: ZEC nenɔ te le ŋkeke ɖeka me Ne gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe nọmba teƒe etɔ̃e la, gaƒe tata le ŋkeke ɖeka me ate ŋu ateƒe etɔ̃e ne nu bubu aɖeke metɔ o. ZIP 218 ƒoa nu ma tɔ le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ɖeka ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu mama le etɔ̃ me bubu ne NU7 dze egɔme. Le fetu ƒe afãmama ƒe ɣeyiɣi si li fifia me la, esia trɔ gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu tso 1.5625 ZEC yi 0.52083333 ZEC (zatoshi 52,083,333). Esi zatoshi 156,250,000 mate ŋu mama nyuie le etɔ̃ me o ta la, gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ɖeka ɖe sia ɖe ƒe xexlẽna ɖea ɖe zatoshi ƒe akpa etɔ̃. Le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 5,040,000 ƒe fetu ƒe afãmama ƒe mama blibo me la, esia nye ZEC 0.0168 le katã me. Kpekpeɖeŋu la nye ZEC yeye katã si wowɔna le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ɖeka me. Woɖea ŋgɔɖoɖo ƒe gaɖeɖe ƒe akpa si li xoxo la tso eŋu hã, eya ta nukulawo [miners] xɔa ga si le xexlẽ bliboa nu vɛ, abe ale si wònɔ egbe ene. Nya aɖe tso ZEC 0.26041666 ƒe xexlẽ ŋu. ZIP ƒe ɖoɖo gbãtɔ ƒe gɔmeɖeɖe ƒe nyagblɔdzedze la ŋlɔ kpekpeɖeŋu si le NU7 megbe be enye floor(156250000 / 6) = 0.26041666 ZEC, eye nyadzɔdzɔ aɖewo gblɔ esia hã. Nyagblɔdzedze ma menyo o le eve ƒe asime: zatoshi 156,250,000 nye kpekpeɖeŋu si le Blossom megbe xoxo, eyata mama le ade me wɔa Blossom ƒe eve ƒe asime teƒe bubu le NU7 ƒe etɔ̃ ƒe asime ŋu. Mɔɖoɖo si nye se la na floor(1,250,000,000 / (2 · 3 · 4)) = zatoshi 52,083,333 le fetu ƒe afãmama ƒe index si li fifia. Zebra ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ƒe nya tso tɔtrɔ sia ŋu (#11463) ƒoa nyagblɔdzedze la be wòbua Blossom ƒe asime le zi eve, eye wògblɔ na dɔwɔlawo be "wɔ mɔɖoɖo la, menye nyagblɔdzedze la o," eye wògblɔ be woɖo nuɖɔɖɔ ɖe ZIP ŋu. Xexlẽ nyuitɔ le dɔwɔwɔ ƒe gɔmedzedze nye 0.52083333 ZEC. Fetu ƒe afãmamawo ƒe ɣeyiɣi menɔa trɔm o Fetu ƒe afãmama ƒe mama ateƒe etɔ̃e ts

text: Zero Knowledge Asset Ƒe Nudzraƒewo Firn Protocol: Firn nye zero-knowledge ɣaɣla [privacy] ƒe nudzraƒe gbãtɔ kpɔ be wòdoe le account-based model me, eye wòtsɔ ɣaɣla si wòate ŋu atsɔ akplɔe ɖe Ethereum-based chains dzi. Ne woza zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛ [proofs] la, Firn naa ga ƒe ɣaɣla dedie, si wòate ŋu awɔ dɔ nyuie na Ethereum kple Ethereum-based L2s ƒe zazãlawo. ALEKE WÒWƆA DƆE? Bena nàzã Firn la, de ETH ɖe protocol la me. Ne èxɔ Firn ƒe balance la vɔ, àte ŋu aɖo ga ɖe Firn zazãlawo gbɔ le ɣaɣla me, alo nàwɔ dɔ kple protocol bubuwo abe Uniswap ene. Àte ŋu ahã nanɔ ga la ɖe network la me le ɣaɣla me. Firn bia adzɔ [fee] sue aɖe, 0.79%, le ETH ƒe hehe katã dzi. Ðo wò asikplɔ-dzralá [non-custodial] RAILGUN Wallet ɖe ɖoɖo me, tsɔ ERC-20 token aɖeke ɖe ɣaɣla me ɖe 0zk gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi [address] si nètsɔ wɔ wò ŋutɔ dzi. Ne wode tokenwo ɖe ɣaɣla me vɔ la, tokenwo, balancewo, kple gaɖoɖowo woŋlɔ wo ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ [encryption] me - Whitepaper StarkEX: Wònye Layer-2 nu ƒe dziyiyi [scalability] ƒe mɔ̃, si le dɔ wɔm le Ethereum Mainnet dzi. Wotsɔ gaɖoɖowo ɖe ƒuƒoƒo me le ɖoɖonu [chain] la me o, eye womeda wo ɖe StarEX ƒe subɔsubɔwo gbɔ. StarEX kpɔ gaɖoɖowo kple balance siwo hiã la ɖa, eye wometrɔ balance si le eme la; wòwɔ STARK ɖaseɖigbalɛwo tso gaɖoɖo la ƒe nyateƒenyenye me. Mɔ̃ŋlɔ ƒe dɔwɔwɔ si kpɔa nu le ɖoɖonu dzi xɔ STARK ɖaseɖigbalɛ la eye wòkpe ɖe edzi - Whitepaper Manta Network: Ɣaɣla le ɖoɖonu dzi na Web 3, DeFi kple bubuwo. Manta Atlantic, ZK L1 ɖoɖonu si le duƒo wu, tsɔ ɣaɣla si wòate ŋu woaprogram ɖe web3 dzi to ɣaɣla kple ame ƒe dzesi si sɔ kple se le ɖoɖonu dzi. $MANTA ƒe xexlẽme ƒo 1,000,000,000 teƒe ɖeka, eye womeɖo ɖe eƒe dzidzime ƒe ɣeyiɣi aɖeke ɖo o. Wotɔ $MANTA tokenwo dzo enumake ne wotrɔ wo - Whitepaper Boltz: Boltz nye Layer 2 ƒe ɖoɖo. Boltz nye bitcoin gatrɔƒe [exchange] si tsɔa ɣaɣla ɖe ŋgɔ, eye menye asikplɔ-dzralá o; wodze eyɔ be wòaɖe sɔɖeɖe tso Bitcoin ƒe layer vovovowo abe liquid kple lightning network ene dome. Kple Boltz, zazãlawo ate ŋu awɔ woƒe bitcoin ɖɔli ɖɔli [swap] le layerwo dome bɔbɔe. Boltz Swaps menye asikplɔ-dzralá o, esia ta zazãlawo ate ŋu akpɔ dzidzɔ be woƒe bitcoin le woƒe asi blibo le ɖɔli ɖɔli ƒe mɔkatã me Whitepaper ShadeProtocol: Shade Protocol nye layer-2 ƒe DeFi dɔwɔwɔwo ƒe ƒuƒoƒo siwo do ƒome kple wo nɔewo, eye wodze wo le Secret Network dzi be woakpɔ ɣaɣla ɖe dzi. Dɔwɔwɔ vevi siawoe nye stablecoins, dziɖuɖu [governance], ga si wode ɖe asi [bonds], ga ƒuƒoƒo [staking] ƒe derivatives, insurance, synthetics, lending, DEXs, kple bubuwo - [Whitepaper] PantherProtocol: Wònye zero-knowledge, protocol geɖewo ƒe layer si le wò ɖoɖonu dzi ƒe nyatakakawo ɣaɣlam eye wòna mɔ be nàge ɖe DeFi me le mɔ si sɔ kple se me. title: Ɣaɣla ƒe tsitsitsi sɔkɔ: Nu si ɣaɣla ƒe ɣɔɣlɔnu ene wɔ ƒe ŋugbe le
description: Woɖe article sia tso Proof Street, si nye nyadzɔdzɔ si le eɖokui ŋutɔ me, eye wòtsɔ ɣaɣla ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu me dɔwɔwɔ ku ɖe ZK, FHE, MPC, TEEs, kple ametsitsi ƒe…
text: Ɣaɣla ƒe tsitsitsi sɔkɔ: Nu si ɣaɣla ƒe ɣɔɣlɔnu ene wɔ ƒe ŋugbe le Woɖe article sia tso Proof Street, si nye nyadzɔdzɔ si le eɖokui ŋutɔ me, eye wòtsɔ ɣaɣla ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu me dɔwɔwɔ ku ɖe ZK, FHE, MPC, TEEs, kple ametsitsi ƒe dzesi si womekpɔna o ŋu. Wodo eɖe go gbã le "Ɣaɣla ƒe tsitsitsi sɔkɔ: Nu si ɣaɣla ƒe ɣɔɣlɔnu ene wɔ ƒe ŋugbe le" le August 12, 2026. Wòkplɔe va le ŋlɔla la ƒe mɔɖeɖe nu abe Zcash Community Grant #339 ƒe akpa ene. Stephen Webber ƒe nuŋlɔe. --- Le July ƒe mamlɛa me, Zama dze ɣaɣla ɖɔli ɖɔli ƒe teƒe dzi le Ethereum mainnet, le private beta me hafi woaɖe eƒe public launch le September me. Esia na asitsalawo ŋutɔwo ŋu wɔ be woana intent si woɣlaŋlɔ, si ɣla ga ƒe home, slippage ƒe mɔɖeɖe, kple ɖɔli ɖɔli la ƒe afɔku. Etsɔ dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɖoɖo sue aɖe wɔ esia. Asitsala la de ɣaɣla gaɖoɖo eve, ɖeka tsɔ asset siwo ŋutɔ wòle, eye bubu la le afɔku si to vovo me kple ga 0, ale be ame si kpɔ nu la akpɔ ɣaɣla ƒe ga si ƒe home womekpɔna le afɔku eve me, eye mate ŋu aka nu si nye nuƒle alo nuƒleɖe o. Market maker siwo woɖo ɖe agbalẽ me la ɖe intent la ƒe ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ ɖe, wokpɔ home la, gake womakpɔ afɔku la o, eye wona quote le afɔku eve siaa. Sealed-bid auction aɖe wɔnɔ ɖoɖonu dzi, eye maker si xɔ dzi la koe nya afɔku si ɖɔli ɖɔli la to. Nu si do tso eme le ƒuƒoƒo me nye ɖɔli ɖɔli si wowɔ le home me le ɖoɖonu si ame katã kpɔa, afi si ame aɖeke si mele asitsalawo dome o mate ŋu aƒo nɔnɔme blibo la katã nu o. Zama yɔ product la be ɣaɣla si tso gɔmedzedze yi nuwuwu, gake nu kae ɣaɣla sia gɔmeɖeɖe nye ŋutɔ? Ɣaɣla le afi sia hia be ɣaɣla nanɔ dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɖoɖo blibo la katã me, ale be ame katã akpɔ nu ɖeka, bidders si womexɔ o nakpɔ nu geɖe, elabena woɖe asitsala la ƒe home ƒe ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ ɖe be woate ŋu ana quote na e, eye bidder si xɔ dzi nakpɔ nu geɖe wu. Ne woagblɔe kpuie la, ɖoɖo la ƒe akpa siaa le nenema elabena ame aɖe wɔ tsɔtsɔme tso ame si hia be wanya nu ka kple ɣe ka me ŋu. Enyo be míatsɔ ɣaɣla aƒo nu le "ameaɖeke mekpena nu aɖeke o" me, gake nu aɖeke manɔ dɔwɔm le agbe me o. Ele be woaɖo ɣaɣla ɖe ɖoɖo me, eye wòate ɖoɖo aɖe yome. Nu si wɔnɔ nyuie lae nye be ƒoƒo ƒe ƒuƒo 10 hafi launch ma, Zcash de ɣaɣla ƒe settlement layer gbã le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu si ame katã kpɔa dzi, eye wòzã zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛwo be wòaɣla ame si dɔ ga, ame si xɔe, kple gaɖoɖo ƒe home, le esime wòfia ame katã be gaɖoɖo la le eteƒe. Ƒe 10 si va yi la me, "ɣaɣla" trɔ zu nyagblɔɖila na technology ƒome ene le ɣeyiɣi ma me: ɣaɣla gaɖoɖowo, fully homomorphic encryption, multi-party computation, kple trusted execution environments. Product siwo tsoa ƒome ene siawo katã me le dɔwɔm fifia le production me, eye wo dometɔ aɖewo le ɖoɖonu ma ke dzi. Eya ta, nu kae le tin la me? Ƒome ene siawo hena ɖoɖo vovovo, eye ɣeaɖewo woƒe ŋu wɔ ɖeka hã, na kuxi vovovo ene. Esi ɖoɖo siaa le vaa abe product ene fifia ta la, dɔ vevi ŋutɔ lae nye be nànya kuxi kae ŋutɔ wòle asiwò. Nu kae ɣaɣla ƒe claim aɖe fia? Ɣaɣla ƒe claim siaa, ne nèɖe eƒe awuwo katã ɖa la, ele be wòɖo ŋu ŋutɔ na biabia ene. Data kae woɣla? Tso ame ka gbɔ? Le data la ƒe agbe ƒe akpa kae me? Eye nu kae wòle be woaxɔ dzi be ŋugbe la nanɔ anyi? Abe kpɔɖeŋu ene la, kpɔ ɖɔli ɖɔli ƒe teƒe la. Ele be wòaɣla home, afɔku, kple slippage. Nu ka ta menye asset pair o? Zama gblɔ be version si ava megbe aɣla esia hã. Tso ame ka gbɔ: tso ame katã kple front-running bots gbɔ bliboe, tso market makers siwo le quote nam gbɔ le akpa aɖe me, eye tso maker si xɔ dzi la gbɔ le akpa sue aɖe ko me. Le akpa kae me: to quote nana kple auction me, kple nufiafia si woɖo ɖe eŋu le settlement me. Eye ame si nèle be nàxɔ dzi la: ŋugbe la ƒe nɔnɔ le FHE ŋutɔ dzi, le smart contractwo dzi, kple threshold key-management system aɖe dzi si ƒe operators mele be woanɔ ƒome ɖeka me wu threshold aɖe o. Abe ale si litepaper la gblɔe ene la, ame ɖeka ko ate ŋu akpɔ decryption keys o. Esia nye ɖoɖo aɖe be woawɔ dɔ kple home le strategy ƒe ɖeɖe go manɔe o. title: Aleke Zcash do ŋgɔ le nyatakaka tɔxɛ ɣaɣla me, kple nu siwo gale
description: Wo trɔ agbalẽ sia tso Proof Street, nyadzɔdzɔ si le eɖokui dzi eye wòle akpa na ɣaɣla me nɔnɔ ƒe ƒeɖeɖewɔwɔ: ZK, FHE, MPC, TEEs, kple ameƒe dzesi ha nuɖo agni…
text: Aleke Zcash do ŋgɔ le nyatakaka tɔxɛ ɣaɣla me, kple nu siwo gale Wo trɔ agbalẽ sia tso Proof Street, nyadzɔdzɔ si le eɖokui dzi eye wòle akpa na ɣaɣla me nɔnɔ ƒe ƒeɖeɖewɔwɔ: ZK, FHE, MPC, TEEs, kple ameƒe dzesi ha nuɖo agni. Wo do eɖe go gbãtɔ abe "Aleke Zcash do ŋgɔ le nyatakaka tɔxɛ ɣaɣla me, kple nu siwo gale" le September 7, 2026. Wo trɔe va afi sia kple ŋlɔla la ƒe mɔɖeɖe abe akpa si le Zcash Community Grant #339 me ene. Stephen Webber ŋlɔe. --- Le Zcash me la, nukpɔsafui [viewing key] dea mɔ na konto ƒe tɔ na wòafia ɣaɣla gaɖoɖo [transaction] ƒe ŋutinya na ame si wòtia. Safuiwo nya eye zãla ƒe asi me wole. Nuwo ƒe tutuwo kple politika ƒe akpɔla siwo gale dɔ wɔm be woana woawɔ dɔ le sɛ̃ɖeɖe ƒe mɔnu siwo ate ŋu azãe me. --- Le August 17 la, Zcash Community Grants ƒe komiti va ƒo ƒu be woakpɔ abɔbɔ si woyɔ be Shielded Compliance Bridge. Deborah Olaboye, ame si kpena ɖe open-source dzi eye wò ƒe dɔwo me la, Ethereum ƒe execution-specs ƒe nudzraɖoƒe hã le eme, wɔ akpɔkpɔdɔ si xɔ unified full viewing key, le compact gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe [block] wo me le testnet indexer ŋu, eye wòtsɔ "compliance reference" le Zcash nya kpui [memo] ƒe akpa me, si doa ɣaɣla transfer kple Travel Rule ƒe nyatakaka si mele ɖoɖonu dzi la ƒo. Ebia ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu [grant] be wòawu dɔa nu, gake komitia megbe o. Nya si woɖo ta nye be sɛ̃ɖeɖe ƒe kadodo ƒe mɔnuwo tso gatrɔƒe [exchange] alo dukɔ ƒe ha si azã wo la ƒe nɔnɔ me, be Ðoɖoɖo common aɖeke meli si woawɔ dɔ ɖe dzi o, eye be ne hadɔwɔƒe aɖeke mebia dɔwɔnu [tools] la o la, ame geɖe maxɔe o. Ƒoƒo ma ke megbe abɔbɔ bubuwo hã o le susu mawo ta, ɖeka na "programmable nyatakaka tɔxɛ ɣaɣla" virtual machine, kple ɣaɣla kple dzideƒo ƒe architecture ƒe framework, si me US ƒe se ƒe nya ƒe anyigbatata le. Ke hã, tsɔtsɔ siawo menye dzesi be ame aɖeke medi esia o. Ne wòkpɔ wo kple ƒe blibo la ƒe nu bubuwo katã la, eƒe gɔme nye nu vovo. Binance bia nu le protocol ƒe keke me le 2024 eye wòxɔ ZIP le ƒe ma ke me. Gemini wɔ ɣaɣla withdrawals le se ƒe kpɔkpɔ te tso 2020 me. Ecosystem la ɖo Washington politika ƒe ha aɖe le June, eye wòɖo dukɔme kadodo ƒe fiẽƒe aɖe le August. Nu si komitia gblɔ, le nyateƒe me la, nye be woŋlɔ hiãhiã la meko abe dɔɖaɖa si ame aɖe ate ŋu awɔ dɔ ɖe dzi ene hafi o. Aleke ɖoɖoa wɔ dɔe ɣaɣla Zcash gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi [address] aɖe le gazazãsafui [spending key] aɖe ƒe kpɔkpɔ te. Wohe nukpɔsafuiwo tso eya me, siwo ate ŋu axlẽ gaɖoɖo ƒe nyatakakawo ne womeate ŋu awɔ ga ƒe yiyiyi o. Full viewing key kpɔ konto la ƒe gaɖoɖowo siwo va eme kple siwo do go, incoming viewing key kpɔ ga siwo woxɔ ko, eye outgoing viewing key dea mɔ na dɔla be wòagbugbɔ axɔ nu si wòdɔ ɖa. Tso ZIP 316 me la, woƒo esiawo katã ƒu le unified viewing keys me, full ɖeka kple incoming ɖeka, siwo kpɔa konto ɖeka ko, afi si konto nye nɔƒe le gakotoku [wallet] ƒe safui ƒe ati me le ZIP 32 te. Unified full viewing key ƒoa gaƒuƒoƒo [pool] ɖe gaƒuƒoƒo ƒe akpawo katã na ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo sia sia si konto la zã, eye konto la ƒe nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi [transparent] extended public key hã le esi me, eyata be ne wòmama ɖeka la, ekpɔa transparent ɖoɖonu [chain] la kple ɣaɣla ƒe ŋutinya la hã. Le ɖeɖe sia me la, nukpɔsafui nye nu si wɔa dɔ ɖe megbe. Exɔa konto la ƒe ŋutinya katã ƒe ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ [encryption] tso afã si wo wɔ konto la, eye womeate ŋu axɔe gbɔ o ne wòmama, negbe be woatsɔ ga la ayi konto yeye me. Gaɖoɖo ɖeka ƒe nukpɔsafui aɖeke mele o, eye nusi ƒe ɣeyiɣi wode se na hã mele o. Josh Swihart, chief executive na ZODL, company si wo wɔ le ƒe sia me tso protocol la ƒe ECC engineering team ƒe amewo me, ɖe esia ƒe nyateƒe kpe ɖe, eye wògblɔ hã be payment ɖeka ƒe nyatakaka ɖeɖe "womewɔe le afi aɖeke o." zcashd, reference ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ [node] gbãtɔ, do RPC mɔnu eve ɖe go, zgetpaymentdisclosure kple zvalidatepaymentdisclosure, siwo dea mɔ na dɔla be wòaɖe fexexe [payment] ɖeka fia na ame etɔ̃. title: Nu Ka Nye Tsitreɖoɖo Ƒomevi Ɖaseɖigbalɛ?
description: Ame siwo wòŋlɔ na: Ame siwo wɔ dzeɖoɖo gbãtɔ. Womedi mathematics, mɔ̃ɖaŋlɔ̃ alo cryptography ƒe nyanya ŋgɔ o.
text: Nu Ka Nye Tsitreɖoɖo Ƒomevi Ɖaseɖigbalɛ? Ale si nàɖo ɖase be mɔ̃ɖaŋlɔ̃ ƒe wɔwɔ le nyuie, eye menye be nèle mɔ kpɔm ko o Series: Tsitreɖoɖo Ƒomevi Ɖaseɖigbalɛ Ƒe Series · Akpa 1 le 3 me Ame siwo wòŋlɔ na: Ame siwo wɔ dzeɖoɖo gbãtɔ. Womedi mathematics, mɔ̃ɖaŋlɔ̃ alo cryptography ƒe nyanya ŋgɔ o. Nu si nàdzo kplee: Nyagɔme fɛfɛ si ana nàse nyuie nu si wònye be wòaɖo ɖase be software le nyuie, nu ka ta esia to vovo tso dodokpɔ tso gɔme, nu si nye machine-checked ɖaseɖigbalɛ, kple teƒe siwo dzi ɖase ma ate ŋu adzɔ ɖaa hã. Woxɔ se na software geɖe elabena wodoe kpɔ: míetsɔe wɔ dɔ kple emenyawo geɖe eye míekpɔ ale si wɔa nu. Tsitreɖoɖo ƒomevi Ɖaseɖigbalɛ [Formal verification] bia biabia si sesẽ wu. Miate ŋu aɖo ɖase, kple mathematics ƒe kaɖedzi bliboa, be system a wɔ nu si wòle be wòawɔ na emenu siawo katã si ate ŋu anɔ anyi, hã esiwo ame aɖeke mebu be yeadɔ kpɔ o? Nuŋɔŋlɔ sia atu susu ma tso gɔmedzeƒe. Gɔmesese gbã, dzesi aɖeke va se ɖe esi woɖo ƒe xa. --- Nu ka ta ele be nàxɔe ƒe gbe? Esia nye nya si dzɔ vavã, eye eyae nye ta si ta series sia li. Le 2022 me, ɣaɣla-crypto ga Zcash ɖe gaƒuƒoƒo ɣaɣla yeye aɖe si woyɔ be Orchard kpe, si na ameawo wɔ asitsɔtsɔ kple gaƒe siwo woɣla. Ƒe ene megbe la, eƒe dɔ wɔ nyuie fũ, eye wodo professional audit geɖe kpɔe. Ke le May 2026 me la, dedienyawo ƒe nudzɔdzɔla aɖe si bu susu nyuie tso mathematics si le te la ŋu (kple kpekpeɖeŋu si tso AI dɔwɔnuwo gbɔ) kpɔ teƒe ɖeka si womeɖo nudzraɖoɖo de eme akpa blibo o le system a ƒe mathematics me. Teƒe ɖeka ma ate ŋu ana atacatɔ aɖe wɔ ga maɖiɖi si meɖoɖo aɖeke mele o, eye elabena woɣla gaƒeawo la, ame aɖeke mate ŋu akpɔe be edzɔ o. Vodada la nɔ afi ma le ɣeyiɣi bliboa me. Womekpɔe to dodokpɔ me o. Dodokpɔ siawo katã va yi nyuie le ƒe ene me. Ame aɖe bu susu tso mathematics la ŋu he kpɔe. Eye esi team la trɔe la, womede patch de eme ko eye wodzo o. Woŋlɔ machine-checked mathematics ƒe ɖaseɖigbalɛ, si ƒe theorem 2,700 kple afɔ aɖe, be nusɔɔ yeye la mate ŋu anɔ vodada ƒomevi ma o. Eyae nye tsitreɖoɖo ƒomevi ɖaseɖigbalɛ, eye esiae wòna wò: menye "mído dzesi geɖe kpɔ eye wowɔ dɔ" o, ke boŋ "míeɖo ɖase be ewɔ dɔ na dzesi siawo katã." Na system siwo me dzesi ɖeka si womekpɔ o ate ŋu ana gbegblẽ gã ava (ga, dzikpɔlawo, kɔkɔe dɔwɔnuwo, cryptography), vovototo sia nye nu katã. Edsger Dijkstra, computer scientist, yɔ teƒe si dodokpɔ mete ŋu akpɔ o ƒe ŋkɔ xoxotɔ, eye eganye vavã va se egbe: Dodokpɔ ate ŋu afi vodada ƒe nɔnɔ fia, ke wòmate ŋu afi woƒe manganɔnɔ fia gbeɖe o. Ne dodokpɔ aɖe yi nyuie la, nèsrɔ be system la wɔ dɔ le emenu ma dzi. Mesrɔ naneke tso emenyawo siwo mèdo kpɔ o ŋu o, eye vodada vɔ̃wo le dzesi siwo ame aɖeke medo kpɔ o me zi geɖe. --- Gɔmesese: Aƒe ƒe agbo dodokpɔ kple aƒe bliboa ƒe ɖaseɖoɖo Bu be wòe nye ame si kpɔa aƒe gã aɖe si ƒe agbo akpe le ŋu, eye wòƒe dɔe nye be nàɖo kpeɖeŋu be agbo siawo katã ƒo le zã me. Dodokpɔ ƒe mɔ: Zɔ le afi sia kple afi sia eye nàdo agbo aɖewo kpɔ. Do agbo blaene, alafa, alo alafa atɔ̃ kpɔ. Agbo siawo katã si nèdo kpɔ la ƒo, eyata wòƒe kaɖedzi ƒoa nu. Ke mèdo wo katã kpɔ o, eye agbo si meƒo o la ate ŋu anye ɖeka si nèdzoe. Tsitreɖoɖo-ƒomevi ɖaseɖigbalɛ ƒe mɔ: Le agboƒoƒe system la ŋutɔ me nyuie eye nàɖo ɖase tso eƒe ŋɔnɔ me be ne wozi "ƒo" ƒe button la, ele be agbo siawo katã nakɔ ɖe eƒe teƒe. Azɔ mele be nàdo agbo ɖeka ɖeka kpɔ o. Èfia be agbo aɖeke mate ŋu anɔ mƒo o, elabena mɔ si nuwɔwɔŋu la wɔe meɖe mɔ na esia o. Vovototo le vavã ƒe kpɔkpɔ le akpa aɖe dzi kple ŋɔnɔ ƒe nɔnɔ aɖe ƒe ɖaseɖoɖo dome. Dodokpɔ ƒe akpa aɖewo koe wòkpɔa. Tsitreɖoɖo ƒomevi ɖaseɖigbalɛ ɖoa ɖase. Eyae nye susu bliboa, eye nu bubu siawo katã nye mɔnu siwo ana wòawɔe kple dzodzro nyuie. --- Tsitreɖoɖo ƒomevi ɖaseɖigbalɛ siawo katã ƒe tikpɔtɔ atọ Tsitreɖoɖo ƒomevi ɖaseɖigbalɛ siawo katã, togbɔ be eƒe sesẽ le aleke o, wotu wo tso nu etɔ pɛ me. title: Orchard ƒe Kpɔɖeŋu: Ne Ɖaseɖigbalɛ Ƒe Ɖoɖoɖo Me Ƒoƒo Le Eme
description: Nusi wòhiã: Ame yeyewo. Akpa 1 ƒo nu tso formal verification ŋu; afisia míakpɔ kpɔɖeŋu vavã si na wòzu be ehiã ŋutɔ. Woɖe nu siawo katã me tso gɔmedzedze.
text: Orchard ƒe Kpɔɖeŋu: Ne Ɖaseɖigbalɛ Ƒe Ɖoɖoɖo Me Ƒoƒo Le Eme Ale si matematiki ƒe fli ɖeka si womeɖo se na o ate ŋu ana woawɔ ga si mekpɔna o kpɔtɔ Series: Formal Verification Series · Akpa 2 le 3 me Nusi wòhiã: Ame yeyewo. Akpa 1 ƒo nu tso formal verification ŋu; afisia míakpɔ kpɔɖeŋu vavã si na wòzu be ehiã ŋutɔ. Woɖe nu siawo katã me tso gɔmedzedze. Nusi wòatsɔ ado go: Nunya wɔnɛ si le eme ke hã wònyɔ, tso ale si cryptographic proof system ate ŋu anyɔ soundness ƒe fɔƒɔ me, nusi 2026 Zcash "Orchard" ƒe kpɔɖeŋu nye tututu, nu ka ta kpɔɖeŋu sia ƒe ƒomevi ate ŋu ayi ɣeyiɣi didi me, eye nu ka ta wòdzɔ kpɔ ha xoxo. Le Akpa 1 me míegblɔ be dodokpɔ ate ŋu afi kpɔɖeŋuwo ƒe nɔnɔ, gake mate ŋu afi woƒe manɔnɔ o, eye be kpɔɖeŋu vɔ̃tɔwo katã le ɖoɖoɖo ƒe nyagblɔɖi, eƒe matematiki si le ete. Nyati sia nye kpɔɖeŋu ƒe nyagblɔ. Le 2026 me, woɖe fli ɖe Zcash ƒe Orchard ɣaɣla [shielded] gaƒuƒoƒo me, si ate ŋu ana ame aɖe wɔ asitsalẽ vɔ̃ si mekpɔna o le fɔƒɔ manɔmee. Etsi ƒe miaka ene eye wogakpɔe kakaka le audit geɖewo me. Eƒe gɔmesese, kple eƒe ŋgɔgbeawo ƒe gɔmesese, nye ɖoɖoɖowo ƒe nyateƒe ɖeɖe ƒe taɖodzinu si nyɔ ŋutɔ. --- Nu ka ta wòle be nàtsɔ susu na esia? Zcash nye cryptocurrency si ƒe mɔ̃ ɖeka nye ɣaɣla. Le eƒe ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo me, gaƒe, gaɖoɖowo ƒe dɔlawo, kple xɔlawo le ɣaɣla. Wowɔ ɣaɣla sia kple zero-knowledge proofs [zero-knowledge proofs]: cryptographic ɖaseɖigbalɛwo si fia be gaɖoɖo ɖeka de sewo katã dzi, ke womefia gaɖoɖoa ƒe nusiwo o. Ɖoɖoɖo sia ƒe lɔlɔ̃ siwo le kpɔɖeŋu mee. Le ledger si nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi [transparent] le eme abe Bitcoin tɔ ene, ne ame aɖe wɔ ga tso fɔƒɔ me, amewo katã akpɔ gaƒe siwo dzi ɖo, eye network la ate ŋu akpɔe eye woatrɔe megbe. Le ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo me la, woɣla gaƒewo le eƒe ŋutɔ ƒe wɔnɛ me. Eya ta, ne ɖaseɖigbalɛ ƒe ɖoɖoɖo ŋutɔ me fli aɖe le, si ana gaɖoɖo si menye nyateƒe o anɔ abe nyateƒe ene la, asitsalẽwɔwɔa anɔ meɖeɖe manɔmee. Màte ŋu akpɔe to ledger la mekpɔkpɔ me o, elabena wowo ledger la wònye be wòanye nu si menɔ ʋuʋuɖi o. Esiae nye afɔku si va eme le Orchard me. Be míagɔmesesee la, ele be míakpɔ nusi zero-knowledge proof ɖeka le kpɔm tututu. --- Nunya: ɖaseɖigbalɛ ɖeka nyo abe eƒe checklist ene ko Bu border officer aɖe ŋu si ele be wòaɖo mɔ na travelers ne mekɔ woƒe agbalẽwo kple eƒe ŋku o. Teƒe ma la, traveler sia sia yɔ checklist [checklist] aɖe, eye officer la ɖoa mɔ na ame sia sia si ƒe checklist katã ƒe dzesiwo le eme. Wode checklist la ɖo be traveler si le se me ko ate ŋu aɖe dzesi le box sia sia me. Azɔ bu be box vevi aɖe le checklist la me o, abe, "passport la ƒe ɣeyiɣi meva nu o." Ame geɖeawo hã awɔe nyui eye nu aɖeke manɔ vɔ̃ o. Gake ame si ƒe passport ƒe ɣeyiɣi va nu la hã ate ŋu aɖe dzesi le box siwo katã susɔ me eye wòato mɔme hena bɔbɔe. Ɖoɖoɖoa kpɔna nyui le ŋkeke sia ŋkeke ƒe zaza me. Fɔƒɔa wɔa dɔ na ame si dii be yeakpɔe ko. Zero-knowledge proof ɖeka wɔa dɔ abe checklist sia ene. Meɖea nusiwo woɣla la fia o; ekpɔna be woɖo seɖoɖo fixed aɖe katã dzi. Eye ne wotsɔ nu si hiã ɖeka de ɖe eŋu o la, ke nusiwo menye nyateƒe o aɖewo hã ate ŋu ato, esi nu katã gale abe nyuie ene. Míawɔ "seɖoɖo checklist" sia nanye nyateƒe tututu, elabena afima tututu kpɔɖeŋua nɔ. --- Matematiki: circuitwo, seɖoɖowo, kple soundness Le emeŋutɔ la, nyagblɔɖi "gaɖoɖo sia le se me" woŋlɔe ɖe circuit [circuit] aɖe me: matematiki ƒe seɖoɖo fixed aɖewo ƒe ƒuƒoƒo, si woyɔna constraints [constraints], woŋlɔ wo abe equationwo siwo le numbewo ŋu ene. Be wòawɔ ɖaseɖigbalɛ si le se me la, ɖaseɖela la ele be wòatsɔ asiri ƒe valuewo (eƒe witness [witness]) ava, siwo ɖo constraint sia sia dzi. Ɖaseɖigbalɛa nana verifier aɖe ka be witness ma le eme, ke mefiae o. Nɔnɔ si míele be míaxɔ tso ɖoɖoɖo sia me la, eŋkɔ le: Soundness [soundness]: Ehiã be mate ŋu wɔ ɖaseɖigbalɛ si le se me na nyagblɔɖi si menye nyateƒe o gbeɖe o. Nyagblɔɖi siwo nye nyateƒe ko le be woanyɔ witnesswo siwo ɖo constraintwo katã dzi. Soundness nye akpɔɖeŋu si tsi asitsalẽwɔwɔ ŋu.
