text: Ironwood: Ale si woɖe kpe edzi be ga mate ŋu woawɔ aɖe o Ale si Zcash ɖo ŋuɖoɖo aɖe ŋu kple ɖaseɖigbalɛ si makina do kpe ɖe eŋu Mama: Formal Verification · Akpa 3 le 3 me Ame siwo woŋlɔe na: ame yeyewo. Akpa 1 kple 2 ɖo formal verification kple Orchard ƒe ŋuɖoɖo la ƒe gɔmeɖeɖe; nuwuwu sia fia ale si susu eveawo do go kple wo nɔewo le ɖoɖonu gɔme aɖe me. Woagblɔ nu siwo katã wòhia na wò la na wò le míaƒe mɔzɔzɔ me. Nu si wòakplɔ ayi: Nunya nyui tso nu si Zcash ɖe kpe ɖe eƒe "Ironwood" gaƒuƒoƒo yeye la ŋu vavã, ale si woɖo ɖaseɖigbalɛ la ɖo, nu si wòɖe kpe ɖe eŋu kple nu si wòmeɖe kpe ɖe eŋu o, ale si woɖe gaƒuƒoƒo xoxo la ɖe zɔzɔ me dedie, kple nu si ta esia fia mɔlɔlɔ yeye na ga si wowɔ kple cryptography. Le Akpa 1 me míesrɔ nu si wògɔme na be woaɖe kpe ɖe ɖoɖonu aɖe ƒe nyuityo ŋu. Le Akpa 2 me míekpɔ ŋuɖoɖo vavã aɖe si dodokpɔ mekpɔ o le ƒe ene me: elliptic-curve ƒe hahatoto si me wodzra ɖeɖe ɖe eme akpa o, si anɔ ŋusẽ na ga ƒe wɔnɔnɔ si ame mate ŋu akpɔ o, si me wòanɔ nu teƒe aɖeke o. Nyatia siae nye eƒe ŋuɖoɖo: ale si Zcash ɖo eŋu, menye kple ɖɔɔɖo ko o, ke boŋ kple ɖaseɖigbalɛ si makina do kpe ɖe eŋu be ŋuɖoɖo ƒome sia katã bu. --- Nu ka ta wòele be wòasusu eŋu? Ne ŋuɖoɖo aɖe le ga dzro la, nu si woɖea ŋu wɔa zi geɖe nye be woaɖɔe eye woayi edzi. Zcash wɔ nu si wòto eŋu wu. Kple ɣaɣla [shielded] gaƒuƒoƒo yeye aɖe si woyɔna be Ironwood, si wode dɔme le July 28, 2026, eƒe mɔsrɔ̃lawo ɖe mathematics ƒe ɖaseɖigbalɛ si makina do kpe ɖe eŋu ɖe go, le theorem 2,700 wu si woŋlɔ le Lean proof assistant me, si ɖe kpe edzi be gaƒuƒoƒo yeye la mate ŋu awɔ ga gblẽ si mewɔ nyateƒe o le ame siwo ƒe ŋutinya woɖe fia me o. Ʉti ɖaseɖigbalɛ la le ame sia ame ƒe kpɔkpɔ me, le ironwood repository si nye open-source la me, eye hadɔ si me wòwɔ la xɔ ɣleti ɖeka wu na hakpɔlawo kple cryptographer ƒe ƒome etɔ̃. Esia le vevie wu Zcash. E nye fiaɖeɖe si le xexeme vavã me si ƒe kekeli sesẽ be wòate ŋu axɔ ga ƒe ɖoɖonu si le dɔ wɔm, aŋlɔ nu si "ga wɔnɔnɔ aɖeke o" gɔme vavã, eye wòaɖe kpe ɖe eŋu, le teƒe si wòaɖo ŋku edzi be wòƒe dodokpɔwo blibo. Etrɔ ŋugbedodo zu theorem. --- Susu gãtɔ: ɖe kpe ɖe specification la ŋu, tsrɔ̃ ŋuɖoɖo ƒome la Akpa 2 va yi ɖe nyanya si wɔ esia dzɔ la ŋu. Ɖo ŋku edzi, elabena nu sia katã tu ɖe eŋu: Ga wɔnɔnɔ ŋuɖoɖo si ame mate ŋu akpɔ o ate ŋu anɔ protocol ƒe specification, si nye mathematics ƒe gɔmeɖeɖe na nu si circuit la ele be wòawɔ la, ko me. Nu si ame ate ŋu akpɔ la ado go le ame sia ame ƒe ga ƒe xexlẽ me. Eya ta ne woɖe kpe ɖe specification la ƒe nyuityo ŋu la, ekaka ga wɔnɔnɔ ŋuɖoɖo si woƒia le eme la katã ɖe tɛ̃. Nu ka ta "le specification ko me"? Elabena gaɖoɖo sia gaɖoɖo ƒe nyawo katã nɔa anyi tegbee le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe [block] sia gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe me, eye eƒe ɖaseɖigbalɛwo hã le eme. Ne software la xɔ gaɖoɖo vɔ̃ aɖe le mɔ vɔ̃ dzi la, ame sia ame ate ŋu atsɔ software si woɖɔ ɖo yi megbe ahama nu si va yi la, eye woakpɔe. Ɖase sia nɔa anyi tegbee eye ame sia ame ate ŋu akpɔe. Mathematics ƒe vodada le gɔmedzedze la me ko ate ŋu aɣla tegbee, elabena "version si sɔ" aɖeke menɔ o be woahama nuwo ɖe eŋu. Eyae nye vodada si formal verification ƒe dɔe be wòaɖe. Dodokpɔ kpɔa nuwɔwɔ le input siwo woɖo kpɔ la dzi, eye Orchard ƒe ŋuɖoɖo la ɣla eɖokui elabena input si woɖo kpɔ aɖeke mede eme o. Ɖaseɖigbalɛ aɖe tso specification la ŋu ku ɖe input katã ŋu ɣeyiɣi ɖeka me, eye eƒo akpa xɔasi si ame aɖeke mebu be woate ŋu akpɔ o hã. Eya koe nye laylaylala ƒe ƒome si sesẽ nam be woaɖe ƒe ene si me wodzra vodada si ame mate ŋu akpɔ o ɖe zɔzɔ me kple dzideƒo. --- Nu ka woɖe kpe edzi vavã Ɖaseɖigbalɛ la ɖe nyagblɔɖeka si nye nu gãtɔ aɖe kpe edzi, si wowɔ tso nu si le anyi kɔkɔe wu me. Balansi ƒe blibododo [Balance integrity] (nu gãtɔ) Balansi ƒe blibododo: Asixɔxɔ si woɣla ɖe gaƒuƒoƒo la me la megava yɔ wu asixɔxɔ si tso ame sia ame gbɔ va eme nete. Esiae nye ga wɔnɔnɔ ƒe mɔxɔɖiɖi le nya bɔbɔe me. Ga ate ŋu ava ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo la me (ame sia ame akpɔe) eye wòado go tsoe (ame sia ame akpɔe), ke le eme afi si woɣla asixɔxɔwo la, asixɔxɔ aɖeke

title: Aleke ɣaɣla [Shielded] Zcash gaɖoɖo [Transaction] wɔa dɔ le nyateƒe me
description: Ame siwo wò ŋu wozɔna: amedzrowo bliboa. Cryptography, blockchain ƒe gɔmesese, kple matematiki ƒe gɔmesese aɖeke mele be woɖe asi na mi o.
text: Aleke ɣaɣla [Shielded] Zcash gaɖoɖo [Transaction] wɔa dɔ le nyateƒe me Nunyanya ƒe Kpɔɖeŋu tso Annkkitaaa Nuxlɔ̃ame si le matematiki gɔme: mɔzɔzɔ si me formula aɖeke mele o na fexexe ɣaɣlawo Mama: Zcash tso Gɔmedzedze ƒe Gɔmegbɔgblɔ . Agbalẽ 0 . Nudzɔdzɔ Ame siwo wò ŋu wozɔna: amedzrowo bliboa. Cryptography, blockchain ƒe gɔmesese, kple matematiki ƒe gɔmesese aɖeke mele be woɖe asi na mi o. Nusi miakplɔ ayi: Nunyaɖeɖe nyuitɔ si fia aleke Zcash ɣe ame kae xe fɛ na ame kae, kple fɛ home nenie, eye wòɖe mɔ na xexeme bliboa be woakpɔe be fɛ aɖeke woɖo le alakpa me alo wozã zi eve o. Agbalẽ siwo katã ava le mama sia me akpɔ mɔ kɔkɔe le mɔ̃ si miage kpɔ la ƒe akpa ɖeka ɖeka me. Eya ta ne nya aɖe le afisia dze wò ŋu abe nu si meɖe gɔme nyuie o ene la, enyo. Esi fia be míatrɔ ava eye míana gɔmesese nyuitɔ na wò. --- Nu ka tae wòle be nàtsɔe na wò ɖokui? Bu be wò bank ƒe akontabubu agbalẽ woɖi ɖe gli aɖe ŋu le dua ƒe ƒoƒo me. Tegbee. Ame sia ame (wò xɔtɔ, wò dɔmea, amedzro aɖe, dɔmea si wòanɔ ɖe ŋgɔ, dziɖuƒe aɖe) ate ŋu axlẽ wò xɔ ƒe fexexe sia fexexe, dɔyɔƒe ƒe fetɔxɛ sia fexexe, nunana sia fexexe, kafe sia fexexe, eye wòatsɔ mɔ kɔkɔe adze ame si nèɖo fɛ ɖe eŋu kple ame si ɖo fɛ ɖe wò ŋu. Esia menye nu vɔ̃ si woɖo le ŋku me ko o. Esia nye ale si Bitcoin wɔa dɔ hã. Wogana yɔna Bitcoin be "anonymous," gake menye nenema o. Enye pseudonymous: wò ŋkɔ mele ledger la dzi o, gake gaɖoɖo sia fexexe, ga home sia fexexe, kple kadodo si le gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo dome la nye nu si ame sia ame kpɔa eye wònɔ anyi tegbee. "Chain analysis" ƒe dɔwɔwɔ bliboa li be woaɖe ŋkɔ mamle etɔ̃ sia ɖa eye woatsɔ gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo akɔ ɖe ame vavãwo ŋu. Ne woɖo wò gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi aɖe kple wò ɖokui vɔ la, wò fɛ ƒe nyawo katã adze go. Zcash wotu be wòaxɔ nya sesẽ aɖe si dze abe be bɔbɔe ene la ŋu: Míate ŋu akpɔ fɛ si nye ɣaɣla bliboa, si ɣe fɛdɔla, fɛxɔla, kple ga home, eye hã míana mɔ na ame sia ame be wòakpɔe be woɖo sewo dzi? Taɖodzinu eve siawo wɔnɔa ɖe wo nɔewo ŋu. Ledger si nye nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi ate ŋu woakpɔe elabena ame sia ame kpɔe. Ɣaɣla gɔme nye be ame aɖeke makpɔe o. Eya ta aleke amewo akpɔ nu si womana mɔ wo be woakpɔ o la? Nya sesẽ sia ƒe fɔfɔe nye mama sia ƒe nya bliboa. Mina míadzɔe. --- Xexeme eve le Zcash me Le nu bubu aɖeke gɔme la, míana gɔmesese na nu si amewo wɔna ɖe ale gbãtɔ: Zcash menye "coin ɣaɣla" o. Enye coin si tsɔ ɣaɣla doa abe amedzro ƒe nɔnɔme ene. Etsi agbe gbãtɔ abe Bitcoin ƒe fork ene, eye eƒe ɖoɖonu ɖeka me la, mɔnu eve si wɔnɔa ɖe wo nɔewo ŋu li. Xexeme nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi Xexeme ɣaɣla --- --- --- Ɣaɣla Nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi, abe Bitcoin ene Ɣaɣla Gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo ƒe gɔmedzedze t... z... alo u... Fɛdɔla / fɛxɔla / ga home Wokpɔna na ame sia ame Woɣena na ame sia ame Teknoloji si le gɔme Bitcoin ƒe mɔnu me ledger si nye nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi Cryptographic adzɔgbeɖeɖe + zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛ Fɛ ate ŋu ato meli la hã: fɛ ƒe tsɔtsɔ ɖe xexeme ɣaɣla me la nye shielding, eye woƒe tsɔtsɔ ava do go la nye deshielding. Xexeme nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi la nye "Bitcoin si wòse gɔme le vovo aɖe me xoxo." Xexeme ɣaɣla lae nye si me cryptography nyuiwo katã le, eye eya ko mama sia le kpɔm. --- Nuxlɔ̃ame: letterɖaka siwo wotu kpoo le board si nye nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi dzi Esi nye nɔnɔme ɖeka si nàtsɔ ayi le agbalẽ la ƒe akpa siwo katã gbɔ. Míatrɔ ava eŋu zi geɖe. Bu be nyatakakadzraƒe si nye nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi gã aɖe li si amewo katã le anyigba dzi kpɔna ɣesiaɣi. Fɛ ƒe xɔxɔ gɔme nye be ame aɖe tu letterɖaka si woɣa eye mekpena o ɖe board la dzi. Letterɖaka la me la nye fɛ home nenie wòtsɔ kple ɣaɣla si fɛxɔla ko ate ŋu axlẽ, elabena woŋlɔ letterɖaka la ɣaɣla ɖe fɛxɔla ma ƒe key ŋu. Xexeme bliboa kpɔ be letterɖaka aɖe va. Ame aɖeke menye etɔla o ate ŋu akpɔ nusi le eme o. Board la doa edzi ɣesiaɣi ko. Womekaka letterɖakawo ɖe anyi alo woɖe wo o. Wotu yeyeawo ɖe edzi ɣesiaɣi. Fɛ ƒe zãzã gɔme nye be wòayi ɖe avɔkaka megbe, nàɖe ɖase be "nyee nye letterɖaka si menye be wozã hafi le board sia dzi la ƒe tɔ, eye wòle be makpɔ mɔ aʋu e", eye nàtsɔ token si womewɔna o aɖe ade ɖe "wozã xoxo" ƒe nuɖ

title: Agbanɔ̃ me xexlẽme: Xexlẽme ƒe ɖoɖo si Cryptography ƒe agbe le me
description: Ame siwo wò ŋlɔ na: Ame yeyeawo. Míebu be wònya suku me xexlẽme bɔbɔe ko (tsɔkpe, zi, ma). Cryptography alo mathematics si le dzogo wu la ƒe sidzedze aɖeke…
text: Agbanɔ̃ me xexlẽme: Xexlẽme ƒe ɖoɖo si Cryptography ƒe agbe le me Nunya ƒe ŋu ŋutinya tso Annkkitaaa gbɔ Nu ka ta "trɔ yi gome" nye Zcash ƒe gɔmedzedze ƒe gbɔɖeɖe Series: Zcash tso gɔmedzedze ƒe nɔnɔme me . Nyati 1 . Agbanɔ̃ me xexlẽme Ame siwo wò ŋlɔ na: Ame yeyeawo. Míebu be wònya suku me xexlẽme bɔbɔe ko (tsɔkpe, zi, ma). Cryptography alo mathematics si le dzogo wu la ƒe sidzedze aɖeke mele be wòhiã o. Nu si wòatsɔ adzoe: Agbanɔ̃ me xexlẽme ƒe gɔmesese si le bɔbɔe eye wòle ete, nu ka ta cryptographerwo zãa wo, kple afi si woɖea eƒe dzesi le Zcash me. Le Nyati 0 me la, míedo go ame atɔ̃: didienu, adzɔgbeɖeɖe, didienu ƒe adzɔgbeɖeɖe ti, gaɣaɣla ɖeɖe dzesi, kple zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛ. Míede biabia aɖe ɖi be: afi ka keywo kple ɣaɣla ƒe mɔnuwo katã tsoe vae? Xexlẽmewo mee wotso. Ke menye xexlẽme bɔbɔe si wòtsɔ tsi tsoe o. Wotso xexlẽme ƒe ɖoɖo tɔxɛ si le eɖokui me, si woyɔna be agbanɔ̃ me xexlẽme [finite field], eye cryptography ƒe akpa gbogbo le Zcash me wotu ɖe eŋu. Nyati sia ana míaɖo eƒe gɔmesese dzidzem. Ale si mído ŋugbe ene la, gɔmesese va gbã. Formula aɖeke manava hafi wòana eɖokui ƒe asixɔxɔ. --- Nu ka ta wòle be na wòatsɔe ɖe dzi? Xexlẽme bɔbɔe wɔa kuxi na cryptography: woƒe xexlẽme menɔa agbe o, eye wodea nya fia. Bu nu si dzɔna ne xexlẽme aɖe gã wu. Ne megblɔ na wò be xexlẽme ɣaɣla aɖe wɔe va zu 8,142,067 la, ènya nu geɖe xoxo: xexlẽme si me dzesi adre le, ele atsyɔ̃, eye "egã kpuie." Eƒe lolome nye dzesi. Eye dzesiwoe nye nu si ɣaɣla ƒe ɖoɖo mate ŋu axɔ be yeana ame o. Cryptography di xexlẽme ƒe ɖoɖo si me: asixɔxɔ siwo katã me le se, ale be computer ate ŋu aɖo wo katã ɖe dzesi me tututu, mɔxɔmɔxɔ alo overflow manɔe o, asixɔxɔawo mede woƒe lolome fia o, elabena ɖoɖoa me "gã wu" ƒe gɔmesese vavã aɖeke mele o, àte ŋu atsɔkpe, aɖe le eŋu, azi, eye nàma bliboe eye nàtrɔ wo aɖo, elabena cryptography ƒe mɔnuwo hia algebra vavã be woawɔ dɔ, eye woate ŋu awɔ teƒea gã kpuie, ale be flilimakaka mele mɔkpɔkpɔa me o. Didi sia ƒe ŋkɔ le. Woyɔe be agbanɔ̃ me xexlẽme. Mina miatu eƒe gɔmesese na ɖeka hafi miaŋlɔ dzesi ɖeka pɛ. --- Gɔmesese: gaƒoƒo Èzãa agbanɔ̃ me xexlẽme gbe sia gbe. Nye gaƒoƒo si le wògli ŋu. Gaƒoƒo si me gaƒoƒo 12 le la me, xexlẽmewo trɔna yi gome. Dze egɔme le ga 10, tsɔkpe ga 5, eye mèva ɖo "ga 15" o, ke boŋ nàva ɖo ga 3. Teƒe wuieve pɛe gaƒoƒoa si, eye ne nàdo xexlẽme va yi dzi la, etrɔna yi gɔmedzedzea me. Nu etɔ̃e dzɔ fifia, siwoe nye nyati sia ƒe tanya gã la katã: Xexemea le se. Teƒe wuieve pɛe li, togbɔ be nàgaɖo xexlẽme yi edzidzi hã. Tsɔkpe ha wɔ dɔ. Àte ŋu atsɔkpe gaƒoƒowo ŋkeke blibo; nàva ɖo gaƒoƒo ƒe teƒe si le ete ɣesiaɣi. Lolome megale vevie o. "Ga 3" megblɔ na wò be ègaɖo ga 3 alo 15 alo 27 o. Trɔtrɔ yi gome la tutui lolome ƒe nyanyui la ɖa. Tututui siae nye ɣaɣla ƒe nɔnɔme si míedi vɛ. Trɔtrɔ yi gome ƒe xexlẽme sia ƒe ŋkɔ le mathematics me: modulo ƒe xexlẽme [modular arithmetic]. Gaƒoƒoa wɔa dɔ "modulo 12," si woŋlɔna be mod 12. Mathematics ƒe amewo di be woadzɔ xexlẽme teƒeawo tso 0 me, eyata "gaƒoƒo mod 12" me teƒeawo nye 0, 1, 2, ..., 11. Gaƒoƒo mod 7 me teƒeawo anye 0 va se ɖe 6. Se ɖeka pɛ: Be nàwɔ nu aɖe "mod p," wɔ xexlẽme bɔbɔe gbã, emegbe mà p me eye nàtsɔ hagbegbe ko. Medekpɔɖeŋu mod 7: 5 + 4 = 9, eye ne womã 9 me la, hagbegbe si susɔe nye 2, eyata 7, ale 5 + 4 = 2 (mod 7). --- Tso gaƒoƒo me yi xexlẽme ƒe aƒe Gaƒoƒo naa míaɖe tsɔkpe. Xexlẽme ƒe aƒe [field] nye kekeɖeŋu: xexlẽme ƒe ɖoɖo si me wɔwɔ eneawo katã wɔa dɔ nyuie, hã ma, si nye esia sesẽ la. Le gɔmesese bɔbɔe me la, xexlẽme ƒe aƒe nye "xexlẽmewo" ƒe ƒome aɖe si me àte ŋu atsɔkpe, aɖe le eŋu, azi, eye nàma (nu bubu ɖe 0 ŋu pɛ), eye se siwo katã wònya va xɔe la gali: ɖoɖo meva dɔ na tsɔkpe alo zizi o, woate ŋu aɖo bracketwo ƒe ƒoƒo bubu, 0 kple 1 li, eye xexlẽme ɖe sia ɖe si ƒe trɔtrɔ yi megbe li kple (tsɔ ɖe 0 ŋu) eƒe ɖeɖe ƒe gome. Rational xexlẽmewo nye xexlẽme ƒe aƒe. Real xexlẽmewo nye xexlẽme ƒe aƒe. Nu si míedi la nye aƒe si le se. Nyati gã lae nye esi, eye edze tugbe: Tsɔ xexlẽme bliboawo 0, 1, ..., p-1 eye nàwɔ xexlẽm

title: Elliptic Curves: Afisi Zcash ƒe Safuiwo kple Adzɔgbeɖeɖewo Le Dzi
description: Ƒome: Zcash tso Gɔmedzedze ƒe Gɔme . Nusiŋɔŋlɔ 2 . Elliptic Curves
text: Elliptic Curves: Afisi Zcash ƒe Safuiwo kple Adzɔgbeɖeɖewo Le Dzi Ɖeɖefia Gbãtɔ tso Annkkitaaa Mɔ si dzi wòate ŋu ayi ɖe ŋgɔ ko, eye wotu tso afisiwo ŋu Ƒome: Zcash tso Gɔmedzedze ƒe Gɔme . Nusiŋɔŋlɔ 2 . Elliptic Curves Ame siwo wotu na: ame yeyeawo. Míebu be nènya Nusiŋɔŋlɔ 1 (finite fields) ko: xexlẽ si trɔa yi ɖe gɔmedzenu me le prime me. Medzidzɔge bubu aɖeke mele be wòhiã o. Nusi nàdzɔ ɖe eme: nufia si nya me le elliptic curves ŋu, "trapdoor" si wɔna be wònye nu si wòahiã, kple ale si Zcash trɔe zu safuiwo kple adzɔgbeɖeɖewo. Nusiŋɔŋlɔ 1 na mí dzɔƒe nyui aɖe na xexlẽ: finite field. Gake field ɖeka ko nye xexlẽwo. Be wòatu safuiwo kple "agbalẽkuku si wodze" tso Nusiŋɔŋlɔ 0 me, Zcash hia nu si me kuxi ƒe ƒome si yina ɖe mɔ ɖeka dzi le: wòbɔbɔ be wòawɔe yi ŋgɔ, gake eƒe megatrɔ gbɔ nye nu si womate ŋu awɔ o. Nu mae nye elliptic curve. Nusiŋɔŋlɔ sia tuae tso gɔmedzenu me, nufia le algebra ŋgɔ. --- Nu ka tae wòle be nàtsɔe ɖe susu me? Ɣaɣla ƒe ɖoɖo ɖe sia ɖe hia mɔ si dzi wòate ŋu ayi ɖe ŋgɔ ko: dɔwɔwɔ si bɔbɔ be woazɔ yi ŋgɔ, eye si megatrɔ gbɔ nye nu si womate ŋu awɔ o. Eya tae. Wò safui ɣaɣla nye xexlẽ si nèɖea ɣla. Wò safui si le duto ƒe ŋkume (kple wò gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi) tsoe me eye wofia na xexlẽame blibo. Ɖoɖo la ƒe dedie blibo le nyateƒe ɖeka dzi: Ne woɖe safui si le duto ƒe ŋkume la, ame aɖeke mate ŋu atrɔ yi megbe va wò safui ɣaɣla gbɔ o. Ne woate ŋu awɔe, woate ŋu azã wò ga. Eya ta míhia matematik ƒe dɔwɔwɔ si me: zɔzɔ yi ŋgɔ (ɣaɣla -> si le duto ƒe ŋkume) le kabakaba eye wòbɔbɔ, gake zɔzɔ yi megbe (si le duto ƒe ŋkume -> ɣaɣla) sesẽ ale gbegbe be computerwo katã siwo le anyigba dzi, ne wowɔ dɔ le xexlẽgbegbe ƒe agbenɔƒe blibo, womakpɔ nuwuwu o. Finite-field ƒe hahã ɖeka menya o; mamae trɔe gbɔ enumake (emae nye Nusiŋɔŋlɔ 1 ƒe tame blibo). Míhia nu si me "trɔe gbɔ" ƒe button bɔbɔ aɖeke mele o. Elliptic curves naa esia ke, eye be woakpe ɖe eŋu la, woƒe afisiwo ɖoa wo ƒe nuku ƒo le mɔ si nyo na adzɔgbeɖeɖewo tutu. Míakpɔ ale si wòle. --- Nufia: afisi si ŋu wòate ŋu "na afisi eve ƒo" Mèbu cryptography ŋu kpɔ o. Elliptic curve nye afisiwo ƒe ha ko (x, y) siwo wɔ equation si le ƒome sia me: Le xexlẽ siwo le gɔmedzenu me la, wòle abe afisi ƒe mɔ bɔbɔ si le yiyi ene, zi geɖe wòna woakpɔ akpa si ƒe nuku le akpa eye tail eve: Nu si wɔa be womakpɔe o lae nye esi: Wòate ŋu "na afisi eve ƒo" le curve sia dzi be wòakpɔ afisi etɔ̃ si le curve ma ke dzi. Esia menye coordinates ƒe nukuɖoɖo gbɔgbɔ o. Geometric se aɖe wònye, eye wòbɔbɔ be woakpɔe kple ŋku wu be woagblɔe. Chord se (afisi vovovowo eve ƒe nukuɖoɖo) Be nàtsɔ P + Q aɖo nuku: Ɖo mɔ dzɔdzɔe aɖe to P kple Q me. Mɔ ma ƒo kple curve la le teƒe bubu ɖeka pɛ. Yɔe be R. Trɔ R yi ɖe horizontal axis ƒe akpa bubu. Eƒe trɔtrɔe nye ɖoɖo la, P + Q. Tangent se (afisi aɖe kple e ŋutɔ ƒe nukuɖoɖo) Be nàwɔ P + P (si woŋlɔna be 2P), afisi evelia mele be nàto mɔ dzi o, eyata zã tangent mɔ le P gbɔ ɖe eteƒe, eye nàwɔ "ƒome etɔ̃, ekema trɔ" ƒe mɔ ma ke. Emae nye dɔwɔwɔ blibo. Geometric se eve. Kple wo, elliptic curve ƒe afisiwo wɔ nu si mathematicianwo yɔna be group: nuwo ƒe ha si me "nukuɖoɖo" dzɔ nyuie. Esi tsɔ "zero" gɔ̃ hã le eme. Afisi si le mavɔ (curve la ƒe zero) Xexlẽ ƒe ɖoɖo ɖe sia ɖe hia 0, nu si metrɔa naneke o ne nàtsɔe kpe ɖe eŋu. Le elliptic curve dzi la, afisi bubu aɖe si yɔna be afisi si le mavɔ nye nu ma, eye woŋlɔna be O. Àte ŋu abu be ele "kakaɖedzi le dzi," afi si mɔ verticalwo ƒoa. Ne nàtsɔ O akpe ɖe afisi aɖeke ŋu la, ele eƒe nɔnɔ me, abe alesi nàtsɔ 0 akpe ɖe eŋu ene. --- Tso aworanwo me yi finite field me Curve bɔbɔ si le etame nye nufia. Gake Zcash mezã xexlẽ siwo le gɔmedzenu o (wona woƒe nɔnɔ nɔ trɔtrɔ eye wona nɔnɔ ƒe lolome, abe Nusiŋɔŋlɔ 1 gblɔ ene). Ezã elliptic curve le finite field me: equation y^2 = x^3 + ax + b ma ke, gake xexlẽ katã wɔna le prime aɖe me. Ne nàwɔ esia la, curve nyui ma gbã ɖe dotwo siwo mate ŋu aka ɖe wo nɔewo ŋu o me, dot ɖeka na (x, y) pair ɖe sia ɖe si wɔ equation la le p me. Mekpɔa ɖe abe curve gɔ̃ o. Gake esiae nye nu vevi: Chord-and-tangen

title: Hashing kple Adzɔgbeɖeɖe: Akpa ƒe Gɔmeɖeɖe Si Wotsɔ Ƒo Tso
description: Ƒometɔwo: Zcash Tso Gɔmedzedze ƒe Nunya Me . Agbalẽ 3 . Hashing kple Adzɔgbeɖeɖe
text: Hashing kple Adzɔgbeɖeɖe: Akpa ƒe Gɔmeɖeɖe Si Wotsɔ Ƒo Tso Gɔmesese Ƒe Nudzodzro Tso Annkkitaaa Ɖe Ale si nàte ŋu aɖo nya vevi ɣa le ame katã ƒe ŋkume eye màte ŋu aɖagblɔa Ƒometɔwo: Zcash Tso Gɔmedzedze ƒe Nunya Me . Agbalẽ 3 . Hashing kple Adzɔgbeɖeɖe Ame siwo wòŋlɔ na: Ame yeyeawo. Míetso Agbalẽ 1 (finite fields) kple Agbalẽ 2 (elliptic curves) dzi, gake gɔmesese la tsɔa eɖokui ko tsi. Nu si nàkpɔ le egbe megbe: Hash ƒe dɔwɔnuwo ƒe gɔmesese nyui, nu si "ɣaɣla" kple "kadodo" gɔme nye vavã, kple ale si Zcash wɔa didienu ƒe adzɔgbeɖeɖewo siwo dea teƒe fexexe siawo katã. Le Agbalẽ 0 me la, míɖe "akpa ƒe gɔmeɖeɖe si wotsɔ ƒo tso" nu: nu si nàte ŋu aɖe ɖe kpekpeƒe ƒe kplɔdzi be akpa li, eye wòɣe nu si le eme ɣla, eye màte ŋu aɖe tɔe ɖo teƒe le megbe o. Mído ŋugbe be míatsɔe afia ale si nu sia ate ŋu ava eme. Agbalẽ sia nye esia. Míahiã nu eve: hash ƒe dɔwɔnuwo kple adzɔgbeɖeɖewo. --- Nu ka ta wòle be nàtsɔe na? Bu be nèɖe ame si awɔ dɔ dzi ƒe tiŋu ɖe gɔme eye nèdi be nàɖe fia, le emegbe, be nèɖe egɔme tsã. Màte ŋu aɖe wòŋgɔɖoɖo la afia ko o (esia ate ŋu akpɔ ameawo ƒe susu ɖe edzi, alo ana woabu be nètrɔe). Eye màte ŋu aɖe eɣla blibo hã o (ekema màte ŋu aɖe naneke afia le megbe o). Nu si nèdi nye mɔ aɖe si nàtsɔ aɖo asixɔxɔ me fifia le ame katã ƒe ŋkume, ale be: Ame aɖeke mate ŋu aka nu si nèɖo ɖe eme o (eaganɔ ɣaɣla fifia), eye Le megbe, ne èɖe eɖe go la, màte ŋu aɖagblɔ nu si wònye o. Woyɔ "ɖo fifia, ɖe go le megbe, mègblɔ alakpa o" ƒe mɔsia be adzɔgbeɖeɖe [commitment], eye eli afi sia afi le Zcash. Wode didienu ƒe asixɔxɔ kple etɔ ƒe dzesi ɖe adzɔgbeɖeɖe me enumake ne wowɔ didienu la. Be míatu adzɔgbeɖeɖewo, ele be míatsɔ wo ƒe dɔwɔnu vevitɔ: hash ƒe dɔwɔnu la adze egɔme. --- Gɔmesese la: asidzedze na data Hash ƒe dɔwɔnu [hash function] xɔ data ɖesiaɖe, alɔŋlɔ ƒe ŋkekevi aɖe alo agbalẽxɔxɔ blibo aɖe, eye wòtsɔe wɔa alɔŋlɔ kpui, si ƒe lolome menye be wòtrɔna o, si woyɔna be digest alo hash. Bu be enye asidzedze na data. Asidzedze crypto ƒe nyui aɖe si le tɔxɛ ene. Mìatsɔ wo anɔ mia ƒe susu me abe gɔmesesewo ene, menye abe equationwo ene o: Tɔxɛ Gɔmesese bɔbɔe Nu ka ta wòle vevie --- --- --- Metrɔna o Nu si wotsɔ de eme ɖeka na asidzedze ɖeka ɣesiaɣi Nàte ŋu aɖetrɔ asidzedze aɖe ɣesiaɣi Wòdoa ŋgɔ kabakaba Asidzedze ƒe wɔwɔ le kabakaba Wòle bɔbɔe be woatsɔe awɔ dɔ afi sia afi Mɔ ɖeka ko (preimage resistant) Ne wòkpɔ asidzedze aɖe la, màte ŋu akpɔ nu si wɔe o Wòɣla data gbãtɔ la Metrɔna o ɖe woƒe tsitsitɔ me Màte ŋu akpɔ nu vovovo eve siwo ƒe asidzedze ɖeka o Ame aɖeke mate ŋu awɔ nudzɔdzɔ aɖe o Eye nɔnɔme bubu aɖe hã li si wɔa be asidzedzewo nakpɔ ɖe ame ŋu abe nukunu ene: Avalanche ƒe nɔnɔme (wode kpe ɖe edzi) Trɔ nu si wotsɔ de eme la kpuie eye asidzedze la atrɔ blibo, eye wòmeganye abe etɔ gbãtɔ ene o. Afisiae SHA-256 asidzedze vavã eve siwo tso gbedeasi eve siwo ƒe alɔŋlɔ ɖeka ko vovo me: Hex ƒe digit 64 dometɔ, 59 vovo. Alɔŋlɔ ɖeka ko wode eme, eye asidzedze si meka ɖe etɔ aɖeke ŋu o do go. Esiae ta màte ŋu atrɔ nu si wotsɔ de eme la vievie be nàva ɖo asidzedze si nèdi la gbɔ o: "xɔe dze ɖe eme / xɔe dzo le eme" ƒe dzesi aɖeke meli be nàto o. --- Tso asidzedze me yi adzɔgbeɖeɖe gbɔ Mɔ si dze abe eƒe nyuie gake wogbãe: be nàwɔ adzɔgbeɖeɖe na asixɔxɔ ɣaɣla v, ɖe eƒe asidzedze H(v) afia ko. Esia kada wò nyuie (màte ŋu agblɔ le megbe be v bubu nènye o, elabena esia ahiã be nàkpɔ nu eve siwo ƒe asidzedze ɖeka). Gake emeɣlana o. Ne asixɔxɔ siwo ate ŋu anɔ la meganɔ agbã o la, avuɖela aɖe atsɔ asidzedze awɔ na asixɔxɔ siawo katã eye wòatsɔ wo asɔ kple tɔwò. Èwɔ adzɔgbeɖeɖe na "ɛ̃" alo "ao"? Wòwɔ hash na wo eve eye wòka ɖe nu si nètia dzi enumake. Nu si medze ŋgɔ o, si nye mia ƒe xɔlɔ kpuie va yi la, le ɖeŋu dzi ɖe ɣaɣla la go. Dɔɖɔɖo la nye nya ɖeka: nudzudzɔ. Adzɔgbeɖeɖe nye wò ƒe asixɔxɔ ƒe asidzedze si wotsɔ xɔ nudzudzɔ yeye aɖe ɖe eme: commitment = H(v, r) afi si r nye asixɔxɔ nudzudzɔ "blinding" si woɣla. Fifia, v ma ke wɔa adzɔgbeɖeɖe si kpɔa ɖe ame ŋu abe bubu ene ɣesiaɣi, elabena r vovo. Tɔxɛ eve si míedi la katã va eme fifi

title: Merkle Ƒe Titiwo: Ale Si Blockchain Ƒoa Dzi ɖe Didienu Katã Ŋu
description: Ame Siwo Wòna Be Wòaxlẽ: Ame yeyeawo. Míetsɔa Nunyaŋlɔɖi 3 (hashing kple adzɔgbeɖeɖewo) ƒe nu nyuie wɔa dɔ. Ne nènya nu si nye kpɔkplɔɖa kple adzɔgbeɖeɖe la…
text: Merkle Ƒe Titiwo: Ale Si Blockchain Ƒoa Dzi ɖe Didienu Katã Ŋu Numekuku Gbãtɔ Tso Annkkitaaa Gbɔ Adzɔgbeɖeɖewo Miliɔn Geɖe ƒe Kpɔkplɔɖa Ƒe Ɖeɖe Kpuie Me Series: Zcash Tso Gɔmedzedze Me . Nunyaŋlɔɖi 4 . Merkle Ƒe Titiwo Ame Siwo Wòna Be Wòaxlẽ: Ame yeyeawo. Míetsɔa Nunyaŋlɔɖi 3 (hashing kple adzɔgbeɖeɖewo) ƒe nu nyuie wɔa dɔ. Ne nènya nu si nye kpɔkplɔɖa kple adzɔgbeɖeɖe la, èɖo ŋu. Nu Si Nàdzɔ Le Emegbe: Nunya si ƒo nu tso Merkle ƒe titiwo ŋu, ale si wòate ŋu aɖe kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe ɖaseɖigbalɛ fia ne mèfia nu si nèdi o, kple ale si esia trɔ zu Zcash ƒe didienu adzɔgbeɖeɖe ƒe ti. Nunyaŋlɔɖi 0 ƒo nu tso "kplɔdzi si ame katã ate ŋu akpɔ" si me didienu katã si wowɔ kpɔ gbeɖe le eye wòganɔa dzi ɖaa. Fifia àte ŋu agblɔ nu si wotsɔ dea eme: adzɔgbeɖeɖewo [commitments] (Nunyaŋlɔɖi 3), agbalẽ dzɔdzɔwo. Ke kplɔdzi vavã aɖe miliɔn alafa geɖewo. Aleke network la atsɔe adzra, aɖe kpekpeɖeŋu na, eye wòana nàɖe ɖase be wò agbalẽ dzɔdzɔ le kplɔdzi la dzi ne mètsɔ asi fia eŋu o? Ŋuɖoɖo la nye ɖoɖo dzɔdzɔ aɖe si nyo ŋutɔ le computer science me: Merkle ƒe ti. --- Nu ka ta nàtsɔ esia ade dziku? Kuxi eve doa le esi nèxɔ adzɔgbeɖeɖewo ƒe xexlẽme kplɔ aɖe si gã. Kuxi gbãtɔ: nyateƒe dzadzɛ le kadodo gã me. Ne nuwo miliɔn 300 le xexlẽme la me, aleke ame aɖe avaɖe kpekpeɖeŋu be woɖe tɔ aɖeke me tɔɖo o? Be woagakpɔ nu miliɔn 300 katã ɣesiaɣi nye nu si womate ŋu awɔ o. Kuxi evelia: ɣaɣla [privacy] ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu. Be nàtsɔ didienu aɖe (Nunyaŋlɔɖi 0) awɔ dɔ la, ele be nàɖe ɖase be wò adzɔgbeɖeɖe le kplɔdzi la dzi vavã. Ke ne nètsɔ asi fia eŋu ("enye entry number 4,201,337!"), èɖe wò ŋutɔ ƒe ame-nyanya fia. Ele be nàɖe ɖase be "nye agbalẽ dzɔdzɔ le kplɔdzi sia dzi afi aɖe" ne mèfia afikae o. Merkle ƒe ti ɖea kuxi eve siawo katã ɖe ɣeyiɣi ɖeka me. Ewɔa xexlẽme blibo la zu kpɔkplɔɖa ɖeka, eye wòana nàɖe kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe ɖaseɖigbalɛ [proof] kpuie aɖe fia si me afi la ƒe nyanya mele o. --- Nuxlɔ̃ame: kpɔkplɔɖawo ƒe hadede ƒeɖuɖu Bu hadede si me woɖoa amedzroa ɖe eŋu ɖe game me, ke ɖe teƒe si amedzrowo li la, kpɔkplɔɖawo ƒoa ƒu. Le anyi ƒe teƒe la, nyatakakawo ƒe akpa ɖe sia ɖe xɔa eya ŋutɔ ƒe kpɔkplɔɖa (eƒe hash tso Nunyaŋlɔɖi 3 me). Esiawo nye aɖakawo [leaves]. Ƒo wo ɖe eve eve. Woƒe kpɔkplɔɖa eveawo woa-hash wo ɖeka me be woazu dzila ƒe kpɔkplɔɖa ɖeka. Ƒo dzilawo ɖe eve eve, hash eve ɖe sia ɖe ɖeka me, eye nàyi edzi. Yi edzi va se ɣe si kpɔkplɔɖa ɖeka ko le dzia. Ɖedziɖula ma nye Merkle ƒe dzita. Nɔnɔme veviŋutɔ ɖeka le eme tso avalanche effect (Nunyaŋlɔɖi 3) me: Dzita la nye nu katã si le etɔ te ƒe kpɔkplɔɖa. Trɔ aɖaka aɖe, to gbɔ ɖeka pɛ, eye eƒe kpɔkplɔɖa atrɔ, si atrɔ eƒe dzila, si atrɔ dzila ma hã, va se ɖe dzi. Dzita la atrɔ. Eyata dzita kpuie ɖeka ate ŋu aɖe ɖase na xexlẽme blibo la ƒe nyateƒe dzadzɛ. Esia ɖea Kuxi gbãtɔ ɖe. --- Ti vavã aɖe si woƒe akɔnta bliboa le Mina míatso aɖaka ene ƒe ti si le etɔ la dzi kple SHA-256 kpɔkplɔɖawo si woƒe akɔnta le aɖakawo A, B, C, D dzi vavã (woɖe digestwo fia kpuie be eƒe xexlẽme nakɔ): Nu katã nye "hash nu aɖe, eye nàhash hashwo ƒe evewo." Nu aɖeke mele eme si wɔ akpa na Nunyaŋlɔɖi 3 o; wode ɖoɖo ti ƒe nɔnɔme me ko. --- Akpa si nyo: kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe ɖaseɖigbalɛ ne mèfia afi o Fifia Kuxi evelia. Gblɔ be nèdi nàɖe ɖase be aɖaka C le ti la me na ame si nya dzita ko. Mèna ti blibo la o. Nèna kpɔkplɔɖawo si hiã be nàtsɔ lia tso C yi dzita la gbɔ, si woyɔna be ɖaseɖeɖe ƒe mɔ [authentication path] (alo Merkle ƒe ɖaseɖigbalɛ): Be nàɖe ɖase be C le ti la me: Na eƒe nɔvi hD, kple Eƒe togbui hAB. Ame si le kpekpeɖeŋu ɖem, esi wònye ame si nya dzita ko, gaɖo akɔnta la ɖo: Woƒe akɔnta wɔ vavã: Esia hena 1b3faa3fcc5e..., si sɔ kple dzita la. Woɖe ɖase be aɖaka la le ti la me. Nu eve wɔa be esia nakpɔ ŋusẽ: Ekpuie. Na aɖaka ene, nèna hash eve. Na ti si me aɖakawo n le, nèna log2(n) hash le eŋu ko. Na aɖaka biliɔn ɖeka, esia nye hash 30 kple eŋu, menye biliɔn ɖeka o. Ɖaseɖigbalɛ la ƒe gãmenyenye mea gã o ne ti la ƒe gãmenyenye ɖo dzi. Enye ɣaɣla ƒe ƒeɖeɖe. Ɖaseɖigbalɛ la fia be wò aɖaka le ti la me afi aɖe. Ne woawɔ esia le zero-knowledge p

title: Zero-Knowledge Ɖaseɖigbalɛ [Proofs]: Ale si Nàfia Be Èle Nyateƒe Gake Mègblɔ Nu Si Ta O
description: Series: Zcash Tso Gɔmedzedze ƒe Gɔmeɖoɖowo Me . Article 5 . Zero-Knowledge Ɖaseɖigbalɛ
text: Zero-Knowledge Ɖaseɖigbalɛ [Proofs]: Ale si Nàfia Be Èle Nyateƒe Gake Mègblɔ Nu Si Ta O Gbedasi ƒe Nyagblɔɖi Tso Annkkitaaa Gbɔ Avɔ̃ si na xexeame katã ƒe amewo ate ŋu akpɔ nya si womate ŋu akpɔ o ƒe nyateƒe Series: Zcash Tso Gɔmedzedze ƒe Gɔmeɖoɖowo Me . Article 5 . Zero-Knowledge Ɖaseɖigbalɛ Amewo si woŋlɔe na: Ame yeyeawo. Míetrɔ ɖo article siwo va do ŋgɔ katã (finite fields, curves, adzɔgbeɖeɖewo, Merkle trees), gake míeɖoa susu siawo katã ɖe edzi ne míele hia wo. Nu si nàtsɔ ado go: Nàse gɔme nyuie, eye wòanya nyateƒe si zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛ nye, ŋugbedodo etɔ si wòwɔ, ale si woɖea nya ɖeɖe siawo katã ƒe ɖase, kple nu si doa ŋusẽ Zcash ƒe Sapling kple Orchard. Esiae nye article si me series blibo la katã le dzodzo na. Tso Article 0 dzi la, míenɔa gbe be woɖea fexexe ƒe nyateƒe "le avɔ̃ megbe," eye woɖea eƒe nyateƒe fia be womefia naneke o. Zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛe nye avɔ̃ ma. Eyae va ɖɔ nya sesẽ si míedze egɔme la: Alekee ame bubuwo ate ŋu akpɔ gaɖoɖo si womede mɔ na wo be woakpɔ o ƒe nyateƒe? --- Nu ka ta wòle be nàdzro eŋu? Bu ŋu ɖe nya si wɔa ŋutinya le Zcash ƒe dzi: Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu [blockchain] le ŋutinya elabena ame sia ame ate ŋu akpɔ eƒe nyateƒe. Zcash ƒe fexexewo nye ɣaɣla [privacy] blibo: ga ƒe asasrã, ame si dɔe, ame si xɔe, wo katã woɣla. Nya siawo ƒe kpɔɖeŋu le abe wodze tsitre ɖe wo nɔewo ŋu ene. Ɖasekpɔkpɔ abe nu si hiã be woakpɔe ene. Ɣaɣla de mɔ kpɔkpɔ ma ŋu. Ne mèkate ŋu aɖe wo ƒe kpɔɖeŋu sia ɖa o la, mèkate ŋu akpɔ ga ɣaɣla si ame sia ame ate ŋu axɔ se ɖe eŋu o. Zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛ (ZKP)e ɖea kpɔɖeŋu ma ɖa. Ena ame si ɖea ɖase ate ŋu aɖe fia na ame si kpɔa ɖase be nya aɖe nye nyateƒe eye womefia naneke tso eŋu wu be enye nyateƒe o. Ga ƒe asasrã aɖeke manɔ o. Ame ƒe dzesi aɖeke manɔ o. Didienu [note] aɖeke manɔ o. Ke ko: "Nu sia mewɔ ɖe seawo katã dzi." Mina míatu gɔmesese la hafi míage ɖe mɔnu sesẽwo me. --- Gɔmesese: ɖaseɖigbalɛ gbetɔ̃ aɖewo Ɖase be nènya password, eye mègblɔe o. Website aɖe ate ŋu akpɔ be nènya wò password to eme be makpɔ wò le nu si password koe ate ŋu aʋu ƒe ʋuʋu me, eye makpɔ password la ŋutɔ o. Nèɖea nyanya ƒe ɖase, eye mède fiafia afia o. Xɔ̃ si mate ŋu akpɔ amadzidze vovototo o kple bola eve. Nèle bola dzĩ aɖe kple bola gbegblẽ aɖe siwo ƒe nɔnɔ ɖeka le wò xɔ̃ si mate ŋu akpɔ amadzidze vovototo o ƒe ŋkume. Èdi be nàna wòaxɔ se be woƒe amadzidze le vovo eye mègblɔ na e be ame kae nye ame kae o. Eɣla bola eveawo le eƒe megbe, eye wòate ŋu aɖɔli wo, eye wòfia ɖeka na wò. Ègblɔ nɛ be eɖɔli wo alo o. Ne bolaawo ƒe amadzidze le vovo tututu la, nèle nyateƒe gblɔm ɣesiaɣi. Ne wole ɖeka ko la, nèle dzodzrom, eye àgbɔ nyateƒe zi ɖeka le zi eve me. Le ƒoƒo 20 megbe la, wò ƒe nyateƒe gblɔgblɔ si medze be o la ana wòaxɔ se be woƒe amadzidze le vovo, gake wòme nya bola kae nye dzĩ o. Exɔ se ɖe nyateƒe aɖe ŋu, eye wòmenya nu bubu aɖeke o. Esiae nye zero knowledge le eƒe suekeke me. Doŋkpe la. Doŋkpe si le ring ƒe nɔnɔ me la ƒe agbe me la, agbo mágica aɖe le eme si ʋuna ne woŋlɔ nya ɣaɣla aɖe ko. Ègblɔ be ènya nya ma. Be nàɖe eƒe nyateƒe fia eye mègblɔe o la: ame si kpɔa ɖase la nɔa gota, eye nèzɔ ge ɖe eme, eye nèfia mɔ ɖe mɔ miɛ alo mɔ gome kple dzodzro. Ame si kpɔa ɖase la va ho mɔ si wòdi be nàdo go tsoe. Ne ènya nya ma tututu la, àte ŋu awɔ nu si wògblɔ ɣesiaɣi (àte ŋu aʋu agbo la be nàtrɔ yi mɔ bubu me ne ele be ewɔ). Ne nèle afɔɖeɖe wɔm la, àte ŋu ado go to mɔ si sɔ ko kple dzodzro, 50/50 le ƒoƒo sia ƒe sia me. Wɔe zi 20, eye ame si le afɔɖeɖe wɔm ƒe mɔnu be wòato eme le ŋgɔme wu milion ɖeka ƒe akpa ɖeka. Doŋkpe ƒe nyagblɔ sia fia ŋugbedodo etɔ si zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛ sia sia lazima be wòawɔ. --- Ŋugbedodo etɔawo Ŋugbedodo Le doŋkpe ƒe nyagblɔ me Le Zcash me --- --- --- Completeness Ne ènya nya la, èdoa go to mɔ sɔ la dzi ɣesiaɣi Gaɖoɖo si le se me ɣesiaɣi naa ɖase si woaxɔ Soundness Ame si le afɔɖeɖe wɔm la woakpɔe le mɔnu sesẽ me Gaɖoɖo si nye atsyɔ̃ (ga si woƒo, double-spend) mate ŋu awɔ ɖase si woaxɔ o Zero-knowledge Ame si kpɔa ɖase la mese nya ɣaɣla l

title: Ɣaɣla [Shielded] Protocol, Ƒe Godoo Katã
description: Ƒometɔƒo: Zcash tso Gɔmedzedze Ƒe Gɔmeɖosewo Me . Agbalẽ 6 . Ɣaɣla Protocol (nuwuwu)
text: Ɣaɣla [Shielded] Protocol, Ƒe Godoo Katã Nugbegbe ƒe Nudzodzro tso Annkkitaaa gbɔ Nu siawo katã ƒe ƒoƒo ɖe ɣaɣla Zcash gaɖoɖo [transaction] ɖeka me Ƒometɔƒo: Zcash tso Gɔmedzedze Ƒe Gɔmeɖosewo Me . Agbalẽ 6 . Ɣaɣla Protocol (nuwuwu) Ame siwo wòŋlɔ na: Ame yeye siwo xlẽ Agbalẽ 0 va se 5. Afisiae nu katã doa ƒo. Nu si nàva kplɔ ayi: Nunya ƒe nɔnɔme blibo, si le ete ŋu le ɣaɣla Zcash gaɖoɖo ŋu, eye ƒometɔƒo la me ƒe nuxexlẽwo katã le woƒe teƒe nyuitɔ me, eye Agbalẽ 0 me ƒe ɣletiviwo katã woƒo. Míedze egɔme le Agbalẽ 0 me kple kpɔɖeŋu dze siwo me mɔme le, eye míeƒo nu tso agbalẽwo siwo wòtu ƒo ɖe kplɔŋlɔ dzikpɔa dzi. Emegbe míetsɔ agbalẽ atɔ̃ tu akpaawo: field siwo wòɖe kpɔ, elliptic curves, adzɔgbeɖeɖe [commitments], Merkle tiwo, kple zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛwo [proofs]. Fifia míatsɔ wo ado ƒo eye míakpɔ ale si fexexe ɣaɣla aɖe wɔe tso gɔmedzedze va se nuwuwu. --- Nu ka tae wòle be nàtsɔe ɖe asi? Ne wòkpɔ ɖeka ɖeka la, akpa siwo katã nèsrɔ la wɔnɔŋlɔ le. Ke Zcash ƒe nukunɔamesi le ale si woƒoa ƒo kple wo nɔewo. Gaɣaɣla ɖeɖe dzesi [nullifier] ɖeka ko mena ɣaɣla o. Adzɔgbeɖeɖe ɖeka ko metea mɔ aɖe tso aɖaŋudzedze ŋu o. Ɖaseɖigbalɛ ɖeka ko meɖea nu si anyi ŋu o. Ƒoƒo lae trɔ akpa atɔ̃ la wo zu ga si le ɣaɣla me eye wòle dzɔdzɔe hã. Agbalẽ sia nye ƒoƒo la. Ne nàwu la, nyagblɔɖi sia "mɔ̃ la doa gaɖoɖo aɖe si wòmate ŋu akpɔ ƒe nyateƒe ɖe asi" ava natsɔe abe kpɔɖeŋu dze si me mɔme le o, ke boŋ abe nu si dze ƒe akpa siwo nèse gɔme xoxo me ene. --- Ame siwo le nya la me, woƒo ƒo ake Esi nye ƒometɔƒo blibo la le axa ɖeka dzi, wòtsɔ Agbalẽ 0 ƒe nya la ƒe akpaawo sɔ kple mɔ̃ la ƒe wɔwɔnuwo. Agbalẽ 0 ƒe nya ƒe akpa Wɔwɔnu vevi Woetu tso --- --- --- Ga si le agbalẽ me Didienu [Note] (asixɔxɔ, ame si wòle be wòaxɔe, random nudzɔdzɔ) woŋlɔe abe field ƒe elements ene (Agb 1) Agbalẽ si wòtu eye wòle kpeŋkpeŋ Didienu ƒe adzɔgbeɖeɖe [Note commitment] Pedersen / Sinsemilla adzɔgbeɖeɖe (Agb 2, 3) Kplɔŋlɔ dzikpɔa Didienu ƒe adzɔgbeɖeɖe ti [Note commitment tree] (anchor = etɔ) Merkle ti si wòle gɔmeɖoɖo me (Agb 4) Dzodzro token Gaɣaɣla ɖeɖe dzesi [Nullifier] ZK-dze hash si wòle didienu kple klu si me ame aɖe ko nya me (Agb 2, 3) "Ga si ge ɖe eme sɔ kple ga si doa tso eme" Asixɔxɔ ƒe adzɔgbeɖeɖewo [Value commitments] + balance ƒe kpɔkpɔ Pedersen adzɔgbeɖeɖewo siwo le homomorphic (Agb 2, 3) Nukunɔamesi si le avɔ la megbe Zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛ [Zero-knowledge proof] zk-SNARK le arithmetic circuit aɖe dzi (Agb 5) "Wò ko ate ŋu axlẽ wò agbalẽ" Didienu si wòɣlaŋlɔ [Encrypted note] + nukpɔsafuiwo [viewing keys] ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ [encryption] + kluwo ƒe ƒomeɖoɖo (agbalẽ sia) --- Afisi kluwo tso Nu si katã ame aɖe ate ŋu awɔ la tsoa klu ɣaɣla ɖeka, si nye gazazãsafui [spending key], to mɔ ɖeka ƒe ƒomeɖoɖo me (ama ɖeka ɖeka fia dzedze si mate ŋu atrɔ megbe o, le Articles 2 kple 3 me ƒe trapdoorwo ƒe amenuveve me): Nu eve si dze be nàkpɔe, elabena wo katã tsoa agbalẽ siwo do ŋgɔ me: Mamã la na wòte ŋu nàtsɔ nukpɔsafui [viewing key] aɖe na ame aɖe (abe auditor ene), si fia wò gaɖoɖowo ke mena mɔ be wòatsɔe afexɛ o. Ɣaɣla nye nu si woate ŋu atia, menye nu sia katã alo melẽ o. Dzedze ɖeka ɖeka nye mɔ ɖeka: nukpɔsafui aɖe si ame le asi me mate ŋu ana ame ma ate ŋu axɔ gazazãsafui la gbɔ o; enye elliptic-curve trapdoor tso Agbalẽ 2 me, si wɔa eƒe dɔ. --- Didienu aɖe fexexe: nyateƒe ene Ne wòdi be nàfexɛ didienu aɖe le ɣaɣla me la, ele be nàde dzesi na mɔ̃ la be nyateƒe ene le eme ɖe ɣeyiɣi ɖeka me eye mèfia didienu la, eƒe asixɔxɔ, eƒe nɔƒe, alo wòame nyenye o. Nyateƒe ɖeka ɖeka xɔa dzadzraɖoɖo aɖe si nènya xoxo. Ɖaseɖigbalɛ la mefia nyateƒe siwo le ete kuraa o (didienu kae, ame ka ƒe klu, asixɔxɔ kae). Efiya ko be nyateƒe ene la katã le eme. Esiae nye ɣaɣla Zcash ƒe nukunu blibo, abe woɖee fia le nɔnɔmetata ɖeka me ene. --- Asixɔxɔ-balance ƒe mɔ (nu vevi si míede ɖe megbe) Le Articles 2 kple 3 me la, míegblɔ be Pedersen adzɔgbeɖeɖewo doa ƒo: adzɔgbeɖeɖe si le v1 ŋu kple adzɔgbeɖeɖe si le v2 ŋu nye adzɔgbeɖeɖe le v1 + v2 ŋu. text: Ɣaɣla [Shielded] Nyadzɔdzɔgbalẽ [Newsletters] Ɖoɖo [Setup] Zebrad ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ [node] si le dɔ wɔm eye wòde sync bliboa, si me RPCwo le dɔ wɔm eye woɖoe be woadzã cookies zainod de sync bliboa Zallet woɖoe be wòawɔ RPCwo Dze Zallet gɔme ./target/release/zallet -c /home/zktails/.zallet/zallet.toml start kple zallet.toml faɖe si woɖo ɖe eŋu toml ƒe kpɔɖeŋu: toCurl.sh chmod +x toCurl.sh Trɔ asi le zebrad RPC (8232) port si sɔ ŋu eye nàtsɔ username kple pw tso zebrad cookie me akpe ɖe eŋu cookie:yourpasswordhere Do RPC ƒe dodokpɔ ./target/release/zallet -c /home/zktails/.zallet/zallet.toml rpc help Ele be wòana Nudzɔdzɔ: Kpɔ be zallet executable ƒe kɔpi le folder si me nèle script la ƒom le Ƒu skriptwo chmod +x ascii2hex hex2ascii shieldNewsletter.sh txBuilderFromFile.sh toCurl.sh Trɔ asi le daoAddress.md ŋu kple UAwo si nèdi be nàzã Ʋu txBuilderFromFile.sh eye nàtrɔ asi le "from" variable la ŋu be wòanye UA si woxɔ ga ɖo ɖe zallet gakotoku [wallet] me Emegbe la, ./shieldNewsletter.sh yourNewsletterHere.md

title: Hame ƒe Dɔwɔwɔwo
description: Di dɔwɔnu [tools], gakotoku [wallets], dɔwɔwɔ ƒe mɔnuwo, agbalẽ ƒe haewo, kple ecosystem ƒe ƒoƒoƒowo si Zcash hame la kple zero-knowledge ecosystem gãtɔ la wɔ.
text: Hame ƒe Dɔwɔwɔwo Di dɔwɔnu [tools], gakotoku [wallets], dɔwɔwɔ ƒe mɔnuwo, agbalẽ ƒe haewo, kple ecosystem ƒe ƒoƒoƒowo si Zcash hame la kple zero-knowledge ecosystem gãtɔ la wɔ. --- Nusrɔ̃, Nyadzɔdzɔ, kple Hame Nye Ƒe Gbãtɔ Zcash Nusrɔ̃ ƒe dɔwɔwɔgbalẽ si Zcash ƒe xexeme hame la wɔ. Yi nàkpɔ ZECPublish Social media si censorship mate ŋu kpe ɖe eŋu o, si Zcash blockchain [blockchain]-me ŋusẽ wɔna. Eƒe agbalẽ ƒe ƒoƒo me la, Zcash ƒe zãlawo ƒe ƒeƒoƒo kple nya si wome nya ame si ŋlɔe o ƒe ƒuƒo le. (Ƒe 2026 ƒe dzove me la, site la mele dɔ wɔm o.) ZK Radio Radio ƒe nudzodzro le internet dzi si wotu be wòana nyatakaka, anɔ ame nusrɔ̃m, eye wòakpɔ Zcash hame la ƒe dzidzɔ. Zcash en Español kple ZKAV Club wɔe. Yi nàkpɔ ZShieldHer Zcash nusrɔ̃ ƒe site na amesiwo xɔ aƒeme vevi ƒe fu. Yi nàkpɔ ZecForge Nuwɔla ƒe dɔwɔƒe na Zcash ecosystem, si tsɔ eŋku ɖe amewo xɔxɔ, nuwɔla ƒe ŋgɔyiyi, kple emenyawo mama ŋu. Yi nàkpɔ Zcash Video Ƒe Ƒuƒoƒo Nusrɔ̃ ƒe video ƒe ƒuƒoƒo blibo si ƒe nyae nye Zcash ƒe mɔ̃, cryptography, ekonomi, kple dziɖuɖu [governance]. Yi nàkpɔ Zcast Spanish gbegblɔme Zcash podcast kple ecosystem la ƒe yeyewo. Yi nàkpɔ Zero-knowledge Audiovisual Club (ZKAV) Audiovisual ƒe ƒuƒoƒo si tsɔ ɣaɣla [privacy] de gbã, si fana amewo, wɔa nu kple wo nɔewo, eye wòdea toɖoɖo ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu na open-source kple ha nuɖo agni [decentralized] ƒe mɔ̃ hame ƒe nudzɔdzɔwo. Yi nàkpɔ Zcash Network School Nusrɔ̃ ƒe emenyawo si woɖo ɖe ɖoɖo me na Zcash zãla yeyeawo kple mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔlawo [developers]. ƒuƒoƒe Zectastic Site si me gamewo si wode Zcash ƒe nɔnɔwo kple hame ƒe nudzɔdzɔ siwo wɔna le esi ma esi la le. Yi nàkpɔ ZEC App Mobile ƒe dɔwɔwɔmɔnu si ƒoa ZEC nyadzɔdzɔwo, hame ƒe dɔwɔwɔ, network ƒe nyatakakawo, gakotokuwo, gatrɔƒewo [exchanges], kple ecosystem ƒe nuɖoɖowo katã ɖe teƒe ɖeka. ƒuƒoƒe PGPZ Hame Hame ƒe teƒe na Pretty Good Policy for Zcash (PGPZ), Washington D.C. ƒe politika ƒe ƒoƒoƒe si tsɔ eŋku ɖe digital cash si ɣaɣla naa, se ƒe wɔwɔ si dze anyi, kple Zcash ƒe dɔ si le dukɔ blibo la ƒe nyui ŋu. Yi nàkpɔ Gleyo Hame ƒe akpaɖeɖe kple fetu nana ƒe platform si woɖe ɖe Zcash hamewo, Web3 ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo, kple Web2 ƒe habɔbɔwo ta. Ena hamewo xɔa memewo eye woɖea wo ŋu to quests, chat, kple fetuwo me, eye ena zãlawo ŋu xɔa eye woaɖe ɣaɣla ZEC. Yi nàkpɔ Zcash Ga ƒe Kpekpeɖeŋuwo ƒe Teƒe [Grants Hub] Ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu [grant] ƒe ɖoɖowo ƒuƒopé [dashboard] sia nye hame la tɔ. Wowɔe be wòana Zcash ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋuwo didi, woƒe yome kpɔkpɔ, kple woƒe nudzodzro nanɔ bɔbɔe. Eƒoa ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe biabiawo, dɔa ƒe afɔɖoƒewo, ga ƒe ɖoɖowo, dzeɖoɖowo, kple nyatakakawo ƒe dzodzro nu ƒu ɖe teƒe ɖeka. Ewɔa esia to nyatakaka yeyewo xɔxɔ tso Zcash Community Grants GitHub repository la me. Platform la ƒe taɖodzinue nye be wòana nɔnɔme si me kɔ wu eye zãlawo zãna bɔbɔe la ame siwo bia ga, komiti ƒe hametɔwo, kple hame la ƒe nudzodzrolawo. Yi nàkpɔe --- Gakotokuwo Kple Fexexe [Payment] Ƒe Dɔwɔnuwo CipherPay Fexexewo si le ɣaɣla me na internet. Menye asikplɔ-dzralá [custodial] o, KYC mele o. Asitsɔlaawo xɔa ZEC tẽ ɖe ɣaɣla gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo dzi. Yi nàkpɔ eZcash Gakotoku Zcash si bɔbɔe be woazã, si ƒe nuteƒewo katã le eme, eye wòwɔa dɔ le platform geɖe dzi, kple autoshielding ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu. Yi nàkpɔ Nozy Wallet Orchard-gbãtɔ ƒe Zcash gakotoku si woɖo na zebrad kple lightwalletd. Ekpe ɖe ɣaɣla me dzidzɔ kple xɔxɔ blibo, key ƒe dzikpɔkpɔ le afi me, kple Ironwood (NU6.3) didienuwo kple Orchard-tso-Ironwood ƒe trɔtrɔ. Woɖea nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo ɖa le fexexe ƒe mɔnu si zãlawo kpɔa la me. Yi nàkpɔ Overpay.com Fexexe ƒe gateway si na zãlawo ŋu zãa ɣaɣla ZEC be woaƒle nu siwo le xexeme vavã me (fifia le alpha me). Yi nàkpɔ ZcashToCash ZcashToCash (zcashto.cash) — ZEC ɖe Cash App, Chime, Monzo, Revolut, Venmo, alo Zelle dzi to Peer me. Woatrɔa ZEC ɖe USDC (NEAR), eye Peer ƒe order si le Base la ɖea USDC ɖe asi me ne taker la ɖe fia fexexe la ƒe kpeɖeŋu. Taker la kpɔa fexexe-app ƒe zãla ƒe ŋkɔ. Menye CEX o, eye menye ZEC si le escrow me o. Yi nàkpɔ Zafu Wallet Open-source

title: Zcash Ƒome ƒe Aɖaŋuɖoɖo Hamea

text: Zcash Ƒome ƒe Aɖaŋuɖoɖo Hamea Zcash Ƒome ƒe Aɖaŋuɖoɖo Hamea, alo ZCAP, nye ha si Zcash Ƒome ƒe membawoe wɔ. Woɖo eɖe anyi be woatsɔ aƒe na ƒomea be woadze eme eye woana woƒe aɖaŋu ne Zcash Foundation hiã be wòawɔ ŋuɖoɖo si ku ɖe ƒomea ŋu alo si ahe to eme na eŋu. Tso 2018 si woɖo eɖe anyi la, hamea kpe ɖe Zcash Foundation ŋu be wòana mɔ na ŋuɖoɖo vevi geɖe, siwo dometɔ aɖewo nye: Zcash ƒe Trademark: Akɔtɔɖeɖe sia ku ɖe be Zcash Foundation nadia mɔ be yeawɔ se ƒe ƒomekɔkɔ kple Electric Coin Company (ECC) be woama Zcash trademark ƒe nɔnɔviɖoɖo kple dɔdzikpɔkpɔ Ga ƒe Ðoɖoɖo: Akɔtɔɖeɖe sia ku ɖe be Zcash Foundation nadze agbagba be woatrɔ nu aɖe le Zcash ga ƒe ɖoɖoɖo me, abe ga si wodoa ƒe kadodo, fetu ƒe afãmama ƒe ɖoɖoɖo, alo asixɔxɔ ƒe kadodo ene ASIC Ƒe Dzɔdzɔeƒe Mɔxexe: Akɔtɔɖeɖe sia ku ɖe be Zcash Foundation nade asi ɖe ASIC ƒe dzɔdzɔeƒe mɔxexe ŋu abe nudzɔdzɔ kple taɖodzinu na Zcash network Zcash Community Grants Committee Ƒe Amewo Tia: Akɔtɔɖeɖe sia ku ɖe be woatia ame eve le Zcash Community Grants (ZCG) committee me, si wɔa dɔ be yeakpɔ ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe ɖeɖeviwo ɖa eye wòana wo ga na Zcash-kukuwo Zcash Minor Grants Program: Akɔtɔɖeɖe sia ku ɖe be woaxɔ alo woagbe ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe biabiawo na Zcash kuku suewo, siwo bia ga tso Zcash Foundation gbɔ [Zcash ɣaɣla ƒe nunɔamesiwo [Shielded Assets] ƒe zazã kple wɔwɔ](https://vote.heliosvoting.org/helios/elections/5dd57b92-01ed-11ec-a0a8-ae3066fac55d/view), si na be woazã DeFi ƒe nunɔamesiwo le Zcash ƒe ɣaɣla ecosystem si nye nɔnɔ gɔmeɖeɖe la me. Zcash Foundation Board of Directors ƒe membawo ƒe tiatia ZCAP ƒe susu nye be woawɔe kple ƒome ƒe memba vovovowo, siwo tso dukɔ vovovowo me, siwo wɔnɔƒe kple tametoto vovovo le. Esia ana be wòanɔ te ɖe eƒe taɖodzinu, si nye be yeatsɔ Zcash zazãlawo kple stake holders ƒe gbe kple dzidzɔ na, le esime wòele network si ʋuʋu eye wòxɔ ame vovovo wɔm. Le October 2023 me la, ZCAP ƒe memba 188 le, eye woɖea eƒe membawo kpɔ zi geɖe. Gawu la, Zcash Foundation "ɖe eligibility criteria la hãkeke na ZCAP membership, eye criteria siwo Zcash community ƒe membawo tsɔ na hã le eme". text: Zcash Ecosystem ƒe Dedienɔnɔ Ecosystem ƒe Dedienɔnɔ ƒe Kplɔla Wode Zcash Ecosystem ƒe Dedienɔnɔ ƒe Kplɔla ƒe dɔa dzi to ZCG ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu me be woana dedienɔnɔ ƒe mɔnuwo ƒe dzadzra kple dɔwɔwɔ si ŋutɔ na Zcash ecosystem blibo la — vevietɔ na ZCG ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu xɔlawo — le ECC kple ZF ƒe afiawo. 2022–2023: earthrise wɔ dɔ abe Ecosystem ƒe Dedienɔnɔ ƒe Kplɔla gbãtɔ ene. Srɔ̃ nu geɖe le zecsec.com. 2024–2025: ZCG tia Least Authority be woayi edzi awɔ dɔa to RFP yeyee me. Wòate ŋu akpɔ nyitsotso le afi sia. 2026: Shielded Labs xɔ Taylor Hornby abe dedienɔnɔ ƒe aɖaŋuɖola ene be wòakpe ɖe Zcash ƒe dedienɔnɔ ƒe ŋusẽwo ŋu. ZCG Dedienɔnɔ kple Gbegbe ƒe Fiaɖuɖu ƒe Dɔwɔwɔ ZCG Dedienɔnɔ kple Gbegbe ƒe Fiaɖuɖu ƒe Dɔwɔwɔ na ɖoɖo si me woate ŋu akpɔ dedienɔnɔ ƒe gbegblẽwo ƒe nya ɖeɖe ɖeɖoɖo me le Zcash ecosystem blibo la me. Dedienɔnɔ ƒe Nyitsotso Yeyeawo (2026) Zebra 4.4.1 (May 2026): Wodo dedienɔnɔ ƒe dzadzra vevi aɖe ɖe go. Wodo ŋusẽ na ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ ƒe dɔwɔlawo katã be woawɔ yeyetɔ enumake. Zebra 4.3.1 (April 2026): Wodo dedienɔnɔ ƒe dzadzra veviwo, nukuku si woɖo le Docker me, kple CI ƒe sesẽwɔwɔ ɖe go. Gbegbe Geɖewo Ƒe Dzadzra (April 2026): Woɖe Zcash gbegblẽ geɖewo ɖa nyuie ne womeɖe asi le zãlawo ƒe ga alo ɣaɣla ŋu o. zcashd Ƒe Nyagblɔɖoɖo (April 2026): Nyagblɔɖoɖo si ana zcashd ƒe aʋawɔƒe si woate ŋu adze la nasẽ ɖe anyi to trafik ƒe tom ɖe Zebra dzi. Gbegbe Ƒe Fiaɖuɖu Kple Dɔmefɔfɔ Nyuitɔ Electric Coin Company kple Zcash Foundation siawo katã ɖo ɖe Gbegbe Ƒe Fiaɖuɖu Kple Dɔmefɔfɔ Nyuitɔ ƒe segbalẽ sia nu, eye vovototo sia koe li: "Zcash nye mɔ̃ si na ɣaɣla sesĩe. Wona didienuwo ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ ɖe woƒe afiƒo, eye wometsɔ zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛwo kplɔ ga ƒe teƒe la ɖe asi o, si woɖe be ame si le Zcash ŋutɔ ƒe asi koe ate ŋu awɔ. Ne esia mewɔ o, eye dzodzro ƒe gbegblẽ aɖe do le eme la, womate ŋu azã dzodzro ƒe gbegblẽ ma ne mɔ aɖeke mele gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu ƒe xexlẽlawo si woate ŋu adze ame si wɔe la alo data kae le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu me si wo zã be woawɔ gbegblẽa la kpɔ o. Eya ta mègawɔ megbe yi teƒe ma ŋgɔ, abe ale si wowɔe le dɔwɔƒe bubuwo me le nyateƒe siawo me ene, o. Segbalẽa ƒo nu tso gbegblẽ ƒe nyagblɔlawo ŋu, siwo ƒe nya katã le eme be woate ŋu awɔe ake. Esia hiã, kpɔɖeŋu, ne gɔmeɖeɖe ƒe ame si tso afima o le eɖem fia kple da ɖase be dedienɔnɔ ƒe kuxi aɖe le eme vavã, eye dedienɔnɔ ƒe kuxi ma le vevi si wogblɔ be ele — si na hatsotso si wɔa nutowo ate ŋu ade dzesi nu sia ƒe vevi nyuie eye woaɖe eɖa. Ke ne dzodzro ƒe gbegblẽ aɖe li la, abe CVE-2019-7167 me ene, míate ŋu atia be míegatsɔ nyatiawo ma akpe ɖe miaƒe nyagblɔwo ŋu na hadɔwɔlawo hafi woadoe ɖe go le ɖoɖo me o, ne míeka ɖe edzi be woate ŋu axɔa kuxi la." Dedienɔnɔ ƒe Nusiwo Wòate Ŋu Azã Zcash Dedienɔnɔ ƒe Nyagblɔɖoɖowo Zebra Dedienɔnɔ ƒe Nyagblɔɖoɖowo Ƒo nyagblɔ tso gbegbe aɖe ŋu le zcash/zcash Ƒo nyagblɔ tso gbegbe aɖe ŋu na ZF

title: Ɖe GitHub Repo kple IPFS
description: Le mɔfia sia me la, míesrɔ ale si nàwɔ Git URL si woate ŋu aklɔn na wò GitHub repository, eye woɖea eƒe dɔ kple IPFS CID. Esia le vevie be nuawo nɔ anyi togbɔ…
text: Ɖe GitHub Repo kple IPFS Gɔmedzedze Le mɔfia sia me la, míesrɔ ale si nàwɔ Git URL si woate ŋu aklɔn na wò GitHub repository, eye woɖea eƒe dɔ kple IPFS CID. Esia le vevie be nuawo nɔ anyi togbɔ be nèli le afi kae le xexeame o, be woate ŋu akpe ɖe asi me, eye wòazu heheɖoƒe si me nyatakaka xɔasiwo nɔ ɣeyiɣi didi! Didienu: Nyatakaka si wòde ɖe IPFS dzi la, network ƒe zazã katã ate ŋu akpɔe. Àte ŋu adi be nàwɔ ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ [encryption] na wò nyatakaka siwo nye wò tɔ alo siwo xɔ asi le teƒe si dzi. Ɖo IPFS Kubo Dze installation ƒe mɔfia si woɖo afi la yome. Le kpɔɖeŋu sia me la, míezã Linux, OS ƒe version bubuwo hã li. Kpɔ be installation la dzi nyuie to "ipfs --version" zazã me. Klɔn Repository Be nàdze egɔme la, tia Git repository si nèdi be nàhost, eye nàklɔne: Wɔ command sia: "git clone https://github.com/zechub/zechub" Azɔ la, na wòanɔ dzadzra be woaklɔne to IPFS dzi. cd zechub git update-server-info Ʋu Git ƒe objectwo: mv objects/pack/.pack . git unpack-objects < .pack rm -f .pack objects/pack/ Esia wɔwɔ ana IPFS nate ŋu awɔ objectwo ƒe deduplication ne nàtrɔ Git repository la emegbe. Kpe ɖe IPFS ŋu Ne nèwu esia wɔwɔ vɔ la, repository ma dzadzra be woaɖe eƒe dɔ. Nu si susɔ koe nye be nàkpe ɖe IPFS ŋu: $ pwd /code/myrepo $ ipfs add -r . CID si wòkpɔe: Qmbgqox5g3614gjTb43s5mdSmmk95aGWWA9EHksL2T91A2 Enyo ŋutɔ! Azɔ wò repository la yia ɖe network la dzi. Klɔn kple IPFS Azɔ la, ele be nàte ŋu axɔ github repository la kple: git clone http://ipfs.io/ipfs/"yourCID" Ke boŋ la, àte ŋu adi eye nàxɔe kple wòƒe IPFS ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ. Didienu mamlɛtɔ: Repo ƒe folder si le IPFS dzi la mexɔa updatewo ɖo kple github repository si le nyateƒe me o. Woɖe eƒe susu be nàde folder la ɖe dzi ake le ɣeyiɣiwo ƒe dome.

title: Ɖe Website ɖe IPFS dzi
description: IPFS (InterPlanetary File System) nye peer-to-peer protocol kple network si wo wɔ be wòawɔ mɔ ha nuɖo agni [decentralized] na filewo ƒe dzadzra kple mama.
text: Ɖe Website ɖe IPFS dzi Nyaɖeɖe tso IPFS ŋu IPFS (InterPlanetary File System) nye peer-to-peer protocol kple network si wo wɔ be wòawɔ mɔ ha nuɖo agni [decentralized] na filewo ƒe dzadzra kple mama. Vovototo le internet ƒe client-server model blema la kple IPFS dome elabena IPFS na mɔ ezãlawo be woama filewo na wo nɔewo tẽ, ɖe woate ŋu akpɔ server aɖe si wozu ɖoƒe ɖeka na nuwo ƒe dzadzra kple mama dzi o. Wona IPFS me filewo ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi [address] kple content-addressing, si fia be wona hash tɔxɛ kple CONTENT IDENTIFIER (CID) na file sia file tso eƒe emetsonu me, eye wozã hash sia be woatsɔ afɔ file la le network la me. IPFS dzraa nyatakakawo ɖo abe gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe [blocks] siwo wodzea si to CID wo dzi ene. Ne èɖe file aɖe kpe ɖe eŋu la, edzraa ɖoe ɖe wò ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ [node] dzi; meɖoa eƒe kɔpi ɖe ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ bubuwo dzi le eɖokui si o. Na eƒe kɔpi aɖe si ŋu woate ŋu aɖo la nanɔ online, alo wɔ ɖoɖo na dzraɖoɖo le adzɔge [remote pinning], ale be exlẽla bubuwo nate ŋu axɔe. Kpɔ IPFS ƒe anyinɔnɔ ɖaa. Xlẽ Nyaɖeɖe tso IPFS ŋu Wò Site ƒe Wɔwɔ Le kpɔɖeŋu sia me la, míele website bɔbɔe aɖe wɔm. Kpɔɖeŋu Site Afɔ 1: Ne mènya web design nyuie o la, ŋlɔ emetsonu vevi na wò website, si me Title, nuŋlɔŋlɔ vevi, linkwo ɖe axa bubuwo/site bubuwo kple footerwo le. Afɔ 2: Zã HTML template!. Tsɔ nuŋlɔŋlɔ si nèŋlɔ la de eme ɖe eƒe teƒewoe. Wòate ŋu awɔ .CSS stylesheet hã na wò website, ne wòdi. Afɔ 3: Tsɔ wò homepage de index.html me le site ƒe folder la ƒe ke (root) me. Tsɔ eƒe nɔnɔmetatawo kple CSS hã de eme, eye nàzã mɔ siwo do ƒome kple wo nɔewo (relative paths) abe style.css ene, ale be woawɔ dɔ le IPFS gateway URL te hã. Ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ ƒe ƒoƒo IPFS Desktop kpɔa ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ (node) dzi na wò. Na wòasi ɖaa le esime nèle wò nyatakakadzraɖoƒe (site) mam. Le mɔ si dzi nàto le command-line dzi ta la, wɔ repository yeye aɖe ƒe gɔmedzedze zi ɖeka ko: Emegbe dze ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ la gɔme eye nàna terminal sia nanɔ ʋuʋu: Wɔ sedede siwo susɔ la le terminal evelia me. Mègadze daemon evelia gɔme o ne IPFS Desktop le nyati sia dzi kpɔm xoxo. Tsɔ Site Folder de IPFS me: Le IPFS Desktop me la, tia faɛl siwo le wò nyatakakadzraɖoƒe (website) ŋu la ƒe agbalẽgo to "Add Folder" tiatia la dzi. -- Na CLI (Command Line Interface) mɔ la, wɔ esia tso wò site la ƒe agbalẽdzraɖoƒe ƒe dada-agbalẽdzraɖoƒe me: Ɖɔli foldername ɖe wò agbalẽdzraɖoƒe (folder) ƒe ŋkɔ teƒe (tsɔ ŋkɔ siwo me teƒe ƒuƒluwo le la de nuŋlɔdzesi "…" me). Dzra CID la ɖo le fli added ... foldername mamlɛtɔ dzi: eyae ɖea agbalẽdzraɖoƒe blibo la fiana, menye index.html ɖeɖe ko o. Ɖe Site la ɖe IPFS dzi: CLI ipfs add sedede la tsɔa nu siwo nètsɔ de eme la dea pin wò kɔmpiuta dzi le gɔmedzedzea me. Ŋlɔ esia nàtsɔ akpɔ folder la ƒe pin: Ɖɔli YOURFOLDERCID kple CID si nèkpɔ le afɔɖeɖe si do ŋgɔ me; ele be nusi do goe nagblɔ be recursive. Pinning (nu ɖoɖo ɖe te) kpɔa ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ sia ƒe kɔpi ta tso nu gbegblẽwo ŋuti ɖeɖeɖa (garbage collection) me, gake mewɔnɛ be kɔmpiuta si wotsi la nanɔ internet dzi o. Be nàte ŋu akpɔ nuawo esime wò ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ mele internet dzi o la, ɖo pinning tso adzɔge (remote pinning) eye nàkpɔ egbɔ be dɔwɔƒe si le adzɔge la wu pinning nu. Ge ɖe wò website me le IPFS dzi: Gbã la, kpɔ wò website to local gateway (mɔnu si dzi nàto ge ɖe nyatakakawo me le wò kɔmpiuta dzi) dzi le http://127.0.0.1:8080/ipfs/YOURFOLDERCID/ (zã gateway port si wò daemon ɖe fia ne mesɔ kple esia o). Slash si le nuwuwu la na be links siwo do ƒome kple teƒe (relative links) nawɔ dɔ le directory la me. Dutoƒe gateway abe https://ipfs.io/ipfs/YOURFOLDERCID/ ene ate ŋu aɖe wò website la afia ne ete ŋu xɔ emenyawo tso ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ (node) si wòate ŋu ade gbe na la gbɔ. Ne wò website la dze nyuie le wò ŋutɔ wò kɔmpiuta dzi la, menye kpeɖodzi be amewo katã ate ŋu akpɔe le dutoƒo o. Le míatɔ ƒe nɔnɔme me la, CID = "QmW2UEfap1vrRRvS5H9wed8qmsx4WsvXBk3GPGVVfWx3r3" IPNS Interplanetary Naming System (IPNS) na mɔ wò be nàtrɔ IPFS CID siwo wotsi kple wò website la, eye nàɖe link ɖeka si me

title: Zcash Gaɖoɖo kple dziɖuɖu [Governance] ƒe nyatakaka
description: Zcash ƒe ɖoɖonu dzi [on-chain] gaɖoɖo ƒe mɔnu, gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe [block] ƒe fetuɖoɖo ƒe mɔnuwo, kple habɔbɔwo ƒe gãtɔwo ƒe dɔwɔwɔ
text: Zcash Gaɖoɖo kple dziɖuɖu [Governance] ƒe nyatakaka Zcash ƒe ɖoɖonu dzi [on-chain] gaɖoɖo ƒe mɔnu, gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe [block] ƒe fetuɖoɖo ƒe mɔnuwo, kple habɔbɔwo ƒe gãtɔwo ƒe dɔwɔwɔ Ale si Zcash ƒe gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe fetuwo wɔa dɔe Zcash nye dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɖaseɖigbalɛ [Proof-of-Work] crypto ga. Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe sia sia si woku la maa wɔna be woama gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu (ZEC si wo wɔ yeyee) kple gaɖoɖo [transaction] ƒe adzɔ [fee]wo le mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ [network upgrade] ƒe se si wode ɖo la nu. Mɔnu si le azɔ (NU6.1 / tso November 24, 2025 yi ɖe edzi) Mamae nye: Nusi xɔa Fetuƒe Nusi wònaa ga na / eƒe nɔnɔme -------------------------------- ------------ ------------------------------------------------------------- Nukulawo [miners] 80% Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe fetu si wòɖo ɖe nukulawo tẽe Zcash Community Grants (ZCG) 8% Hame ƒe ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu [grant]wo (eyi edzi va se ɖe 2028) Ga si ga ŋutɔwo kpɔa eŋu (Coinholder-Controlled Fund) 12% Lockbox xoxo la ƒe gawoe wotsɔ dze egɔme; ga ŋutɔwo tiaa ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋuwo (ZIP 1016) NU6 megbeɖeɖe ƒe dev fund xoxo (2020-Nov 2024) Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu sia sia ƒe 20% yi ɖe mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔla [developer] habɔbɔwo gbɔ tẽe: 7% -> Electric Coin Company (ECC) / Bootstrap Project 5% -> Zcash Foundation (ZF) 8% -> Zcash Community Grants (ZCG) Woɖe "dev fund" 20% sia ɖa eye wotsɔ ZCG 8% + lockbox 12% ƒe ɖoɖo ɖo eteƒe to ZIP 1015 (NU6, November 2024) me. Tso November 2024 va se ɖe November 2025 la, 12% la nɔ ƒoƒom ɖe Deferred Dev Fund Lockbox me, eye mɔnu aɖeke menɔ anyi be woazãe o. Mɔnu si le zazã me fifia: ZIP 1016 - Hame kple Coinholder ƒe gaɖoɖo ƒe mɔnu Wowɔ ZIP 1016 (le February 2025 me) wòdze dɔwɔwɔ gɔme le mainnet dzi to NU6.1 dzi le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 3,146,400 dzi le November 24, 2025 (ZIP 255). Eya: Yi edzi le 8% ƒe mama wɔm na ZCG. Trɔ lockbox 12% la wòzu "Coinholder-Controlled Fund" (si wotu tso lockbox ƒe ga si le xoxo kple gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu 12% si yi edzi la me). Awɔ dɔ va se ɖe fetu ƒe afãmama (halving) etɔ̃lia dzi (ZIP la ɖe mɔ be ŋkeke ma natrɔ ne NU7 trɔ gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒewo ƒe ɣeyiɣi). Ɖe mɔ na ZEC coin ƒe nɔlawo be woatia nu le ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋuwo ŋu (ame geɖe ƒe akɔntaɖeɖe bɔbɔe, ZEC 420,000 ya teti ƒe nutiatia). Bia tso Key-Holder Organizations (si woƒo ZF kple Shielded Labs ɖe eme fifia, eye woƒo Bootstrap/ECC ƒe ŋkɔ le ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe nɔnɔmewo me) si be woakpɔ ga ƒe mama dzi to multisig me, si se ƒe nubabla kple coin ƒe nɔlawo ƒe nyametsotsowo de asi le. Léa ZIP 1015 ƒe hiãhiãwo katã siwo ku ɖe lockbox ƒe zazã ŋu la me ɖe asi (ecosystem ƒe ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋuwo ƒe gaɖoɖo). Kpɔɖeŋu sia trɔ tso habɔbɔ si kpɔa nu dzi yi ɖe coin ƒe nɔlawo ƒe dziɖuɖu tẽe, le mama 12% la ŋu. Metrɔa ZIP ƒe mɔnu alo trademark ƒe sewo o. Habɔbɔ gãtɔwo kple woƒe gaɖoɖo ƒe teƒewo Electric Coin Company (ECC) / Bootstrap Project Wo nye Zcash ƒe wɔlawo gbãtɔ (2016). Le ɣeyiɣi si va yi me la, wonɔ dev fund la ƒe 7% xɔm va se ɖe November 2024. Le January 2026 me la, engineering kple product team gãtɔ la dze le Bootstrap/ECC ŋu ɖe dziɖuɖu ƒe kpekpeɖeŋuwo ta eye woƒo Zcash Open Development Lab (ZODL). ECC/Bootstrap megaxɔ protocol ƒe gaɖoɖo tẽe o eye megale mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔla team gãtɔ la ƒe dɔwɔƒe o. Etsɔ donationwo, sponsorshipwo, kple eya ŋutɔ ƒe gadzraɖoƒe [treasury] doa eɖokui. Esi eteƒe gã le ŋutinya me, gake menye protocol ƒe mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔla habɔbɔ si wɔa dɔ fifia o. -> Kpɔ eƒe nyatakaka bliboa: Electric Coin Company Zcash Open Development Lab (ZODL) Woƒoe le January 2026 me tso Zcash protocol ƒe mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔlawo (ECC engineering kple product team gãtɔ la) gbɔ le esi wodze le Bootstrap/ECC ŋu megbe. Woxɔ seed funding si wu dollar million 25 tso investorlawo gbɔ, eye a16z Crypto kple Coinbase Ventures le wo dome. Team la, si me Zcash protocol ƒe wɔlawo kple mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔlawo gbãtɔwo le, yi edzi le protocol gãtɔ ƒe mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖo, ZIP ƒe kpekpeɖeŋuwo, kple ɣaɣla [privacy] dɔwɔnuwo me, eye Zodl mobile gakotoku [wallet] le wo dome (woɖe eƒe ŋkɔ tso Zashi). text: Electric Coin Company (Ɣetrɔ) Nudzraɖoƒe - GitHub - X/Twitter Ku ɖeka ŋu tso GitHub ƒe kadoɖa sia ŋu. ECC ƒe repositorywo le zodl-inc. Eyae nye habɔbɔ ma ke, woɖe eƒe ŋkɔ trɔ esi team la yi ɖe ZODL. Ame bubu aɖe ŋlɔ github.com/Electric-Coin-Company ƒe ŋkɔ xoxoa ɖe eɖokui me le May 2026, eye mele nu ka aɖeke si wòkɔ kple ECC alo ZODL o, eyata mègaxɔ se na code si woɖe ɖe afima o. Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe Nyaɖeɖefia Dɔwɔwɔ le ECC nye be wòana amegbetɔwo nakpɔ ga ƒe ablɔɖe. Ga ƒe ɣaɣla [financial privacy] le vevie le dɔwɔwɔ sia me, eye wòhiã be woakpɔ amegbetɔ ƒe bubu, dedienyenye, ŋutɔ-ɖokui-ƒe-ŋusẽ, kple lɔlɔ̃ ɖe asi. Ga ƒe ɣaɣla ƒe kpɔkpɔ nanye bɔbɔe abe ale si wònye be nàtu avɔ le wòƒe me ene. Ke esi Web2 do ɖe eme la, ŋusẽ ƒe teƒe ku ɖe afɔ ɖeka dzi ŋutɔ, eye ame siwo le ŋusẽ la wɔ ɖokuinɔƒe le wòƒe me xɔ. Màte ŋu atu avɔ o. Ele be míatu nu yeye aɖe. Ga ƒe dɔwɔnu yeye sia, si amegbetɔ sia amegbetɔ ate ŋu akpɔ la, anɔ bɔbɔe na ezazã, anɔ ɣaɣla blibo kple mɔ siwo nana woate ŋu aɖe nya afia, eye eƒe teƒeƒe si tsɔe ɖo anyi anɔ akpa gege kple sesẽ. Zodl, si woyɔna tsã be Zashi: iOS - Android - F-Droid Wotu e ɖe Fexexe ɣaɣla tɔwo [Private Payments] ta. Zashi nye ɖokui ƒe asikplɔdzadzra ɣaɣla [shielded] ZEC gakotoku [wallet] na digital gaɖoɖo ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ [encryption] tɔwo, si ECC wɔ eye wodo goe le 2024 me. Wotu eya be wòakplɔ xɔ̃wo kple ƒometɔwo ayi Zcash kple digital fexexewo siwo nye ɣaɣla me, kple interface si bɔbɔe na amesiwo mekpe crypto ŋu kpɔ haɖe o be woate ŋu aɖo gakotoku ɖe anyi, akpɔ ZEC, eye woawɔ gaɖoɖo le minuti ʋɛ aɖewo me. Woɖe gakotoku la ƒe ŋkɔ trɔ ɖe Zodl me le February 2026 esi team la yi ɖe ZODL. Ezazãtɔ siwo li xoxo hã mele be woawɔ nu aɖeke o, elabena app la trɔ eƒe brand le eƒe update si kplɔe ɖo me; esiae ta store ƒe kadoɖawo siwo le dzi la ʋu Zodl. Azɔ woele eƒe dzadzra wɔm le afima le ECC teƒe, eyata kpɔ ZODL ƒe axa na nyatakaka si le fifia. Integrationwo siwo wotu le ECC ƒe ƒeawo me: Coinbase: crypto ƒe amedzro yeyewo ate ŋu aƒle ZEC tẽ le gakotoku la me, eye woaɖo account ƒe ŋlɔŋlɔ, KYC, kple coinwo ƒe hehenyawo tso gatrɔƒewo [exchanges] me ɖi. Flexa: wɔe be wòbɔbɔ be amewo nàzã ZEC vavã, eye wòna ezazãtɔ yeyewo ate ŋu atsɔe aƒle nu le nudzrɔƒe akpe geɖewo abe Barnes & Noble, GameStop, kple Chipotle ene. Keystone: nye ŋgɔyiyi gã aɖe na Zcash ƒe hadome, si wole wòwɔm tso ƒe geɖewo. Integration sia fia ŋutinya gã aɖe le Zcash ƒe zãzãme, elabena wòna woate ŋu adzra ZEC si nye ɣaɣla ɖe cold storage me. Nunyɔnu kple Ŋgɔyiyi Team la kplɔ ŋgɔ le ŋgɔyiyi siwo woade dzesi le ɣeyiɣi geɖewo, eye gbãtɔ nye ƒe Zcash ƒe dzidzeme abe Zero-Knowledge Proofs ƒe commercial zãzã gbãtɔ le xexeme ene. Bubu geɖewo kplɔe ɖo, abe Sapling mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ network upgrade ene, si na gaɖoɖo siwo nye ɣaɣla nɔ bɔbɔe wu, eye ɣeyiɣi si hiã be woatu gaɖoɖo dze ɖe 90% me, kple memory ƒe dzidzeme si wu 97%, si na woate ŋu awɔ gaɖoɖo siwo nye ɣaɣla le mobile device dzi zi gbãtɔ. Ŋgɔyiyi si le vevie ŋutɔ nye esi vae yi. Eƒe tutu kple eƒe zãzã na halo2 ƒe ɖaseɖigbalɛ [proving] system si me mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖo xexlẽnuwo [trusted setup] mele o le Network Upgrade 5 me na Zcash. Esia woɖe mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖo xexlẽnuwo ɖa eye wòdze ɣeyiɣi yeye aɖe na Zcash. Tso 2022 dzi la, esia le dɔ wɔm le Zcash Mainnet dzi, eye wòna ezazãtɔwo ate ŋu azã teƒeɖoɖo si dedie wu kple si ate ŋu atrɔ bɔbɔe na woƒe fexexe ƒe protocol. Hatuwɔwɔ Kple Ɖekawɔwɔ ECC ƒe team la doa alɔ kple ɖe nu wɔnɛ na Zcash ƒe ecosystem le mɔ geɖewo nu, eye woɖeawo wɔa dɔ kple team siwo le eme kple team siwo le gota zi geɖe be woakpɔ eye woana Zcash ƒe protocol nadze edzi. Ɖekawɔwɔwo me le dɔwɔwɔ kple Gemini be woana gaɖoɖo siwo nye ɣaɣla nadze woƒe platform dzi, Flexa be woana Zcash ƒe mobile fexexewo nɔ bɔbɔe le nudzrɔƒewo, asikplɔwo dzra mɔ [hardware wallet] ƒe companywo abe Keystone ene be woana ZEC si nye ɣaɣla ƒe cold storage, Brave na Zcash ƒe support le browser me, kple team bubuwo le Zcash ƒe ecosystem me be woatsɔ nyonyo ava Zcash me. text: Zcash Foundation Misión ƒe Nyaa Míaƒe taɖodzinu le ZF ŋu nye be míawɔ dɔwɔnu siwo ana network siwo ƒe mɔ le dɔme nakpɔ dziɖuɖu, eye wòame na ame sia ame nakpɔ eya ŋutɔ ƒe ɣaɣla [privacy] ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe mɔ nu. Ɣaɣla ƒe gɔme veviŋutɔe nye be nàte ŋu atia nu si woama alo woamama kple amewo. Ɣaɣla ƒo autonomy kple lɔlɔ̃ ɖe eŋu; ele vevie na ame ƒe bubu kple dukɔviha ƒe agbe nyuitɔ ƒe yi ɖe edzi. Ameawo kple Hamea Zcash Foundation wɔ dɔwɔla 12 ɖo alɔ̃, siwo le xexea me godoo. Woɖo ŋku protocol ƒe ŋgɔyiyi, protocol ƒe dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ, protocol ƒe dziɖuɖu [governance], infrastructure ƒe ŋgɔyiyi, kple Zcash ƒe nutoa ƒe nudzɔdzɔwo ƒe kpɔkpɔ dzi. Zcash Foundation ƒe dɔmedzoe menye be wòawɔ dɔ ɖeka ko na Zcash o, eyata wògblɔna ɣaɣla ƒe mɔnu siwo wɔnɛ be woakpɔ ɣaɣla ɖe edzi na amegbetɔ ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu kple dukɔ blibo ƒe nyuie. Zcash Foundation ƒe Ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu [grant] na ecosystem la mɔ be wòaxɔ ga na dɔwɔwɔ siwo kpe ɖe ɣaɣla ƒe ecosystem ŋu, abe Zebra (ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ [node] ƒe dɔwɔɖoɖo si le eɖokui ŋutɔ me na Zcash) & FROST kple dɔwɔwɔ bubu vovovowo to Zcash Community Grants Committee dzi. Foundation la hã wɔa Zcon, ƒomevi ƒe takpekpe si wɔna ɖe ŋkume le ƒe sia ƒe, si ɖo ŋku Zcash ecosystem la ŋu, eye wòkpena ɖe nutoa ƒe dɔwɔwɔ siwo tso amewo ŋutɔ gbɔ la ŋu, abe Zcon Vozes, nutome tɔxɛ ƒe takpekpewo, Zcash Foundation A/V Club, si nye Zero Knowledge Audio Visual Club fifia, kple nutoa ƒe yɔyɔwo siwo ʋu na ame sia ame, nutoa ƒe nudzɔdzɔwo kple AMA's bubu. Zcash Foundation wɔa Zcash Trademark policy ɖe eƒe nunana ƒe ɖoɖowo siwo woɖe yeyee tso Electric Coin Co gbɔ la nu. Esia kpena be woa"kpɔ Zcash, eƒe habɔbɔ siwo kplii, kple Zcash nutoa ƒe ŋkɔ nyui dzi" to be woa"de nyatakaka ƒe teƒe siwo nye nyateƒe fia, eye esia nena nyatakaka si nye aʋatso alo si menye nyateƒe o ƒe dzɔdzɔkpɔkpɔ ɖea" kple be woa"de app kple subɔsubɔ siwo nye nyateƒe fia, eye esia nena nukunu ƒe wɔwɔ ƒe dzɔdzɔkpɔkpɔ ɖea." Hame ƒe Nutoɖoɖo Zcash Foundation nye 501(c)(3) ƒe tax si me woɖena o, hame si menya ga ɖe eɖokui ŋu o, nublanuikɔ. Le woƒe Hamea ƒe ŋutɔ megbe la, Board of Directors le wo si, eye woana nutoa ƒe dziɖuɖu ƒe tiatiawo awɔ to be woabia Zcash Community Advisory Panel. Ga ƒe Kpekpeɖeŋu Zcash Foundation megaxɔ ga tso Zcash ƒe ŋgɔyiyi fund me tso November 2024 dzi o. Fifia, woɖea ga na The Foundation to nunana siwo wòate ŋu aɖe tax le woŋu o ƒe mɔ dzi. Wòate ŋu akpɔ ale si wowɔa ga la kple woƒe ƒe kpuie ƒe Transparency Reports. Zcash Community Grants Ƒe Program https://zcashcommunitygrants.org/ Program sia ɖea ga na hamea siwo le woɖokui ŋutɔ me be woawɔ ŋgɔyiyi gã si yina edzi (alo dɔ bubu) si anɔ vi na Zcash ecosystem la. Ame atɔ̃ sɔŋ siwo woatia tso Zcash Community Advisory Panel me lae tia ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋuwo. Woɖe dzi na hamea kple habɔbɔ siwo di be woado ŋgɔ usability, dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ, ɣaɣla kple Zcash ƒe zazã la be woaɖo biabia na Zcash Community Grant! title: Zcash Community Grants
description: Zcash Community Grants ƒe ɣeyiɣi sia ƒea ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu na timu siwo wɔnɔ ɖokuiwoe le ge ɖe Zcash ƒe nɔnɔme me, be woawɔ ŋgɔyiyi gã si ayi edzi (alo dɔ bubu)…
text: Zcash Community Grants Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe Taɖodzi Zcash Community Grants ƒe ɣeyiɣi sia ƒea ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu na timu siwo wɔnɔ ɖokuiwoe le ge ɖe Zcash ƒe nɔnɔme me, be woawɔ ŋgɔyiyi gã si ayi edzi (alo dɔ bubu) na Zcash ƒe nɔnɔme ƒe amewo katã ƒe nyui. Ame Kple Timuwo Komiti a de dzikpɔna Zcash Community Grants, eye fifia ame atɔ̃e le eme. Hamea kpɔna eye wòɖea asi ɖe ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu [grant] ƒe biabiawo ŋu tso etɔ̃lawo ƒe timuwo gbɔ, siwo di be woatu nu ɖe Zcash ƒe protocol dzi. Nya bubu le Team ŋu. Dɔ yeyewo si ZCG da asi ɖe enu la enye Zcash Shielded Assets (ZSA), si QEDIT ƒe timu kplɔna. Woele DeFi tsɔm vɛ na ZEC kple Zcash, to fexexe [payment] ƒe protocol yeye si kplɔ nɔnɔme bubuwo ɖe Zcash ƒe mainnet ŋu dzi. Zcash Media ƒe documentary kpui a fia Zcash amegãwo abe Edward Snowden, Zooko kple Deirdre Connolly ene, eye eƒe taɖodzi nye be wòawɔ video siwo sɔ na ɣeyiɣi, wɔnɔa dzidzɔ, eye wonoa nu, be amewo katã nakpɔ wo. Asikplɔwo dzra mɔ ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu na Ledger be wòakpe ɖe Sapling ƒe ɣaɣla [shielded] gaɖoɖowo [transaction] katã ŋu, eye esia na wòte ŋu dzra Zcash ɖe ɣaɣla kple dedie me. Zondax ƒe Timu wɔ esia. Ɖoɖo bɔbɔe si wòate ŋu awɔ ɣaɣla fexexe kple Point-of-sale system na xɔme siwo le mɔdzi, kple SDK, nye dɔ si ZGo le wɔm. Global Ambassador ƒe ɣeyiɣi kpena ɖe Zcash ŋu be wòanɔ teƒe geɖe le dukɔwo me kple hamea ƒe nudzɔdzɔwo siwo wɔna ɖe amewo ŋkume le xexeame katã. Zcash Grants Committee kpɔ dɔ bubu geɖe hã, kpɔ Nɔnɔme blibo, si wowɔ yeyee, ƒe xexlẽ na dɔ siwo woɖo ɖe edzi. Hame ƒe Nɔnɔme Zcash Community Grants nye hame si le ɖokui me tso Electric Coin Company kple Zcash Foundation gbɔ. Ga ƒe Kpekpeɖeŋu Zcash Community Grants xɔ gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe [block] ƒe kpekpe ƒe 8%, le ŋkɔɖi ƒe mɔnu si NU6.1 de le ZIP 1016 me la nu. Tɔsisi sia dze egɔme esi ZIP 1015 ƒe tɔsisi si nɔ anyi kpɔ la wu, eye wòayi yi Zcash ƒe fetu ƒe afãmama [halving] evelia le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 4,406,400 me, le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe teƒeƒo si le egbea nu. ZCG zã ga siawo be wòakpe ɖe habɔbɔwo siwo tsi tre ɖokuiwo ŋu le Zcash ƒe ecosystem me. Nuɖoɖowo Zcash ŋgɔyiyi kple dziɖuɖu governance Aleke Nàɖo Ga Ƒe Kpekpeɖeŋu Ƒe Biabia Tso ZCG Dzi (GitHub + Hamea ƒe Forum) Afɔ 1: Dzra Wò Ɖoɖo ɖe Eŋu Wɔ ɖoɖo klaro si me nu siawo le: Dɔ la ƒe ŋkɔ kple ame si biaa la ƒe nyawo Kuxi la ƒe nɔnɔme kple ɖoɖo si wòɖo be nàwɔ Nu siwo woatsɔ ana, ɣeyiɣi ƒe ɖoɖo, kple afɔwo Ga ƒe ɖoɖo kple ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu si wòbia Nunya si sɔ kple afɔkuwo --- Afɔ 2: Ɖo Biabia ɖe GitHub Dzi Yi ɖe Zcash Community Grants GitHub repository dzi Ʋu Issues tab la eye nàzi New Issue dzi Tia grant application template si sɔ Ɖo fiaƒe siwo katã wobia la eye nàɖo biabia la ɖa GitHub ƒe issue la nye biabia ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ si nye nyateƒe. --- Afɔ 3: Wɔ Hamea Ƒe Forum Ƒe Nunyaɖoɖo Yi ɖe Zcash Community Forum dzi Wɔ thread yeye le Zcash Community Grants ƒe ha me Zã tanya ma ke abe GitHub ƒe issue la ene Tsɔ nyadzɔdzɔ kpui aɖe kpe ɖe eŋu, eye nàtsɔ kadodo yi GitHub ƒe issue la gbɔ ade eme --- Afɔ 4: Va De Asi Le Kpɔkpɔ Me Lé ŋku ɖe GitHub ƒe issue kple forum ƒe thread ŋu Ɖo ŋu na biabiawo kple nya siwo amewo gblɔ tso ZCG Committee kple hamea gbɔ --- Afɔ 5: Nu Si Do Ɖe Emegbe Ɖoɖo siwo woɖe asi ɖe enu la ayi ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu kple nyadzɔdzɔ ƒe afɔ me Ɖoɖo siwo woɖe asi ɖe enu o la ATE ŊU woawɔ wo yeye eye woaɖo wo ɖa ake --- Nudzɔdzɔ: GitHub nye nuŋɔŋlɔ ƒe teƒe gɔ̃; forum la nye teƒe na amewo katã ƒe numedzodzro.

text: Ga ƒe Ɣaɣla [privacy] Ƒe Dɔwɔƒe (FPF) FPF Ŋuti Financial Privacy Foundation (FPF) nye ame siwo mewɔa gaɖuɖu ta o, eye woɖe woƒe dɔwɔƒe ɖo le Cayman Islands. FPF ƒe taɖodzinu vevi wu nye be yeaɖe nufiame na ame vovovowo kple habɔbɔwo, eye woadzɔ wo be woakpɔ woƒe ga ƒe ɣaɣla kple dedienɔnɔ dzi. FPF di be yeadoa asi ga ƒe ɖoɖo si le dzɔdzɔe kple dzidzedzee, si bɔbɔa ame sia ame ƒe ɣaɣla. FPF ƒe dɔ vevi si ku ɖe ga ƒe ɣaɣla ŋu nye be yeana nyatakakawo, nu siwo ana kpekpeɖeŋu, kple kpekpeɖeŋu na ame vovovowo kple habɔbɔwo be woate ŋu ade wɔnɔ wɔnƒe ga ƒe ɣaɣla kple adzra e ɖe teƒe nyuitɔ dzi. Financial Privacy Fund (FPF) le ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu [grant] ƒe ɣeɖeɖe aɖe si woyɔna be FPF X FPF wɔm fifia. Nyatakaka ku ɖe FPF X FPF ŋu FPF X FPF nye FPF ƒe ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe ɣeɖeɖe gbãtɔ si woɖo be woakpɔe ɖa, Financial Privacy Fund (FPF x FPF) ŋuti. Ɖoɖoa ana ga na engineering dɔwo le Zcash ecosystem me, siwo ɖo ɖe nuwuwu gbɔ, alo dɔwo siwo akpe ɖe ecosystem la ŋu enumake eye woate ŋu awu wo le ɣeyiɣi kple ga ƒe katã si woɖo la me. FPF X FPF dzɔe kple ga sue aɖe ko be woawɔ ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe nunana ƒe mɔa nyuie, eye wòle mɔ kpɔm be yeawɔ ɣeyiɣi bubuwo le ŋgɔ. FPF x ZecHub Bounty ƒe Ɖoɖoɖo - Blog ƒe Nyati FPF X FPF Ɖoɖoɖo ƒe Nudzidzewo FPF X FPF Ɖoɖoɖo ƒe nudzidzewo enye be FPF ƒe nudzidzewo geɖe le ɖoɖo la me, eye wonye: Fund Amount: Va se ɖe $50,000 USD Maximum Request: $25,000 USD KYC Requirements: Aɖeke meli o Type of Project: Engineering dɔwo ko siwo ate ŋu akpe ɖe Zcash ecosystem la ŋu tɔxɛ eye woate ŋu awu wo blibo ko woakpɔ. Payment: Fexexe [payment] le dɔa ƒe wawɔ nyuie vɔ megbe Launch Date: March 18, 2024 Ga ƒe Kpekpeɖeŋu Ƒe Biabia Ƒe Mɔ FPF X FPF ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe biabia ƒe mɔ la me mɔ vovovo geɖe le. Gbã, ele be ame siwo biaa la nadzro ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu la to dedienɔnɔ ƒe fɔm si woɖo la dzi. Emegbe la, FPF akpɔ biabia la ɖa be yeanya ne wòde bubuwo ŋu, eye woana nyatakaka na ame siwo biaa la ku ɖe woƒe nɔnɔ ŋu le ŋkeke 5 ƒe kalenda me le biabia ƒe ɣeyiɣi ƒe nuwuwu megbe. Emegbe la, komiti aɖe si woɖo ɖe ɣeyiɣi ma ta akpɔ biabia la ɖa eye wòade dzesi le ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe nunana ŋu le ŋkeke 20 ƒe kalenda me le nunana ƒe ɣeyiɣi ƒe nuwuwu megbe. Woaɖe ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu siwo woana la ƒe nudzidzewo ɖe FPF ƒe asitɔ ƒe axa dzi be ame sia ame nakpɔe eye woawɔe kple akɔntabubu. Nyatakaka Bubu ku ɖe FPF X FPF ŋu Wòate ŋu akpɔ nyatakaka bubu ku ɖe FPF X FPF ŋu le Financial Privacy Fun (FPF) ƒe asitɔ ƒe axa dzi afii, eye ne FPF X FPF ƒe ɖoɖo la ŋu ɖe biabia gale asiwò la, wòate ŋu ayɔ FAQs ƒe nyatia afii: Biabia siwo wodzia zi geɖe. Ne wòdi be nàzu Volunteer Reviewer na FPF X FPF ƒe ɖoɖo sia ƒe ɣeyiɣi sia ta la, taflatse yi ɖe kadodo sia dzi. Ne biabia bubuwo le asiwò ku ɖe FPF X FPF Ga ƒe Kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe Ɖoɖoɖo ŋu la, wòate ŋu abia to email ɖe FPF. Nu siwo Wotsɔ Kpe ɖe Eŋu Financial Privacy Fund

title: Shielded Labs
description: Shielded Labs nye Zcash ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe ga me wotsɔna ƒe kpeɖeŋu ƒe habɔbɔ si nye ɖe eɖokui ŋu, eye wodo teƒe le Switzerland. Eƒe dɔ vevi nye be wòatu ga…
text: Shielded Labs Shielded Labs nye Zcash ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe ga me wotsɔna ƒe kpeɖeŋu ƒe habɔbɔ si nye ɖe eɖokui ŋu, eye wodo teƒe le Switzerland. Eƒe dɔ vevi nye be wòatu ga ɣaɣla si woate ŋu aɖe gbe, si doa ŋusẽ ame ƒe ablɔɖe kple ɖokui dziɖuɖu, eye wòatsɔ ŋusẽ ana dɔ si ado ŋusẽ Zcash network ƒe nɔnɔmeɖeɖe, dedie kple nu ƒe dziyiyi. Shielded Labs tsɔa engineering ƒe ŋusẽ si nye ɖe eɖokui ŋu kpea ɖe Zcash ecosystem me. Menye Electric Coin Company, Zcash Foundation, alo Zcash Community Grants ƒe akpa o, eye eɖo eɖokui ɖe eme be enye Zcash ecosystem ƒe habɔbɔ gbãtɔ si mexɔ ga le Development Fund alo gaɖoɖowo ƒe fetuwo me to mɔ aɖeke nu o. Dɔwɔwɔ Kple Teƒe Shielded Labs doa ŋusẽ protocol kple infrastructure ƒe dɔ si ate ŋu ana Zcash nakpɔ ŋusẽ geɖe le ɣeyiɣi didi me. Eƒe nu siwo wòɖe fia le amewo ŋkume ɖo ŋku edzi be: Ame ƒe ablɔɖe kple finansi ɣaɣla Ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu si nye ɖe eɖokui ŋu, le Development Fund me tɔwo ƒe akpata Bubu na ZEC ƒe nɔlawo kple coinholder ƒe susu Zãlawo ƒe ɖokui ŋusẽ kple ɖokui dziɖuɖu Mɔ̃ yeyewo ƒe ŋusẽ na nɔnɔmeɖeɖe, dedie kple nu ƒe dziyiyi Dɔwɔwɔ kple Zcash ƒe dɔwɔla bubuwo Habɔbɔ la kpena to engineering ƒe dɔ tɔxɛ, numekuku si le amewo ŋkume, infrastructure ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu, kple ecosystem ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ƒuƒo. Eya hã na dzidzɔnu siwo le amewo ŋkume na dziɖuɖu ƒe akɔntabubu kple coinholder siwo ɖona ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu, eye wòkpena be Zcash community ƒe amewo nanya ɣeyiɣi kple mɔ si woate ŋu akpɔ akpa le dziɖuɖu ƒe dzesiwo me. Dɔwɔwɔwo Si Le Yina Fifia Shielded Labs ɖea dɔwɔwɔ teƒe didi aɖewo siwo le yina fifia fia le amewo ŋkume: Network Sustainability Mechanism - Tutu trɔtrɔ siwo woɖoe ɖe ŋgɔ be woakpe ɖe Zcash ƒe dedie ƒe ga ƒe ŋusẽ le ɣeyiɣi didi me, esi wole ZEC ƒe 21 million ƒe supply cap kpɔm ɖe asi. NSM ƒe dɔ la tsɔ ZEC ƒe dzadzra, issuance ƒe ɖeɖeɖo, kple adzɔ ƒe dzadzra ƒe tutu siwo woɖe fi le ZIPs 233, 234, kple 235 me va. Crosslink - Gbɔgbɔ trɔtrɔ ƒe consensus ƒe tutu si aɖe Zcash ƒe proof-of-work gaɖoɖowo ƒe wɔwɔ kple proof-of-stake ƒe finality ƒo, ale be ZEC ƒe nɔlawo ate ŋu akpe ɖe network la ƒe dedie ŋu esi nukulawo gale gaɖoɖowo wɔm. Dynamic Fees - Numekuku kple dɔwɔnuwo na Zcash ƒe gaɖoɖo ƒe adzɔ siwo wòle bɔbɔe be wòanɔ ŋgɔ na, wòasɔ na zãlawo, eye wòakpɔ ŋusẽ geɖe esi network la le trɔm. Zero - Open-source Zcash infrastructure software ƒe ƒuƒo si wòkpena, na gatrɔƒewo, nukuku ƒe gaƒuƒoƒowo, gakotoku ƒe namelawo, kple habɔbɔ bubu siwo ɖo ŋusẽ ɖe Zcash infrastructure ŋu. Ironwood - Zcash ƒe mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ kple ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo si wowɔ be woaɖo ŋu na Orchard ƒe gaƒoɖoɖo ƒe kuxi, eye wòatu mɔ si dzi woate ŋu akpɔ ɖe eɖokui ŋu be Zcash ƒe ga si le yiyim la le eteƒe. Epoch - Numekuku kple engineering ƒe dɔ si woɖe gbe le October 2026 me be woawɔ post-quantum cryptography si sɔ be woatsɔ awɔ dɔ, si me akpɔ dedie ŋutɔ, na Zcash, eye woatsi ɖaseɖigbalɛ ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu ɖe cryptography ƒe akpa veviwo ŋu. Dɔ la ƒe taɖodzinu nye be wòanɔ sɔ be woatsɔ awɔ dɔ hafi 2027 ƒe nuwuwu, si ate ŋu anye mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ si ava megbe ƒe gɔmeɖoƒe. Edzea ɖe Project Tachyon kple post-quantum ƒe dɔ bubu siwo le ecosystem la me ŋu. Epoch Kple Cryptography Ƒe Ƒuƒo Le October 2026 me la, Shielded Labs dzɔ Epoch, dɔ si woɖo ɖe eŋu tɔxɛ be wòakpɔ Zcash ɖe etsɔme ƒe quantum computing, AI ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe aʋawɔwɔwo, kple ameaɖewo siwo le ŋgɔ na ŋu. Dɔ la di be wòatrɔ cryptography ƒe akpawo siwo quantum ate ŋu aɖu dzi wo ŋu, eye wòatsɔ formal verification awɔ dɔ ɖe protocol la ƒe akpa veviwo ŋu. Epoch ƒe dzikpɔlae nye ame etɔ ƒe cryptography ƒe ƒuƒo: Ulrich Haböck – Cryptography ƒe Dzikpɔla Gã (tsã la enɔ StarkWare; ɣemaɣi do ŋgɔ la enɔ Polygon Zero). Enya zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛwo kple post-quantum cryptography ŋutɔ; enye logUp lookup argument ƒe ŋlɔla, eye wòŋlɔ Circle STARKs ƒe agbalẽ kple ame bubu.
