text: Valar Group Yi nàkpɔ website Dɔ ƒe Ɖeɖefia Valar Group nye engineering ƒe ha si tsitre ɖe eɖokui ŋu, eye wòƒe ŋkuléle le nu ƒe dziyiyi [scaling] na Zcash, ga ƒe tɔxɛlawo ƒe dziɖuɖu [governance] ƒe sesẽ wɔwɔ, kple protocol la ƒe ɣaɣla [privacy], dɔwɔwɔ ŋusẽ, kple dzidzime ƒe sesẽ ƒe nyonyo dzi. Eƒe dɔ le protocol ƒe teƒe me ƒe infrastructure dzi: token ƒe tɔxɛlawo ƒe ƒoƒoɖoɖo ɣaɣla, ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo [full node] ƒe software si wɔ dɔ kaba, gakotoku [wallet] ƒe sync ƒe mɔ̃nu, kple mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ [network upgrades] si wɔe be ɣaɣla Zcash nazu nu si woate ŋu azã le teƒe gã wu me. Ha la ƒe taɖodzinu nye be wòana ZEC ƒe tɔxɛlawo mɔ̃ aɖe be woatsɔ woƒe didiwo afia le ɣaɣla me, ana ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ ƒe dɔwɔlawo software si wɔ dɔ kaba wu eye wòte ŋu awɔ nu geɖe, eye wana gakotokuwo dɔwɔnu [tools] siwo katã ƒe ɣaɣla ɖe asi na zãlawo, eye woaɖe network la me ƒe tɔxɛ dzudzɔ. Gbegbe Valar Group ƒe kplɔla nye Dev Ojha (ValarDragon), si nye Osmosis ƒe hadzila aɖe kple team si wɔ Cosmos ƒe gɔmedzedze la ƒe membre. Le ƒe eveawo me, ewɔ dɔ le zk-SNARKs, BFT consensus, kple DeFi ƒe system siwo wɔ dɔ le amewo ƒe ŋkume la me. Group la ƒe dɔ siwo woɖe fia le Zcash me zu nyuie le amewo dome esi ecosystem la trɔ yi protocol ƒe team siwo tsitre ɖe woawo ŋu me, le core development ƒe 2026 ƒe woɖo ɖe aga bubu me megbe. Valar Group ɖe eƒe ŋku me abe ha siwo le Zcash infrastructure ƒe dzidzime ƒe mama wɔm kple Project Tachyon, Shielded Labs, ZODL, kple Zcash Foundation ene. Nusi va yina le eƒe dɔ me zi geɖe nye be Zcash ƒe ɣaɣla ƒe nɔnɔwo nakpe ɖe fexexe [payment] ko ŋu o. Ne wokɔa tɔxɛlawo be woanɔ vote ɖe issuance, gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe [block] ƒe gaƒoƒo, alo mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ ƒe teƒe ŋu la, ele be woate ŋu awɔe tso ɣaɣla ƒe balances me, eye womagblɔ woƒe ŋkɔ, balance, alo ame ɖeka ƒe vote o. Hiãhiã sia wɔe be Valar Group naɖo coinholder voting ɖoɖonu aɖe si woɖe ɖe eŋu ko eye wòɖe asi. Nu ƒe dziyiyi kple cryptography ƒe gbeɖa sia ke wɔ node kple sync ƒe dɔ si wòwɔ la hã. Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe siwo wɔ kaba, gakotoku ƒe synchronization si le bɔbɔe, kple ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo si te ŋu wɔ nu geɖe la nye nusiwo wole be wòanɔ hafi woate ŋu azã ga ɣaɣla le fexexe network ƒe teƒe me, menye be woazãe abe nu si wokpɔna ko ene o. Nukpɔkpɔ Valar Group ƒe nu siwo woɖe fia kple project ƒe dɔ fia Zcash network aɖe si ate ŋu: Ade asi ɖe coinholder voting ɣaɣla si woate ŋu akpɔe ɖe asi kple si woate ŋu awɔ zi geɖe abe dziɖuɖu ƒe mɔ̃nu ene. Ana proof-of-work ƒe fexexewo nakpɔ nu ƒe dziyiyi me, eye wòakpɔ ɣaɣla ƒe ɣaɣla ɖe asi. Aɖe gakotoku kple ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ ƒe nusiwo ɖom mɔ̃ kpɔtɔ le PIR, pruning, kple gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe kakaƒoƒo kaba me. Asɔ implementation ƒe vovototo dzi to ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo ƒe stack si tsitre ɖe eŋu ŋu. Akpe ɖe post-quantum ƒe dzadzraɖoɖo kple protocol ƒe mɔ̃ ƒe sewo trɔtrɔ siwo woakpɔ ɖe asi nyuie me ŋu. Ha la wɔ dɔ abe contributor si tsitre ɖe eŋu ŋu ene, menye protocol la ƒe owner ene o. Protocol ƒe trɔtrɔwo gale ZIPs, implementation, review, kple community ƒe dzesiɖeɖe me. Valar Group ƒe dɔe nye be wòaɖo, awɔ, adzra, eye wòaɖe systems siwo wɔe be mɔ̃nu siawo nakpɔ dzi la ɖe open-source me. Strategic Areas Valar Group ƒe dɔwo ƒo ƒu le teƒe ene me. Coinholder Ƒe Dziɖuɖu Ɣaɣla Zcash mezã automatic on-chain [ɖoɖonu dzi] protocol ƒe control o. Coinholder polls nye dzesi siwo nye advisor, eye wodea asi le rough-consensus ƒe mɔ̃nu gã aɖe ŋu. Valar Group tu Tokenholder Voting Chain la be woate ŋu axɔ dzesi siawo tso ɣaɣla ƒe balances me, eye womagblɔ voter ƒe ameŋkɔ alo ame ɖeka ƒe vote ƒe gãme o. Nɔnɔ si wozã fifia la zãa: Cosmos SDK ƒe application chain aɖe si wòle voting rounds ƒe ɖoɖo wɔm. Snapshot ƒe ɖaseɖigbalɛ [proof] siwo tsɔ ɖe Ironwood didienu [note] siwo woate ŋu azã ga le ŋu. Vote ƒe amount ƒe homomorphic encryption [ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ]. Private Information Retrieval na gaɣaɣla ɖeɖe dzesi [nullifier] ƒe non-membership ƒe ɖaseɖigbalɛwo. Coordinator multisig aɖe kple election authority si woamama le teƒe vovovowo. Taɖodzinu la nye be woatsɔ

title: Zcash Labs
description: Zcash Labs nye ɖokuibɔbɔ ƒe habɔbɔ si ɖo ŋku ɖe Zcash kple e digital asset, ZEC, ƒe vavã me dɔwɔwɔ, tsɔtsɔ kple zazã ŋu. Zcash Labs doa asi ɖe asi kple…
text: Zcash Labs --- Zcash Labs nye ɖokuibɔbɔ ƒe habɔbɔ si ɖo ŋku ɖe Zcash kple e digital asset, ZEC, ƒe vavã me dɔwɔwɔ, tsɔtsɔ kple zazã ŋu. Zcash Labs doa asi ɖe asi kple asitsɔƒewo, habɔbɔwo, mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔlawo [developer], kple ɖokuibɔbɔ ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo siwo di be woazã Zcash ƒe teknoloji le nuƒoƒowo, subɔsubɔwo, fexexe [payment] ƒe ɖoɖowo, alo application siwo woate ŋu azã le xexeame ƒe nɔnɔwo me. Zcash Labs tsɔ eɖokui dea ɖe eme abe go to market ƒe habɔbɔ na Zcash ene. Le go to market ƒe nɔnɔ me la, esia fia be woadoa asi le Zcash ƒe teknoloji ƒe tsɔtsɔ tso teknikál ŋutinya siwo li xoxo yi dɔwɔwɔwo siwo asitsɔƒewo kple zazãlawo ate ŋu azã me. Be woawɔ ta sia ava eme la, Zcash Labs ƒoa aɖaŋuɖoɖo, solution engineering, teknikál tsɔtsɔ, infrastructure dɔwɔwɔ, nuƒoƒo dzikpɔkpɔ, gã ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu [grant] na dɔwɔwɔ gɔmedzedze, ga ƒe underwriting, kple hãƒoƒo ƒe nudzɔdzɔ ɖe mɔ ɖeka me si ɖo ŋku ɖe nuƒoƒowo ƒe gododo kple xexeame me zazã ŋu. Zcash Labs gblɔ be habɔbɔa nye ɖokuibɔbɔ tɔ, eye wometsɔa eɖokui kple Zcash Foundation ƒo ɖekae o. Ɖokuibɔbɔ ƒe nɔnɔ sia na Zcash Labs ate ŋu adecide le eɖokui ƒe ŋkume be dɔwɔwɔ, tsɔtsɔ, kple infrastructure kae wòdi be yeadoa asi ɖe asi kplii, tsɔ zɔnuwo kple ga siwo le habɔbɔa ƒe kpɔɖeŋu te. --- Gɔmedzedze ƒe nyateƒe Woɖe Zcash Labs fia na amewo to e official website dzi le August 6, 2026. Le August 12, 2026 la, Zcash Labs tsɔ e dɔwɔwɔwo va ɖe community la ŋkume to Zcash Community Forum dzi le gbeɖeɖe si ƒe tanyae nye Announcing Zcash Labs A Zcash Go To Market Company. Eya ta be woɖe gbeƒãɖeɖea fia le August 2026 me hã la, Zcash Labs gblɔ be e dɔwɔwɔwo dzɔna hafi gbeƒãɖeɖe ma va do. Zcash Labs nɔ dɔ wɔm kple dɔwɔwɔwo siwo zã Zcash, eye wònɔ kpekpem ɖe development ƒe mɔ dzi hafi woɖe Zcash Labs ƒe nyenye fia na amehawo katã. Nuɖoɖo gɔmedzedze aɖe si woɖe fia na amewo emegbe nye eƒe kpɔɖeŋu le zcashtocash ƒe development me. Zcash Labs ƒe gododo kplɔa ɖo ɖe hiahiã si nye be woagblẽ teƒe si le Zcash ƒe teknoloji si li kple asitsɔƒeawo alo mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔlawo ƒe nuteŋu be woazãe dome. Asitsɔƒe aɖe ate ŋu akpɔ hiahiã si sɔ kple Zcash, gake menya teknoloji si hiã, mɔ si woato atsɔe, alo infrastructure si woazã o hafi. Le ɣeyiɣi ma ke me la, dɔwɔwɔ yeye aɖe ate ŋu akpɔ susu nyui, gake wòhia teknikál kpekpeɖeŋu, nuƒoƒo dzikpɔkpɔ, gã ƒe kapital, alo kpekpeɖeŋu be wòanɔ production ƒe teƒe. Zcash Labs wɔa dɔ le teƒe ma, tsɔ kpekpeɖeŋu si tsɔ asitsɔƒeawo kple mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔlawo ƒe hiahiãwo sɔ kple Zcash ƒe teknoloji. Zcash Labs ƒe mɔa dzea egɔme kple habɔbɔ aɖe ƒe kuxi alo hiahiãwo ƒe se. Ne wose hiahiã mawo vɔ la, Zcash Labs kpɔa be Zcash nye teknoloji si sɔa. Ne wosɔ kple wo nɔewo la, Zcash Labs kpe ɖe asi be woaɖo teknikál mɔ si woate ŋu azã atsɔ atu tsɔtsɔa. Akpa sia ate ŋu aɖe Zcash ƒe teknoloji siwo li ƒe tiatia, architecture ƒe tata, infrastructure ƒe hiahiãwo ƒe ɖoɖo, kple component bubuwo ƒe development ne solution siwo li mekpe ɖe eŋu o. Kple mɔ sia la, Zcash Labs ate ŋu anɔ eme tso gɔmedzedze ƒe nuƒoƒo tso zã nyawo [use case] ŋu va se ɖe system si le dɔ wɔm vavãe. Esia wòaɖo Zcash Labs ƒe nɔƒe abe ɖokuibɔbɔ ƒe habɔbɔ le Zcash ecosystem me si doa go to market ene, elabena e dɔwɔwɔ menɔa plan alo teknikál development ko dzi o, ke boŋ wòɖe mɔ si wɔa be solutionwo ava zazã le xexeame me hã. --- Zcash Labs ƒe Ta Vevi Zcash Labs ƒe ta vevitɔe nye be wòana Zcash ƒe zazã nakeke ava amehawo dome, to kpekpeɖeŋu si service builders ate ŋu azã enumake. Wotsɔ mɔ vevi geɖewo nyaa ta sia: kpekpe ɖe asitsɔƒewo kple habɔbɔwo ŋu be woaɖo be Zcash sɔ na woƒe hiahiãwo hã, kpekpe le teknikál tsɔtsɔ ƒe mɔ me, infrastructure ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu, kple gã ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu na dɔwɔwɔwo siwo ate ŋu akeke Zcash ƒe zazã. Zcash Labs di be wòakeke dɔwɔwɔwo ƒe xexlẽme siwo zã Zcash menye ko o, ke boŋ wòana mɔ ƒe nu xɔxɔ nava bɔbɔ na ame siwo mekɔ teknikál numanya kpɔ o hã. Eya ta, woɖea mɔ bliboa aɖe si dzea egɔme kple aɖaŋuɖoɖo, eye strategy ƒe tata, teknikál dɔwɔwɔ, kple ne wokpɔ be dɔwɔwɔa le dzidzɔ ge la, gã ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu kplɔe ɖo. --- Zcas

title: Ga ƒe Dziɖulawo Ƒe Ga Ƒe Kpekpeɖeŋu Si Woɖe Le Ŋgɔ
description: Ga ƒe Dziɖulawo Ƒe Ga ƒe Kpekpeɖeŋu Si Woɖe Le Ŋgɔ ƒe Dɔɖoɖo ƒea ga na dɔ si wowu xoxo eye wotsɔ nusi woate ŋu akpɔ kple ŋkuléle nam le Zcash ƒe ecosystem me.
text: Ga ƒe Dziɖulawo Ƒe Ga Ƒe Kpekpeɖeŋu Si Woɖe Le Ŋgɔ Ga ƒe Dziɖulawo Ƒe Ga ƒe Kpekpeɖeŋu Si Woɖe Le Ŋgɔ ƒe Dɔɖoɖo ƒea ga na dɔ si wowu xoxo eye wotsɔ nusi woate ŋu akpɔ kple ŋkuléle nam le Zcash ƒe ecosystem me. Etsɔa ga tso Ga ƒe Dziɖulawo Ƒe Gaƒuƒoƒo me (gaɖoɖowo ƒe fetu ƒe 12% kple Dev Fund si woɖo ɖe megbe ƒe Lockbox ƒe nudzɔdzɔ), si ZIP 1016 de dzidzɔe eye woɖe eƒe dɔwɔwɔ gɔme le NU6.1 (November 2025). Dɔɖoɖoa dzea le ɣleti etɔwo me va se ɖe fetu ƒe afãmama [halving] evelia (2028). Key-Holder Organizations (kpɔe be Shielded Labs, FPF) wɔ gaawo ƒe ɖoɖo le multisig me. --- Ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋuwo le dɔ si wowu xoxo ko wotsɔna - wonoa fetu na amewo ƒe dɔ si wowu xoxo (kpɔe be dɔwɔwɔ, ɖoɖo ɖe eŋu, hamea ƒe tutu). Dɔ si wòle be nàwɔ le ŋgɔ la nàbia Zcash Community Grants (ZCG, fetu ƒe 8%). --- Biabia Siwo Dze Ɖe Eŋu Taɖodzinu: Dɔ si wowu eye amesiame ate ŋu akpɔ kple ŋkuléle nam, si doa vi na Zcash (ɣaɣla [privacy], ame geɖe ƒe wɔwɔe, dɔwɔnuwo, dedienɔnɔ). Nudzɔdzɔwo (ga ƒe dziɖulawo doa ŋkuléle na): Nudzɔdzɔ si fia be eƒe ŋusẽ le eye wotsɔ nusi le asinye va. Wòtsɔa eɖokui ɖe Zcash ƒe nudzɔdzɔwo (ɣaɣla, ha nuɖo agni [decentralized]) ŋu. Ŋkɔkɔɖi si le ʋuʋuɖi me (code, nyatakakawo, metrics). Mafɔfɔ aɖeke mele o: Ame sia ame (ame ɖeka, hatsotso, dɔwɔƒewo) ate ŋu abia alo woaɖe eƒe ŋkɔ afia. Biabia siwo le dzidzedze: Woaɖo akɔnta na wo ɖeka ɖeka; ZEC ƒe kpeɖeŋu geɖe wu la wɔa dzɔdzɔ. Wote ŋu agbe be o: Key-Holders ate ŋu agbe be o le se ƒe fukpekpe alo nu si ana ve na zãlawo/hamea ta (wogbɔna wò akpae, eye wotsɔ taɖodzinu dona). Ale Si Nàɖo Biabia Aɖe ɖa Dzra Biabia La Ɖo: Ɖe dɔ si wowu, eƒe ŋusẽ, kple ŋkuléle (kadodoƒewo, nusiwo wotsɔ va) me. Ɖe ga si wòbia (ZEC/USD ƒe asime) kple ta si tae nèbiae me. Tsɔ gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi kple ame si woate ŋu ado go kplii kpee. Ɖo Ɖa: Ɖe eɖe ɖa le Zcash Community Forum (forum.zcashcommunity.com) ƒe Grants akpa me. Tɔgbi: "[Retroactive Grant] - [Project Name]". Zã markdown ƒe ɖoɖo si le ʋuʋuɖi me. Ɣeyiɣi ƒe Nuŋɔŋlɔ: Le ɣleti etɔwo me; woɖea gbe le forum/X dzi (kpɔe be Q4 2025: October 12, 2025, 11:59 PM UTC). Biabia siwo va le megbe: Ɖo wo ɖa ake le akpa si kplɔe ɖo alo nàbia ZCG. Nàwɔ Dɔ Kple Ameawo: Ɖo eŋu na hamea ƒe biabiawo le ŋkeke 30 ƒe metsɔmetsɔ me. Ŋlɔɖi: FPF kpɔa dɔɖoɖoa dzi (se ƒe dzeɖoɖo, nuƒoƒo); woaƒo biabiawo katã ɖe GitHub dzi be amesiame nakpɔ. Akɔnta Ƒe Dɔwɔwɔ Kple Ɣeyiɣiwo Ɣleti Etɔwo Ƒe Ɣeyiɣi (kpɔe be Q4 2025, Q1 2026): Biabia Ƒe Ɣeyiɣi ƒe Nuŋɔŋlɔ: Le ɣleti ƒe titina (woɖea gbe). Ŋkeke 30 Ƒe Metsɔmetsɔ: Edzea egɔme le biabia ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ megbe; wɔnɔa nuƒoƒo kple nyagblɔɖi le forum ƒe threads me (wogbɔna wɔa summary thread zi geɖe). Akɔnta Ƒe Ɣeyiɣi: Edzea metsɔmetsɔ la yome (kpɔe be keke 1-2 le November me na Q4). Nusi Woɖe Fia Kple Ga Ƒe Nana: Le esia megbe enumake; woxea ga ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu siwo woda ɖa la ɖe woƒe dzeɖoɖo nu (KYC na ga si wu $50k). Akɔnta: Ga ƒe dziɖulawo tsɔa ZEC siwo le asi na wo wɔa akɔnta (matsɔa ɖe teƒe ɖeke o; Orchard gaƒuƒoƒo [pool] dzea eŋu). Mɔnu: Akɔnta si ha nuɖo agni (kpɔe be to voting authorities). Dada ɖa: Nàva se ɖe ZEC ƒe 420,000 quorum kple amewo ƒe akpa gã ƒe "ẽ". Akɔnta ɖeka ɖeka le eɖokui ƒe nɔnɔ me; wòate ŋu azã ga ma ke ɖe biabia vovovowo dzi. Nusiwo doa go le ʋuʋuɖi me eye amesiame ate ŋu akpɔ wo. Ŋlɔɖi: Akpa Si Le Dzi Fifia (le January 5, 2026): Q4 2025 wu enu (November akɔnta); woele mɔ kpɔm be Q1 2026 biabiawo ava enumake - kpɔ forum la dzi na nyagblɔɖiwo. Nyawo Siwo Va Yeye: Kpɔ Zcash Community Forum Grants Section. Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe mɔnu ate ŋu atrɔ le hamea ƒe nyagblɔɖiwo nu.

title: Sovright
description: Sovright nye US 501(c3) dzikpɔkpɔ ƒe hadome si mewɔa dzidzedze o, eye wode wɔnunya na amegbetɔwo ƒe wɔnɔaɖokpe ŋu. Wotɔ dɔa gɔme kple ɖe ŋkuɖoɖo ɖe Zcash ƒe…
text: Sovright Sovright nye US 501(c3) dzikpɔkpɔ ƒe hadome si mewɔa dzidzedze o, eye wode wɔnunya na amegbetɔwo ƒe wɔnɔaɖokpe ŋu. Wotɔ dɔa gɔme kple ɖe ŋkuɖoɖo ɖe Zcash ƒe nuteƒewɔwɔ, nukuku [mining], protocol ƒe nututu, kple ecosystem ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu ŋu; dɔa tua dɔwɔnu [tools] kple subɔsubɔwo siwo ƒe ta nye be woakpe ɖe asɔzɔ̃ si nye sutɔ digital ga ƒe nuteƒewɔwɔ ŋu, eye woakpe ɖe Zcash ƒe network ƒe sesẽtɔtɔ le ɣeyiɣi didi me ŋu. Tsã la, womanya Sovright be Bootstrap. Ŋkɔ gbagbe la fia be hadome la ƒe tɔgbui ƒe ta gã nye be woatu Zcash ƒe nuteƒewɔwɔ ƒe company tso gɔmedzeƒe ke ŋu. Yi ɖe asaɖa me Ŋkɔ Ŋkɔ Sovright nye sovereign kple right ƒe ƒoƒo. Eɖe hadome la ƒe ɖeŋkuɖoɖo ɖe ame sia ame ƒe wɔnɔaɖokpe, ɣaɣla [privacy], kple mɔkpɔkpɔ be woatia ale si woakpɔ amedzidzime ƒe data, ga, nyadzɔdzɔwo, compute, kple internet dzi nɔnɔ wɔ ɖo ŋu fia. Sovright ƒe dɔwɔwɔ dze egɔme kple Zcash, ga si ɣaɣla nɔa eŋu eye wowɔe be wòanɔ te, si zãa zero-knowledge cryptography be wòakpe ɖe ɣaɣla gaɖoɖowo [shielded transactions] ŋu. Le ɣeyiɣi ƒe yiɖe edzi me la, hadome la ƒe ɖeŋkuɖoɖo hãe tso asikplɔ-dzralá [private] ga ko gbɔ yi nuteƒewɔwɔ ƒe nuxaxa kekeakewo gbɔ, siwo me nye nyadzɔdzɔ siwo le dedie, network siwo sesẽ, compute si ɣaɣla nɔa eŋu, kple AI ƒe kadodo siwo le dedie. Nukuku ƒe Gaƒuƒoƒo Sovright wɔa Zcash ƒe nukuku gaƒuƒoƒo [mining pool] le: mining.sovright.com Woɖo Sovright Mining Pool ɖe eŋu be wòakpe ɖe nukula [miner] ƒe wɔnɔaɖokpe ŋu eye wòaɖe nukuku gaƒuƒoƒo ƒe ƒoƒo ɖe esi. Nukuku gaƒuƒoƒo ƒe ƒoƒo nye nuxaxa si gbugbɔna le proof-of-work networkwo me, elabena gaƒuƒoƒo ʋee aɖe ate ŋu akpɔ network ƒe hashrate ƒe akpa gã aɖe wɔ ɖe wo ŋutɔ ƒe asi. Esia ate ŋu aɖe ha nuɖo agni [decentralized] ƒe ŋusẽ ɖe esi eye wòakpe ɖe gaƒuƒoƒo ƒe wɔnɔlawo ƒe nɔnɔ ŋu. Woɖo Sovright Mining Pool ɖe eŋu na solo nukulawo, wɔnɔla suewo, kple ame bubuwo siwo di be woakpe ɖe Zcash ƒe ha nuɖo agni nukuku ecosystem ŋu. Gaƒuƒoƒo la ɖea ŋku ɖe fexexe [payment] ƒe wɔwɔ ƒe logic si me nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi [transparent] nɔe ŋu, ŋkuɖoɖo ƒe ŋutete, kple dɔwɔwɔ ƒe adzɔ [fee] sue aɖe ko ŋu. Testnet ƒe version si le fifia la menaa fexexewo o, eye woɖoe ɖe eŋu na dodokpɔ ko. (Egbɔna enumake) Network Ƒe Sesẽtɔtɔ Network ƒe sesẽtɔtɔ fia nuteƒewɔwɔ si tsɔa Zcash ƒe gaɖoɖowo ƒe wɔnɔaɖokpe kple sesẽtɔtɔ. Gaɖoɖo siwo ɣaɣla nɔa eŋu mele ɖe cryptography ko ŋu o, ke boŋ woɖea asi ɖe network ƒe nuteƒewɔwɔ si le wo te ƒe nɔnɔ kple wɔnɔaɖokpe ŋu hã. Sovright bua network ƒe sesẽtɔtɔ be enye dɔwɔwɔ ƒe teƒe vevi na Zcash ƒe dedienɔnɔ kple zãzã ƒe ŋutete si wòate ŋu awɔ le ŋutinya me ƒe dzidzedze. Ga Ƒe Wɔnɔaɖokpe Ga ƒe wɔnɔaɖokpe fia ame sia ame ƒe ŋutete be wòakpɔ eye wòaɖe asi ɖe ye ŋutɔ ƒe ga ŋu, ne wòmeɖe asi ɖe mɔtitina ƒe mɔɖeɖe ŋu o. Le Zcash ƒe nɔnɔ me la, esia wɔ ɣaɣla fexexewo, ŋutɔ ƒe asikplɔ, kple nuteƒewɔwɔ si naa zazãlawo ŋutete be woawɔ gaɖoɖo le wo ŋutɔ ƒe nɔƒoɖoewo nu. Sovright bua ga ƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ kple ga si zazãla ŋutɔ kpɔa ɖe asi be wo nye ame sia ame ƒe wɔnɔaɖokpe ƒe akpa veviwo.

title: Obscura Labs
description: Obscura Labs nye ɖokuia ƒe habɔbɔ si wo ŋlɔ ɖe Nigeria, eye wò ƒe ɖoɖo vevi le Afrika kple asi le dzadzɛ ƒe asimewo bubuwo dzi.
text: Obscura Labs Yi website Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe Nyagblɔɖi Obscura Labs nye ɖokuia ƒe habɔbɔ si wo ŋlɔ ɖe Nigeria, eye wò ƒe ɖoɖo vevi le Afrika kple asi le dzadzɛ ƒe asimewo bubuwo dzi. Eƒe dɔwɔwɔe nye be wòatu nɔnɔme, dɔwɔnu [tools], kple mɔ siwo ana woawɔe le ŋutilã me, siwo ana Zcash ƒe habɔbɔ nakpɔe bɔbɔe, anɔ kɔkɔe, anɔ ha nuɖo agni [decentralized], eye wòanye sesĩe ɣeyiɣi didi me le Afrika katã. Habɔbɔa di be yeaƒo asi na ɣaɣla [privacy] si le ga ƒe dɔwɔwɔ me ƒe mɔ̃ ƒe zazã, to mɔ siwo ana amewo nakpɔ nɔnɔme nyui, kpe ɖe mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔla [developer]wo kple asiwo ŋu, fia nu zãlawo, eye wòasesẽ Zcash ƒe habɔbɔwo le teƒea me. Gɔmedzedze ƒe Nyawo Obscura Labs ye Chidi Olisa, Zcash Nigeria ƒe kplɔla, wɔ. Hafi yeatu Obscura Labs la, Chidi de asi Zcash ƒe habɔbɔa ƒe dɔ me to habɔbɔwo tutu, nusɔsrɔ, ɖeɖefia, nyawo ŋlɔŋlɔ ɖe teƒea ƒe gbe me, zãla ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu, kple dɔwɔwɔ siwo ƒe ta nye be woaɖe amewo le Nigeria kple Afrika ƒe teƒewo bubuwo me akpɔ ga ƒe ɣaɣla kple Zcash. Nukpekpe kple zãlawo, nusrɔlawo, mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔlawo, asiwo, kple habɔbɔa ƒe amewo fia ƒomevi geɖe siwo do mɔ na Zcash ƒe zazã le Afrika katã. Esiawoe nye nɔnɔme ƒe sue, sukɔkɔe si le be woakpɔ ZEC to teƒea ƒe ga me, kpekpeɖeŋu si mesɔ na mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔlawo o, nusɔsrɔ ƒe nuŋlɔɖi siwo woɖe ɖe teƒea ƒe gbe me ƒe sue, kple kadodo sue kple fexexe [payment] ƒe ɖoɖowo siwo wozã gbe sia gbe. Obscura Labs dzɔ ɖe kuxi siawo ŋu. Habɔbɔa tsi tre ɖe susu sia dzi be nyanya ɖeka menya o ne wodi be zazã nasɔ ɣeyiɣi didi. Habɔbɔwo hã hiã nɔnɔme si wòle dzi, nuƒoƒo si woate ŋu akpɔ bɔbɔe, dɔwɔnu na mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔlawo, ga ƒe mɔnu, nusɔsrɔ, kple habɔbɔ ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu si asɔ ɣeyiɣi didi. Nukpɔkpɔ Obscura Labs ƒe nukpɔkpɔe nye be yeaƒo asi na Afrika wòazu teƒe sesĩe aɖe le Zcash ƒe nɔnɔme, zazã, kple habɔbɔa ƒe tsitsi me. Habɔbɔa di be yeazu Afrika ƒe amedzro vevi aɖe si ana Zcash ƒe habɔbɔa nakpɔ nu nyui to: Zcash ƒe nɔnɔme si wòle dzi ƒe dɔwɔwɔ. Mɔ siwo ana woakpɔ ZEC kple fexexe siwo dzra ɣaɣla ɖo ƒe nyonyo. Kpekpeɖeŋu na zãlawo, mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔlawo, asiwo, kple habɔbɔ ƒe ɖoɖowo. Dɔwɔnu kple subɔsubɔ siwo ana woawɔe le ŋutilã me ƒe tutu. Zcash ƒe habɔbɔ siwo anɔ anyi ɣeyiɣi didi ƒe dziɖoɖo. Teƒe ƒe vovototo ƒe tsitsi le Zcash ƒe nɔnɔme kple habɔbɔa ƒe amedede me. Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe Teƒe Veviwo Obscura Labs ɖo eƒe ŋku ɖe dɔwɔwɔ ƒe teƒe vevi ene dzi gbã. Nɔnɔme ƒe Tutu Nɔnɔme si wòle dzi hiã na gakotoku [wallet]wo, applicationwo, mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔlawo, gatrɔƒe [exchange]wo, fexexe ƒe subɔsubɔwo, kple zãlawo be woate ŋu ado go kple Zcash ƒe network. Obscura Labs wɔna eye wòtu Zcash ƒe nɔnɔme le Afrika me be networka ƒe nyonyo, teƒe ƒe vovototo, dzidzedze, kple sesẽ nasɔ. Dɔ sia ƒe ta nye be yeaɖe nɔnɔme ƒe dɔwɔlawo ƒe sue ƒe dziɖoɖo ɖa eye wòana subɔsubɔ si wòle dzi na zãlawo kple mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlawo le Afrika ƒe asimewo. Nɔnɔme ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo ate ŋu akpɔe le: Zcash ƒe mainnet RPC ƒe teƒe si amewo katã ate ŋu azã. Zcash ƒe testnet RPC ƒe teƒe si amewo katã ate ŋu azã. Zebra ƒe ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo [full node]wo. lightwalletd ƒe subɔsubɔwo. DNS seederwo. Nɔnɔme ƒe ŋkɔkpɔkpɔ si amewo katã ate ŋu akpɔ. APIwo siwo woɖo ɖe mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔlawo ŋu. Kadodo ƒe dɔwɔnuwo kple nuŋlɔɖiwo. Subɔsubɔ bubuwo siwo ana nu si do mɔ na tutu le Zcash dzi nasue. To nɔnɔme ƒe nyonyo nazu bɔbɔe wu me la, Obscura Labs di be yeaƒo asi na mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔlawo, gakotokuwo, applicationwo, asiwo, kple subɔsubɔwo siwo le kadodo wɔm kple Zcash ƒe habɔbɔa. Zazã kple Ga Ƒe Mɔnu Ne Zcash ado ŋusẽ le gbe sia gbe ƒe nɔnɔme me la, ele be amewo nakpɔe, adzra ɖo, azãe, eye woatrɔ ZEC manɔ kuxi si mehiã o. Obscura Labs kpena ɖe dɔwɔwɔwo ŋu siwo ƒe ta nye be woana nyuie le: Mɔ si le ZEC kple Afrika ƒe teƒea ƒe gaawo dome. Fiat ƒe gege ƒe mɔwo kple dodo ƒe mɔwo. Asime ƒe zazã. Fexexe ƒe kadodowo. Fexexe siwo atravɔ dukɔ ƒe liƒo. Zãla ƒe gbedede. Gakotoku ƒe nyonyo. ZEC ƒe zazã si le ŋutilã me na amesiame kple asiwo. title: ZingoLabs
description: ZingoLabs nye nukpɔla ƒe hatɔ siwo tsɔ wo ɖokui de ameƒomevi ƒe agbenɔnɔ nyuie wɔwɔ me. Míexɔe se be teknɔlɔdzi na na viɖe na amegbetɔwo, eye míenɔa anyi nyuie…
text: ZingoLabs Nyatakakadzraƒe vevi - GitHub - X/Twitter - Instagram ZingoLabs nye nukpɔla ƒe hatɔ siwo tsɔ wo ɖokui de ameƒomevi ƒe agbenɔnɔ nyuie wɔwɔ me. Míexɔe se be teknɔlɔdzi na na viɖe na amegbetɔwo, eye míenɔa anyi nyuie to nu siwo woƒe lɔlɔ̃ le eme me. Míele ɖoɖowo siwo wɔna be esia anɔ te ŋu dzrom. Zingo Lab Cyan wɔa dɔ abe ɣaɣla [Shielded] DAO ene. Míetsɔa míatɔwo ɖoa gadzraɖoƒe [treasury] me, afi si hatɔ sia hatɔ si ƒe nukpɔsafui [viewing key] le. Woɖea ga tso gadzraɖoƒe la me ne hatɔwo ɖo vote be woakpe ɖe aɖaŋu aɖe ŋu. Dɔwo Zingo! gakotoku [Wallet] (GitHub) Zingo gakotoku nye Zcash gakotoku si ƒe nɔnɔwo blibo, eye woɖoe be wòasɔ na zãlawo, ke hã eƒe nɔnɔ xɔasi aɖewo le na zãla siwo le ŋgɔ wu. Ekpea ɖe nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi [transparent], Sapling kple Ironwood gaƒuƒoƒo [pools] ŋu, eƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi [address] ƒe agbalẽ le na fexexe [payments] siwo gagbɔna, eye wòte ŋu akpɔ wo le gbe vovovowo me. Eyae nye gakotoku gbãtɔ si kpe ɖe Orchard ŋu eye wòwɔ NU5 ƒe nɔnɔwo. Zingo! ƒe nɔnɔ vevi aɖe nye be wòate ŋu azã nya kpui [Memo] ƒe teƒe atsɔ ana nya siwo le vevie ku ɖe wò gaɖoɖo [transactions] ŋu. Zingo! le mɔ̃ nyuitɔwo kple PCwo dzi. Àkpɔ downloadwo katã le afi Zingolib (GitHub) API kple test-app si ɖe zcash ƒe nɔnɔwo fia na appwo be woazã. Zingolib naa library na zingo-mobile, kple cli application si le eme, si woyɔna be zingo-cli, command-line nyatakaka si hiã ƒe gakotoku si doa gbe kple ɖoɖonu [chain] ƒe indexer abe Zaino ene. Zaino Indexer (GitHub) Zaino nye Rust indexer na Zcash ƒe gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu [blockchain], si Zingo ƒe hatɔ la wɔ. Enye indexer si le Z3 stack me: ekpea ɖe ɖoɖonu ƒe nyatakakawo ŋu tso Zebra validator aɖe gbɔ, eye wòsubɔa gakotokuwo, explorerwo, kple client bubuwo. Enye mɔ si ɖo ta na lightwalletd. Zaino naa nɔnɔ veviwo na nyatakaka si hiã ƒe mɔ [light clients] siawo, abe gakotokuwo kple application siwo mehiã gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu ƒe ŋutinya blibo o ene, kple client blibowo alo gakotokuwo. Ekpea hã ɖe gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe [block] ƒe explorerwo ŋu, eye wònaa mɔ be woage ɖo gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu si woɖo kpɔ kple ɖoɖonu nyuitɔ si womeɖo kpɔ o kple mempool si Zebra ƒe ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ blibo [full node] ƒe validator kpɔa dzi la gbɔ. zcashd va ɖo eƒe End-of-Support ƒe dzeɖiƒe le 18 July 2026 le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe 3,417,100, eye mekpea ɖe Ironwood (NU6.3) ŋu o. Zaino xlea Zebra ƒe validator. ZLN (zcash-local-net) (GitHub) Dɔwɔnu [tools] ƒe ƒome aɖe si dzea Zcash ƒe processwo gɔme eye wòkpɔa dzi na wo. Wozãa esia na integration testing le nusiwo ƒe ŋgɔyiyi me: nyatakaka si hiã ƒe mɔwo indexerwo validatorwo Eƒe taɖodzinu nye be wòana testing ƒe teƒe si ate ŋu atrɔ eye wòsesẽ na ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ [nodes] veviwo (validatorwo) abe Zebra ene, indexerwo abe Zaino ene, kple nyatakaka si hiã ƒe mɔ ƒe gakotokuwo abe zingo-cli ene. Stack si wòdzea gɔme le gɔmedzedze me nye Zebrad, zainod, kple zcash-devtool. zcashd kple lightwalletd ƒe process xoxowo le legacy-stack ƒe nɔnɔ si womekpea ɖe ŋu o megbe, eye woɖo ɖe woƒe ɖeɖe ɖa. Kpuie na dɔwɔnu si dzea, ɖoa ɖe cache me, eye wòloa Zcash ƒe ɖoɖonu ƒe nyatakakawo (na mainnet, testnet, kple regtest), wozãa zcash-local-net tso Zaino ƒe test suite me be woatsɔ akpɔ Lightwallet RPC ƒe subɔsubɔwo siwo le Zaino me (kpɔ Zaino testing ƒe agbalẽwo).

text: ZKAV Club Nuto - GitHub - X/Twitter - YouTube The Zcash Foundation de asi na mía; dɔa sia si tso dukɔme tɔwo ƒe asi me la di be yeaɖo xexeame blibo ŋu to nutoa kple nutome ƒe wɔwɔwo me. Èyɔ nuwɔla ƒe ha be woasrɔ nu eye woawɔ dɔ ɖekae be woakɔ nyadzɔdzɔwo kple nya siwo doa ŋusẽ, fia nu, eye woma Zcash kple ga ƒe ɣaɣla [privacy] ƒe ŋugbedodo la. Dɔ Ƒe Nyaɖeɖe Míenye nuwo ƒe wɔla ƒe xexea blibo ƒe ha si dea dzɔdzɔme na ɣaɣla, Zcash, kple hadede tutu. Míaɖekae míatu teƒe aɖe be míama nyadzɔdzɔwo, nusrɔsrɔwo kple nuɖuɖuwo, be woakpe ɖe nuwo ƒe wɔwɔ kple tata ŋu, si wɔnɔna le nyati siwo dea dzɔdzɔme na mí ŋu. Míedi be ame siwo le dɔa gbɔ kekeake la nana woagblɔ woƒe nya, eye woama woƒe dzidzɔ kple agbenɔnɔ ƒe nuteƒewɔwɔ be ɣaɣla ƒe nufiala kple Zcash nadzɔ le xexeame ƒe akpa sia akpa. Zk Av Club ƒe ɣeyiɣi didi ƒe taɖodzinu nye be yeatu media wɔla siwo ŋu wòate ŋu, siwo le yready, eye woga le asi na ƒe network, be woatsi nyadzɔdzɔwo tso Zcash kple ɣaɣla ŋu, siwo ƒe gɔme le nutoa me eye xexea blibo ƒe amewo hã nana woaɖu. Hadede Kple Hatiwɔwɔ Zk Av Club ana internet dzi ƒe hadɔwɔwɔwo ɣesiaɣi, eye wòawɔ dɔ kple nutoa ƒe nudzɔdzɔwo be woawɔ adzɔdzɔ tso nyati siwo dea dzɔdzɔme na xexea blibo ƒe Zcash kple ɣaɣla ƒe hadewo ŋu. Esi míaƒe ŋkuléle le internet dzi ƒe gbe kple nuku ƒe nuwɔwɔ ŋu ta la, afi siae anɔ be amewo asrɔ nu tso media ƒe hiahiãwo kple nutoa ƒe Zcash kple ɣaɣla ŋu wɔnɔla ƒe hadewo ƒe dzɔdzɔwo ŋu le xexeame blibo me, eye woawɔ nu. Nudzɔdzɔwo Nudzɔdzɔwo anɔ hɔ̃ eye woanye fɛtɔ, eye woate ŋu anɔ le mɔ geɖewo me abe nufiafiawo, Q+A, AMA, dɔwɔƒewo, kuxi fɔfɔ, susu ƒe mama kple nu bubu aɖe keŋkeŋ ene. Adzɔdzɔ ɖe sia ɖe, togbɔ be mɔ kae woazã hã, anɔ Zcash ƒe ŋkuléle le ɣaɣla ŋu abe nyati kple nɔnɔme ene. Mígate ŋu aɖe mɔ na woƒe dzɔdzɔme o. Ame Kae Míenye Míenye xexea blibo ƒe gbe kple agbenɔnɔ ƒe hadɔ. To hadede me la, míana ŋusẽ eye míatsɔ ame ɖe sia ɖe ƒe gbe ɖe ŋgɔ be wòagblɔ Zcash ƒe nya to eya ŋutɔ ƒe ŋkuléle me, le eya ŋutɔ ƒe mɔ nu. Míana nuɖuɖuwo kple kadodo siwo akpa ɖe nuwɔlawo ŋu eye woaɖe asi le woŋu, ale be woatsɔ woƒe gbe tɔxɛ va xexea blibo ƒe ɣaɣla ƒe adzɔdzɔ me. Míekpɔe be kadodo ƒe web aɖe li, siwo doa gbe eye wɔnɔa nu le gbegbɔgblɔ vovovo me, eye woƒe nuɖuɖu tso Zk Av Club ƒe nyadzɔdzɔwo kple nuwo siwo woma la me, eye woatsɔ nu akpe ɖe eŋu. title: Hame ƒe Broadcasting kple VDO.Ninja kple OBS Studio
description: Wɔna kple volɔntiawo ƒe ha ƒe wɔ wò tutorial kpui sia le DWeb Camp 2023 me. Nɔnɔmetata sia ƒe taɖodzinu nye be woazã smartphone mɔ̃wo siwo ƒo xlã offline MESH…
text: Hame ƒe Broadcasting kple VDO.Ninja kple OBS Studio Wɔna kple volɔntiawo ƒe ha ƒe wɔ wò tutorial kpui sia le DWeb Camp 2023 me. Nɔnɔmetata sia ƒe taɖodzinu nye be woazã smartphone mɔ̃wo siwo ƒo xlã offline MESH network be woawɔ video ƒe nuŋlɔɖi kple streaming ɖeka. Míezã open source dɔwɔwɔ eve, OBS Studio (Open Broadcaster software) kple VDO.Ninja. Àte ŋu atsɔ dɔwɔwɔ siawo ava le wò kɔmpiuta dzi eye nàwɔ wo le afi ma. OBS Studio (Open Broadcaster software) OBS Studio nye dɔwɔwɔ si nye ablɔɖe kple open source, si woazã be woaŋlɔ nu alo woawɔ live streaming, eye wòle operating system vovovowo dzi. Woɖe dɔwɔwɔ sia go gbã le 2012 me, eye game streaming ƒe hame kple video content creators siwo wòawɔ wo ɖokui ƒe dɔwo lɔ̃e e ŋutɔ. OBS Studio ƒe user interface ate ŋu akpɔ ɖe amesi zãm wò le zi gbã la ŋu abe nu si sesẽ ene. Woama OBS Studio ƒe screen la ƒe akpa eve, "Preview" kple "Broadcast". Preview ƒe window fia video siwo li (camera vovovowo abe webcam, Iriun Webcam, OBS Virtual Camera, Video kple Browser source), siwo woyɔ be "Scenes", eye "Broadcast" fia live stream la. Be nàtsɔ remote camera stream tso VDO.ninja ava OBS Studio me la, nàdze egɔme kple Browser Source yeye ƒe tsatsala kple "Sources > Add > Browser". Le window yeye la me la, àte ŋu ana source URL tso VDO.Ninja eye nàtia "Make source visible". Azɔ la, àte ŋu adze remote streams ƒe broadcasting gɔme. VDO.Ninja VDO.Ninja nye web application si nye ablɔɖe kple open source, si na wò ŋu trɔ wò mobile devices zu live streaming camera. Àte ŋu atsɔ dɔwɔwɔ sia ava eye nàɖoe le wò kɔmpiuta dzi, alo nàzã online version le https://vdo.ninja. tẽ. VOD.Ninja ƒe interface bɔbɔe; ke ɖe VDO.Ninja ƒe website la ŋu le wò mobile device ƒe web browser me eye nàtia "Add your camera to OBS". Emegbe la, àtia wò camera kple audio device tso devicewo ƒe list la me eye nàdzi "Start". Emegbe la, nàxɔ "view" link si nàte ŋu akpe ɖe OBS Studio ŋu. Hame ƒe ƒoƒo ƒe kplɔɖoɖo kple VDO.Ninja Dze egɔme to VDO.ninja dzi kple wò web browser le desktop/laptop dzi. Be nàwɔ xɔ yeye eye nàkplɔ wò hame ƒe call livestream ŋu la, dzi Create a Room. Screen si kplɔe ɖo la abia nyatakaka vevi aɖewo tso asike woawɔ wò xɔ la ɖo. Ne woawɔ xɔ aɖe vɔ la, director la axɔ control options geɖe le screen si kplɔe ɖo la dzi. Ne amewo ge ɖe wò xɔ me la, wò, abe director ene, nàkpɔ source options kple controls katã ƒe dzɔdzɔ kple woƒe video kple audio. Nyabiase siwo wozã ɣesiaɣi Video graphic cards ka ƒomevi woahiã na OBS Studio? Àte ŋu azã personal computer si ƒe graphic card nyo kple memory geɖe, alo nàzã hardware encoders Teradek VidiU. Ɖe OBS na wò ŋu nàwɔ live translation kple captioning? Hame la ƒe plugin aɖewo li siwo abe wotena feature sia gɔme ene. https://github.com/eddieoz/OBS-live-translation Ɖe àte ŋu awɔ wò ŋutɔ ƒe plugins na OBS Studio? Ɛ̃, OBS kpe ɖe lua kple python scripting ŋu. Eya kple JavaScript na Overlays kple webviews. Ɖe míazã live fade to black alo transitions? Esia le wò, producer la, si! Ɖe delay li ne nèle streaming wɔm? Esia ɖe afi si nèle streaming wɔm ɖo ŋutɔ. Ɖe, YouTube ate ŋu anɔ kple minute ɖeka alo wu ema ƒe delay elabena wowo ƒe serverwo wɔ video processing hafi woabroadcast e. Audio ƒe ɖoɖo ɖea ne wòzã OBS le machine bɔbɔe dzi eye nèle green-screening wɔm Zã Hardware encoder alo zã stream yard https://support.streamyard.com/hc/en-us/articles/360056350852-How-to-Use-OBS-Virtual-Camera-with-StreamYard alo RiverSide.FM Akpe Ryan Ajay Arky Nusiwo woazã https://obsproject.com/help https://docs.vdo.ninja/ Office Hours: Media kple digital event hame https://alex4d.com/notes/item/media-and-digital-event-community

Emegbe: Aleke nàte ŋu ada ame bubuwo ƒe fayilwo ɖe wò mɔ̃xɔ̃ƒe dzi be míaɖe ɖeka koe nye kuxiƒe [single point of failure] la le ɣeyiɣi si ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ gbãtɔ la mele internet dzi o. title: Ɖe Nyaɖeɖefia Aɖe IPFS dzi
description: IPFS (InterPlanetary File System) nye peer-to-peer protocol kple network si wo wɔ be wòawɔ mɔ ha nuɖo agni [decentralised] na filewo ƒe dzadzra kple mama.
text: Ɖe Nyaɖeɖefia Aɖe IPFS dzi Nyaɖeɖefia ƒe Gɔmedzedze ku ɖe IPFS ŋu IPFS (InterPlanetary File System) nye peer-to-peer protocol kple network si wo wɔ be wòawɔ mɔ ha nuɖo agni [decentralised] na filewo ƒe dzadzra kple mama. To vovo na internet ƒe client-server model blema la, IPFS na mɔ zãlawo be woama filewo na wo nɔewo tẽ, le esime wometsɔa centralised server aɖe o be wòadzra emewo ɖo eye wòama eme. Wotsɔ content-addressing na filewo ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi [address] le IPFS me, si fia be wòxɔ file ɖe sia ɖe na hash alo CONTENT IDENTIFIER (CID) tɔxɛ aɖe le eƒe emenyawo nu, eye wozãa hash sia be woaxɔ file la tso network la me. IPFS dzraa nyatakakawo ɖo abe gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe [block] siwo wode dzesii kple CID wo ene. Ne èkpe file aɖe ɖe eŋu la, edzraa eɖo ɖe wò ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ [node] dzi ko; mekɔa eƒe kɔpi ɖe ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ bubuwo dzi le eɖokui si o. Na kɔpi aɖe si ŋu ame bubuwo ate ŋu aɖo la nanɔ online ɣesiaɣi, alo ɖo ɖoɖo na dzadzraɖo le adzɔge (remote pinning), ale be hlẽla bubuwo nate ŋu axɔe. Kpɔ IPFS ƒe anyinɔnɔ ɖaa. Xlẽ: Gɔmedzedze Nyaɖeɖefia ku ɖe IPFS ŋu Wò Ɖe Nyaɖeɖefia ƒe Wɔwɔ Le kpɔɖeŋu sia me la, míele website bɔbɔe aɖe wɔm. Kpɔɖeŋu Ɖe Nyaɖeɖefia Afɔ 1: Ne mènya web design nyuie o la, ŋlɔ emenyawo katã na wò website, siwoe nye Title, nuŋɔŋlɔ ƒe ŋutilã gã, linkwo na axa bubuwo alo site bubuwo kple footerwo. Afɔ 2: Zã HTML template!. Ɖe nuŋɔŋlɔ si nèŋlɔ la ɖe eme ɖe ale si wòle. Ɖe ŋutinya me la, àte ŋu awɔ .CSS stylesheet hã na wò website. Afɔ 3: Tsɔ wò aƒemenuŋɔŋlɔ gbãtɔ (homepage) de index.html me le site ƒe nudzraɖoƒe (folder) gbãtɔ ƒe ke dzi. Tsɔ eƒe nɔnɔmetatawo kple CSS hã de eme, eye nàzã mɔ siwo do ƒome kplii (relative paths) abe style.css ene, ale be woawɔ dɔ le IPFS gateway URL te hã. Ɣaɣla Dzesi Ŋɔŋlɔ ƒe Ðoɖo IPFS Desktop kpɔa ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ (node) dzi na wò. Na wòanɔ dɔ wɔm le esime nèle wò nyatakakadzraɖoƒe mam na amewo. Le mɔ si toa command-line dzi ta la, dze repository yeye aɖe gɔme zi ɖeka ko: Emegbe dze ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ la gɔme eye nàgblẽ terminal sia ɖe ʋuʋu: Wɔ sedede siwo susɔ la le terminal evelia me. Mègadze daemon evelia gɔme o ne IPFS Desktop xa le dzɔdzɔm na nudzraɖoƒe sia xoxo. Tsɔ Site Folder kpe ɖe IPFS ŋu: Le IPFS Desktop me la, tia agbalẽdzraɖoƒe (folder) si me wò nyatakakadzraɖoƒe ƒe faɛlwo le, to Add Folder ƒe tiatia dzi. – Le CLI mɔ̃ (CLI route) dzi la, wɔ esia tso wò site ƒe agbalẽdzraɖoƒe ƒe dzinɔ agbalẽdzraɖoƒe (parent directory) me: Ɖɔli foldername ɖe wò agbalẽƒoƒe ƒe ŋkɔ teƒe (tsɔ ŋkɔ siwo me teƒe ƒuƒlu le la de nyagbe-dzesiwo me). Dzra CID la ɖo le added ... foldername fli mamlɛtɔ dzi: eyae ɖea agbalẽƒoƒe bliboa fiana, menye index.html ɖeɖeko o. Ɖe Site la ƒe pin ɖe IPFS dzi: CLI ƒe ipfs add sedede la tsɔa nu siwo nèdo ɖe eme la ƒoa pin ɖe wò kɔmpiuta dzi le gɔmedzedzea me. Kpɔ folder la ƒe pin to esia dzi: Ɖɔ YOURFOLDERCID ɖe CID si tso afɔɖeɖe si do ŋgɔ me la teƒe; ele be nu si do go la nagblɔ recursive. Pinning (pinning) kpɔa ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ sia ƒe kɔpi ta tso nugbegblẽwo ƒe ɖeɖeɖa (garbage collection) me, gake mewɔnɛ be kɔmpiuta si wotsi la nanɔ internet dzi o. Ne èdi be nuwo nanɔ asiwò ne wò ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ mele internet dzi o la, ɖo pinning le adzɔge (remote pinning) eye nàkpɔ egbɔ be adzɔge dɔwɔƒe la wu pinning la nu. Ke ɖe wò website ŋu le IPFS dzi: Gbã la, kpɔ wò website to local gateway (mɔnu si le wò kɔmpiuta dzi) si le http://127.0.0.1:8080/ipfs/YOURFOLDERCID/ dzi (zã gateway port si wò daemon ta ne etɔ vovo). Slash si le nuwuwu la naa be relative links (kadodo siwo ku ɖe teƒe si nèle ŋu) nawɔ dɔ le directory la me. Dzɔtsoƒe si le ablɔ me abe https://ipfs.io/ipfs/YOURFOLDERCID/ ene (public gateway) ate ŋu aɖee afia ne ete ŋu xɔ nyatakakawo tso ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ (node) si wòate ŋu ade gbɔ la gbɔ. Ne èkpɔe le wò ŋutɔ wò kɔmpiuta dzi nyuie la, menye kpeɖodzi be ame sia ame ate ŋu akpɔe le internet dzi o. title: Ɖe GitHub Repo Dɔ Kple IPFS
description: Le mɔfiafia sia me la, míesrɔ ale si nàwɔ URL si woate ŋu awɔ git clone kple na wò GitHub repository si woɖe dɔe kple IPFS CID.
text: Ɖe GitHub Repo Dɔ Kple IPFS Gɔmedzedze Le mɔfiafia sia me la, míesrɔ ale si nàwɔ URL si woate ŋu awɔ git clone kple na wò GitHub repository si woɖe dɔe kple IPFS CID. Esia wɔ dɔ na emetɔnu be nusiwo le eme nali sɔ gbɔna togbɔ be afi kae wònɔ, be wòakpɔ tso ƒomevi ƒe xexlẽ ɖe eŋu, eye wòanye nuteƒe si me xɔasi le na nyatakakadzɔdzɔe! Didienu [Note]: Nyatakaka si woɖo ɖe IPFS la le network la ƒe zazãla katãwo ƒe asime. Èate ŋu adi be nàwɔ ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ [encryption] na wò ŋutɔ ƒe nyatakaka alo nyatakaka si le vevie le afi sia. Ɖo IPFS Kubo Dze installation ƒe mɔfiafia si woɖo ɖe afi sia yome. Le kpɔɖeŋu sia me la, míezã Linux, OS ƒe version bubuwo hã le mɔ. Kpɔ be installation la dzɔ edzi kple ipfs –version Wɔ Repository ƒe Clone Be nàdze egɔme la, tia Git repository si nèdi be nàhost eye nàwɔ clone na: Wɔ sedede sia: "git clone https://github.com/zechub/zechub” Fifia, be wòanɔ klalo be woawɔ clone nae to IPFS dzi. cd zechub git update-server-info Ʋu Git ƒe objects: Esia awɔ be IPFS nate ŋu awɔ objects deduplication ne nàle Git repository la yɔm le megbe. Tsɔe Ɖe IPFS Ne wowɔ esia vɔ la, repository ma le klalo be woaɖe dɔe. Nusi koe gale na wòawɔ lae nye be nàtsɔe aɖo ɖe IPFS: $ pwd /code/myrepo $ ipfs add -r CID si tsoa eme lae nye: Qmbgqox5g3614gjTb43s5mdSmmk95aGWWA9EHksL2T91A2 Enyo ŋutɔ! Fifia la, wò repository la le network la dzi. Wɔ Clone Kple IPFS Fifia la, ele be nàte ŋu axɔ GitHub repository la kple: git clone http://ipfs.io/ipfs/yourCID Le mɔ bubu nu la, àte ŋu adi eye nàxɔe kple wò ŋutɔ ƒe IPFS ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ [node]. Didienu Mlɔeba: Repo folder si le IPFS dzi la mexɔa updatewo ɖe GitHub repository ŋutɔ la ƒe updatewo kplii o. Woɖe aɖaŋu be nàtsɔ folder la aɖo ake le ɣeyiɣi siwo ɖoɖo me.

title: Kpekpeɖeŋu na ZecHub
description: ZecHub doa alɔ̃ ɖe amewo ŋu be woasrɔ̃ nu tso Zcash ŋu. Ne èle axa sia xlem la, míekpɔ dzidzɔ gã be èbu be yeakpekpe ɖe eŋu! Kpekpeɖeŋu sia kple sia si nàwɔ la…
text: Kpekpeɖeŋu na ZecHub ZecHub doa alɔ̃ ɖe amewo ŋu be woasrɔ̃ nu tso Zcash ŋu. Ne èle axa sia xlem la, míekpɔ dzidzɔ gã be èbu be yeakpekpe ɖe eŋu! Kpekpeɖeŋu sia kple sia si nàwɔ la ana woadze alea ɖe zechub.wiki kple ZecHub social media bubuwo dzi. Kpekpeɖeŋu amedzrowo Be nàkpɔ ZecHub ŋuti kpɔɖeŋu, xlẽ README. Gɔmedzedze ZecHub zã GitHub be wòakplɔ hadome ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu dzi. Ne wònye amedzro le GitHub me la, megblẽ o! Míama ale si nàte ŋu akpe ɖe ZecHub ŋu abe hadome ƒe kpekpeɖeŋutɔ ene. Míexena tip le ɣaɣla [shielded] ZEC me na kpekpeɖeŋu si woda dzi. Fetu ƒe agbɔsɔsɔwo menɔ kplikpli ɖe ZEC ŋu o — kpɔ Ale si woɖoa fetuwo. Le mɔfia sia me la, àkpɔ kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe dɔwɔmɔ la ƒe kpɔɖeŋu tso issue aɖe ƒe ɖeke me, pull request (PR) wɔwɔ, kpɔkpɔ, kple PR ƒe tsɔtsɔ kpeɖe ŋu. Va geɖe nya me Gbã la, va geɖe nya me le míaƒe hadome ƒe kadodoɖoƒewo me. Ŋlɔnu ƒe Mɔfiawo Kpekpeɖeŋu sia kple sia si nàtsɔ aɖe ZecHub ŋu la, ele be wòawɔ ɖe ZecHub ŋlɔnu ƒe mɔfia ŋu. Esia ƒo wikiwo, dokumentiwo kple social media ƒe emenyawo hã. Mɔ siwo dzi nàte ŋu akpe ɖe eŋu ZecHub nye hadome ƒe dɔwɔaɖe si ƒe tae nye be wòana kpekpeɖeŋu kple nu siwo hiã na Zcash ƒe zãlawo kple mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔlawo [developers]. Mɔ geɖewo li si dzi nàte ŋu age ɖe ZecHub me, abe míaƒe nyadzɔdzɔgbalẽ [newsletter] si doa go kɔsiɖa sia kɔsiɖa ŋlɔŋlɔ, míaƒe sidzedzeƒe ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu, alo mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖowɔwɔ ƒe dɔwo me kpekpeɖeŋu ene. Efia kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe ƒomevi siwo ZecHub xɔna fifia: Ale si woɖoa fetuwo Woexena tip le ɣaɣla ZEC me. ZEC ƒe xexlẽdzesi siwo nɔ tanya siwo le ete la me tsã la nye ŋkeke si va yi ƒe nɔnɔmetatawo le ZEC/USD ƒe asimekɔxɔ xoxotɔ aɖe dzi. Mègabu wo be woyee nye asimekɔxɔ siwo le fifia o. Ale si wotia agbɔsɔsɔ aɖe: Sɔ dɔa ɖe USD ƒe teƒe me le bounty ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ ƒe se me. Tia target aɖe le teƒe ma me — menye eteƒe dziŋgɔtɔ la ɖe sia ɖe o. Trɔe le ZEC/USD ƒe asimekɔxɔ si le fifia kple amewo katã kpɔa la dzi, eye nàde ZEC ɖe bounty la dzi: Trɔe ɖe decimal teƒe 4. Se ƒe faɖeɖefia la koe nye nyateƒe ƒe tsoƒe ɖeka. Ne axa sia kple faɖeɖefia ma ƒe nya mesɔ o la, se la koe nɔ anyi. Dɔ si woxe fetu ɖe ta la le ZEC Bounties dzi. Nɔnɔ etɔ̃ siwo menye nu ɖeka o: Wotsɔ kpeɖe eŋu — Woxɔ PR la ɖe repository la me. Woda fetu dzi — Sponsor aɖe alo DAO la lɔ̃ be fetu due, eye wɔɖoɖo kae wòanɔ. Woxe fetu — ZEC va ɖo wò ɣaɣla Unified Address dzi. Kpekpeɖeŋu si wotsɔ kpeɖe eŋu menana fetu ƒe dzedze ɖe eɖokuiŋu o. Fetu si woda dzi menye fexexe [payment] si wowu enu o. Dev ƒe Dɔ Dev ƒe dɔ si woda dzi katã si kpena ɖe Zcash ecosystem ŋu be woatu. Esia ate ŋu afɔ míaƒe wiki, gakotoku [wallet] yeyeawo, alo application sia kple sia si nàte ŋu abu. Zcash Mɔfiawo (video) Mɔfia ƒe kpɔɖeŋu aɖe le ete: Wɔ eye nàma mɔfiawo tso Zcash ƒe appwo ŋu, eye nàxɔ fetu. Ɖo PR ɖe zechub/tutorials alo nàɖo video la ɖe #video-content channel le Discord me. Ne video la de míaƒe dzodzro ƒe sewo la, míatsɔe ado go eye míaxe tip na wò. ZecHub Wiki - wiki ƒe axa yeye si wodo go Míaƒe wiki ƒe site la doa Zcash ŋuti srɔ̃nuwo go le mɔ bɔbɔe kple mɔ si bɔbɔ be woagblɔe me. Zcash nye mɔ̃ si dzi ŋutɔ, eye hadome si le agbe geɖe le eŋu, eyata dokumenti geɖe gale si míele be míatu. Míaƒe tae nye be míatu dokumentiwo tso: Efiawo nye nuwo siwo kekeake, eyata nu geɖe li si nàwɔ tsoe. Ne èdi numekpɔkpɔ aɖe la, kpɔ míaƒe wiki-docs site si le fifia eye nàkpɔ nu siwo bu. Ne èɖo nya si nèdi be yeŋlɔ vɔ la, dze wò tɔtrɔwo wɔwɔ gɔme eye nàsrɔ̃ ale si nàɖo PR ɖe ZecHub repo la dzi. Wowɔ míaƒe dokumentiwo katã eye wokpɔa wo dzi le repo sia me. Wòle be nàwɔ ɖe ZecHub ŋlɔnu ƒe mɔfia ŋu ne èle wiki ƒe axa ŋlɔm, eye nàzã axa si le akpa ma ke me xoxo abe ƒomekɔkɔe ƒe kpɔɖeŋu ene. Ne èɖo PR vɔ la, mèɖe kuku nàɖo nya na @dismad, @squirrel, alo @vito le discord ƒe #zechub akpa me, eye woakpɔ wò PR eye woatsɔe akpeɖe eŋu ne ele be woatsɔe ade site la dzi. Ne wotsɔe kpeɖe eŋu la, woatsɔ doc la ade ZecHub website la dzi. Ne doc la medze o la, woana tɔtrɔ siwo nàwɔ le PR la me. ZecHub Wiki - wiki ƒe axa si wogɔmeɖe ZecHub ƒe tae nye be wòana open-source

title: ZecHub Ƒe Ŋlɔnu ƒe Nɔnɔme Ƒe Fiafia [Style Guide]
description: ZecHub ƒe ŋlɔnu ƒe nɔnɔme le bɔbɔe eye ame sia ame ate ŋu axlẽe bɔbɔe. Míewɔ dzidzɔ na ame sia ame, eye míetsɔ míaƒe ŋku ɖo Zcash ƒe nutoa dzi.
text: ZecHub Ƒe Ŋlɔnu ƒe Nɔnɔme Ƒe Fiafia [Style Guide] ZecHub ƒe ŋlɔnu ƒe nɔnɔme le bɔbɔe eye ame sia ame ate ŋu axlẽe bɔbɔe. Míewɔ dzidzɔ na ame sia ame, eye míetsɔ míaƒe ŋku ɖo Zcash ƒe nutoa dzi. Gbedasiwo [Principles] Le klalo be nàkpe ɖe ame ŋu [Ready to assist] - Fia na Zcash zãlawo be míele woƒe gbɔ. Kpui eye nàɖo eƒe nyateƒe [Brief and to the point]: Gblɔ nyasaɖa si bɔbɔe wu si nàte ŋu. Dze egɔme kple nu si le vevie wu. Zãla ƒe hiãhiã me nɔ [User-centered]: Míeŋlɔ na zãlawo gbã, na mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔlawo evelia, eye na ame bubuawo etɔlia. Gɔmedzedze [Basics] Ɖo eƒe nyateƒe [Get to the point]. Dze egɔme kple nu si le vevie wu. Tsɔ nya veviwo ɖo ŋgɔ be ame nate ŋu akpɔ wo kaba. Na zãla ƒe tiatiawo kple afɔɖewo nanɔ kɔ. Ŋlɔ ale si nàgblɔe [Write like you speak]. Míatɔ zãlawo nye amegbetɔwo vavã. Ɖo nu na wo to ŋlɔŋlɔ me. Nànɔ kpui [Be brief]. Na nyanya si sɔ be zãlawo nakpɔ be woaɖɔ kuxi aɖe ɖe eme alo woatia nu aɖe. Mègatsɔ full stop le tanya me o [Skip periods in titles]. Ɖe esia ɖa le tanya, ta, tanya sue, UI ƒe tanya, kple list ƒe nu siwo me nya etɔ alo si wu menɔ o ƒe nuwuwu. Wotsɔ full stop le kpuiewo kple ŋlɔnu ƒe ŋutilã me. Medewo: Zi Send ƒe button dzi->Zi Send ƒe button dzi Ne mèka ɖe edzi o la, mègaɖo ŋlɔdzesiwo ƒe gãgã o [When in doubt, avoid capitalization]. Ɖo ŋlɔdzesi gã na ŋkɔ vavãwo alo ŋkɔwo abe Zcash ene ko, kple tanya alo nyagblɔɖi ƒe nya gbãtɔ. Medewo: Aleke nàaɖo ZEC ɖa kple Unified Address. → Aleke nàaɖo ZEC ɖa kple unified address Gaŋlɔŋlɔ gbɔgbɔ [Rewrite weak writing]. Zi geɖe la, dze nyagblɔɖi sia kple wɔwɔnya aɖe. Ele te ŋu be kple wonɔ wo ate ŋu awɔ tɔtrɔ le wo me. Medewo: Àte ŋu aɖo ZEC ɖa eye nàxɔe tso wò mobail telefon me->Ɖo ZEC ɖa eye nàxɔe kple wò telefon Mègatsɔ teƒe geɖe o [Don't be spacey]. Tsɔ teƒe ɖeka ko le full stop kple colon megbe. Ɖe asi le nya siwo menye English o ŋu [Avoid non-English words] abe de facto alo ad hoc ene. Ɖe asi le Latin ƒe abidada siwo tsɔ nyaaŋlɔwo ƒe English nyagblɔɖiwo nɔ ŋu. Tsɔ esia Le esia ƒe teƒe ------------- ----------------- le kpɔɖeŋu me e.g. esiae nye i.e. Tweets Nɔnɔme ƒe fiafia sia le gbogbɔ me la nye be woaŋlɔ article alo zãla ƒe fiafia na ZecHub. Eƒe sewo wɔ dɔ na tweets kple nyagblɔɖi kpui bubuawo hã: na woanɔ kpui, tsɔ nu vevi wu ɖo ŋgɔ, eye mègatsɔ nuwuwu ƒe dzesi le fli kpuiwo me o. --- ZecHub ƒe nɔnɔme ƒe fiafia wotsɔe tso Microsoft Ŋlɔnu ƒe Nɔnɔme Ƒe Fiafia me eye wowɔ tɔtrɔwo le eŋu. Ɖe asi le Microsoft ƒe fiafia ŋu ne èhiãe.

text: ZecWeekly Nyadzɔdzɔgbalẽ [Newsletter] ZecWeekly nye nyadzɔdzɔgbalẽ si doa go every Sunday morning. Eme la, nyadzɔdzɔ siawo katã siwo dzɔ le kwasiɖa me le Zcash ecosystem la me. Hameviwo tia nyadzɔdzɔawo ɖe kwasiɖa sia kwasiɖa, eye wodzea kadodo siwo ƒo akpa le eme. Meɖe kuku be nàŋlɔ ŋkɔ ɖe nyadzɔdzɔgbalẽ la ŋu le afisia. Kpe ɖe eŋu Nyadzɔdzɔgbalẽ ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu wɔa dɔ nyuie ne ame ɖeka si ƒoa nu kpɔa ta la naŋlɔ tɔxɛ na kwasiɖa si dze o, wòto fiafi ƒe bounty alo hadede ƒe nuteƒe me, eye wòɖo pull request la ɖe asi le kwasiɖa me ƒe kadodowo vɔ megbe. Mègana edition si gbɔna o hafi ZecHub naɖo alo akaka ɣeyiɣi na edition ma. Pull request siwo va do ŋgɔ zi geɖe medzia nyadzɔdzɔ siwo va le kwasiɖa ƒe nuwuwu o, wotsɔa ɖe curator si woɖo xɔ se kplii o, alo wowɔa deadline si medze o. Kaka edition si le fifia Hafi nàdze ŋɔŋlɔ gɔme: Kpɔ ZEC Bounties be nàkpɔ nyadzɔdzɔgbalẽ ƒe dɔ si le fifia. Lala be woɖo wò. Nyadzɔdzɔgbalẽ ƒe editionwo le XS band me le bounty amounts policy me. ZEC ƒe nɔmba si le bounty si le agbe la ŋu nye esi woana, menye tanya kpa aɖeke si xoxo le contributing guides me o. Wɔ repository fork Ne èye yeye le GitHub la, zã mɔ sia: Ʋu ZecHub repository la. Zi Fork eye nàwɔ fork le wò GitHub account te. Le wò fork me la, wɔ branch yeye na edition la. Branch ƒe ŋkɔ si ƒe gɔmesese le nyuie, abe digest-may-30-2026 ene. title: MultiSig Demo
description: Historical. This walkthrough no longer runs.
text: MultiSig Demo Historical. This walkthrough no longer runs. Every step below depends on zcashd, which reached its automatic End-of-Support halt on 18 July 2026. The seven scripts shipped alongside this page drive it through zcash-cli, so none of them can reach a running node today. These scripts cannot be ported mechanically. They are built on the raw-transaction and wallet RPCs (createrawtransaction, signrawtransaction, createmultisig, dumpprivkey) that zcashd deprecated before the halt; Zallet replaces those with new methods that operate on PCZTs rather than raw transaction hex, and is still in beta with many zcashd methods not yet ported. For multi-party custody on Zcash today, see FROST & Threshold Custody, which includes a direct comparison with transparent multisig, and the Ywallet FROST demo. To move an existing node off zcashd, see the migration guide to Zebra and Zallet. This page is kept as a historical record of the transparent multisig workflow. This demo requires zcashd, which halted on 18 July 2026 and no longer runs. Nothing below can be completed against the live chain. Gather public keys from needed individuals https://github.com/iancoleman/bip39 If using zcashd, you can create a UA and use your transparent reciever as well. Then use getPubkey.sh to extract your public key. Create 2x Multisig (2 of 3) t3 addresses run createMultiSig.sh to generate your multisig address and redeem script. What's needed are 3 public keys ./createMultiSig.sh pubk1 pubk2 pubk3 # 1st t3 ./createMultiSig.sh pubk4 pubk5 pubk6 # 2nd t3 for the change address. NOTE: in this example pubk1,pubk4 are the same person, pubk2,pubk5 are the same person and so on ... NOTE2: the ORDER of your pubkeys matters! Pay attention to this!!!! Fund t3 address Use any wallet/facuet to fund address Create MultiSig transaction ./createMultiSigTX.sh txid voutIndex scriptPubKey redeemScript oldAmount tAddy amount changeTaddy where, ./txDetails.sh txid => will help you find the needed information Sign MultiSig TX Open signMultiSigTX.sh and add your private keys in the pk1,pk2, ... variables. I would not recommend typing these into your terminal. If you have access to all your private keys you can use them all at once to save time, but in most real world examples, the signing will be done via folks around the world so each of the required participants will need to sign, then send back the updated raxTX "hex" output which the others will use to sign to complete the signing proceedure. Who ever creates the first tx, will sign with their private key and send out the updated rawTX hex that needs to be signed by the other participants. ./signMultiSigTX.sh rawTX txid voutIndex scriptPubKey redeemScript valueInitialTX To sign this tx, at least 2 out of the three private keys need to sign it. If the public key you gave was exported using a T-address from zcashd, you can get the private key of your T address with: zcash-cli dumpprivkey "t-addr" This command halted with zcashd and returns nothing today; it is recorded here only to show how the demo obtained its keys. For this demo, I have used iancoleman's bip39 to quickly isolate the needed private keys. Broadcast signed TX ./sendMultiSignedTX.sh signedTXfromLastStep Sources https://learnmeabitcoin.com/technical/script/p2sh/ https://bitcoin.stackexchange.com/questions/6100/how-will-multisig-addresses-work https://zcash.github.io/rpc/

text: Workshop Day 3 Data Analytics The science of analyzing raw data using specialized systems, tools, and techniques to identify patterns, trends, and insights It involves: Zcash Encrypted electronic cash. The first cryptocurrency to develop zero-knowledge encryption for private peer-to-peer payments. note: If you want accurate data that you TRUST, it is recommended to run your own full node [zebrad]. You can setup the z3 infrastructure [ zebrad + zainod/lightwalletd + "wallet of choice here" ] if you want a complete and robust solution. You access the data using RPC's(Remote Procedure Calls) For a quick demostration of how this works, watch this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ok9Wa8FNbMA Workshop Demo This workshop will focus on collecting and transforming data from the wallet level. This level is where most folks will access the Zcash blockchain. Usecase ( Create a .csv file of all transactions for a given account in Zkool) This is a popular scenario where one would need to organize and optimize their digital personal finances. Step 1 Open Zkool and select the account you want to use note: We will be using a testnet wallet for this demo. note2: We are choosing Zkool here, but ANY wallet that has export functionality will work! https://github.com/hhanh00/zkool2 Step 2 Go to the top right menu and select "Export Transactions" Step 3 Download bash script we will use to transform our data. For Developers who are watching, I will be using bash which is standard in most Linux Distros, but you can use your language of choice. For non-devs or students getting your feet wet, use AI! Some example prompts that can get you started: "How can I use "bash/rust/python/ ... etc." to transform CSV files" note: You still need to understand the basics but running these workshops are how you understand the FLOW of the process. note2: AI is not usually private so be extra careful when using it as a student! Step 4 Setup scripts for use and run chmod +x cleanCSV.sh ./cleanCSV.sh "nameofexportBackup" Step 5 Use data Open in libreOffice or any CSV viewer for use!

title: Zero to Zero Knowledge: CryptoNote ƒe Protocol
description: CryptoNote protocol na ɣaɣla [privacy] sesẽ le ɖoɖonu dzi. Egbe míesrɔ̃ eƒe nɔnɔme veviwo katã kple ale si ɣaɣla ƒe dɔwɔwɔ xɔasi aɖewo wɔe la.
text: Zero to Zero Knowledge: CryptoNote ƒe Protocol Series: Zero to Zero Knowledge Eya nye nu dzadzɛ aɖe egbe! CryptoNote protocol na ɣaɣla [privacy] sesẽ le ɖoɖonu dzi. Egbe míesrɔ̃ eƒe nɔnɔme veviwo katã kple ale si ɣaɣla ƒe dɔwɔwɔ xɔasi aɖewo wɔe la. --- Gɔmedzedze Wodo CryptoNote ƒe nyadzɔdzɔ ƒe agbalẽ gbãtɔ ɖe go le ŋkɔ bubu "Nicolas van Saberhagen" te. Bytecoin nye crypto ga gbãtɔ si wɔ protocol la. Dɔwɔwɔ si amewo nya wu si zazãna egbe nye Monero (XMR). Wozãe hã le TurtleCoin, Aeon, kple bubuawo me. --- CryptoNote ƒe Nɔnɔme Veviwo CryptoNote Protocol na nɔnɔme vevi etɔ: Gaɖoɖowo ƒe makpɔkpɔ kple kadodo manɔ anyi [Unlinkability] Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɖaseɖigbalɛ [Proof of Work] si nye na amewo katã (ASIC mate ŋu tsi tre na o) Gaɖeɖe si trɔna --- Makpɔkpɔ - Ring ƒe Asidede Agbalẽ Te Wɔna be wo mate ŋu akpɔ afɔɖeɖe o vevie to Ring ƒe Asidede Agbalẽ Te [Ring Signatures] zazãme. Ne nèle gaɖoɖo aɖe ɖom la, woɖea wò key si ame katã ate ŋu akpɔ kple key bubu siwo nye alakpadawo ("ring") — wòwo katã me ga ƒe lolome ɖeka le. Esia wɔe be ezu vevie ŋutɔ be woanya ame kae dɔ gaawo le nyateƒe me. Ring ƒe lolome wɔ tɔtrɔ gã le ame siwo dometɔ woate ŋu anya la ƒe ha me. Ring gãwo na ɣaɣla nyuie. Tsatsamama kple Zcash: Zcash ƒe ame siwo dometɔ woate ŋu anya la ƒe ha nye gaɖoɖowo katã si woɖo kpɔ ɣe sia ɣe le ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo aɖe me (esi gã wu CryptoNote ring ƒe lolome si zɔna zi geɖe). --- Ring CT (Gaɖoɖowo siwo Ɣaɣla) Ring CT ƒe model na ɣaɣla ɖe CryptoNote ƒe gaawo me wu ale si wònɔ tsã. Esi wòɣla amedzɔla ko le tsã la teƒe, Ring CT hã ɣla ga siwo le amedzɔla kple ame si xɔe la dome ƒe lolome. Ezã: Elliptic Curve Cryptography Pedersen ƒe Adzɔgbeɖeɖe [Commitments] Homomorphic ƒe Ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ [Encryption] Woza ɖaseɖigbalɛwo [Proofs] be woafia be ga ƒe lolome la gã wu 0 eye wònɔ lolome siwo nyo me ke menye be woafia lolome vavãawo o. Stealth ƒe Gaɖoƒe ƒe Dzesiawo [Addresses] hã tsɔ gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi si zɔna ɣetrɔ ɖeka ko kpe ɖe ame si xɔe la ŋu. --- Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe Ɖaseɖigbalɛ si Nye na Amewo Katã (ePoW) CryptoNote di be yeawɔ nukuku [mining] ƒe ɖoɖo si nyo na amewo katã to ASICwo ƒe tsiteƒe ŋu. Ezã CryptoNight algorithm (dɔwɔwɔ si bia memory geɖe). To vovototo si le Bitcoin ƒe SHA256 kple CryptoNight dome la, woɖo CryptoNight be wòatsi tre na vovototo si le CPU, GPU, kple ASIC nukulawo dome. CryptoNight ƒe afɔwo: Dze memory ƒe teƒe gã aɖe (scratchpad) gɔme kple nyatakakawo siwo wɔna alea ko Wɔ xexlẽ kple ŋlɔŋlɔ ƒe dɔ geɖe le scratchpad la dzi Ɖe scratchpad la katã ƒe hash be nàkpɔ tɔxɛ mamlɛtɔ (Nyaɖeɖe: Monero tsi CryptoNight ŋu yi algorithm bubuwo gbɔ tso esime ma.) --- Gaɖeɖe Si Trɔna Le fetu ƒe afãmama [halving] ƒe nuwɔna kpuie siwo le (abe Bitcoin ene) teƒe la, CryptoNote zã gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ƒe fetu si ɖea ɖe eɖokui dzi vie vie. Esia wɔe be gaɖeɖe ƒe mɔnu la nɔ dzɔdzɔe wu le ɣeyiɣi me. Zcash ƒe Kadodo: Zcash ƒe mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖoŋlɔlawo do go be yewoawɔ gaɖeɖe ƒe mɔnu si dzɔdzɔe wu le etsɔme, ate ŋu atso "Zcash Posterity Fund" aɖe dzi. --- Nuƒoƒo CryptoNote ɖee fia be ye nye mɔnu sesẽ si woɖe to kpɔkpɔ me nyuie na ɣaɣla le ɖoɖonu dzi. Eƒe yenɔamedzi geɖewo kpɔ ŋusẽ le ɣaɣla coin ƒe nutome blibo la me. Dɔdɔlawo aɖewo xɔe se be CryptoNote ƒe nɔnɔmewo ate ŋu akplɔ kple zero-knowledge ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒowo siwo me wometsɔ ame aɖe ƒe dzidease wɔ dɔ o le etsɔme. --- Thread Gbãtɔ tso ZecHub (@ZecHub) https://x.com/ZecHub/status/1636473585781948416 --- Woxɔ axa sia ƒe nuwo tso Zero to Zero Knowledge ƒe thread gbãtɔ me na ZecHub wiki la.

title: Zero to Zero Knowledge: Hash ƒe dɔwɔnuwo [Hash Functions]
description: Woezɔ na mi le ƒeƒle yeye sia me: Zero to Zero Knowledge!
text: Zero to Zero Knowledge: Hash ƒe dɔwɔnuwo [Hash Functions] Ƒeƒle ƒe gɔmedzedze Woezɔ na mi le ƒeƒle yeye sia me: Zero to Zero Knowledge! Le ƒeƒle sia me la, míeasrɔ gɔmedzedzeƒe nyanya tso teknolojia vovovo geɖe siwo wozãna le míaƒe ɣaɣla ƒe protocolwo me ŋu. --- Akpa 1: Hash ƒe dɔwɔnuwo Egbe míedze egɔme kple Hash ƒe dɔwɔnuwo [Hash Functions] - cryptography ƒe akpa vevi aɖe si wozãna le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonuwo me. Le ƒeƒle sia me megbe la, míatsɔ nya aɖewo siwo ɖo wɔnɔwo ɖe eƒe nɔnɔwo ŋu aɖe. Nu kae nye Hash ƒe dɔwɔnu? Hash ƒe dɔwɔnuwo xɔ nu si ƒe didime ate ŋu anɔ aleke kee, eye wowɔ eme na nuɖeɖe si ƒe didime le ɖoɖo me. Mesedzi si woawɔ hash na = Nudzɔdzɔ Algorithm si wozãna = Hash ƒe dɔwɔnu Nuɖeɖe si do tso eme = Hash ƒe asixɔxɔ Wò ŋutɔ nàte ŋu ado eŋu! Mina míakpɔ egɔme kple asiɖeɖe le dɔwɔnu sia zãm! Ɖo nuŋlɔɖi ɖe eme aleke kee be nàkpɔ nuɖeɖe si ƒe didime le ɖoɖo me. Kpɔ ale si nuɖeɖe la trɔna ɖe hash wɔwɔ ƒe algorithm vovovowo nu. Do eŋu: https://cryptii.com/pipes/hash-function --- Cryptographic Hash ƒe dɔwɔnuwo ƒe nɔnɔwo Cryptographic Hash ƒe dɔwɔnuwo ele be woanɔ kple nɔnɔ 3 siawo: Mɔ ɖeka - Eŋu nɔa vevie be wòatrɔ hash ƒe dɔwɔnu aɖe ƒe dɔwɔwɔ megbe Woɖea woaƒe teƒe vovovo - Nudzɔdzɔ vovovo eve mate ŋu awɔ hash ɖe nuɖeɖe ma ke ŋu o Wɔwɔ si mele trɔtrɔ me o - Na nudzɔdzɔ ɖe sia ɖe, hash ƒe dɔwɔnu aɖe ana nuɖeɖe ma ke ɣe sia ɣe --- Hash ƒe dɔwɔnu siwo wozãna zi geɖe Hash ƒe dɔwɔnu ƒe ƒomevi geɖe li. Woƒe kpɔɖeŋu aɖewo nye: Secure Hashing Algorithm (SHA-3) Message Digest Algorithm 5 (MD5) BLAKE2b - Wozãna le Zcash ƒe kɔkɔe kplɔɖeɖe me Gɔmedzedze na BLAKE2: https://www.blake2.net --- Hash ƒe dɔwɔnuwo ƒe zãzã le xexeame Nyatakakawo ƒe blibonyenye hash wɔwɔ (Nyatakakawo ƒe blibonyenye ƒe kpekpeɖeŋuwo) Nyatakakawo ƒe blibonyenye ƒe kpekpeɖeŋuwo nye "Nyatakakawo ƒe blibonyenye hash wɔwɔ" ƒe kpɔɖeŋu aɖe. Wozãna wo be woawɔ checksumwo na nyatakaka ƒe faɛlwo, eye woana kakaɖedzi na ezãla aɖe be nuwo le ete ŋu. Merkle ƒe atiwo (Hash ƒe atiwo) Hash ƒe ati alo Merkle ƒe ati wɔe kple alɔ̃wo kple atiaƒe ƒe ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔwo, siwo dzi wode cryptographic hash na nyatakaka ƒe gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe aɖe. Merkle ƒe atiwo nye cryptographic adzɔgbeɖeɖe ƒe ɖoɖo ƒe kpɔɖeŋu aɖe. Wokpɔna ati la ƒe Root be enye adzɔgbeɖeɖe, eye wode ɖase be atiaƒe ƒe ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔwo le adzɔgbeɖeɖe gɔmedze la me. Wonɔa nyatakaka si wode ɖe P2P networkwo dzi alo si wotra la kpɔm, eye wonye be nyatakaka si tso wɔnɔviwo gbɔ va la metrɔ o. Didienu ƒe adzɔgbeɖeɖe ƒe ati le Zcash Le Zcash Sapling kple Orchard ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒowo me la, wozãna Didienu ƒe adzɔgbeɖeɖe ƒe ati be woakpɔ be gaɖoɖowo sɔ ɖe gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi nu, le esime woɣla dɔla, xɔla kple ga siwo wozã la ɖe bliboa. Asidede agbalẽ te ƒe hash (Bitcoin ƒe nɔnɔ nu gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒewo) SHA256 nye "Asidede agbalẽ te ƒe hash" ƒe kpɔɖeŋu aɖe si wozãna be gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe ɖe sia ɖe le Bitcoin ƒe ɖoɖonu me nanɔ ɖe etɔ̃ me. Nukulawo zãna gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe si va yi la ƒe hash + gaɖoɖowo katã ƒe hash le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe si li fifia me (hashMerkleRoot) + Ɣeyiɣi ƒe dzesi + xexlẽme si menye ɖoɖo me o / network ƒe sesẽ na gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe yeye. Equihash (Zcash Nukuku) Equihash nye hash wɔwɔ ƒe algorithm si wozãna le Zcash nukuku me. Wozãnae hã le networkwo abe Komodo kple Horizen ene me. Equihash: Asymmetric Proof-of-Work Based on the Generalized Birthday Problem (Biryukov kple Khovratovich): https://eprint.iacr.org/2015/946 --- Nuxexlẽ bubuwo Be nàgase Hash ƒe dɔwɔnu ƒe ƒomevi vovovoawo kple wɔnɔƒe zãzãwo nyuie wu la, esi nye nuƒoɖeŋu nyui aɖe: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hashfunction --- Kakaɖi tso ZecHub (@ZecHub) gbɔ X ƒe kakaɖi gɔmedze: https://x.com/ZecHub/status/1621240109663227906 --- Wotsɔ Zero to Zero Knowledge ƒe kakaɖi gɔmedze la wɔ axa sia na ZecHub wiki.

text: Zero to Zero Knowledge: Lelantus Protocol Ƒoƒo: Zero to Zero Knowledge Egbe míele Lelantus kpɔm! Wodo go le 2019 me, eye mɔɖa sia tso Zerocoin dzi. Wozãa esia le Firo ga ƒe ƒomea me (xoxo Zcoin) be woawɔ ɣaɣla [privacy] ɖoɖonu dzi [on-chain] gaɖoɖo [transaction]wo. Ele abe Zcash ene le mɔ aɖewo nu, gake wòto vovo le eƒe akpa geɖewo me. --- Zcash kple Firo Ƒe Mɔɖa Ƒe Gɔmeɖoƒewo Zcash - Wotu eƒe mɔɖa ɖe Zerocash dzi Firo (Zcoin) - Wotu eƒe mɔɖa ɖe Zerocoin dzi --- Firo Ƒe ɣaɣla Mɔɖawo ƒe Dzidzime Abe Zcash ene, Firo zãa ɣaɣla [shielded] gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi [address]wo be wòawɔ fexexe [payment] si me ame ƒe ŋkɔ menye. Woaɖe ga ƒe adzɔgbeɖeɖe la ɖe go eye wowɔa eƒe nudzraɖoƒe le ledger la dzi ne wowɔ ga la (to Mint alo Spend gaɖoɖowo me). --- Basecoin Zerocoin Ƒe Model Lelantus zãa basecoin zerocoin ƒe model xoxo la. title: Zero to Zero Knowledge: Nunya ƒe Gadzraɖoɖi Nyawo
description: Nunya ƒe gadzraɖoɖi nyawo [Mnemonic seed phrases] doa alɔ na cryptocurrency ƒe akpa vevi aɖe — ɖokui ƒe asikplɔwɔwɔ [self-custody].
text: Zero to Zero Knowledge: Nunya ƒe Gadzraɖoɖi Nyawo Series: Zero to Zero Knowledge Nunya ƒe gadzraɖoɖi nyawo [Mnemonic seed phrases] doa alɔ na cryptocurrency ƒe akpa vevi aɖe — ɖokui ƒe asikplɔwɔwɔ [self-custody]. Egbe míesrɔ ale si wogbea gadzraɖoɖi nya ɖe eme eye wozae le gakotoku [wallet]wo me. --- Nukae Nye Nunya ƒe Gadzraɖoɖi Nyawo? Wode gagbɔɖoɖi nyawo [Recovery phrases] ƒe gɔme le BIP-39 ƒe ɖoɖowɔwɔ nu, si nye gagbɔɖoɖi nya ƒome si wozã wu egbe. Gagbɔɖoɖi nyawo ƒe wɔwɔ dzea egɔme kple dzodzro [randomness] ƒe dzidzenu. Entropy geɖe fia dedienyenye geɖe. Wobu be 128 bits ƒe entropy de na zãlawo ƒe akpa gãtɔ. Le entropy gɔmedzeƒe ƒe didime nu la, gagbɔɖoɖi nya la anɔ nya 12 va se ɖe 24 ƒe didime. --- Ɖoɖoɖo Kple Ɖoɖoɖo: Ale Si Wogbea Nya 12 ƒe Gadzraɖoɖi Nya Gbe Entropy Míedzea egɔme kple entropy 128 bits ƒe gbegbe. Tsɔ Checksum Kpee Míetsɔ SHA256 hea entropy la. Hash sia ƒe bits gbãtɔ aɖewo zu checksum la. Esia na dzesi si nye tɔxɛ na míawo ƒe entropy. Ma Ƒe Akpa 11-bitwo Bits 132 blibo la (entropy 128 kple checksum 4) mae ɖe akpa 11 bits ƒe akpa-akpa me. Ɖe Nya Ƒe Ƒomea Ɖo 11-bit ƒe ƒoƒo siawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe trɔna zu decimal xexlẽme (0-2047). BIP-39 ƒe nya ƒomeawo me nya 2048 koe le tututu (English, Spanish, Chinese, kple bubuawo). Wozã xexlẽme siawo be woakpɔ nya si sɔ kple wo le nya ƒomea me. Nɔnɔmetata: Fifia míexɔ gagbɔɖoɖi nya 12 si wɔ dzodzro eye amegbetɔ ate ŋu axlẽ! --- Tso Gagbɔɖoɖi Nya Me -> Seed -> Fexexe ƒe Gaɖoƒe Ƒe Dzesiawo Kple gagbɔɖoɖi nya la, gakotoku atee agbe safuiwo be woawɔ fexexe [payment] ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo [addresses] kple gakotoku ƒe akonta vovovowo. Safui siwo wogbe la nye deterministic — gbedodonu ma ke ɣeaɣi kpɔa dzenu ma ke. Seed Ƒe Gbebetata Wokpɔ gakotoku ƒe seed la tso nunya ƒe nya la me kple Key Derivation Function (KDF): Le Bitcoin me: PBKDF2 Le Zcash me: Blake2b-256/512 Esia doa 64-byte (512-bit) ƒe seed. Afi Ƒe Safuiwo Womaa seed la ɖe 32-byte ƒe ƒoƒo eve me: Afi Ƒe Gazazãsafui [Master Spending Key] Afi Ƒe Ɖoɖonu ƒe Kode [Master Chain Code] Wozã esiawo le Hierarchical Deterministic (HD) Wallets me be woakpɔ vi safuiwo. --- Zcash Ƒe Tɔxɛwo (ZIP-32) Le Zcash me la, woate ŋu ade nukpɔsafui [viewing] ƒe mɔɖeɖe alo gazazãsafui [spending] ƒe mɔɖeɖe ɖe asi ɖeɖe na ati ƒe akpa suewo me tɔwo, eye esia magblẽ afi ƒe seed la o. ZIP-32 ɖe hierarchical deterministic safui ƒe gbebetata ƒe ɖoɖowɔwɔ si wotrɔ be wanasɔ kple Zcash ƒe ɣaɣla [privacy] ƒe tɔxɛwo gɔme. Tso Expanded Spending Key me la, míekpɔ: Full Viewing Key Incoming Viewing Key Fexexe ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo ƒe ƒoƒo Safui ƒe gbebetata ƒome vovovowo wɔa gota ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo siwo dze be woana na dɔlilawo le ɣaɣla [shielded] ƒe gaƒuƒoƒo [pools]wo katã me (Sapling kple Orchard). Zcash hã dea emexɔ ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo alɔ na gakotoku ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo abe Auto-Shielding ene. --- Nuƒoƒowo ZIP-32: Ɣaɣla ƒe Hierarchical Deterministic Gakotokuwo Zcash Protocol Ƒe Ɖoɖowɔwɔ (NU5) Ɣaɣla-le-gɔmedze me gakotokuwo ƒe nukpɔkpɔ --- Ɖeɖefɔ ƒe Dzetugbe Tso ZecHub (@ZecHub) Gbɔ https://x.com/ZecHub/status/1624125037945946145 --- Wotsɔ ɖeɖefɔ ƒe Zero to Zero Knowledge dzetugbe la ƒe nya wɔ axa sia na ZecHub wiki la.

title: PGP na Crypto Podcast
description: Woezɔ na “PGP (Pretty Good Policy) na Crypto Podcast," si nye Electric Coin Co ƒe dɔwɔwɔ aɖe.!
text: PGP na Crypto Podcast Woezɔ na “PGP (Pretty Good Policy) na Crypto Podcast," si nye Electric Coin Co ƒe dɔwɔwɔ aɖe.! Miele gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu [blockchain] ƒe mɔ̃nu, dukɔmevi ƒe politika, kple xexeame sewo ƒe nyawo ƒe nuto. Míaƒe taɖodzinu nye be míana nunya sesẽ kple amedzrowo ƒe nyagblɔɖiwo míaƒe toviwo tso nya vevi siwo le gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu kple cryptocurrency ƒe etsɔme ŋgɔ ƒe mɔnukpɔkpɔme. Àse dɔwɔƒe la ƒe dzikpɔlawo, dukɔƒe dɔwɔlawo, kple sukɔlawo ƒe nyamedzodzro siwo le ŋgɔ na dukɔmevi ƒe politika ƒe nɔnɔme si le blockchain technology ŋu wɔwɔ me. Míaƒe amedzroawo ama woƒe ŋutilã ƒe nukpɔkpɔ vovovo tso kuxiwo kple mɔnuwo siwo le dɔwɔƒe la ŋgɔ, eye tso ale si fifia sewo, se siwo wole bɔbɔm, kple politika ƒe mɔnuwo wɔa dɔ ɖe blockchain ƒe nɔnɔme ƒe tsitsi kple ŋgɔyiyi ŋu. title: Zero to Zero Knowledge: Woate Ŋu Ɖe Dɔwɔƒewo (TEEs)
description: Zero to Zero Knowledge trɔ gbɔ kple nya yeye!
text: Zero to Zero Knowledge: Woate Ŋu Ɖe Dɔwɔƒewo (TEEs) Series: Zero to Zero Knowledge Zero to Zero Knowledge trɔ gbɔ kple nya yeye! Kɔsiɖa sia me míele Woate Ŋu Ɖe Dɔwɔƒewo (TEEs) dzrom - ale si woazã wo le ɣaɣla gaɖeawo kple gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ɖoɖonu [blockchain] ƒe dɔwɔwɔ bubuwo me. --- TEEs kple Gaɖoɖowo Ƒuƒoƒowo: Nɔnɔme Siwo Ɖo Ŋu Ɖe Ŋunye Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒowo kple TEEs ƒe ŋusẽwo ƒo ɖe wo nɔewo ŋu ŋutɔ: Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒowo doa ŋugbe be nuwo anɔ anyi, nɔnɔme nanɔ yi, eye wòate ŋu akpɔ nɔnɔme blibo la katã ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu le amewo katã ŋkume - ke woƒe akɔnta ƒe ŋusẽ megbɔ o. TEEs ate ŋu awɔ akɔnta ƒe dɔ sesẽwo le ɣaɣla me - ke nɔnɔme si anɔ yi le wo me le dzidzime o. Ne woƒo ƒu la, woate ŋu awɔ ɣaɣla-sesĩe ƒe ɖoɖowo siwo ƒe ŋusẽ le ŋutɔ. --- Secret Network: TEE-Ɖe Ŋusẽ Na Ɣaɣla Secret Network zã TEE mɔ̃ (vevie Intel SGX) be wòawɔ akɔnta le nu siwo woŋlɔ ɣaɣla kple ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ [encryption] me, nu siwo doa go, kple nɔnɔme ŋu. Validator ɣaɣla dzesi ŋɔŋlɔ [node] sia sia wɔa dɔ kple Intel SGX chips. Woƒo gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi [consensus] kple akɔnta ƒe papa ɖeka: Woaɖe gaɖoɖowo [transactions] le enclave siwo le dedie me. Woaɖe ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ le TEE me ko. Esia to vovo na Zcash, si zã zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛwo [proofs] na ɣaɣla. Le Zcash me la, woɖea ɣaɣla gaɖoɖowo ɖe go eye wole kpekpeɖeŋu wɔm le amewo katã ŋkume, eye data bubu aɖeke meɖea fia network la o. Zcash Shielded Assets wɔa ɖe gɔme sia ke dzi. Ne nàdi be yeanya ale si woawɔ TEEs le Secret Network dzi ƒe numeɖeɖe blibo la, xlẽ nyatakaka nyui sia si @lwoetzel ŋlɔ: https://carter-woetzel.medium.com/secret-network-tees-lets-talk-fud-vulnerability-33ca94b6df38 --- Ale Si Secret Network Lea Keys Kple Nɔnɔme Ɖe Asi Network la ƒe gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi ƒe ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ ƒe nuku le validator sia sia ƒe TEE me. Mɔ̃ŋlɔ ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo [smart contracts] zã ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ ƒe keys tɔxɛ siwo meate ŋu woakpɔe o. Secret contracts wɔa dɔ le Cosmos SDK compute module dzi, ke woɖoa alɔ na nu siwo woŋlɔ ɣaɣla kple nu siwo doa go, kple nɔnɔme. --- Remote Attestation Remote Attestation nye ɖeɖeɖase be enclave a le dɔ wɔm le hardware ƒe dedie teƒe vavã me. Ena mɔ na ame si le didime be wòakpɔe be: Dɔwɔwɔ nyuitɔe la le dɔ wɔm Meɖe asi le dɔwɔwɔ la ŋu o Ele dɔ wɔm le dedie me le Intel SGX enclave me Enclaves hã le signing kple attestation keys siwo nye ame ŋutɔ tɔ, siwo meate ŋu woakpɔ wo tso gota o. --- Data Sealing Elabena enclaves menye nɔnɔme ƒe nuwo o la, zi aɖewo woate ŋu aɖo data ɖe memori si mewɔ ŋu se o me. Data Sealing zã key si tso CPU me va la na data ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ le enclave me. Gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒe [block] si woŋlɔ ɣaɣla la ate ŋu aɖe ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ la le ɖoɖo ma ke dzi ko. --- Oasis Network Oasis Network hã zã TEEs to eƒe confidential ParaTime (kpɔɖeŋu, Sapphire kple Cipher) me. Data si woŋlɔ ɣaɣla kple mɔ̃ŋlɔ ƒe dɔwɔwɔ la ge ɖe TEE me. Woaɖe ɣaɣlaŋlɔŋlɔ na data la, woawɔ dɔ kple e, eye woaŋlɔe ɣaɣla ake hafi wòado go tso enclave me. --- TEEs Le Proof-of-Stake Networks Me Proof-of-Stake gaɖoɖowo ƒuƒoƒowo geɖe (siwo katã Secret kple Oasis hã le) zã Tendermint abe woƒe gbegbɔgblɔ ɖi ƒe ɖoɖo ene. Na PoS validators: Ele be woakpɔ keys le dedie me eye woaɖe wo fia le plaintext me gbeɖe o. Ele be validators anɔ online (woaɖe fe na wo ne woɖe mɔ). Ne ame dea asi le mesajewo siwo ƒo tsiam na nɔewo ŋu la, wòate ŋu akplɔ ame ɖe slashing me. TEEs dze egbe na validator keys ƒe wɔwɔ kple zãzã le dedie me. --- Zcash Kple Proof-of-Stake Ƒe Nudzodzro Zcash le nudzodzro wɔm vevi tso ale si wòava yi ɖe Proof-of-Stake ŋu. Xlẽ nudzodzro la: https://electriccoin.co/blog/zcash-proof-of-stake-research/ Kpɔ akpa sia le Zcash Foundation Community Call me si me woɖe PoS ƒe ɖoɖo vovovowo kple woƒe ɣaɣla ƒe nɔnɔmewo me: --- Thread Gbãtɔ si ZecHub (@ZecHub) ŋlɔ https://x.com/ZecHub/status/1633579659282587651 --- Woxɔ axa sia ƒe nuwo tso Zero to Zero Knowledge ƒe thread gbãtɔ me na ZecHub wiki.

title: Zero to Zero Knowledge: Nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi [Transparent] kple Ɣaɣla [Shielded] Gaɖoɖowo & Ɖekae Ƒe Gaɖoƒe ƒe…
description: Ne èle Zcash srɔm zi gbã la, àkpɔ be gaɖoɖo ƒomevi eve le mɔ: Nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi kple Ɣaɣla.
text: Zero to Zero Knowledge: Nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi [Transparent] kple Ɣaɣla [Shielded] Gaɖoɖowo & Ɖekae Ƒe Gaɖoƒe ƒe Dzesiewo Xexlẽme: Zero to Zero Knowledge Ne èle Zcash srɔm zi gbã la, àkpɔ be gaɖoɖo ƒomevi eve le mɔ: Nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi kple Ɣaɣla. Egbe míele wo srɔm eye míakpɔ ŋkeke yeye ƒe nɔnɔwo dometɔ ɖeka si le #Zcash ƒe nutome la me, Ɖekae Ƒe Gaɖoƒe ƒe Dzesiewo. --- Nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi kple Ɣaɣla Gaɖoɖowo Nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi Gaɖoɖowo zã t-gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiewo (Base58 meŋlɔŋlɔ). Ame sia ame ate ŋu akpɔ nuwo katã kple dɔmeɖeɖe, abe Bitcoin ene. Ɣaɣla Gaɖoɖowo zã gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiewo si woŋlɔ na Sapling alo Orchard gaƒuƒoƒowo. Esia ɣla dzɔla, xɔla, kple gaƒeƒe to zero-knowledge ɖaseɖigbalɛwo me. Ɣaɣla Gaɖoɖo fia gaɖoɖo siawo katã si zã gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiewo si woŋlɔ na Sapling/Orchard gaƒuƒoƒowo. Ɖekae Ƒe Gaɖoƒe ƒe Dzesiewo (UAs) wowɔ wo be woaɖe kpleɖe ɣaɣla alo nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi gaɖoɖowo ɖe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ɖeka me. --- Gaɖoƒe Ƒe Dzesi Ƒomeviwo le Zcash Gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ƒomevi etɔe le zazãm: (T) Nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi – Base58 (Z) Sapling – Bech32 (UA) Ɖekae Ƒe Gaɖoƒe ƒe Dzesi – Bech32m Agbalẽdzesiwo ƒe xexlẽme (eye eya ta QR code ƒe lolome) gɔme ɖe edzi kple ƒomevi siawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe. --- Ale Si Ɖekae Ƒe Gaɖoƒe Ƒe Dzesiewo Wɔ Dɔe Woŋlɔ gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiewo kple kɔkɔewo abe byte ƒe woƒe mɔnu ( Raw Encoding ) ene. Receiver Encoding me la, nyatakaka si hiã katã le be woatrɔ asset ɖeka to protocol aɖe me. Ɖekae Ƒe Gaɖoƒe ƒe Dzesi ƒe raw encoding nye receiverwo ƒe encodingwo (typecode, didime, addr) ƒe ƒoƒo: UA: 0x03 Sapling: 0x02 Nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi: 0x01 Nu si le vevie: Ɣaɣla fexexe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi atɔ ɖeka koŋ hĩ le UA ɖe sia ɖe me. (Sprout gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiewo menye nu si wowɔa dɔe le Canopy ƒe upgrade megbe o.) Ɖeɖeɖe bliboa: ZIP-316: Ɖekae Ƒe Gaɖoƒe Ƒe Dzesiewo --- Ɖekae Ƒe Gaɖoƒe Ƒe Dzesiewo Ƒe Viɖeawo Ewɔe bɔbɔe na gatrɔƒewo - Fifia woate ŋu ado ɣaɣla gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo me kple woadoe go le mɔ dedie wu. Eŋu akpɔ etsɔme - Woate ŋu atsɔ ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo yeyewo akpe ɖe eŋu ne gakotokuwo manɔ gbãm o. Ɣaɣla le gɔmedzedze - UA ɖe sia ɖe me la, ɣaɣla gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi atɔ ɖeka koŋ le, eyata ɣaɣla nɔa mɔ sia mɔ. Esia nye tɔtrɔ gã aɖe si le kpeɖe ŋu xoxo be ZEC geɖe naava ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒo me. --- Orchard Gaɖoɖowo & Wɔwɔwo Orchard tsɔ susu yeye aɖe vɛ si woyɔna be Wɔwɔwo: Wowɔe be metadata ƒe lele le ŋgɔ ŋu nade ɖe egbɔ to anchor ɖeka zazã na Wɔwɔwo katã le gaɖoɖo ɖeka me. Woƒoa (V4) Spend + Output ƒe fieldwo katã ɖe value commitment ɖeka me. Esia na Halo2 ɖaseɖigbalɛ ƒe system la ŋuɖoɖo ƒe tɔtrɔwo nava anyi. Daira ɖe Anchor ƒe nɔƒewo ƒe gɔme me (zcon3): --- Asixɔxɔ ƒe Balance & Ɣaɣla Le nyateƒe aɖewo me (abe gaƒuƒoƒo vovovowo dome gaɖoɖowo ene), ame si mele gota la ate ŋu akpɔ gaƒeƒewo. Ke hã, valueBalanceSapling kple valueBalanceOrchard zã homomorphic adzɔgbeɖeɖewo be woaɖe ZEC ƒe katã le ɣaɣla gaƒuƒoƒowo me afi, eye woaxe mɔ na asixɔxɔ ƒe alakpanu. Xlẽ nu geɖe: ZIP 209: Mègana Chain Value Pool Balances Siwo Doa Dzidzɔ Tso Range Me O --- Ɣeyiɣi Si Gbɔna Ƒe Ɖeɖeɖewo ECC ƒe team la le RPC mɔnu yeye aɖewo wɔm le zcashd me (si ɖe zsendmany teƒe) si ana be zãlawo nakpɔ gaɖoɖo si wodo ɖaɖa daɖi, eye woaxɔe alo woagbe edzi le eƒe ɣaɣla ƒe nɔnɔwo nu. --- Aɖaŋu Thread sia tsɔ gbãna ame ɖe YWallet ŋu, le gaɖoɖo ƒe ɖoɖo si wòkpɔ hafi nàdzi send la ta. YWallet menɔa dɔ wɔm o azɔ eye woamaɖe eƒe version yeyee na Ironwood o, eyata mate ŋu adze ɖoɖonu la yome o. Tia gakotoku si wole dɔ wɔm ɖe eŋu tso Gakotokuwɔwo ƒe axa dzi ɖe teƒe, eye nàfia tɔ si aɖe nu si gaɖoɖo la aɖe fia hafi woadzoe. Article nyui aɖe ku ɖe gaɖoɖo ƒe ɣaɣla ŋu: https://medium.com/@hanh.huynh/ --- Thread Gbãtɔ Tso ZecHub (@ZecHub) https://x.com/ZecHub/status/1628498645627666432 --- Woƒo axa sia nu tso Zero to Zero Knowledge ƒe thread gbãtɔ me na ZecHub ƒe wiki.

title: Zero to Zero Knowledge
description: Nudzodzro ŋkekevi aɖe tso susuwo si le asigbalẽ ga si ɣaɣla le megbe. Dze egɔme tso etɔgbi.
text: Zero to Zero Knowledge Nudzodzro ŋkekevi aɖe tso susuwo si le asigbalẽ ga si ɣaɣla le megbe. Dze egɔme tso etɔgbi. # Tanyigba Nusi wòasrɔ --- ------- --------------------- 1 Hash ƒe dɔwɔnu Nusi ɖe sia ɖe si wòna la zu emetsonu si ƒe didime menoa vɔvɔ o. Nɔnɔme atọ si hash aɖe nakpɔ. 2 Gadzraɖoɖi nya Ale si nyaƒiɖa aɖe zu keywo siwo le wòga ɖo. 3 Zcash Gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi Nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi kple ɣaɣla gaɖoɖowo, kple Unified Addresses. 4 Dɔwɔƒe si wòka ɖe dziɣa me Mɔ̃ si dzɔdzɔ le ɣaɣla me kple afi si wòmesɔ o. 5 Cryptonote Mɔnu si le Monero ƒe ɣaɣla ƒe megbe, kple ale si wòto vovo na Zcash. 6 Lelantus Protocol si le Firo ƒe megbe, kple ale si wòtsɔe sɔ kple Zcash. Gbãtɔ ƒe nyadzɔdzɔwo Woƒo nu sia nu tso Zero to Zero Knowledge ƒe nyadzɔdzɔwo le X dzi. Hash ƒe dɔwɔnu Gadzraɖoɖi nya Zcash Gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi Dɔwɔƒe si wòka ɖe dziɣa me Cryptonote Lelantus
